children.text: Chapter 1
oṃ mahan me voco bhargo me voco yaśo me vocaḥ stomaṃ me voco bhuktiṃ me vocaḥ sarvaṃ me vocas tan māvatu tan māviśatu tena bhukṣiṣīya
children.translated_text: Om. Speak greatness for me; speak splendor for me; speak fame for me; speak the <s>stoma</s> (hymn of praise) for me; speak enjoyment for me; speak everything for me. May that protect me; may that enter me; by that may I enjoy.

children.text: devo devam etu somaḥ somam etv ṛtasya pathā
children.translated_text: Let the god go to the god; let <s>Soma</s> go to <s>Soma</s> by the path of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order).

children.text: vihāya dauṣkṛtyam
children.translated_text: Having abandoned evil-doing.

children.text: badvā nāmasi sṛtiḥ somasaraṇī somaṃ gameyam
children.translated_text: You are by name <s>Badvā</s>, the course, the path of <s>Soma</s>; may I go to <s>Soma</s>.

children.text: pitaro bhūḥ pitaro bhūḥ pitaro bhūḥ
children.translated_text: O Fathers, be present; O Fathers, be present; O Fathers, be present.

children.text: nṛmaṇa ūrdhvabharasaṃ tvordhvabharā dṛśeyam
children.translated_text: O man-minded one, may I see you as the upward-bearing one, through the upward bearers.

children.text: mṛdā śithirā devānāṃ tīrthaṃ vedir asi mā mā hiṃsīḥ
children.translated_text: O soft one, O loosened one, you are the gods' ford, the altar; do not harm me.

children.text: viṣṇoḥ śiro 'si yaśodhā yaśo mayi dhehi
children.translated_text: You are the head of <s>Viṣṇu</s>, bestower of fame; place fame in me.

children.text: iṣa ūrja āyuṣe varcase ca ||
children.translated_text: For refreshment, strength, life, and brilliance.

children.text: yunajmi te pṛthivīm agninā saha yunajmi vācaṃ saha sūryeṇa yukto vāto 'ntarikṣeṇa te saha yuktās tisro vimṛjaḥ sūryasya
children.translated_text: I yoke your earth together with <s>Agni</s>; I yoke speech together with <s>Sūrya</s>. The wind is yoked together with your midspace; yoked are the three cleansers of the sun.

children.text: ṛtasya sadane sīdāmi
children.translated_text: I sit down in the seat of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order).

children.text: ṛtapātram asi
children.translated_text: You are the vessel of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order).

children.text: vānaspatyo 'si bārhaspatyo 'si prājāpatyo 'si prajāpater mūrdhāsy atyāyupātram asīdam ahaṃ māṃ prāñcaṃ prohāmi tejase brahmavarcasāya
children.translated_text: You are wooden; you belong to <s>Bṛhaspati</s>; you belong to <s>Prajāpati</s>; you are the head of <s>Prajāpati</s>; you are the vessel of surpassing life. Here I set myself forward, facing east, for energy and for <s>brahmavarcas</s> (priestly brilliance).

children.text: maruto napāto 'pāṃ kṣayāḥ parvatānāṃ kakubhaḥ śyenā ajirā endraṃ vagnunā vahata ghoṣeṇāmīvāṃ cātayadhvaṃ yuktāstha vahata
children.translated_text: O offspring of the <s>Maruts</s>, abodes of the waters, peaks of the mountains, swift hawks, carry <s>Indra</s> with your cry; drive away disease with your sound. You are yoked: carry him.

children.text: idam aham amuṃ yajamānaṃ paśuṣv adhy ūhāmi paśuṣu ca māṃ brahmavarcase ca
children.translated_text: Here I lift up this sacrificer among the cattle, and I lift up myself among cattle and in <s>brahmavarcas</s> (priestly brilliance).

children.text: vasavas tvā gāyatreṇa chandasā saṃmṛjantu rudrās tvā traiṣṭubhena chandasā saṃmṛjantv ādityās tvā jāgatena chandasā saṃmṛjantu
children.translated_text: May the <s>Vasus</s> cleanse you with the <s>Gāyatra</s> meter; may the <s>Rudras</s> cleanse you with the <s>Triṣṭubh</s> meter; may the <s>Ādityas</s> cleanse you with the <s>Jagatī</s> meter.

children.text: pavitraṃ te vitataṃ brahmaṇaspate prabhur gātrāṇi paryeṣi viśvato 'taptatanūr na tad āmo aśnute śṛtāsa id vahantaḥ saṃ tad āśataḥ
children.translated_text: Your purifier is stretched out, O <s>Brahmaṇaspati</s>; as a master you pass around the limbs on every side. The unheated, raw body does not reach that; only the cooked ones, bearing it, attain it together.

children.text: praśukraitu devīmanīṣāsmad rathaḥ sutaṣṭo na vājy āyuṣe me pacasva varcase me pavasva viduḥ pṛthivyā divo janitrācchṛṇvantv āpo 'dhaḥ kṣarantīḥ somehodgāya mām āyuṣe mama brahmavarcasāya yajamānasyarddhyā amuṣya rājyāya ||
children.translated_text: Let the bright divine insight go forth from us like a well-fashioned racing chariot. Ripen for my life; flow for my brilliance. Let the waters, flowing downward from the birthplace of earth and heaven, hear. At the <s>Soma</s>, sing me upward for my life, for my <s>brahmavarcas</s> (priestly brilliance), for the sacrificer's prosperity, and for the kingship of so-and-so.

children.text: vekurānāmāsi juṣṭā devebhyo namo vāce namo vācaspataye devi vāg yat te vāco madhumat tasmin mā hāḥ sarasvatyai svāhā
children.translated_text: You are by name <s>Vekura</s>, pleasing to the gods. Homage to speech; homage to the lord of speech. O goddess Speech, whatever sweetness of speech is yours, do not leave me in regard to that. Svāhā to <s>Sarasvatī</s>.

children.text: sūryo mā divyābhyo nāṣṭrābhyaḥ pātu vāyur antarikṣābhyo 'gniḥ pārthivābhyaḥ svāhā
children.translated_text: May <s>Sūrya</s> protect me from the heavenly destroyers, <s>Vāyu</s> from those of the midspace, and <s>Agni</s> from the earthly ones. Svāhā.

children.text: yo 'dya saumyo vadho 'ghāyūnām udīrate viṣūkuhasya dhanvanāpa tān varuṇo 'padhamatu
children.translated_text: Whatever <s>Soma</s>-weapon of the evil-minded is raised today from the bow of <s>Viṣūkuha</s>, may <s>Varuṇa</s> drive those away and down.

children.text: yo ma ātmā yā me prajā ye me paśavas tair ahaṃ mano vācaṃ prasīdāmi
children.translated_text: With that self of mine, that offspring of mine, and those cattle of mine, I make mind and speech gracious.

children.text: agnes tejasendrasyendriyeṇa sūryasya varcasā bṛhaspatis tvā yunaktu devebhyaḥ prāṇāyāgnir yunaktu tapasā somaṃ yajñāya voḍhave dadhātv indra indriyaṃ satyāḥ kāmā yajamānasya santu
children.translated_text: With the heat of <s>Agni</s>, with the power of <s>Indra</s>, and with the brilliance of <s>Sūrya</s>, may <s>Bṛhaspati</s> yoke you to the gods. May <s>Agni</s>, through austerity, yoke <s>Soma</s> for breath and set him to carry the sacrifice; may <s>Indra</s> set strength in place. May the sacrificer's true desires come to pass.

children.text: annaṃ kariṣyāmy annaṃ praviṣyāmy annaṃ janayiṣyāmi
children.translated_text: I shall make food; I shall enter food; I shall generate food.

children.text: annam akaram annam abhūd annam ajījanam
children.translated_text: I made food; food came into being; I generated food.

children.text: śyeno 'si gāyatracchandā anu tvā rabhe svasti mā saṃ pārayā mā stotrasya stotraṃ gamyād indravanto vanemahi bhakṣīmahi prajām iṣam
children.translated_text: You are a hawk, of the <s>Gāyatra</s> meter; I take hold after you. Carry me safely across. May the chant reach the chant. Possessed of <s>Indra</s>, may we win; may we enjoy offspring and refreshment.

children.text: saṃ varcasā payasā saṃ tapobhir aganmahi manasā saṃ śivena saṃ vijñānena manasaś ca satyair yathā vo 'haṃ cārutamaṃ vadānīndro vo dṛśe bhūyāsaṃ sūryaś cakṣuṣe vātaḥ prāṇāya somo gandhāya brahma kṣatrāya
children.translated_text: Together with brilliance, with milk, and with austerities we have come; together with auspicious mind, with knowledge, and with the truths of the mind. As I may speak what is most pleasing to you, may I become <s>Indra</s> for your sight, <s>Sūrya</s> for your eye, <s>Vāta</s> for breath, <s>Soma</s> for smell, and <s>Brahman</s> for royal power.

children.text: namo gandharvāya viṣvagvādine varcodhā asi varco mayi dhehi ||
children.translated_text: Homage to the <s>Gandharva</s> <s>Viṣvagvādin</s>. You are the bearer of brilliance; place brilliance in me.

children.text: adhvanām adhvapate svasti me 'dyāsmin devayāne pathi bhūyāt
children.translated_text: O lord of the paths among the roads, may there be welfare for me today on this god-traveled path.

children.text: samrāḍ asi kṛśānuḥ
children.translated_text: You are the sovereign, <s>Kṛśānu</s>.

children.text: tutho 'si janadhāyo nabho 'si pratakvāsaṃmṛṣṭo 'si havyasūdanaḥ
children.translated_text: You are <s>Tutha</s>, support of people; you are the sky; you are swift; you are cleansed; you are the consumer of oblations.

children.text: vibhur asi pravāhaṇaḥ
children.translated_text: You are <s>Vibhu</s>, the forward carrier.

children.text: vahnir asi havyavāhanaḥ
children.translated_text: You are <s>Vahni</s>, the carrier of oblations.

children.text: śvātro 'si pracetāḥ
children.translated_text: You are <s>Śvātra</s>, the discerning one.

children.text: tutho 'si viśvavedā uśig asi kavir aṅghārir asi bambhārir avasyur asi duvasvān
children.translated_text: You are <s>Tutha</s>, all-knowing; you are <s>Uśij</s>, the seer; you are <s>Aṅghāri</s>; you are <s>Bambhāri</s>; you are <s>Avasyu</s>; you are <s>Duvasvān</s>.

children.text: śundhyur asi mārjālīyaḥ
children.translated_text: You are <s>Śundhyu</s>, the <s>Mārjālīya</s>.

children.text: ṛtadhāmāsi svarjyotiḥ
children.translated_text: You are the abode of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order), the light of heaven.

children.text: samudro 'si viśvavyacāḥ
children.translated_text: You are the ocean, all-expansive.

children.text: ahir asi budhnyaḥ
children.translated_text: You are <s>Ahi Budhnya</s>.

children.text: ajo 'sy ekapāt
children.translated_text: You are <s>Aja Ekapād</s>.

children.text: sagarā asi budhnyaḥ
children.translated_text: You are the oceans, belonging to the depth.

children.text: kavyo 'si kavyavāhanaḥ
children.translated_text: You are <s>Kāvya</s>, carrier of the ancestral offerings.

children.text: pāta māgnayo raudreṇānīkena piṣṭata mā namo vo 'stu mā mā hiṃsiṣṭa ||
children.translated_text: Protect me, O fires, with your Rudra-like front; do not crush me. Homage to you; do not harm me.

children.text: ṛtasya dvārau stho mā mā saṃtāptam
children.translated_text: You two are the doors of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order); do not scorch me.

children.text: namaḥ sakhibhyaḥ pūrvasadbhyo namaḥ parasadbhyaḥ
children.translated_text: Homage to the companions seated before; homage to those seated after.

children.text: śyeno nṛcakṣā agneṣṭvā cakṣuṣāva paśyāmi
children.translated_text: As a hawk seeing men, I look down upon you with the eye of <s>Agni</s>.

children.text: indavindrapītasya ta indriyāvato gāyatracchandasaḥ sarvagaṇasya sarvagaṇa upahūta upahūtasya bhakṣayāmi
children.translated_text: O drop, of you who have been drunk by <s>Indra</s>, endowed with <s>Indra</s>'s power, of the <s>Gāyatra</s> meter and belonging to the whole troop, I, called by the whole troop, consume the invited one.

children.text: ūrdhvaḥ sapta ṛṣīn upa tiṣṭhasvendrapīto vācaspate saptartvijo 'bhyucchrayasva juṣasva lokam mārvāg avagāḥ
children.translated_text: Stand upright near the seven seers, drunk by <s>Indra</s>; O <s>Vācaspati</s>, rise up above the seven priests; enjoy the world; do not go downward away from me.

children.text: soma rārandhi no hṛdi pitā no 'si mama tan mā mā hiṃsīḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Soma</s>, make room in our heart; you are our father. That is mine; do not harm me.

children.text: soma gīrbhiṣṭvā vayaṃ vardhayāmo vācovidaḥ sumṛḍīko na āviśa
children.translated_text: O <s>Soma</s>, we, knowers of speech, strengthen you with songs; enter us as one very gracious.

children.text: āpyāyasva sametu te viśvataḥ soma vṛṣṇyam
children.translated_text: Swell up; let your virile strength come together for you from every side, O <s>Soma</s>.

children.text: avamais ta ūrdhvais te kāvyais te pitṛbhir bhakṣitasya madhumato nārāśaṃsasya sarvagaṇasya sarvagaṇa upahūta upahūtasya bhakṣayāmi
children.translated_text: Of you who have been consumed by the lower ones, by the higher ones, by the <s>Kāvyas</s>, and by the <s>Pitṛs</s>, of the honey-sweet <s>Nārāśaṃsa</s> belonging to every group, invoked by every group and invoked: I partake.

children.text: dīkṣāyai varṇena tapaso rūpeṇa manaso mahimnā vāco vibhūtyā prajāpatis tvā yunaktu prajābhyo 'pānāya
children.translated_text: May <s>Prajāpati</s> yoke you, by the color of consecration, by the form of austerity, by the greatness of mind, and by the power of speech, for offspring and for the out-breath.

children.text: vāyur yunaktu manasā stomaṃ yajñāya voḍhave dadhātv indra indriyaṃ satyāḥ kāmā yajamānasya santu
children.translated_text: May <s>Vāyu</s> yoke the <s>stoma</s> (chant) with the mind, to carry the sacrifice; may <s>Indra</s> bestow power; may the sacrificer's desires be fulfilled.

children.text: vṛṣako 'si triṣṭupchandā anu tvā rabhe svasti mā saṃpārayā mā stotrasya stotraṃ gamyād indravanto vanemahi bhakṣīmahi prajām iṣam
children.translated_text: You are <s>Vṛṣaka</s>, having the <s>triṣṭubh</s> meter. I take hold of you; convey me safely across. May the chant of the <s>stotra</s> come to me. With <s>Indra</s> may we win; may we consume offspring and food.

children.text: indavindrapītasya ta indriyāvatastriṣṭupchandasaḥ sarvagaṇasya sarvagaṇa upahūta upahūtasya bhakṣayāmi
children.translated_text: O <s>Indu</s>, of you who have been drunk by <s>Indra</s>, who are full of power and have the <s>triṣṭubh</s> meter, belonging to every group, invoked by every group and invoked: I partake.

children.text: sūryo yunaktu vācā stomaṃ yajñāya voḍhave dadhātv indra indriyaṃ satyāḥ kāmā yajamānasya santu
children.translated_text: May <s>Sūrya</s> yoke the <s>stoma</s> with speech, to carry the sacrifice; may <s>Indra</s> bestow power; may the sacrificer's desires be fulfilled.

children.text: svaro 'si gayo 'si jagacchandā anu tvā rabhe svasti mā saṃpārayā mā stotrasya stotraṃ gamyād indravanto vanemahi bhakṣīmahi prajām iṣam
children.translated_text: You are <s>Svara</s>; you are <s>Gaya</s>, having the <s>jagatī</s> meter. I take hold of you; convey me safely across. May the chant of the <s>stotra</s> come to me. With <s>Indra</s> may we win; may we consume offspring and food.

children.text: indavindrapītasya ta indriyāvatastriṣṭupchandasaḥ sarvagaṇasya sarvagaṇa upahūta upahūtasya bhakṣayāmi
children.translated_text: O <s>Indu</s>, of you who have been drunk by <s>Indra</s>, who are full of power and have the <s>triṣṭubh</s> meter, belonging to every group, invoked by every group and invoked: I partake.

children.text: āyur me prāṇo mano 'si me prāṇa āyupatnyām ṛci yan me mano yamaṃ gataṃ yad vā me aparāgataṃ rājñā somena tad vayaṃ punar asmāsu dadhnasi
children.translated_text: You are my life, my breath, my mind; you are my breath in the life-sustaining verse. Whatever mind of mine has gone to <s>Yama</s>, or whatever has gone away from me, with king <s>Soma</s> may we set that again within ourselves.

children.text: yan me yamaṃ vaivasvataṃ mano jagāma dūragās tan ma āvartayā punar jīvātave na martave 'tho ariṣṭatātaye
children.translated_text: Whatever far-ranging mind of mine has gone to <s>Yama Vaivasvata</s>, bring that back to me again for life, not for death, and also for freedom from injury.

children.text: yenāhyājim ajayad vicakṣya yena śyenaṃ śakunaṃ suparṇaṃ yad āhuś cakṣur aditāv anantaṃ somo nṛcakṣā mayi tad dadhātu ||
children.translated_text: By that with which, discerning, he won the contest, by that with which he perceived the falcon, the bird, the fair-winged one, that which they call the eye in boundless <s>Aditi</s>, may <s>Soma</s>, seeing men, place in me.

children.text: aindraṃ saho 'sarji tasya ta indavindrapītasyendriyāvato 'nuṣṭupchandaso harivataḥ sarvagaṇasya sarvagaṇa upahūta upahūtasya bhakṣayāmi
children.translated_text: The might belonging to <s>Indra</s> has been released. Of that, O <s>Indu</s>, drunk by <s>Indra</s>, full of power, having the <s>anuṣṭubh</s> meter, possessed of the bay steeds, belonging to every group, invoked by every group and invoked: I partake.

children.text: indavindrapītasya ta indriyāvato 'nuṣṭupchandasaḥ sarvagaṇasya sarvagaṇa upahūta upahūtasya bhakṣayāmi
children.translated_text: O <s>Indu</s>, of you who have been drunk by <s>Indra</s>, who are full of power and have the <s>anuṣṭubh</s> meter, belonging to every group, invoked by every group and invoked: I partake.

children.text: stutasya stutam asy ūrjasvat payasvad ā mā stotrasya stotraṃ gamyād indravanto vanemahi bhakṣīmahi prajām iṣam
children.translated_text: You are the praised one of what has been praised, full of nourishment and full of milk. May the chant of the <s>stotra</s> come to me. With <s>Indra</s> may we win; may we consume offspring and food.

children.text: iṣṭayajuṣas te deva soma stutastomasya śastokthasya tirohnyasya yo 'śvasanir gosanir bhakṣas tasyopahūta upahūtasya bhakṣayāmi
children.translated_text: O divine <s>Soma</s>, of you with the offered <s>yajus</s>, whose <s>stoma</s> has been sung and whose <s>uktha</s> has been recited, of the <s>Tirohṇya</s> draught, that horse-winning and cow-winning portion, invoked and invoked: I partake of that.

children.text: ṛtasya tvā deva stomapade viṣṇor dhāmāni vimuñcāmy etat tvaṃ deva stomān avakaram agann aśīmahi vayaṃ pratiṣṭhām
children.translated_text: O god, at the <s>stoma</s>-place of truth I release you into the stations of <s>Viṣṇu</s>. You, O god, have gone to this remnant of the <s>stomas</s>; may we attain firm standing.

children.text: somehānu mehi soma saha sadasa indriyeṇa
children.translated_text: O <s>Soma</s>, come here; follow me, <s>Soma</s>, together with the power of the sacrificial seat.

children.text: subhūr asi śreṣṭho raśmir devānāṃ saṃsad devānāṃ yātur yayā tanvā brahma jinvasi tayā mā jinva tayā mā janaya prakāśaṃ mā kuru
children.translated_text: You are <s>Subhū</s>, the best ray, the assembly of the gods, the course of the gods. With the body by which you quicken the sacred utterance, quicken me with that; generate me with that; make me manifest.

children.text: apāṃ puṣpam asy oṣadhīnāṃ rasa indrasya priyatamaṃ haviḥ svāhā
children.translated_text: You are the flower of the waters, the sap of the plants, the dearest oblation of <s>Indra</s>. Svāhā.

children.text: hāriyojanasya te deva someṣṭayajuṣaḥ stutastomasya śastokthasya yo 'śvasanir gosanir bhakṣas tasyopahūta upahūtasya bhakṣayāmi
children.translated_text: O divine <s>Soma</s>, of you as <s>Hāriyojana</s>, with the offered <s>yajus</s>, whose <s>stoma</s> has been sung and whose <s>uktha</s> has been recited, that horse-winning and cow-winning portion, invoked and invoked: I partake of that.

children.text: devakṛtasyainaso 'vayajanam asi pitṛkṛtasyainaso 'vayajanam asi manuṣyakṛtasyainaso 'vayajanam asy asmatkṛtasyainaso 'vayajanam asi yad divā ca naktaṃ cainaś cakṛma tasyāvayajanam asi yat svapantaś ca jāgrataś cainaś cakṛma tasyāvayajanam asi yad vidvāṃsaś cāvidvāṃsaś cainaś cakṛma tasyāvayajanam asy enasa enasāvayajanam asi
children.translated_text: You are the removal of sin committed by the gods; you are the removal of sin committed by the fathers; you are the removal of sin committed by humans; you are the removal of sin committed by us. Whatever sin we committed by day and by night, you are its removal. Whatever sin we committed asleep and awake, you are its removal. Whatever sin we committed knowingly and unknowingly, you are its removal. You are the sin-removing removal of sin.

children.text: apsu ghautasya te deva soma nṛbhiḥ sutasya
children.translated_text: Of you, O divine <s>Soma</s>, washed in the waters and pressed by men...

children.text: madhumantaṃ bhakṣaṃ karomi
children.translated_text: I make the draught honey-sweet.

children.text: sam adbhya oṣadhībhyaḥ
children.translated_text: Together with the waters and the plants.

children.text: kāmakāmaṃ ma āvartaya
children.translated_text: Bring back to me what I desire, desire by desire.

children.text: ūrg asy ūrjam mayi dhehi
children.translated_text: You are nourishment; place nourishment in me.

children.text: prāṇa somapīthe me jāgṛhi
children.translated_text: O breath, keep watch for me at the <s>Soma</s>-drinking.

children.text: dadhikrāvṇo akāriṣaṃ jiṣṇor aśvasya vājinaḥ
children.translated_text: I have made praise of <s>Dadhikrāvan</s>, the conquering, prize-winning horse.

children.text: surabhi no mukhā karat pra na āyūṃṣi tāriṣat ||
children.translated_text: May he make our mouths fragrant; may he carry our lifespans forward.

children.text: aśvo 'sy atyo 'si mayo 'si hayo 'si vājy asi saptir arvāgasi vṛṣāsi
children.translated_text: You are a horse; you are a courser; you are vigor; you are a steed; you are prize-winning; you are a swift runner; you face hither; you are a bull.

children.text: ādityānāṃ patmānv ihi namas te 'stu mā mā hiṃsīḥ
children.translated_text: Go along the course of the <s>Ādityas</s>. Homage be to you; do not harm me.

children.text: vāyoṣṭvā tejasā pratigṛhṇāmi nakṣatrāṇāṃ tvāṃ rūpeṇa pratigṛhṇāmi sūryasya tvā varcasā pratigṛhṇāmi
children.translated_text: I receive you with the brilliance of <s>Vāyu</s>; I receive you with the form of the stars; I receive you with the radiance of <s>Sūrya</s>.

children.text: rathantaram asi vāmadevyam asi bṛhad asi
children.translated_text: You are <s>Rathantara</s>; you are <s>Vāmadevya</s>; you are <s>Bṛhat</s>.

children.text: aṅkānyaṅkū abhito rathaṃ yau dhvāntaṃ vātāgram abhisaṃcaratau dūre hetir indriyavān patatrī te no 'gnayaḥ paprayaḥ pārayantu
children.translated_text: The two, crooked and counter-crooked, on both sides of the chariot, who move through the darkness at the front of the wind, the far-reaching missile, powerful and winged: may those protecting <s>Agnis</s> carry us across.

children.text: vaiśvānaraḥ pratnathā nākam āruha divaḥ pṛṣṭhe mandamānaḥ sumanmabhiḥ sapūrvavaj jantave dhanāḥ samānam ayman paryeti jāgṛviḥ
children.translated_text: As of old, <s>Vaiśvānara</s> has climbed to the firmament, rejoicing on the back of heaven with favorable thoughts. As before, wakeful, he goes around the common path with wealth for the creature.

children.text: gidaiṣa te ratha eṣa vām aśvinā ratho 'riṣṭo viśvabheṣajaḥ
children.translated_text: This is your chariot; this is your chariot, O <s>Aśvins</s>, unharmed and bearing all remedies.

children.text: kṛśāno savyān āyaccha
children.translated_text: O <s>Kṛśānu</s>, draw in the left-hand reins.

children.text: dāsāno dakṣiṇān avagṛhāṇa ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Dāsāna</s>, take hold of the right-hand reins.

children.text: devasya tvā savituḥ prasave 'śvinor bāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyāṃ pratigṛhṇāmi
children.translated_text: At the impulse of the god <s>Savitṛ</s>, with the arms of the <s>Aśvins</s>, with the hands of <s>Pūṣan</s>, I receive you.

children.text: varuṇas tvā nayatu devi dakṣiṇe varuṇāyāśvaṃ tenāmṛtatvam aśīya vayo dātre bhūyān mayo mahyaṃ pratigrahītre
children.translated_text: May <s>Varuṇa</s> lead you, O divine <s>dakṣiṇā</s> (sacrificial gift); [I give] a horse to <s>Varuṇa</s>. Through that may I attain immortality; may vitality belong to the giver and delight to me, the receiver.

children.text: varuṇas tvā nayatu devi dakṣiṇe rudrāya gāṃ tayāmṛtatvam aśīya vayo dātre bhūyān mayo mahyaṃ pratigrahītre
children.translated_text: May <s>Varuṇa</s> lead you, O divine <s>dakṣiṇā</s> (sacrificial gift); [I give] a cow to <s>Rudra</s>. Through that may I attain immortality; may vitality belong to the giver and delight to me, the receiver.

children.text: varuṇas tvā nayatu devi dakṣiṇe 'gnaye 'jam
children.translated_text: May <s>Varuṇa</s> lead you, O divine <s>dakṣiṇā</s> (sacrificial gift); [I give] a goat to <s>Agni</s>.

children.text: agnaye hiraṇyam
children.translated_text: [I give] gold to <s>Agni</s>.

children.text: agnīṣomābhyām ajān mayāmṛtatvam aśīya vayo dātre bhūyān mayo mahyaṃ pratigrahītre
children.translated_text: [I give] goats to <s>Agni</s> and <s>Soma</s>. Through them may I attain immortality; may vitality belong to the giver and delight to me, the receiver.

children.text: annasyānnapatiḥ prādād anamīvasya śuṣmiṇo namo viśvajanasya kṣāmāya bhuñjati mā mā hiṃsīḥ
children.translated_text: The lord of food has given food that is free from sickness and full of strength. Homage to the earth, the dwelling of all people. As it is enjoyed, do not injure me.

children.text: varuṇas tvā nayatu devi dakṣiṇe tvaṣṭre 'viṃ tayāmṛtatvam aśīya vayo dātre bhūyān mayo mahyaṃ pratigrahītre
children.translated_text: May <s>Varuṇa</s> lead you, O divine <s>dakṣiṇā</s> (sacrificial gift); [I give] a sheep to <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s>. Through that may I attain immortality; may vitality belong to the giver and delight to me, the receiver.

children.text: gnās tvā 'kṛntann apaso 'tanvata vayitryo 'vayan
children.translated_text: The divine women cut you; the waters stretched you out; the weaving women wove you.

children.text: varuṇas tvā nayatu devi dakṣiṇe bṛhaspataye vāsas tenāmṛtatvam aśīya vayo dātre bhūyān mayo mahyaṃ pratigrahītre
children.translated_text: May <s>Varuṇa</s> lead you, O divine <s>dakṣiṇā</s> (sacrificial gift); [I give] a garment to <s>Bṛhaspati</s>. Through that may I attain immortality; may vitality belong to the giver and delight to me, the receiver.

children.text: varuṇas tvā nayatu devi dakṣiṇe uttānāyāṅgirasāyāprāṇat tenāmṛtatvam aśīya vayo dātre bhūyān mayo mahyaṃ pratigrahītre
children.translated_text: May <s>Varuṇa</s> lead you, O divine <s>dakṣiṇā</s> (sacrificial gift); [I give] the breathless one to <s>Uttāna Āṅgirasa</s>. Through that may I attain immortality; may vitality belong to the giver and delight to me, the receiver.

children.text: varuṇas tvā nayatu devi dakṣiṇe pūṣṇa uṣṭram
children.translated_text: May <s>Varuṇa</s> lead you, O divine <s>dakṣiṇā</s> (sacrificial gift); [I give] a camel to <s>Pūṣan</s>.

children.text: vāyave mṛgaṃ tenāmṛtatvam aśīya vayo dātre bhūyān mayo mahyaṃ pratigrahītre
children.translated_text: [I give] a wild animal to <s>Vāyu</s>. Through that may I attain immortality; may vitality belong to the giver and delight to me, the receiver.

children.text: prajāpataye hastinaṃ prajāpataye varāhaṃ prajāpataye vrīhiyavāṃs tair amṛtatvam aśīya vayo dātre bhūyān mayo mahyaṃ pratigrahītre
children.translated_text: [I give] an elephant to <s>Prajāpati</s>, a boar to <s>Prajāpati</s>, and rice and barley to <s>Prajāpati</s>. Through them may I attain immortality; may vitality belong to the giver and delight to me, the receiver.

children.text: varuṇas tvā nayatu devi dakṣiṇe kṣetrapataye tilamāṣās tair amṛtatvam aśīya vayo dātre bhūyān mayo mahyaṃ pratigrahītre
children.translated_text: May <s>Varuṇa</s> lead you, O divine <s>dakṣiṇā</s> (sacrificial gift); [I give] sesame and beans to <s>Kṣetrapati</s>. Through them may I attain immortality; may vitality belong to the giver and delight to me, the receiver.

children.text: varuṇas tvā nayatu devi dakṣiṇe savitre 'śvataraṃ vāśvatarīṃ vā tayāmṛtatvam aśīya vayo dātre bhūyān mayo mahyaṃ pratigrahītre
children.translated_text: May <s>Varuṇa</s> lead you, O divine <s>dakṣiṇā</s> (sacrificial gift); [I give] a mule or a she-mule to <s>Savitṛ</s>. Through that may I attain immortality; may vitality belong to the giver and delight to me, the receiver.

children.text: ka idaṃ kasmā adāt kāmaḥ kāmāyādāt kāmo dātā kāmaḥ pratigrahītā kāmaḥ samudram āviśat kāmena tvā pratigṛhṇāmi kāmaitat te ||
children.translated_text: Who gave this, and to whom? Desire gave it to Desire. Desire is the giver; Desire is the receiver. Desire entered the ocean. With Desire I receive you. O Desire, this is yours.

children.text: raśmir asi kṣayāya tvā kṣayaṃ jinva savitṛprasūtā bṛhaspataye stuta
children.translated_text: You are a rein. For settled dwelling I take you; strengthen the dwelling. Impelled by <s>Savitṛ</s>, praise <s>Bṛhaspati</s>.

children.text: pretir asi dharmaṇe tvā dharmaṃ jinva savitṛprasūtā bṛhaspataye stuta
children.translated_text: You are advance. For <s>dharma</s> (sacred order) I take you; strengthen dharma. Impelled by <s>Savitṛ</s>, praise <s>Bṛhaspati</s>.

children.text: anvitir asi dive tvā divaṃ jinva savitṛprasūtā bṛhaspataye stuta
children.translated_text: You are continuation. For heaven I take you; strengthen heaven. Impelled by <s>Savitṛ</s>, praise <s>Bṛhaspati</s>.

children.text: saṃdhir asy antarikṣāya tvāntarikṣaṃ jinva savitṛprasūtā bṛhaspataye stuta
children.translated_text: You are conjunction. For the midspace I take you; strengthen the midspace. Impelled by <s>Savitṛ</s>, praise <s>Bṛhaspati</s>.

children.text: pratidhir asi pṛthivyai tvā pṛthivīṃ jinva savitṛprasūtā bṛhaspataye stuta
children.translated_text: You are a support. For earth I take you; strengthen earth. Impelled by <s>Savitṛ</s>, praise <s>Bṛhaspati</s>.

children.text: viṣṭambho 'si vṛṣṭyai tvā vṛṣṭiṃ jinva savitṛprasūtā bṛhaspataye stuta
children.translated_text: You are a prop. For rain I take you; strengthen rain. Impelled by <s>Savitṛ</s>, praise <s>Bṛhaspati</s>.

children.text: prāco 'sy ahne tvāhar jinva savitṛprasūtā bṛhaspataye stuta
children.translated_text: You are the eastern one. For day I take you; strengthen day. Impelled by <s>Savitṛ</s>, praise <s>Bṛhaspati</s>.

children.text: anvāsi rātryai rātriṃ jinva savitṛprasūtā bṛhaspataye stuta
children.translated_text: You are the following one. For night I take you; strengthen night. Impelled by <s>Savitṛ</s>, praise <s>Bṛhaspati</s>.

children.text: uśig asi vasubhyas tvā vasūn jinva savitṛprasūtā bṛhaspataye stuta
children.translated_text: You are the eager one. For the <s>Vasus</s> I take you; strengthen the <s>Vasus</s>. Impelled by <s>Savitṛ</s>, praise <s>Bṛhaspati</s>.

children.text: praketo 'si rudrebhyas tvā rudrān jinva savitṛprasūtā bṛhaspataye stuta
children.translated_text: You are a clear token. For the <s>Rudras</s> I take you; strengthen the <s>Rudras</s>. Impelled by <s>Savitṛ</s>, praise <s>Bṛhaspati</s>.

children.text: sudītir asy ādityebhyas tvādityān jinva savitṛprasūtā bṛhaspataye stuta
children.translated_text: You are bright illumination. For the <s>Ādityas</s> I take you; strengthen the <s>Ādityas</s>. Impelled by <s>Savitṛ</s>, praise <s>Bṛhaspati</s>.

children.text: ojo 'si pitṛbhyas tvā pitṝn jinva savitṛprasūtā bṛhaspataye stuta ||
children.translated_text: You are vigor. For the <s>Pitṛs</s> I take you; strengthen the <s>Pitṛs</s>. Impelled by <s>Savitṛ</s>, praise <s>Bṛhaspati</s>.

children.text: tantur asi prajābhyas tvā prajā jinva savitṛprasūtā bṛhaspataye stuta
children.translated_text: You are a thread. For offspring I take you; strengthen offspring. Impelled by <s>Savitṛ</s>, praise <s>Bṛhaspati</s>.

children.text: rodasy asy oṣadhībhyas tvauṣadhīr jinva savitṛprasūtā bṛhaspataye stuta
children.translated_text: You are the world-pair. For the plants I take you; strengthen the plants. Impelled by <s>Savitṛ</s>, praise <s>Bṛhaspati</s>.

children.text: pṛtanāṣāḍ asi paśubhyas tvā paśūn jinva savitṛprasūtā bṛhaspataye stuta
children.translated_text: You are battle-winning. For the animals I take you; strengthen the animals. Impelled by <s>Savitṛ</s>, praise <s>Bṛhaspati</s>.

children.text: abhijid asi yuktagrāvendrāya tvendraṃ jinva savitṛprasūtā bṛhaspataye stuta
children.translated_text: You are victorious, with the pressing stone yoked. For <s>Indra</s> I take you; strengthen <s>Indra</s>. Impelled by <s>Savitṛ</s>, praise <s>Bṛhaspati</s>.

children.text: adhipatir asi prāṇāya tvā prāṇān jinva savitṛprasūtā bṛhaspataye stuta
children.translated_text: You are overlord. For breath I take you; strengthen the vital breaths. Impelled by <s>Savitṛ</s>, praise <s>Bṛhaspati</s>.

children.text: dharuṇo 'sy apānāya tvāpānān jinva savitṛprasūtā bṛhaspataye stuta
children.translated_text: You are support. For the downward breath I take you; strengthen the downward breaths. Impelled by <s>Savitṛ</s>, praise <s>Bṛhaspati</s>.

children.text: saṃsarpo 'si cakṣuṣe tvā cakṣur jinva savitṛprasūtā bṛhaspataye stuta
children.translated_text: You are the creeping movement. For sight I take you; strengthen sight. Impelled by <s>Savitṛ</s>, praise <s>Bṛhaspati</s>.

children.text: vayodhā asi kṣetrāya tvā kṣetraṃ jinva savitṛprasūtā bṛhaspataye stuta
children.translated_text: You are giver of vigor. For the field I take you; strengthen the field. Impelled by <s>Savitṛ</s>, praise <s>Bṛhaspati</s>.

children.text: trivṛd asi trivṛte tvā savṛd asi savṛte tvā pravṛd asi pravṛte tvānuvṛd asy anuvṛte tvā savitṛprasūtā bṛhaspataye stuta
children.translated_text: You are <s>trivṛt</s> (threefold); for the trivṛt I take you. You are <s>savṛt</s>; for the savṛt I take you. You are <s>pravṛt</s>; for the pravṛt I take you. You are <s>anuvṛt</s>; for the anuvṛt I take you. Impelled by <s>Savitṛ</s>, praise <s>Bṛhaspati</s>.

children.text: niroho 'si nirohāya tvā saṃroho 'si saṃrohāya tvā praroho 'si prarohāya tvānuroho 'sy anurohāya tvā savitṛprasūtā bṛhaspataye stuta
children.translated_text: You are <s>niroha</s>; for niroha I take you. You are <s>saṃroha</s>; for saṃroha I take you. You are <s>praroha</s>; for praroha I take you. You are <s>anuroha</s>; for anuroha I take you. Impelled by <s>Savitṛ</s>, praise <s>Bṛhaspati</s>.

children.text: vasuko 'si vasyaṣṭir asi veṣaśrīr asi savitṛprasūtā bṛhaspataye stuta
children.translated_text: You are <s>Vasuka</s>; you are <s>Vasyaṣṭi</s>; you are <s>Veṣaśrī</s>. Impelled by <s>Savitṛ</s>, praise <s>Bṛhaspati</s>.

children.text: ākramo 'syākramāya tvā saṃkramo 'si saṃkramāya tvotkramo 'sy utkramāya tvotkrāntir asy utkrāntyai tvā savitṛprasūtā bṛhaspataye stuta ||
children.translated_text: You are the step; for stepping I take you. You are the transition; for transition I take you. You are the upward step; for upward stepping I take you. You are the departure; for departure I take you. Impelled by <s>Savitṛ</s>, praise <s>Bṛhaspati</s>.

children.text: Chapter 2
tisṛbhyo hiṅ karoti sa prathamayā tisṛbhyo hiṅ karoti sa madhyamayā tisṛbhyo hiṅ karoti sa uttamayodyatī trivṛto viṣṭutiḥ
children.translated_text: For three he makes the hiṅ-call with the first; for three he makes the hiṅ-call with the middle; for three he makes the hiṅ-call with the last. This is the rising arrangement of the <s>trivṛt</s>.

children.text: jyeṣṭho jyaiṣṭhineya stuvīta
children.translated_text: <s>Jyeṣṭha Jyaiṣṭhineya</s> should chant.

children.text: agrād agraṃ rohaty abhikrāmantī viṣṭutir abhikrāmantyā evābhikrāntena hi yajñasyardhnoti tasmād etayā stotavyam ṛddhyā eva
children.translated_text: The advancing <s>viṣṭuti</s> (arrangement of praise) climbs from front to front. For by the very advance of the advancing one he prospers in the sacrifice; therefore one should perform the chant with this, precisely for prosperity.

children.text: pāpavasīyaso vidhṛtir vipāpmanā vartate ya etayā stute nāvagato 'parudhyate nāparuddho 'vagacchati
children.translated_text: It is the separation of what is worse and evil; he who is praised with this moves free from evil. One who has not gone down is not obstructed, and one who is not obstructed does not go down.

children.text: eṣā vai pratiṣṭhitā trivṛto viṣṭutiḥ pratitiṣṭhati ya etayā stute ||
children.translated_text: This, indeed, is the firmly established <s>viṣṭuti</s> of the <s>Trivṛt</s> (threefold stoma). He who is praised with this gains firm standing.

children.text: tisṛbhyo hiṅ karoti sa parācībhis tisṛbhyo hiṅ karoti sa parācībhis tisṛbhyo hiṅ karoti sa parācībhiḥ parivartinī triviṣṭutiḥ
children.translated_text: For three verses he makes the <s>hiṅ</s>, with the backward-turned ones; for three verses he makes the <s>hiṅ</s>, with the backward-turned ones; for three verses he makes the <s>hiṅ</s>, with the backward-turned ones. This is the turning threefold <s>viṣṭuti</s>.

children.text: praparīvartam āpnoti ya etayā stute saṃtatā viṣṭutiḥ prāṇo 'pāno vyānas ta ṛcas tān hiṅkāreṇa saṃtanoti
children.translated_text: He who is praised with this obtains full turning-about. The continuous <s>viṣṭuti</s> is breath, out-breath, and diffused breath; these are the ṛcs, and he joins them together by means of the <s>hiṅkāra</s>.

children.text: ślakṣṇeva tu vā īśvarā paśūn nirmṛjaḥ saiṣā ca parācota śreyān bhavaty uta yādṛg eva tādṛṅ net tu pāpīyān
children.translated_text: But, as it were smoothly, it is liable to wipe away the cattle. This one is also backward-turned; still, a man becomes better, or else just such as he was, but not worse.

children.text: tām etāṃ bhāllavaya upāsate tasmāt te pratigṛṇantaḥ parīvartān na cyavante ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Bhāllavayas</s> attend upon this form. Therefore, when they make the response, they do not fall away from the turnings.

children.text: tisṛbhyo hiṅ karoti sa parācībhis tisṛbhyo hiṅ karoti yā madhyamā sā prathamā yottamā sā madhyamā yā prathamā sottamā tisṛbhyo hiṅ karoti yottamā sā prathamā yā prathamā sā madhyamā yā madhyamā sottamā kulāyinī trivṛto viṣṭutiḥ
children.translated_text: For three verses he makes the <s>hiṅ</s>, with the backward-turned ones. For three verses he makes the <s>hiṅ</s>: the middle one is first, the last one is middle, and the first one is last. For three verses he makes the <s>hiṅ</s>: the last one is first, the first one is middle, and the middle one is last. This is the nest-forming <s>viṣṭuti</s> of the <s>Trivṛt</s>.

children.text: prajākāmo vā paśukāmo vā stuvīta vai kulānāyapaśavaḥ kulāyaṃ kulāyam eva bhavati
children.translated_text: One who desires offspring or one who desires cattle should be praised with it. For cattle belong to households; it becomes household after household.

children.text: etām evānujāvarāya kuryād etāsām evāgraṃ pariyatīnāṃ prajānām agraṃ paryeti
children.translated_text: This same one should be made for a later-born man. By these verses themselves, as they go round to the front, he goes round to the front of offspring.

children.text: etām eva bahubhyo yajamānebhyaḥ kuryāt yat sarvā agriyā bhavanti sarvā madhye sarvā uttamāḥ sarvān evainān samāvadbhājaḥ karoti nānyonyam apaghnate sarve samāvadindriyā bhavanti
children.translated_text: This same one should be made for many sacrificers. Since all become first, all middle, and all last, he makes all of them equal sharers; they do not strike one another down, and all become equal in power.

children.text: varṣukaḥ parjanyo bhavatīme hi lokās tṛcas tān hiṅkāreṇa vyatiṣajati
children.translated_text: <s>Parjanya</s> becomes a rain-bringer. These worlds are the triplets of verses, and he interweaves them by means of the <s>hiṅkāra</s>.

children.text: pāpavasīyasaṃ tu bhavati
children.translated_text: But it becomes worse and more evil.

children.text: adharottaram apāvagato rudhyateva gacchaty aparuddhaḥ pāpīyān śreyāṃsam abhyārohati janatā janatām abhyety anyonyasya prajā ādadate na yathākṣetraṃ kalpante ||
children.translated_text: When lower and upper are out of order, one who has gone down becomes obstructed, as it were, and one obstructed goes downward; the worse mounts over the better, people press upon people, they take one another's offspring, and they do not settle according to their proper fields.

children.text: pañcabhyo hiṅ karoti sa tisṛbhiḥ sa ekayā sa ekayā pañcabhyo hiṅ karoti sa ekayā sa tisṛbhiḥ sa ekayā pañcabhyo hiṅ karoti sa ekayā sa ekayā sa tisṛbhiḥ pañcapañcinī pañcapañcadaśasya viṣṭutiḥ
children.translated_text: For five verses he makes the <s>hiṅ</s>: one set with three, one with one, and one with one. For five verses he makes the <s>hiṅ</s>: one with one, one with three, and one with one. For five verses he makes the <s>hiṅ</s>: one with one, one with one, and one with three. This is the five-by-five <s>viṣṭuti</s> of the <s>Pañcadaśa</s> (fifteenfold stoma).

children.text: pāṅktaḥ puruṣaḥ pāṅktāt paśavas tayā puruṣaṃ ca paśūṃś cāpnoti vajro vai pañcapaśo yat pañca pañca vyūhati vajram eva tad vyūhati śāntyā eṣā vai pratiṣṭhitā pañcadaśasya viṣṭutiḥ pratitiṣṭhati ya etayā stute ||
children.translated_text: The person is fivefold, and cattle come from the fivefold. With that he obtains both the person and cattle. The fivefold arrangement of the <s>Pañcadaśa</s> is a <s>vajra</s>; when he arranges it five by five, he arranges the <s>vajra</s> itself, for pacification. This, indeed, is the firmly established <s>viṣṭuti</s> of the <s>Pañcadaśa</s>; he who is praised with this gains firm standing.

children.text: pañcabhyo hiṅ karoti sa tisṛbhiḥ sa ekayā tisṛbhyo hiṅ karoti sa parācībhiḥ saptabhyo hiṅ karoti sa ekayā sa tisṛbhiḥ sa tisṛbhis trīn stomān prativihitā brahmavarcasakāmaḥ stuvīta
children.translated_text: For five verses he makes the <s>hiṅ</s>: one set with three, one with one. For three verses he makes the <s>hiṅ</s>, with the backward-turned ones. For seven verses he makes the <s>hiṅ</s>: one with one, one with three, and one with three. The three <s>stomas</s> are set in correspondence; one who desires <s>brahmavarcas</s> (sacred brilliance) should be praised with it.

children.text: pañcabhiḥ pañcadaśaṃ tisṛbhis trivṛtaṃ saptabhiḥ saptadaśam
children.translated_text: With five he makes the <s>Pañcadaśa</s>, with three the <s>Trivṛt</s>, and with seven the <s>Saptadaśa</s> (seventeenfold stoma).

children.text: vīryaṃ vai stomā vīryam eva tad ekadhā samūhate brahmavarcasyāvaruddhyai tejasvī brahmavarcasī bhavati ya etayā stute ||
children.translated_text: The <s>stomas</s> are vigor; he thereby gathers that vigor together in one place for the securing of <s>brahmavarcas</s>. He who is praised with this becomes radiant and possessed of <s>brahmavarcas</s>.

children.text: tisṛbhyo hiṅ karoti sa parācībhiḥ pañcabhyo hiṅ karoti sa ekayā sa tisṛbhiḥ sa ekayā saptabhyo hiṅ karoti sa ekayā sa tisṛbhiḥ sa tisṛbhir udyatī pañcadaśasya viṣṭutiḥ
children.translated_text: For three verses he makes the <s>hiṅ</s>, with the backward-turned ones. For five verses he makes the <s>hiṅ</s>: one with one, one with three, and one with one. For seven verses he makes the <s>hiṅ</s>: one with one, one with three, and one with three. This is the rising <s>viṣṭuti</s> of the <s>Pañcadaśa</s>.

children.text: etayā vai devāḥ svargaṃllokam āyan svargakāmaḥ stuvīta svargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai svargāllokān na cyavate tuṣṭuvānaḥ
children.translated_text: With this the gods went to the heavenly world. One who desires heaven should be praised with it, for complete attainment of the heavenly world. Having been praised, he does not fall from the heavenly world.

children.text: abhikrāmantī viṣṭutir abhikrāmantyā evābhikrāntena hi yajñasyardhnoti tasmād etayā stotavyam ṛddhyā eva ||
children.translated_text: It is an advancing <s>viṣṭuti</s>; for by the very advance of the advancing one he prospers in the sacrifice. Therefore one should perform the chant with this, precisely for prosperity.

children.text: pañcabhyo hiṅ karoti sa tisṛbhiḥ sa ekayā sa ekayā pañcabhyo hiṅ karoti sa ekayā sa tisṛbhiḥ sa ekayā saptabhyo hiṅ karoti sa ekayā sa tisṛbhiḥ sa tisṛbhir daśasaptā saptadaśasya viṣṭutiḥ
children.translated_text: For five verses he makes the <s>hiṅ</s>: one set with three, one with one, and one with one. For five verses he makes the <s>hiṅ</s>: one with one, one with three, and one with one. For seven verses he makes the <s>hiṅ</s>: one with one, one with three, and one with three. This is the ten-and-seven <s>viṣṭuti</s> of the <s>Saptadaśa</s>.

children.text: etayā vai devā asurān atyakrāmann ati pāpmānaṃ bhrātṛvyaṃ krāmati ya etayā stute
children.translated_text: With this the gods stepped beyond the <s>Asuras</s>; he who is praised with this steps beyond evil and beyond the rival kinsman.

children.text: abhikrāmantī viṣṭutir abhikrāmantyā evābhikrāntena hi yajñasyardhnoti tasmād etayā stotavyam ṛddhyā eva
children.translated_text: It is an advancing <s>viṣṭuti</s>; for by the very advance of the advancing one he prospers in the sacrifice. Therefore one should perform the chant with this, precisely for prosperity.

children.text: garbhiṇī viṣṭutiḥ pa prajayā pra paśubhir jāyate ya etayā stute
children.translated_text: The <s>viṣṭuti</s> is pregnant; he who is praised with this is brought forth with offspring and brought forth with cattle.

children.text: viḍ vai saptadaśas tasyā rājā garbho viśa eva tad rājānaṃ garbhaṃ karoti
children.translated_text: The <s>Saptadaśa</s> is the people, and the king is its embryo. Thus he makes the king an embryo within the people themselves.

children.text: nāvagato 'parudhyate nāparuddho 'vagacchati
children.translated_text: One who has not gone down is not obstructed, and one who is not obstructed does not go down.

children.text: annaṃ vai saptadaśo yat sapta madhye bhavanti pañcapañcābhito 'nnam eva tan madhyato dhīyate 'naśanāyuko yajamāno bhavaty anaśanāyukāḥ prajāḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>Saptadaśa</s> is food. Since seven are in the middle and five and five on both sides, food is thereby placed in the middle. The sacrificer becomes one whose life is not subject to hunger, and his offspring become ones whose lives are not subject to hunger.

children.text: vairājo vai puruṣaḥ sapta grāmyāḥ paśavo yad daśapūrvā bhavanti saptottamā yajamānam eva tat paśuṣu pratiṣṭhāpayati
children.translated_text: The person is connected with the <s>Virāj</s>. The domestic animals are seven. Since ten are first and seven last, he thereby establishes the sacrificer among the animals.

children.text: eṣā vai pratiṣṭhitā saptadaśasya viṣṭutiḥ pratitiṣṭhati ya etayā stute ||
children.translated_text: This indeed is the established <s>viṣṭuti</s> (chant-distribution) of the <s>saptadaśa</s> (seventeenfold stoma); he who praises with it becomes established.

children.text: eṣa eva vyūhaḥ saptaikamadhyā
children.translated_text: This very arrangement is the <s>saptaikamadhyā</s>, the one-with-a-single-in-the-middle among sevens.

children.text: brahmaṇo vā āyatanaṃ prathamā kṣatrasya madhyamā viśa uttamā yat prathamā bhūyiṣṭhā bhājayati brahmaṇy eva tad ojo vīryaṃ dadhāti brahmaṇa eva tat kṣatraṃ ca viśaṃ cānuge karoti kṣatrasyāsya prakāśo bhavati ya etayā stute
children.translated_text: The first part is the seat of <s>brahman</s> (priestly sacred power), the middle one of <s>kṣatra</s> (royal power), and the last one of the <s>viś</s> (people). When he gives the greatest share to the first, he thereby places force and vigor in <s>brahman</s>; thereby he makes both <s>kṣatra</s> and the <s>viś</s> followers of <s>brahman</s>. The radiance of <s>kṣatra</s> belongs to the one who praises with this.

children.text: tām etāṃ trikharvā upāsate tasmāt te spardhamānā na vilīyante
children.translated_text: The <s>Trikharvas</s> practice this very one; therefore, though they compete, they do not fall apart.

children.text: saptabhyo hiṅ karoti sa tisṛbhiḥ sa tisṛbhiḥ sa ekayā tisṛbhyo hiṅ karoti parācībhiḥ saptabhyo hiṅ karoti sa ekayā sa tisṛbhiḥ sa tisṛbhiḥ saptāsthitā
children.translated_text: He makes the <s>hiṅ</s> for seven: that is with three, that with three, that with one. He makes the <s>hiṅ</s> for three with the reversed verses. He makes the <s>hiṅ</s> for seven: that with one, that with three, that with three. This is the <s>saptāsthitā</s>, the seven-based arrangement.

children.text: bhrātṛvyaṃ stuvīta yathā saptāsthitena matyena samīkaroty evaṃ pāpmānaṃ bhrātṛvyaṃ prarujati
children.translated_text: One should praise against a rival with it. Just as one levels with a seven-set <s>matya</s> implement, so he breaks down the evil rival.

children.text: etām eva bahubhyo yajamānebhyaḥ kuryād yaḥ prathamo hiṅkāraḥ sa prathamāyā yattāṃ saptabhyo hiṅ karoti tena sā sapta bhajate yat saptaiva madhye sapadyante tena sā sapta bhajate ya uttamo hiṅkāraḥ sa uttamayā yattāṃ saptabhyo hiṅ karoti tena sā sapta bhajate sarvān evainān samāvadbhājaḥ karoti nānyonyam apaghnate samāvadindriyā bhavanti
children.translated_text: One should make this very arrangement for many sacrificers. The first <s>hiṅkāra</s> belongs to the first part; when he makes that <s>hiṅ</s> for seven, by that it receives a share of seven. Since precisely seven fall in the middle, by that it receives a share of seven. The last <s>hiṅkāra</s> belongs to the last part; when he makes that <s>hiṅ</s> for seven, by that it receives a share of seven. He makes all these sacrificers equal sharers; they do not strike one another down, and they become equal in vital power.

children.text: tām etām abhipratāriṇa upāsate tasmāt ta ojiṣṭhāsvānām ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Abhipratārins</s> practice this very one; therefore they are the strongest among their own people.

children.text: eṣa eva vyūha ubhayaḥ saptaikamadhyā nirmadhyā
children.translated_text: This very arrangement is twofold: the <s>saptaikamadhyā</s>, with one in the middle among sevens, and the <s>nirmadhyā</s>, without a middle.

children.text: ānujāvara stuvītāloko vā eṣa yad ānujāvaro yat saptaprathamāḥ saptottamās tisro madhye tryakṣaraḥ puruṣo lokam evāsmai tan madhyataḥ karoti tasmiṃlloke pratitiṣṭhati
children.translated_text: An <s>ānujāvara</s> should praise with it. This, namely the <s>ānujāvara</s>, is an open space; for there are seven at the beginning, seven at the end, and three in the middle, and <s>puruṣa</s> is three syllables. He thereby makes a world for him in the middle; in that world he becomes established.

children.text: etām eva prajākāmāya kuryān madhyato vā eṣa saṃrūḍho yaḥ prajāṃ na vindate lokam evāsmai taṃ madhyataḥ karoti taṃ lokaṃ prajayā ca paśubhiś cānuprajāyate
children.translated_text: One should make this very arrangement for one who desires offspring. He who does not obtain offspring is, as it were, blocked up in the middle. He makes that world for him in the middle, and in that world he is propagated with offspring and cattle.

children.text: etām evāparuddharājanyāya kuryād viḍ vai saptadaśas tasyā rājā garbho viśa eva tad rājānaṃ nirhantyapāvagato 'parudhyate 'vagacchaty aparuddhaḥ
children.translated_text: One should make this very arrangement for an excluded <s>Rājanya</s>. The <s>saptadaśa</s> is the <s>viś</s>; the king is its embryo. Thus he brings the king forth from the <s>viś</s>. Having gone away he is shut out; the one who has been shut out comes back.

children.text: etām evābhicaryamāṇāya kuryāt prajāpatir vai saptadaśaḥ prajāpatim eva madhyataḥ praviśanty astṛtyai ||
children.translated_text: One should make this very arrangement for one against whom hostile rites are being performed. The <s>saptadaśa</s> is <s>Prajāpati</s>; they enter <s>Prajāpati</s> himself in the middle, so as not to be overthrown.

children.text: pañcabhyo hiṅ karoti sa tisṛbhiḥ sa ekayā sa ekayā tisṛbhyo hiṅ karoti sa parācībhir navabhyo hiṅ karoti sa tisṛbhiḥ sa tisṛbhiḥ sa tisṛbhiḥ
children.translated_text: He makes the <s>hiṅ</s> for five: that is with three, that with one, that with one. He makes the <s>hiṅ</s> for three: that with the reversed verses. He makes the <s>hiṅ</s> for nine: that with three, that with three, that with three.

children.text: caturastomān prativihitā brahmavarcasakāmāḥ stuvīta pañcabhiḥ pañcadaśaṃ tisṛbhis trivṛtaṃ navabhis triṇavaṃ svayaṃ saptadaśaḥ sampanno vīryaṃ vai stomā vīryam eva tad ekadhā samūhate brahmavarcasyāvaruddhyai tejasvī brahmavarcasī bhavati ya etayā stute ||
children.translated_text: The four <s>stomas</s> are arranged in correspondence. One desiring <s>brahmavarcas</s> (sacred brilliance) should praise with it: with five, the <s>pañcadaśa</s>; with three, the <s>trivṛt</s>; with nine, the <s>triṇava</s>; and the <s>saptadaśa</s> is completed by itself. The <s>stomas</s> are vigor; thus he gathers vigor into one place, for the winning of <s>brahmavarcas</s>. He who praises with this becomes radiant and possessed of <s>brahmavarcas</s>.

children.text: tisṛbhyo hiṅ karoti sa parācībhiḥ pañcabhyo hiṅ karoti sa ekayā sa tisṛbhiḥ sa ekayā navabhyo hiṅ karoti sa tisṛbhiḥ sa tisṛbhiḥ sa tisṛbhir udyatī saptadaśasya viṣṭutiḥ
children.translated_text: He makes the <s>hiṅ</s> for three: that with the reversed verses. He makes the <s>hiṅ</s> for five: that with one, that with three, that with one. He makes the <s>hiṅ</s> for nine: that with three, that with three, that with three. This is the ascending <s>viṣṭuti</s> of the <s>saptadaśa</s>.

children.text: etayā vai devāḥ svargaṃ lokam āyan svargakāmaḥ stuvīta svargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai svargāllokān na cyavate tuṣṭuvāno 'bhikrāmantī viṣṭutir abhikrāntyā evābhikrāntena hi yajñasyardhnoti tasmād etayā stotavyam ṛddhyā eva ||
children.translated_text: By this the gods went to the heavenly world. One desiring heaven should praise with it, for the complete attainment of the heavenly world. While praising, he does not fall from the heavenly world. The <s>viṣṭuti</s> is an advancing one; by advancing, indeed, there is advance, for by what has advanced one succeeds in the sacrifice. Therefore one should praise with this, precisely for success.

children.text: saptabhyo hiṅ karoti sa tisṛbhiḥ sa tisṛbhiḥ sa ekayā pañcabhyo hiṅ karoti sa ekayā sa tisṛbhiḥ sa ekayā pañcabhyo hiṅ karoti sa ekayā sa ekayā sa tisṛbhir bhastrāvācīnabilā
children.translated_text: He makes the <s>hiṅ</s> for seven: that with three, that with three, that with one. He makes the <s>hiṅ</s> for five: that with one, that with three, that with one. He makes the <s>hiṅ</s> for five: that with one, that with one, that with three. This is the bellows with its mouth turned downward.

children.text: yaṃ dviṣyāt tasya kuryād yathāvācīnabilayā bhastrayā pradhūnuyād evaṃ yajamānasya paśūn pradhūnoty apakrāmantī viṣṭutis tayā yajamānasya paśavo 'pakrāmanti pāpīyān bhavati ya etayā stute ||
children.translated_text: One should make it for the man whom he hates. Just as one would blow away with a bellows whose mouth is turned downward, so he blows away the sacrificer's cattle. The <s>viṣṭuti</s> is one that goes away; by it the sacrificer's cattle go away. He who praises with it becomes worse off.

children.text: saptabhyo hiṅ karoti sa tisṛbhiḥ sa tisṛbhiḥ sa ekayā saptabhyo hiṅ karoti sa ekayā sa tisṛbhiḥ sa tisṛbhiḥ saptabhyo hiṅ karoti sa tisṛbhiḥ sa ekayā sa tisṛbhiḥ saptasaptiny ekaviṃśasya viṣṭutiḥ
children.translated_text: He makes the <s>hiṅ</s> for seven: that with three, that with three, that with one. He makes the <s>hiṅ</s> for seven: that with one, that with three, that with three. He makes the <s>hiṅ</s> for seven: that with three, that with one, that with three. This is the seven-by-seven <s>viṣṭuti</s> of the <s>ekaviṃśa</s> (twenty-onefold stoma).

children.text: sapta grāmyāḥ paśavas tān etayā spṛṇoti sapta śirasi prāṇāḥ prāṇā indriyāṇīndriyāṇy evaitayāpnoti
children.translated_text: There are seven domestic animals; with this he secures them. There are seven vital breaths in the head; the vital breaths are the faculties. With this he obtains the faculties.

children.text: eṣā vai pratiṣṭhitaikaviṃśasya viṣṭutiḥ pratitiṣṭhati ya etayā stute ||
children.translated_text: This indeed is the established <s>viṣṭuti</s> of the <s>ekaviṃśa</s>; he who praises with it becomes established.

children.text: pañcabhyo hiṅ karoti sa tisṛbhiḥ sa ekayā sa ekayā saptabhyo hiṅ karoti sa ekayā sa tisṛbhiḥ sa tisṛbhir navabhyo hiṅ karoti sa tisṛbhiḥ sa tisṛbhiḥ sa tisṛbhir udyaty ekaviṃśasya viṣṭutiḥ
children.translated_text: He makes the <s>hiṅ</s> for five: that with three, that with one, that with one. He makes the <s>hiṅ</s> for seven: that with one, that with three, that with three. He makes the <s>hiṅ</s> for nine: that with three, that with three, that with three. This is the ascending <s>viṣṭuti</s> of the <s>ekaviṃśa</s>.

children.text: etayā vai devāḥ svargaṃ lokam āyan svargakāmaḥ stuvīta svargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai svargāllokān na cyavate tuṣṭuvāno 'bhikrāmantī viṣṭutir abhikrāntyā evābhikrāntena hi yajñasyardhnoti tasmād etayā stotavyam ṛddhyā eva
children.translated_text: By this, indeed, the gods went to the heavenly world. One who desires heaven should have the praise sung with it, for the attainment of the heavenly world. Praising, he does not fall from the heavenly worlds. The <s>viṣṭuti</s> (extended chant-pattern) is an advancing one; by advancing, indeed, he advances, for by what has been advanced he prospers in the sacrifice. Therefore this should be sung, precisely for prosperity.

children.text: saiṣā trivṛt prāyaṇā trivṛd udayanā yat trivṛd bahiṣpavamānaṃ bhavati navaitā ekaviṃśasyottamā bhavanti prāṇā vai trivṛt prāṇān eva tad ubhayato dadhāti tasmād ayam ardhabhāgavāk prāṇa uttareṣāṃ prāṇānāṃ sarvam āyur eti na purāyuṣaḥ pramīyate ya etayā stute
children.translated_text: This one has the <s>Trivṛt</s> as its going forth and the <s>Trivṛt</s> as its rising. Since the <s>Bahiṣpavamāna</s> is <s>Trivṛt</s>, these nine become the final parts of the <s>Ekaviṃśa</s>. The <s>Trivṛt</s> is breath; thus he places breaths on both sides. Therefore this breath, having a half-share among the later breaths, reaches a full lifetime; he who is praised with this does not die before the end of life.

children.text: tām etāṃ kradviṣa upāsate tasmāt te sarvam āyur yanti ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Kradviṣas</s> attend upon this one; therefore they reach a full lifetime.

children.text: navabhyo hiṅ karoti sa tisṛbhiḥ sa tisṛbhiḥ sa tisṛbhiḥ pañcabhyo hiṅ karoti sa ekayā sa tisṛbhiḥ sa ekayā saptabhyo hiṅ karoti sa tisṛbhiḥ sa ekayā sa tisṛbhiḥ pratiṣṭutiḥ
children.translated_text: He makes the <s>hiṅ</s> for nine: with three, with three, and with three. He makes the <s>hiṅ</s> for five: with one, with three, and with one. He makes the <s>hiṅ</s> for seven: with three, with one, and with three. This is the <s>pratiṣṭuti</s> (responsive praise).

children.text: navabhis trivṛtaṃ pratiṣṭauti pañcabhiḥ pañcabhiḥ pañcadaśaṃ saptabhiḥ saptadaśaṃ svayam ekaviṃśaḥ sampannaḥ
children.translated_text: With nine he performs the <s>pratiṣṭuti</s> of the <s>Trivṛt</s>; with five and five, that of the <s>Pañcadaśa</s>; with seven, that of the <s>Saptadaśa</s>. He himself is completed as the <s>Ekaviṃśa</s>.

children.text: sa eva stomā yajñaṃ vahanti tān uttame stotre saṃtarpayati yathānaḍuho vāśvān vāśvatarān vohuṣaḥ saṃtarpayed evam etad uttame stotre stomān saṃtarpayati tṛpyati prajayā paśubhir ya etayā stute
children.translated_text: Those very <s>stomas</s> carry the sacrifice. He satisfies them in the final <s>stotra</s>, just as one would satisfy draught oxen, horses, or mules that have carried a load. In this way he satisfies the <s>stomas</s> in the final <s>stotra</s>. He for whom this is sung is satisfied with offspring and cattle.

children.text: etām eva purodhākāmāya kuryād brahma vai trivṛt kṣatram ekaviṃśo yat trivṛtaikaviṃśaṃ pratipadyate brahma tat kṣatrasya purastān nidadhāti gacchati purodhāṃ na purodhāyāś cyavate ya etayā stute
children.translated_text: One should perform this very one for a man who desires the office of <s>purodhā</s> (domestic priest). The <s>Trivṛt</s> is <s>brahman</s> (priestly power), and the <s>Ekaviṃśa</s> is <s>kṣatra</s> (royal power). When he approaches the <s>Trivṛt</s> and <s>Ekaviṃśa</s>, he places <s>brahman</s> before <s>kṣatra</s>. He attains the office of <s>purodhā</s> and does not fall away from that office, he for whom this is sung.

children.text: tām etāṃ prāvāhaṇya upāsate tasmāt te purodhāyā na cyavanta ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Prāvāhaṇyas</s> attend upon this one; therefore they do not fall away from the office of <s>purodhā</s>.

children.text: navabhyo hiṅ karoti sa tisṛbhiḥ sa tisṛbhiḥ sa tisṛbhis tisṛbhyo hiṅ karoti sa parācībhir navabhyo hiṅ karoti sa tisṛbhiḥ sa tisṛbhiḥ sa tisṛbhiḥ sūrmy ubhayata ādīptā
children.translated_text: He makes the <s>hiṅ</s> for nine: with three, with three, and with three. He makes the <s>hiṅ</s> for three: with verses turned away. He makes the <s>hiṅ</s> for nine: with three, with three, and with three. This is a firebrand kindled at both ends.

children.text: brahmavarcasakāmaḥ stuvīta tejo vai trivṛt tryakṣaraḥ puruṣo yat trivṛtāv abhito bhavatas tisro madhye yathā hi hiraṇyaṃ niṣṭaped evam enaṃ trivṛtau niṣṭapatas tejase brahmavarcasāya
children.translated_text: One who desires <s>brahmavarcasa</s> (sacred radiance) should have the praise sung. The <s>Trivṛt</s> is brilliance, and the word <s>puruṣa</s> is three-syllabled. Since there are two <s>Trivṛts</s> on both sides and three in the middle, just as one would heat gold, so the two <s>Trivṛts</s> heat him for brilliance, for <s>brahmavarcasa</s>.

children.text: apaśavyeva tu vā īśvarā paśūn nirdahaḥ kilāsattvān nūbhayamati hi niṣṭapataḥ
children.translated_text: But it is, as it were, unfavorable to cattle; it is liable to burn up the cattle and to produce a spotted affliction, for it heats excessively on both sides.

children.text: etām evābhiśasyamānāya kuryācchamalaṃ vā etam ṛcchati yam aślīlā vāg ṛcchati yaivainam asāv aślīlaṃ vāg vadati tām asya trivṛtau niṣṭapatas tejasvī bhavati ya etayā stute ||
children.translated_text: One should perform this very one for a man who is being cursed. Defilement befalls the man whom foul speech befalls. Whatever foul speech that person speaks against him, the two <s>Trivṛts</s> burn it away for him. He for whom this is sung becomes brilliant.

children.text: Chapter 3
navabhyo hiṅ karoti sa tisṛbhiḥ sa pañcabhiḥ sa ekayā navabhyo hiṅ karoti sa ekayā sa tisṛbhiḥ sa pañcabhir navabhyo hiṅ karoti sa pañcabhiḥ sa ekayā sa tisṛbhiḥ
children.translated_text: He makes the <s>hiṅ</s> for nine: with three, with five, and with one. He makes the <s>hiṅ</s> for nine: with one, with three, and with five. He makes the <s>hiṅ</s> for nine: with five, with one, and with three.

children.text: vajro vai triṇavo vajram eva tad vyūhati śāntyai
children.translated_text: The <s>Triṇava</s> is a thunderbolt; he thereby spreads out the thunderbolt itself, for pacification.

children.text: pañcabhir vihitaikā paricarā pāṅktāḥ paśavo yajamānaḥ paricarā yat pañcabhir vidadhāty ekā paricarā bhavati yajamānam eva tat paśuṣu pratiṣṭhāpayaty eṣā vai pratiṣṭhitā triṇavasya viṣṭutiḥ pratitiṣṭhati ya etayā stute ||
children.translated_text: When it is arranged with fives, one is the <s>paricarā</s> (attendant element). Cattle are fivefold, and the sacrificer is the attendant element. Since he arranges it with fives and one becomes the attendant element, he thereby establishes the sacrificer among cattle. This is the established <s>viṣṭuti</s> of the <s>Triṇava</s>. He for whom this is sung becomes established.

children.text: saptabhyo hiṅ karoti sa tisṛbhiḥ sa ekayā navabhyo hiṅ karoti sa ekayā sa tisṛbhiḥ sa pañcabhir ekādaśabhyo hiṅ karoti sa pañcabhiḥ sa tisṛbhiḥ sa tisṛbhir udyatī triṇavasya viṣṭutiḥ
children.translated_text: He makes the <s>hiṅ</s> for seven: with three and with one. He makes the <s>hiṅ</s> for nine: with one, with three, and with five. He makes the <s>hiṅ</s> for eleven: with five, with three, and with three. This is the rising <s>viṣṭuti</s> of the <s>Triṇava</s>.

children.text: etayā vai devāḥ svargaṃ lokam āyan svargakāmaḥ stuvīta svargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai svargāllokānna cyavate tuṣṭuvāno 'bhikrāmantī viṣṭutir abhikrāntyā evābhikrāntena hi yajñasyardhnoti tasmād etayā stotavyam ṛddhyā eva ||
children.translated_text: By this, indeed, the gods went to the heavenly world. One who desires heaven should have the praise sung with it, for the attainment of the heavenly world. Praising, he does not fall from the heavenly worlds. The <s>viṣṭuti</s> is an advancing one; by advancing, indeed, he advances, for by what has been advanced he prospers in the sacrifice. Therefore this should be sung, precisely for prosperity.

children.text: ekādaśabhyo hiṅ karoti sa tisṛbhiḥ sa saptabhiḥ sa ekayaikādaśabhyo hiṅ karoti sa ekayā sa tisṛbhiḥ sa saptabhir ekādaśabhyo hiṅ karoti sa saptabhiḥ sa ekayā sa tisṛbhiḥ
children.translated_text: He makes the <s>hiṅ</s> for eleven: with three, with seven, and with one. He makes the <s>hiṅ</s> for eleven: with one, with three, and with seven. He makes the <s>hiṅ</s> for eleven: with seven, with one, and with three.

children.text: anto vai trayastriṃśaḥ paramo vai trayastriṃśa stomānāṃ saptabhir vihitaikā paricarā sapta grāmyāḥ paśavo yajamānaḥ paricarā yat saptabhir vidadhāty ekā paricarā bhavati yajamānam eva tad antataḥ paśuṣu pratiṣṭhāpayaty eṣā vai pratiṣṭhitā trayastriṃśasya viṣṭutiḥ pratitiṣṭhati ya etayā stute ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Trayastriṃśa</s> is the end; the <s>Trayastriṃśa</s> is the highest of the <s>stomas</s>. When it is arranged with sevens, one is the <s>paricarā</s>. There are seven domestic animals, and the sacrificer is the attendant element. Since he arranges it with sevens and one becomes the attendant element, he thereby establishes the sacrificer at the end among cattle. This is the established <s>viṣṭuti</s> of the <s>Trayastriṃśa</s>. He for whom this is sung becomes established.

children.text: ekādaśabhyo hiṅ karoti sa tisṛbhiḥ sa pañcabhiḥ sa tisṛbhir ekādaśabhyo hiṅ karoti sa tisṛbhiḥ sa tisṛbhiḥ sa pañcabhir ekādaśabhyo hiṅ karoti sa pañcabhiḥ sa tisṛbhiḥ sa tisṛbhir nedīyaḥsaṃkramā
children.translated_text: He makes the <s>hiṅ</s> for eleven: with three, with five, and with three. He makes the <s>hiṅ</s> for eleven: with three, with three, and with five. He makes the <s>hiṅ</s> for eleven: with five, with three, and with three. This is the nearer-crossing pattern.

children.text: anto vai trayastriṃśo yathā mahāvṛkṣasyāgraṃ sṛptvā nedīyaḥsaṃkramāt saṃkrāmaty evam etan nedīyaḥsaṃkramayā nedīyaḥsaṃkramāt saṃkrāmati
children.translated_text: The <s>Trayastriṃśa</s> is the end. Just as, after climbing to the top of a great tree, one crosses over by a nearer crossing, so by this nearer-crossing pattern he crosses over from the nearer crossing.

children.text: pañcabhir vihitās tisraḥ paricarāḥ pāṅktāḥ paśava etāvān puruṣo yadātmā prajā jāyā yat pañcabhir vidadhāti tisraḥ paricarā bhavanti yajamānam eva tat paśuṣu pratiṣṭhāpayati paśumān bhavati ya etayā stute ||
children.translated_text: Arranged by fives, there are three <s>paricarās</s> (recurrent turns). Cattle are fivefold. A person is of this extent: the self, offspring, and wife. When he arranges it by fives and there are three <s>paricarās</s>, he thereby establishes the sacrificer among cattle. He who is praised with this becomes possessed of cattle.

children.text: navabhyo hiṅ karoti sa tisṛbhiḥ sa pañcabhiḥ sa ekayaikādaśabhyo hiṅ karoti sa ekayā sa tisṛbhiḥ sa saptabhis trayodaśabhyo hiṅ karoti sa saptabhiḥ sa tisṛbhir udyatī trayastriṃśasya viṣṭutiḥ
children.translated_text: For nine verses he makes the <s>hiṅ</s>: with three, with five, and with one. For eleven verses he makes the <s>hiṅ</s>: with one, with three, and with seven. For thirteen verses he makes the <s>hiṅ</s>: with seven and with three. This is the rising <s>viṣṭuti</s> (arrangement of praise) of the <s>Trayastriṃśa</s> (thirty-threefold stoma).

children.text: etayā vai devāḥ svargaṃ lokam āyan svargakāmaḥ stuvīta svargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai svargāllokānna cyavate tuṣṭuvāno 'grād agraṃ rohaty abhikrāmantī viṣṭutir abhikrāntyā evābhikrāntena hi yajñasyardhnoti tasmādetayā stotavyam ṛddhyā eva ||
children.translated_text: By this the gods went to the heavenly world. One who desires heaven should be praised with it, for the complete attainment of the heavenly world. While praising, he does not fall away from the heavenly world. The <s>viṣṭuti</s> climbs from summit to summit. For by the very advance of the advancing one he prospers in the sacrifice. Therefore one should perform the chant with this, precisely for prosperity.

children.text: trayodaśabhyo hiṅ karoti sa tisṛbhiḥ sa pañcabhiḥ sa pañcabhir ekādaśabhyo hiṅ karoti sa pañcabhiḥ sa tisṛbhiḥ sa tisṛbhir navabhyo hiṅ karoti sa tisṛbhiḥ sa tisṛbhiḥ sa tisṛbhiḥ pratyavarohiṇī trayastriṃśasya viṣṭutiḥ
children.translated_text: For thirteen verses he makes the <s>hiṅ</s>: with three, with five, and with five. For eleven verses he makes the <s>hiṅ</s>: with five, with three, and with three. For nine verses he makes the <s>hiṅ</s>: with three, with three, and with three. This is the descending <s>viṣṭuti</s> of the <s>Trayastriṃśa</s>.

children.text: yathā mahāvṛkṣasyāgraṃ sṛptvā śākhāyāḥ śākhām ālambham upāvarohed evam etayemaṃ lokam upāvarohati pratiṣṭhityai
children.translated_text: As, after climbing to the top of a great tree, one would come down by taking hold of branch after branch, so by this he descends to this world, for firm establishment.

children.text: trivṛtā praiti trivṛtodeti prāṇā vai trivṛt prāṇenaiva praiti prāṇam abhyudeti sarvam āyur eti na purāyuṣaḥ pramīyate ya etayā stute
children.translated_text: With the <s>Trivṛt</s> he goes forth; with the <s>Trivṛt</s> he rises up. Breath is indeed the <s>Trivṛt</s>. By breath he goes forth, and he rises up to breath. He attains his full lifespan and does not die before the end of life, he who is praised with this.

children.text: tām etāṃ karadviṣa upāsate tasmāt te sarvam āyur yanti ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Karadviṣas</s> practice this form. Therefore they attain their full lifespan.

children.text: pañcadaśabhyo hiṅ karoti sa tisṛbhiḥ sa pañcabhir ekādaśabhyo hiṅ karoti sa pañcabhiḥ sa tisṛbhiḥ sa tisṛbhiḥ saptabhyo hiṅ karoti sa tisṛbhiḥ sa ekayā sa tisṛbhiḥ
children.translated_text: For fifteen verses he makes the <s>hiṅ</s>: with three and with five. For eleven verses he makes the <s>hiṅ</s>: with five, with three, and with three. For seven verses he makes the <s>hiṅ</s>: with three, with one, and with three.

children.text: yo vai trayastriṃśam ekaviṃśe pratiṣṭhitaṃ veda pratitiṣṭhati pratiṣṭhā vā ekaviṃśaḥ stomānāṃ yad etāḥ sapta trayastriṃśasyottamā bhavanti saptavidhaikaviṃśasya viṣṭutir ekaviṃśa eva tat trayastriṃśaṃ pratiṣṭhāpayati pratitiṣṭhati ya etayā stute ||
children.translated_text: He who knows the <s>Trayastriṃśa</s> established in the <s>Ekaviṃśa</s> gains firm standing. The <s>Ekaviṃśa</s> is indeed the foundation among the <s>stomas</s>. Since these seven are the last part of the <s>Trayastriṃśa</s>, this is the sevenfold <s>viṣṭuti</s> of the <s>Ekaviṃśa</s>; thereby he establishes the <s>Trayastriṃśa</s> in the <s>Ekaviṃśa</s>. He who is praised with this gains firm standing.

children.text: aṣṭābhyo hiṅ karoti sa tisṛbhiḥ sa catasṛbhiḥ sa ekayāṣṭābhyo hiṅ karoti sa ekayā sa tisṛbhiḥ sa catasṛbhir aṣṭābhyo hiṅ karoti sa catasṛbhiḥ sa ekayā sa tisṛbhiḥ
children.translated_text: For eight verses he makes the <s>hiṅ</s>: with three, with four, and with one. For eight verses he makes the <s>hiṅ</s>: with one, with three, and with four. For eight verses he makes the <s>hiṅ</s>: with four, with one, and with three.

children.text: paśavo vai chandogā yad aṣṭābhyo 'ṣṭābhyo hiṅ karoti aṣṭāśaphāḥ paśavaḥ śaphaśas tat paśūn āpnoti
children.translated_text: The <s>chandogas</s> (Sāman-chanters) are cattle. When he makes the <s>hiṅ</s> for eight and eight verses, cattle have eight hoofs; hoof by hoof he obtains cattle.

children.text: catasṛbhir vihitaikā paricarā catuṣpādāḥ paśavo yajamānaḥ paricarā yaccatasṛbhir vidadhātyekā paricarā bhavati yajamānam eva tat paśuṣu pratiṣṭhāpayaty eṣā vai pratiṣṭhitā caturviṃśasya viṣṭutiḥ pratitiṣṭhati ya etayā stute ||
children.translated_text: Arranged by fours, there is one <s>paricarā</s>. Cattle are four-footed, and the sacrificer is the <s>paricarā</s>. When he arranges it with four and one <s>paricarā</s> results, he thereby establishes the sacrificer among cattle. This indeed is the firmly established <s>viṣṭuti</s> of the <s>Caturviṃśa</s> (twenty-fourfold stoma). He who is praised with this gains firm standing.

children.text: pañcadaśabhyo hiṅ karoti sa tisṛbhiḥ sa ekādaśabhiḥ sa ekayā caturdaśabhyo hiṅ karoti sa ekayā sa tisṛbhiḥ sa daśabhiḥ pañcadaśabhyo hiṅ karoti sa ekādaśabhiḥ sa ekayā sa tisṛbhiḥ
children.translated_text: For fifteen verses he makes the <s>hiṅ</s>: with three, with eleven, and with one. For fourteen verses he makes the <s>hiṅ</s>: with one, with three, and with ten. For fifteen verses he makes the <s>hiṅ</s>: with eleven, with one, and with three.

children.text: brahmaṇo vā āyatanaṃ prathamā kṣatrasya madhyamā viśa uttamā yat pañcadaśinyau pūrve bhavataś caturdaśottamā brahmaṇi caiva tat kṣatre caujo vīryaṃ dadhāti brahmaṇe caiva tat kṣatrāya ca viśam anugāṃ karoti kṣatrasyevāsya prakāśo bhavati ya etayā stute
children.translated_text: The first is the seat of <s>brahman</s> (sacred authority), the middle one of <s>kṣatra</s> (royal power), and the last of the <s>viś</s> (common people). Since the two former are fifteenfold and the last is fourteenfold, he thereby places force and vigor in <s>brahman</s> and <s>kṣatra</s>, and thereby makes the <s>viś</s> subordinate to <s>brahman</s> and <s>kṣatra</s>. He who is praised with this has the manifestation of <s>kṣatra</s>.

children.text: astomā vā ete yacchandogā ayujo hi stomā yugmanti chandāṃsi yad eṣā yujinī catuścatvāriṃśasya viṣṭutis tenāstomāḥ
children.translated_text: These are without a <s>stoma</s>, namely the <s>chandogas</s>; for the <s>stomas</s> are odd, while the metres go in pairs. Since this is the even <s>viṣṭuti</s> of the <s>Catuścatvāriṃśa</s> (forty-fourfold stoma), by that they are without a <s>stoma</s>.

children.text: eṣā vai pratiṣṭhitā catuścatvāriṃśasya viṣṭutiḥ pratitiṣṭhati ya etayā stute ||
children.translated_text: This indeed is the firmly established <s>viṣṭuti</s> of the <s>Catuścatvāriṃśa</s>. He who is praised with this gains firm standing.

children.text: caturdaśabhyo hiṅ karoti sa tisṛbhiḥ sa daśabhiḥ sa ekayā pañcadaśabhyo hiṅ karoti sa ekayā sa tisṛbhiḥ sa ekādaśabhiḥ pañcadaśabhyo hiṅ karoti sa ekādaśabhiḥ sa ekayā sa tisṛbhir nirmadhyā
children.translated_text: For fourteen verses he makes the <s>hiṅ</s>: with three, with ten, and with one. For fifteen verses he makes the <s>hiṅ</s>: with one, with three, and with eleven. For fifteen verses he makes the <s>hiṅ</s>: with eleven, with one, and with three. It is without a middle.

children.text: astīva vā ayaṃ loko 'stīvāsau chidram ivedam antarikṣaṃ yad eṣā nirmadhyā bhavatīmān eva lokān anuprajāyate pra prajayā pra paśubhir jāyate ya etayā stute
children.translated_text: This world exists, as it were, and that world exists, as it were; this midspace is like a gap. Since this <s>viṣṭuti</s> is without a middle, he is born forth after these worlds. He is born forth with offspring and forth with cattle, he who is praised with this.

children.text: pañcadaśabhyo hiṅ karoti sa tisṛbhiḥ sa ekādaśabhiḥ sa ekayā pañcadaśabhyo hiṅ karoti sa ekayā sa tisṛbhiḥ sa ekādaśabhiḥ caturdaśabhyo hiṅ karoti sa daśabhiḥ sa ekayā sa tisṛbhiḥ
children.translated_text: For fifteen verses he makes the <s>hiṅ</s>: with three, with eleven, and with one. For fifteen verses he makes the <s>hiṅ</s>: with one, with three, and with eleven. For fourteen verses he makes the <s>hiṅ</s>: with ten, with one, and with three.

children.text: ājyānāṃ prathamā pṛṣṭhānāṃ dvitīyokthānāṃ tṛtīyā
children.translated_text: The first belongs to the <s>Ājyas</s>, the second to the <s>Pṛṣṭhas</s>, and the third to the <s>Ukthas</s>.

children.text: yājyānāṃ sā hotur yā pṛṣṭhānāṃ sā maitrāvaruṇasya yokthānāṃ sā brāhmaṇācchaṃsino yaiva hotuḥ sācchāvākasya yā pṛṣṭhānāṃ sa hotur yokthānāṃ sā maitrāvaruṇasya yājyānāṃ sā brāhmaṇācchaṃsino yaiva hotuḥ sācchāvākasya yokthānāṃ sā hotur yājyānāṃ sā maitrāvaruṇasya yā pṛṣṭhānāṃ brāhmaṇācchaṃsino yaiva hotuḥ sācchāvākasya sarvā ājyeṣu sarvāḥ pṛṣṭheṣu sarvā uktheṣu
children.translated_text: The one among the <s>yājyās</s> belongs to the <s>Hotṛ</s>; the one among the <s>pṛṣṭhas</s> belongs to the <s>Maitrāvaruṇa</s>; the one among the <s>ukthas</s> belongs to the <s>Brāhmaṇācchaṃsin</s>; the very one that belongs to the <s>Hotṛ</s> belongs to the <s>Acchāvāka</s>. The one among the <s>pṛṣṭhas</s> belongs to the <s>Hotṛ</s>; the one among the <s>ukthas</s> belongs to the <s>Maitrāvaruṇa</s>; the one among the <s>yājyās</s> belongs to the <s>Brāhmaṇācchaṃsin</s>; the very one that belongs to the <s>Hotṛ</s> belongs to the <s>Acchāvāka</s>. The one among the <s>ukthas</s> belongs to the <s>Hotṛ</s>; the one among the <s>yājyās</s> belongs to the <s>Maitrāvaruṇa</s>; the one among the <s>pṛṣṭhas</s> belongs to the <s>Brāhmaṇācchaṃsin</s>; the very one that belongs to the <s>Hotṛ</s> belongs to the <s>Acchāvāka</s>. All are in the <s>ājya</s> chants, all in the <s>pṛṣṭha</s> chants, all in the <s>ukthas</s>.

children.text: paśavo vai samīṣantī yad eṣā sarvāṇi savanāny anusaṃcaratyanusavanam evainaṃ paśubhiḥ samardhayati paśuman bhavati ya etayā stute ||
children.translated_text: Cattle, indeed, come together. Since this one passes through all the pressings, at each pressing he enriches him with cattle. He becomes possessed of cattle who is praised with this.

children.text: ṣoḍaśabhyo hiṅ karoti sa tisṛbhiḥ sa dvādaśabhiḥ sa ekayā ṣoḍaśabhyo hiṅ karoti sa ekayā sa tisṛbhiḥ sa dvādaśabhiḥ ṣoḍaśabhyo hiṅ karoti sa dvādaśabhiḥ sa ekayā sa tisṛbhiḥ
children.translated_text: For sixteen he makes the <s>hiṅ</s>: one set with three, one with twelve, and one with one. For sixteen he makes the <s>hiṅ</s>: one with one, one with three, and one with twelve. For sixteen he makes the <s>hiṅ</s>: one with twelve, one with one, and one with three.

children.text: anto vā aṣṭācatvāriṃśaḥ paśavaś chandogā yat ṣoḍaśabhyaḥ ṣoḍaśabhyo hiṅ karoti ṣoḍaśakalāḥ paśavaḥ kalāśas tat paśūn āpnoti
children.translated_text: The <s>Aṣṭācatvāriṃśa</s> is an end. The <s>Chandogas</s>, the chant-singers, are cattle. Since he makes the <s>hiṅ</s> for sixteen and sixteen, and cattle have sixteen parts, by those parts he obtains cattle.

children.text: dvādaśabhir vihitaikā paricarā dvādaśamāsāḥ saṃvatsaro yajamānaḥ paricarā yad dvādaśabhir vidadhāty ekā paricarā bhavati yajamānam eva tad antatas saṃvatsare paśuṣu pratiṣṭhāpayaty eṣā vai pratiṣṭhitāṣṭācatvāriṃśasya viṣṭutiḥ pratitiṣṭhati ya etayā stute ||
children.translated_text: It is arranged with twelve; one is the <s>paricarā</s> (attendant element). The year has twelve months; the sacrificer is the <s>paricarā</s>. When he arranges it with twelve and one becomes the <s>paricarā</s>, thereby at the end he establishes the sacrificer in the year among the cattle. This, indeed, is the firmly established <s>viṣṭuti</s> of the <s>Aṣṭācatvāriṃśa</s>; he who is praised with this gains firm standing.

children.text: ṣoḍaśabhyo hiṅ karoti sa tisṛbhiḥ sa daśabhiḥ sa tisṛbhiḥ ṣoḍaśabhyo hiṅ karoti sa tisṛbhiḥ sa tisṛbhiḥ sa daśabhiḥ ṣoḍaśabhyo hiṅ karoti sa daśabhiḥ sa tisṛbhiḥ sa tisṛbhir nedīyaḥsaṃkramā
children.translated_text: For sixteen he makes the <s>hiṅ</s>: one set with three, one with ten, and one with three. For sixteen he makes the <s>hiṅ</s>: one with three, one with three, and one with ten. For sixteen he makes the <s>hiṅ</s>: one with ten, one with three, and one with three. This is the <s>nedīyaḥsaṃkramā</s> (nearer-transition) arrangement.

children.text: anto vā aṣṭācatvāriṃśo yathā mahāvṛkṣasyāgraṃ sṛptvā nedīyaḥsaṃkramāt saṃkrāmaty evam etan nedīyaḥsaṃkramayā nedīyaḥsaṃkramāt saṃkrāmati
children.translated_text: The <s>Aṣṭācatvāriṃśa</s> is an end. Just as, after climbing to the top of a great tree, one crosses over from a nearer point of passage, so by this <s>nedīyaḥsaṃkramā</s> he crosses over from a nearer point of passage.

children.text: daśabhir vihitā tisraḥ paricarā daśākṣarā virāḍ etāvān puruṣo yad ātmā prajā jāyā yad daśabhir vidadhāti tisraḥ paricarā bhavanti yajamānam eva tad virājy annādye 'ntataḥ pratiṣṭhāpayatyannādo bhavati ya etayā stute ||
children.translated_text: It is arranged with ten; three are the <s>paricarās</s>. The <s>Virāj</s> has ten syllables. A person is just this much: self, offspring, and wife. When he arranges it with ten and three <s>paricarās</s> result, thereby at the end he establishes the sacrificer in the <s>Virāj</s>, in the eating of food. He becomes an eater of food who is praised with this.

children.text: Chapter 4
