gāvo vā etat sattram āsata tāsāṃ daśasu māssu śṛṅgāṇy ajāyanta tā abruvannarāḥ smottiṣṭhāmopaśā no 'jñateti tā udatiṣṭhan
children.translated_text: Cows once sat down to this <s>sattra</s> (sacrificial session). Their horns were born in ten months. They said, 'We have attained it; let us rise. Our desire has been fulfilled.' Then they rose up.

children.text: tāsāṃ tv evābruvann āsāmahā evemau dvādaśau māsau saṃsaṃvatsaram āpayāmeti tāsāṃ dvādaśasu māḥsu śṛṅgāṇi prāvartanta tāḥ sarvam annādyam āpnuvaṃs tā etās tūparās tasmāt tāḥ sarvān dvādaśamāsaḥ prerate sarvaṃ hi tā annādyam āpnuvan
children.translated_text: But some of them said, 'Let us remain seated through these two months also; let us bring the year to completion.' In twelve months their horns turned back, and they obtained all food for eating. These are those <s>tūparās</s> (cows with turned-back or blunted horns). Therefore they go on through all twelve months, for they obtained all food for eating.

children.text: sarvam annādyam āpnoti ya evaṃ veda
children.translated_text: He obtains all food for eating who knows thus.

children.text: prajāpatir vā idam eka āsīt so 'kāmayata bahu syāṃ prajāyeyeti sa etam atirātram apaśyat tam āharat tenāhorātre prājanayat
children.translated_text: <s>Prajāpati</s> alone was this universe. He desired, 'May I become many; may I be propagated.' He saw this <s>Atirātra</s>; he brought it, and with it he generated day and night.

children.text: yad eṣo 'tirātro bhavaty ahorātre eva prajanayanty ahorātrayoḥ pratitiṣṭhanty etāvān vāva saṃvatsaro yad ahaśca rātriś cāhorātrābhyām eva tat saṃvvatsaram āpnuvanti
children.translated_text: When this <s>Atirātra</s> takes place, they generate day and night and establish themselves in day and night. For this much indeed is the year, namely day and night; through day and night they thereby obtain the year.

children.text: yaj jyotiṣṭomo bhavati yajñamukhaṃ tad ṛdhnuvanti yad uktho yajñakrator anantarayāya yad rātriḥ sarvasyāptyai
children.translated_text: When it is a <s>Jyotiṣṭoma</s>, thereby they prosper in the opening of the sacrifice; when it is an <s>Uktha</s>, it is for the non-interruption of the sacrificial performance; when it is night, it is for the attainment of everything.

children.text: sa etān stomān apaśyat jyotir gaur aur itīme vai lokā ete stomā ayam eva jyotir ayaṃ madhyamo gaur asāvuttama āyuḥ
children.translated_text: He saw these <s>stomas</s>: <s>Jyotis</s>, <s>Go</s>, and <s>Āyus</s>. These worlds are these <s>stomas</s>: this one here is <s>Jyotis</s>, this middle one is <s>Go</s>, and that highest one is <s>Āyus</s>.

children.text: yad ete stomā bhavantīmān eva lokān prajanayanty eṣu lokeṣu pratitiṣṭhanti
children.translated_text: When these <s>stomas</s> occur, they generate these worlds and establish themselves in these worlds.

children.text: sa etaṃ tryahaṃ punaḥ prāyuṅkta tena ṣaḍahena ṣaṭkratūn prājanayat
children.translated_text: He applied this three-day rite again; by that six-day rite he generated the six seasons.

children.text: yad eṣa ṣaḍaho bhavati ṛtūn eva prajanayanti ṛtuṣu pratitiṣṭhanti
children.translated_text: When this <s>ṣaḍaha</s> occurs, they generate the seasons and establish themselves in the seasons.

children.text: sa etaṃ ṣaḍahaṃ punaḥ prāyuṅkta tābhyāṃ dvābhyāṃ ṣaḍahābhyāṃ dvādaśamāsaḥ prājanayat
children.translated_text: He applied this <s>ṣaḍaha</s> again; with those two <s>ṣaḍahas</s> he generated twelve months.

children.text: yad etau ṣaḍahau bhavato māsān eva prajanayanti māseṣu pratitiṣṭhanti
children.translated_text: When these two <s>ṣaḍahas</s> occur, they generate the months and establish themselves in the months.

children.text: sa etau dvau ṣaḍahau punaḥ prāyuṅkta taiś caturbhiḥ ṣaḍahaiścaturviṃśatim ardhamāsān prājanayat
children.translated_text: He applied these two <s>ṣaḍahas</s> again; with those four <s>ṣaḍahas</s> he generated twenty-four half-months.

children.text: yad ete catvāraḥ ṣaḍahā bhavantyardhamāsān eva prajanayantyardhamāseṣu pratitiṣṭhanti
children.translated_text: When these four <s>ṣaḍahas</s> occur, they generate the half-months and establish themselves in the half-months.

children.text: sa idaṃ bhuvanaṃ prajanayitvā pṛṣṭhyena ṣaḍahena vīryam ātmanyadhatta
children.translated_text: Having generated this world, he placed vigor in himself by means of the <s>Pṛṣṭhya ṣaḍaha</s>.

children.text: yad eṣaḥ pṛṣṭhyaḥ ṣaḍaho bhavati vīrya evāntataḥ pratitiṣṭhanti
children.translated_text: When this <s>Pṛṣṭhya ṣaḍaha</s> occurs, they finally establish themselves in vigor.

children.text: tena māsān saṃvvatsaraṃ prājanayad yad eṣa māso bhavati saṃvvatsaram eva prajanayanti saṃvvatsare pratitiṣṭhanti ||
children.translated_text: With it he generated the months and the year. When this month occurs, they generate the year and establish themselves in the year.

children.text: prāyaṇīyam etad ahar bhavati
children.translated_text: This day becomes the <s>Prāyaṇīya</s> (opening) day.

children.text: prāyaṇīyena vā ahnā devāḥ svargaṃ lokaṃ prāyan yat prāyaṃs tat prāyaṇīyasya prāyaṇīyatvam
children.translated_text: For with the <s>Prāyaṇīya</s> day the gods went forth to the heavenly world. Since they went forth, that is the prāyaṇīya-ness of the <s>Prāyaṇīya</s>.

children.text: tasmāt prāyaṇīyasyāhna ṛtvijā bhavitavyam etaddhi svargasya lokasya nediṣṭhaṃ ya etasyartviṅ na bhavati hīyate svargāllokāt
children.translated_text: Therefore on the prāyaṇīya day one should serve as an <s>ṛtvij</s> (officiating priest), for this is nearest to the heavenly world. Whoever is not its <s>ṛtvij</s> is deprived of the heavenly world.

children.text: caturviṃśaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: It is twenty-fourfold.

children.text: caturviṃśatyakṣarā gāyatrī tejo brahmavarcasaṃ gāyatrī teja eva brahmavarcasam ārabhya prayanti
children.translated_text: The <s>Gāyatrī</s> has twenty-four syllables; the <s>Gāyatrī</s> is brilliance and <s>brahmavarcas</s> (sacred splendor). They set forth after taking hold of brilliance and <s>brahmavarcas</s> itself.

children.text: caturviṃśaṃ bhavati caturviṃśo vai saṃvvatsaraḥ sākṣād eva saṃvvatsaram ārabhante
children.translated_text: It is twenty-fourfold. The year indeed is twenty-fourfold; they take hold of the year directly.

children.text: yāvatyaś caturviṃśasyokthasya stotrīyās tāvatyaḥ saṃvvatsarasya rātrayaḥ stotrīyābhir eva tat saṃvvatsaram āpnuvanti
children.translated_text: As many <s>stotrīya</s> verses as there are of the twenty-fourfold <s>uktha</s>, so many are the nights of the year; by the <s>stotrīya</s> verses they thereby obtain the year.

children.text: pañcadaśastotrāṇi bhavanti pañcadaśārdhamāsasya rātrayo 'rdhamāsaśa eva tat saṃvvatsaram āpnuvanti
children.translated_text: There are fifteen <s>stotras</s>; fifteen are the nights of the half-month. Half-month by half-month they thereby obtain the year.

children.text: pañcadaśa stotrāṇi pañcadaśa śastrāṇi samāso māsaśa eva tat saṃvvatsaram āpnuvanti
children.translated_text: There are fifteen <s>stotras</s> and fifteen <s>śastras</s>; that is the sum. Month by month they thereby obtain the year.

children.text: tad āhur īrma iva vā eṣā hotrā yad acchāvākyā yad acchāvākam anusaṃtiṣṭhata īśvarermā bhavitor iti yadyukthaṃ smātraikakubhañcodvaṃśīyañcāntataḥ pratiṣṭhāpye vīryaṃ vā ete samanīvīrya evāntataḥ pratitiṣṭhanti
children.translated_text: They say, "This <s>hotrā</s> is as it were defective, namely the <s>acchāvākyā</s>; if they complete the rite by following the <s>acchāvāka</s>, it is liable to become defective." If the <s>uktha</s>, the <s>smātra</s>, the <s>ekakubha</s>, and the <s>udvaṃśīya</s> are set at the end, these are vigor; in common vigor they stand firm at the end.

children.text: atho khalvāhuragniṣṭomameva kāryameṣa vai yajñaḥ svargyo yad agniṣṭoma ūrdhvo hi hotāram anusaṃtiṣṭhate
children.translated_text: Now they also say, "The <s>Agniṣṭoma</s> alone should be performed. This, the <s>Agniṣṭoma</s>, is indeed the sacrifice that leads to heaven, for it comes to completion upward after the <s>Hotṛ</s>."

children.text: dvādaśa stotrāṇyagniṣṭomo dvādaśa māsāḥ saṃvvatsaras tena saṃvvatsarasaṃmito dvādaśa stotrāṇi dvādaśa śastrāṇi taccaturviṃśatiś caturviṃśatir ardhamāsāḥ saṃvvatsaras tena saṃvvatsarasaṃmitaḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>Agniṣṭoma</s> has twelve <s>stotras</s>; the year has twelve months, and by that it is commensurate with the year. There are twelve <s>stotras</s> and twelve <s>śastras</s>; that is twenty-four. The year has twenty-four half-months, and by that it is commensurate with the year.

children.text: atho khalvāhuruktham eva kāryam ahnaḥ samṛddhyai
children.translated_text: Now they also say, "The <s>uktha</s> itself should be performed, for the prosperity of the day."

children.text: sarvāṇi rūpāṇi kriyante sarvaṃ hyetāhnāpyate
children.translated_text: All forms are performed, for everything is obtained by this day.

children.text: pavante vājasātaye somāḥ sahasrapājasa iti sahasravatī pratipat kāryā
children.translated_text: The opening verse should contain "thousand": "The <s>Somas</s> purify themselves for the winning of strength, of thousandfold might."

children.text: saṃvvatsarasya rūpaṃ sarvam evainān etayā punāti sarvān abhivadati
children.translated_text: It is the form of the year. By this he purifies them all and addresses them all.

children.text: atho khalvāhuḥ pavasva vāco agriya ity eva kāryā mukhaṃ vā etat saṃvvatsarasya yad vāco 'graṃ mukhata eva tat saṃvvatsaram ārabhante
children.translated_text: Now they also say, "The verse beginning 'Purify thyself, foremost of speech' alone should be used." For the beginning of speech is the mouth of the year; from the mouth itself they thereby take hold of the year.

children.text: mithunam iva vā eṣā vyāhṛtiḥ pavasveti puṃso rūpaṃ vāca iti striyāḥ someti puṃso rūpaṃ citrābhir iti striyā mithunam evaibhyo yajñamukhe dadhāti prajananāya
children.translated_text: This utterance is like a pair: "purify thyself" is the form of the male, "of speech" that of the female; "Soma" is the form of the male, "with bright ones" that of the female. Thus at the opening of the sacrifice he places a pair for them, for procreation.

children.text: agne yuṅkṣvā hi ye taveti jarābodhīyam agniṣṭoma sāma kāryaṃ yuktenaiva saṃvvatsareṇa prayanti caturviṃśatyakṣarāsu bhavati caturviṃśasya rūpam
children.translated_text: The <s>Jarābodhīya</s>, the <s>Agniṣṭoma</s> <s>sāman</s> beginning "Agni, yoke those that are yours," should be used. They set forth with the year yoked. It occurs in verses of twenty-four syllables; it is the form of the twenty-fourfold stoma.

children.text: atho khalvāhuryajñāyajñīyam eva kāryam
children.translated_text: Now they also say, "The <s>Yajñāyajñīya</s> alone should be used."

children.text: panthā vai yajñāyajñīyaṃ patha eva tan na yanti ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Yajñāyajñīya</s> is a path; thereby they do not go away from the path.

children.text: abhīvarto brahmasāma bhavati
children.translated_text: The <s>Abhīvarta</s> is the <s>brahmasāman</s>.

children.text: abhīvartena vai devāḥ svargaṃ lokam abhyavartanta yad abhīvarto brahmasāma bhavati svargasya lokasyābhivṛttyai
children.translated_text: By the <s>Abhīvarta</s> the gods turned toward the heavenly world. When the <s>Abhīvarta</s> is the <s>brahmasāman</s>, it is for turning toward the heavenly world.

children.text: ekākṣaraṇidhano bhavaty ekākṣarā vai vāg vācaiva tad ārabhya svargaṃ lokaṃ yanti
children.translated_text: It has a one-syllable <s>nidhana</s> (finale). Speech indeed is one-syllabled. Taking hold by speech itself, they go to the heavenly world.

children.text: sāmneto yanty ṛcā punar āyanti
children.translated_text: From here they go by the <s>sāman</s>; by the <s>ṛc</s> they come back again.

children.text: sāma vai asau loka ṛg ayaṃ yad itaḥ sāmnā yanti svargaṃ lokam ārabhya yanti yad ṛcā punar āyantyasmin loke pratitiṣṭhanti
children.translated_text: The <s>sāman</s> is that world, and the <s>ṛc</s> is this one. When they go from here by the <s>sāman</s>, they go after taking hold of the heavenly world; when they come back again by the <s>ṛc</s>, they stand firm in this world.

children.text: yat sāmāvasṛjeyur ava svargāllokāt padyeran yad ṛcam anusṛjeyur naśyeyur asmāllokāt
children.translated_text: If they were to abandon the <s>sāman</s>, they would fall away from the heavenly world; if they were to let the <s>ṛc</s> go after it, they would perish from this world.

children.text: samānaṃ sāma bhavaty anyonyaḥ pragātho 'nyadanyaddhi citram adhvānam avagacchanneti
children.translated_text: The <s>sāman</s> is the same, while each <s>pragātha</s> is different; for, travelling over a varied road, one reaches place after different place.

children.text: vṛṣā vā eṣa retodhā yad abhīvartaḥ pragātheṣu reto dadhad eti yad itaḥ samānaṃ sāma bhavaty anyonyaḥ pragātho reta eva tad dadhati yat parastāt samānaḥ pragātho bhavatyanyadanyat sāma reta eva taddhitaṃ prajanayanti
children.translated_text: This <s>Abhīvarta</s> is a bull, a placer of seed; it goes placing seed in the <s>pragāthas</s>. When from here the <s>sāman</s> is the same and each <s>pragātha</s> is different, they thereby place seed. When afterward the <s>pragātha</s> is the same and each <s>sāman</s> is different, they generate that deposited seed.

children.text: sāmnetaḥ pragāthāṃ dugdhe pragāthena parastāt sāmāni dugdhe salomatvāya
children.translated_text: By the <s>sāman</s> from here he milks the <s>pragāthas</s>; by the <s>pragātha</s> afterward he milks the <s>sāmans</s>, so that there may be hair and full covering.

children.text: yo vā adhvānaṃ punar nivartayanti nainaṃ te gacchanti ye 'punar nivartaṃ yanti te gacchati
children.translated_text: Those who turn a road back do not reach it; those who go on a road without turning back, they reach it.

children.text: ya āstutaṃ kurvate yathā dugdhām upasīded evaṃ tat
children.translated_text: Those who make what has already been sung are like someone who would sit down beside a cow already milked.

children.text: ye nāstutaṃ yaṃ kāmaṃ kāmayante tam abhyaśnuvate
children.translated_text: Those who make what has not yet been sung attain whatever desire they desire.

children.text: brahmavādino vadanti yātayāmāḥ saṃvvatsarā3 ayātayāmā3 iti te nāyātayāmeti vaktavyaṃ punar anyāni stotrāṇi nivartanta ūrdhvam eva brahmasāmaiti ||
children.translated_text: The expounders of <s>brahman</s> ask, "Are the years exhausted, or unexhausted?" One should not say of them, "unexhausted," for other <s>stotras</s> turn back again, while the <s>brahmasāman</s> goes only upward.

children.text: pañcasu māḥsu bārhatāḥ pragāthā āpyante
children.translated_text: In five months the <s>Bārhata</s> <s>pragāthas</s> are completed.

children.text: teṣv āpteṣu chandasī saṃyujyaitavyam
children.translated_text: When they have been completed, one should proceed after joining the two metres.

children.text: tisra uṣṇihaḥ syur ekā gāyatrī tās tisro bṛhatyo bhavanti
children.translated_text: There should be three <s>Uṣṇih</s> verses and one <s>Gāyatrī</s>; these become three <s>Bṛhatī</s> verses.

children.text: tad āhuḥ saṃśara iva vā eṣa chandasāṃ yad dve chandasī saṃyuñjantīti
children.translated_text: They say, "This is as it were a commingling of metres, when they join two metres."

children.text: caturuttarair eva chandobhir etavyam
children.translated_text: One should proceed with metres increasing by four.

children.text: paśavo vai caturuttarāṇi chandāṃsi paśubhir eva tat svargaṃ lokam ākramam ānayanti
children.translated_text: The metres increasing by four are the animals; by means of animals they thereby bring about the ascent to the heavenly world.

children.text: ekaṃ gāyatrīm ekāham upeyur ekāmuṣṇiham ekāham ekām anuṣṭubham ekāhaṃ bṛhatyā pañcamāsa iyuḥ paṅktim ekāham upeyus triṣṭubhā ṣaṣṭhaṃ māsam īyuḥ śvo viṣuvān bhaviteti jagatīm upeyuḥ
children.translated_text: One day they should approach with a single <s>Gāyatrī</s>, one day with a single <s>Uṣṇih</s>, one day with a single <s>Anuṣṭubh</s>; with the <s>Bṛhatī</s> they should go through the fifth month, one day they should approach with the <s>Paṅkti</s>, with the <s>Triṣṭubh</s> they should go through the sixth month, and, thinking "tomorrow the <s>Viṣuvant</s> will be," they should approach with the <s>Jagatī</s>.

children.text: tad āhur anavakﾱptāni vā etāni chandāṃsi madhyandine bṛhatyā caiva triṣṭubhā caitavyam
children.translated_text: They say: "These meters are not properly arranged for the midday pressing; at the midday pressing one should proceed with the <s>Bṛhatī</s> and the <s>Triṣṭubh</s> only."

children.text: ete vai chandasī vīryavatī ete pratyakṣaṃ madhyandinasya rūpam
children.translated_text: These two meters are vigorous; these are visibly the form of the midday pressing.

children.text: rathantare 'hani bṛhatī kāryaitad vai rathantarasya svam āyatanaṃ yad bṛhatī sva eva tad āyatane rathantaraṃ pratitiṣṭhati bārhate 'hani triṣṭup kāryaitad vai bṛhataḥ svam āyatanaṃ yat triṣṭup sva eva tad āyatane bṛhadrathantare pratitiṣṭhantī itaḥ
children.translated_text: On the <s>Rathantara</s> day the <s>Bṛhatī</s> should be used. For the <s>Bṛhatī</s> is the proper seat of the <s>Rathantara</s>; in its own seat the <s>Rathantara</s> is thereby established. On the <s>Bārhata</s> day the <s>Triṣṭubh</s> should be used. For the <s>Triṣṭubh</s> is the proper seat of the <s>Bṛhat</s>; in its own seat the <s>Bṛhat</s> and <s>Rathantara</s> are thereby established from this point.

children.text: trayastriṃśatā pragāthair etavyaṃ trayastriṃśad devatā devatāsv eva pratitiṣṭhanto yanti caturviṃśatyaitavyaṃ caturviṃśatir ardhamāsāḥ saṃvvatsaraḥ saṃvvatsara eva pratitiṣṭhanto yanti dvādaśabhir etavyaṃ dvādaśa māsāḥ saṃvvatsaraḥ saṃvvatsara eva pratitiṣṭhanto yanti ṣaḍbhir etavyaṃ ṣaḍ ṛtava ṛtuṣv eva pratitiṣṭhanto yanti caturbhir etavyaṃ catuṣpādāḥ paśavaḥ paśuṣv eva pratitiṣṭhanto yanti tribhir etavyaṃ traya ime lokā eṣv eva lokeṣu pratitiṣṭhanto yanti dvābhyām etavyaṃ dvipād yajamānaḥ svargasya lokasyākrāntyā anyenānyena hi padā puruṣaḥ pratitiṣṭhann eti ||
children.translated_text: One should proceed with thirty-three <s>pragāthas</s>: the deities are thirty-three, and they go while establishing themselves among the deities. One should proceed with twenty-four: the half-months are twenty-four and make a year, and they go while establishing themselves in the year. One should proceed with twelve: the months are twelve and make a year, and they go while establishing themselves in the year. One should proceed with six: the seasons are six, and they go while establishing themselves in the seasons. One should proceed with four: cattle are four-footed, and they go while establishing themselves among cattle. One should proceed with three: these worlds are three, and they go while establishing themselves in these worlds. One should proceed with two: the sacrificer is two-footed, for climbing to the heavenly world; for a person goes on, gaining footing with one foot after another.

children.text: svarasāmāna ete bhavante
children.translated_text: These are <s>svarasāman</s> chants.

children.text: svarbhānur vā āsurādityaṃ tamasāvidhyat taṃ devāḥ svarair aspṛṇvan yat svarasāmāno bhavanty ādityasya spṛtyai
children.translated_text: The <s>Asura</s> <s>Svarbhānu</s> struck the <s>Āditya</s> with darkness; the gods restored him with the <s>svaras</s>. Since they are <s>svarasāman</s> chants, it is for the restoration of the <s>Āditya</s>.

children.text: parair vai devā ādityaṃ svargaṃ lokam apārayan yad apārayaṃstat parāṇāṃ paratvaṃ
children.translated_text: By the <s>Parā</s> chants the gods carried the <s>Āditya</s> across to the heavenly world. Because they carried him across, that is the being beyond of the <s>Parā</s> chants.

children.text: pārayanty enaṃ parāṇi ya evaṃ veda
children.translated_text: The <s>Parā</s> chants carry across the one who knows thus.

children.text: saptadaśā bhavanti
children.translated_text: They are <s>Saptadaśa</s>, seventeenfold.

children.text: prajāpatir vai saptadaśaḥ prajāpatim evopayanti
children.translated_text: <s>Prajāpati</s> is seventeenfold; they approach <s>Prajāpati</s> himself.

children.text: anuṣṭup chandaso bhavanty ānuṣṭubho vai prajāpatiḥ sākṣād eva prajāpatim ārabhante
children.translated_text: They are in the <s>Anuṣṭubh</s> meter; <s>Prajāpati</s> is <s>Anuṣṭubh</s>; they lay hold of <s>Prajāpati</s> directly.

children.text: trayaḥ purastāt trayaḥ parastād bhavanti
children.translated_text: There are three before and three after.

children.text: devā vā ādityasya svargāllokād avapādād abibhayus tam etaiḥ stomaiḥ saptadaśair adṛṃhan yad ete stomābhavanty ādityasya dhṛtyai
children.translated_text: The gods feared that the <s>Āditya</s> would fall away from the heavenly world; with these seventeenfold <s>stomas</s> they made him firm. Since these <s>stomas</s> are present, it is for the firmness of the <s>Āditya</s>.

children.text: catustriṃśā bhavanti varṣma vai catustriṃśo varṣmaṇaivainaṃ saṃmimate
children.translated_text: They are <s>Catustriṃśa</s>, thirty-fourfold; the <s>Catustriṃśa</s> is stature, and by stature they measure him out.

children.text: tasya parācīnātipādād abibhayus taṃ sarvaiḥ stomaiḥ paryārṣan viśvajidabhijidbhyāṃ vīryaṃ vā etau stomau vīryeṇaiva tad ādityaṃ paryuṣanti dhṛtyai
children.translated_text: They feared that he would overstep too far away; they surrounded him with all the <s>stomas</s>, with the <s>Viśvajit</s> and <s>Abhijit</s>. These two <s>stomas</s> are vigor; with vigor they enclose the <s>Āditya</s> for firmness.

children.text: anavapādāyānatipādāya
children.translated_text: It is so that there may be no falling down and no overstepping.

children.text: tad āhuḥ kartapraskanda iva vā eṣa yat trayastriṃśataḥ saptadaśam upayantīti pṛṣṭhyo 'ntaraḥ kāryaḥ
children.translated_text: They say: "This is like a leap for the performer, when they approach the <s>Saptadaśa</s> from the <s>Trayastriṃśa</s>." A <s>Pṛṣṭhya</s> interval should be made.

children.text: tasya yat saptadaśam ahas tad uttamaṃ kāryaṃ salomatvāya
children.translated_text: Of that, the seventeenth day should be made the last, for <s>salomatva</s>, having the hair intact, that is, continuity.

children.text: tad āhur udaraṃ vā eṣa stomānāṃ yat saptadaśo yat saptadaśaṃ madhyato nirhareyur aśanāyavaḥ prajāḥ syur aśanāyavaḥ sattriṇaḥ
children.translated_text: They say: "The <s>Saptadaśa</s> is the belly of the <s>stomas</s>; if they were to remove the <s>Saptadaśa</s> from the middle, the subjects would be hungry and the <s>sattrins</s>, the session-sacrificers, would be hungry."

children.text: trayastriṃśād eva saptadaśa upetyo varṣma vai trayastriṃśo varṣma saptadaśo varṣmaṇa eva tad varṣmābhisaṃkrāmanti
children.translated_text: From the <s>Trayastriṃśa</s> one should approach the <s>Saptadaśa</s>: the <s>Trayastriṃśa</s> is stature, the <s>Saptadaśa</s> is stature, and thus they pass from stature to stature.

children.text: nānāhur ukthāḥ kāryā3 iti yady ukthāḥ syuḥ
children.translated_text: Some say, "Should <s>Ukthas</s> be performed?" If <s>Ukthas</s> were used,

children.text: paśavo vā ukthāni śāntiḥ paśavaḥ śāntenaiva tad viṣuvantam upayanti
children.translated_text: the <s>Ukthas</s> are cattle, and cattle are peace; by what is pacified they thereby approach the <s>Viṣuvant</s>.

children.text: tad āhur vivīvadham iva vā etad yad agniṣṭomo viṣuvān agniṣṭomau viśvajidabhijitāvathetara ukthāḥ syur iti
children.translated_text: They say: "It would be like an uneven carrying-yoke if the <s>Viṣuvant</s> were an <s>Agniṣṭoma</s>, the <s>Viśvajit</s> and <s>Abhijit</s> were <s>Agniṣṭomas</s>, and the other days were <s>Ukthas</s>."

children.text: agniṣṭomā eva sarve kāryāḥ
children.translated_text: All should be <s>Agniṣṭomas</s>.

children.text: vīryaṃ vā agniṣṭomo vīrya eva madhyataḥ pratitiṣṭhanti nava saṃstutā bhavanti nava prāṇāḥ prāṇeṣv eva pratitiṣṭhanti ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agniṣṭoma</s> is vigor; they take their stand in vigor in the middle. There are nine completed chants; the breaths are nine, and they take their stand in the breaths.

children.text: viṣuvān eṣa bhavati
children.translated_text: This is the <s>Viṣuvant</s>.

children.text: devaloko vā eṣa yad viṣuvān devaokam eva tad abhyārohanti
children.translated_text: The <s>Viṣuvant</s> is the world of the gods; they thereby ascend to the world of the gods.

children.text: ekaviṃśo bhavaty ekaviṃśo vā asya bhuvanasyāditya ādityalokam eva tad abhyārohanti
children.translated_text: It is <s>Ekaviṃśa</s>, twenty-onefold; the <s>Āditya</s> is the twenty-first in this world, and they thereby ascend to the world of the <s>Āditya</s>.

children.text: dvādaśa māsāḥ pañcartavas traya ime lokā asāv āditya ekaviṃśaḥ
children.translated_text: The twelve months, the five seasons, these three worlds, and that <s>Āditya</s> make twenty-one.

children.text: madhyata eva yajñasya pratitiṣṭhanti
children.translated_text: They take their stand in the very middle of the sacrifice.

children.text: vāyo śukro ayāmi ta iti śukravatī pratipad bhavaty ādityasya rūpam
children.translated_text: The <s>pratipad</s>, the opening verse, is one containing <s>śukra</s>: "<s>Vāyo śukro ayāmi te</s>." It is the form of the <s>Āditya</s>.

children.text: vāyur vā etaṃ devatānām ānaśe 'nuṣṭup chandasaṃ yad ato 'nyā pratipat syāt pradahet
children.translated_text: <s>Vāyu</s> among the deities reached this <s>Anuṣṭubh</s> meter; if there were another opening verse after this, it would burn him.

children.text: yanti vā ete prāṇādityāhur ye gāyatryāḥ pratipado yantīti yad vāyavyā bhavanti tena prāṇān na yanti prāṇo hi vāyuḥ
children.translated_text: Those who proceed with <s>Gāyatrī</s> opening verses, they say, go away from breath. Because these are addressed to <s>Vāyu</s>, they do not go away from the breaths, for <s>Vāyu</s> is breath.

children.text: atho śamayanty evainam etayā śāntir hi vāyuḥ
children.translated_text: Moreover, they simply pacify him with this; for <s>Vāyu</s> is peace.

children.text: āyāhi somapītaya iti saumī pāvamānī
children.translated_text: The <s>Pavamānī</s> belonging to <s>Soma</s> is "Come for the drinking of <s>Soma</s>."

children.text: niyutvatī bhavati paśavo vai niyutaḥ śāntiḥ paśavaḥ śāntenaiva tad ādityam upayanti
children.translated_text: It is accompanied by the <s>Niyuts</s>; the <s>Niyuts</s> are cattle, and cattle are peace; by what is pacified they thereby approach the <s>Āditya</s>.

children.text: divākīrtyasāmā bhavati
children.translated_text: It is the <s>Divākīrtya-sāman</s>.

children.text: svarbhānur vā āsur ādityaṃ tamasāvidhyat tasya devā divākīrtyais tamo 'pāghnan yad divākīrtyāni bhavanti tama evāsmād apaghnanti raśmayo vā eta ādityasya yad divākīrtyāni raśmibhir eva tad ādityaṃ sākṣād ārabhante
children.translated_text: <s>Svarbhānu</s>, the Asura, struck <s>Āditya</s> with darkness. The gods drove his darkness away with the <s>Divākīrtyas</s>. When the <s>Divākīrtyas</s> are present, they drive darkness away from him. These, namely the <s>Divākīrtyas</s>, are the rays of <s>Āditya</s>; with rays they directly lay hold of <s>Āditya</s>.

children.text: bhrājābhrāje pavamānamukhe bhavato mukhata evāsya tābhyāṃ tamo 'paghnanti
children.translated_text: <s>Bhrāja</s> and <s>Abhrāja</s> are placed at the mouth of the <s>Pavamāna</s>; by those two they drive away his darkness from the front.

children.text: mahādivākīrtyaṃ ca vikarṇaṃ ca madhyato bhavato madhyata evāsya tābhyāṃ tamo 'paghnanti bhāsam antato bhavati patta evāsya tena tamo 'paghnanti
children.translated_text: <s>Mahādivākīrtya</s> and <s>Vikarṇa</s> are placed in the middle; by those two they drive away his darkness from the middle. <s>Bhāsa</s> is at the end; by it they drive away his darkness from his footing.

children.text: daśastobhaṃ bhavati daśākṣarā virāḍ virājy eva pratitiṣṭhanti
children.translated_text: It has ten <s>stobhas</s>. The <s>Virāj</s> has ten syllables; they thereby stand firm in the <s>Virāj</s>.

children.text: yat tv ity āhuḥ ṣaḍbhir ito māsair adhvānaṃ yanti ṣaḍbhiḥ punar āyanti kva tarhi svargo loko yasya kāmāya sattram āsata iti
children.translated_text: But when they say, "With six months they go on the road from here, and with six they return; where, then, is the heavenly world for whose sake they sit through the <s>sattra</s>?"

children.text: mūrdhānaṃ diva iti svargaṃ lokam ārabhante
children.translated_text: With the verse "the head of heaven" they lay hold of the heavenly world.

children.text: aratiṃ pṛthivyā ity asmiṃlloke pratitiṣṭhanti
children.translated_text: With the verse "the reach of the earth" they stand firm in this world.

children.text: vaiśvānaram ṛta ājātam agnim iti viṣuvata eva tad rūpaṃ kriyate
children.translated_text: With the verse "<s>Agni Vaiśvānara</s>, born from truth," the very form of the <s>Viṣuvat</s> is fashioned.

children.text: kaviṃ samrājam atithiṃ janānām ity annādyam evopayanti
children.translated_text: With the verse "the seer, the sovereign, the guest of peoples," they obtain food and the eating of food.

children.text: āsan nāpātraṃ janayanta devā iti jāyanta eva
children.translated_text: With the verse "the gods generated the vessel at the mouth," they are indeed generated.

children.text: tat triṣṭub jagatīṣu bhavati traiṣṭubhjāgato vā ādityo yad ato 'nyāsu syād ava svargāl lokāt padyeran
children.translated_text: That <s>Triṣṭubh</s> occurs among <s>Jagatīs</s>, for <s>Āditya</s> belongs to the <s>Triṣṭubh</s> and <s>Jagatī</s>. If it were among other metres, they would fall down from the heavenly world.

children.text: samrāḍvatīṣu bhavati sāmrājyaṃ vai svargo lokaḥ svarga eva loke pratitiṣṭhanti ||
children.translated_text: It occurs among verses containing the word "sovereign." The heavenly world is sovereignty; they stand firm in the heavenly world itself.

children.text: ātmā vā eṣa saṃvvatsarasya yad viṣuvān pakṣāv etāv abhito bhavato yena ceto 'bhīvartena yanti yaś ca parasmāt pragātho bhavati tāv ubhau viṣuvati kāryau pakṣāv eva tad yajñasyātman pratidadhati svargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai
children.translated_text: This <s>Viṣuvat</s> is the self of the year. These two wings are on either side: the one with which they go, the <s>Cetas Abhīvarta</s>, and the <s>pragātha</s> that comes after it. Both should be performed at the <s>Viṣuvat</s>. Thus they set the wings of the sacrifice upon its self, for the complete attainment of the heavenly world.

children.text: indra kratuṃ na ābhareti pragātho bhavati
children.translated_text: There is the <s>pragātha</s>, "O <s>Indra</s>, bring us resolve."

children.text: vasiṣṭho vā etaṃ putrahato 'paśyat sa prajayā paśubhiḥ prājāyata yad eṣa pragātho bhavati prajātyai
children.translated_text: <s>Vasiṣṭha</s>, whose son had been killed, saw this; he increased with offspring and cattle. Since this <s>pragātha</s> is used, it is for procreation.

children.text: jīvā jyotir aśīmahīti ye vai svasti saṃvvatsaraṃ saṃtaranti te jīvā jyotir aśnuvate
children.translated_text: With the verse "May we, living, attain the light": those who safely cross through the year attain the light while living.

children.text: māno ajñātā vṛjanā durādhyo māśivāso 'vakramur iti ye vai stenā ripavas te durādhyas tān eva tad atikrāmati
children.translated_text: With the verse "May unknown hostile bands, hard to master, and unfriendly men not step upon us": thieves and enemies are indeed the hard-to-master ones; these he thereby passes beyond.

children.text: tvayā vyayaṃ pravataḥ śaśvatīr apo 'ti śūra tarāma so 'tisaṃvvatsaro vai pravataḥ śaśvatīr apas tam eva tat taranti
children.translated_text: With the verse "With you, O hero, may we cross beyond the everlasting waters on the slope": the over-year is indeed the slope and the everlasting waters; that very thing they cross.

children.text: adyādyāśvaḥ śvas tvām idā hyo naro vayam enam idā hya iti saṃtanayaḥ pragāthā bhavanti teṣām ekaḥ kāryaḥ salomatvāya śvastanam evābhisaṃtanvanti
children.translated_text: There are the continuous <s>pragāthas</s>, beginning "today, today, O horse," "tomorrow you," and "yesterday we men, yesterday this one." One of them should be performed for unbroken continuity; they thereby extend themselves toward tomorrow.

children.text: atho khalv āhur indra kratuṃ na ābharety eva kāryaṃ samṛddhyai
children.translated_text: But others say that only "O <s>Indra</s>, bring us resolve" should be performed, for prosperity.

children.text: pratyavarohiṇo māsā bhavanti
children.translated_text: The months are descending in return.

children.text: yathā vā ito vṛkṣaṃ rohanty evam enaṃ pratyavarohanti svargam eva lokaṃ rūḍhvāsmiṃl loke pratitiṣṭhanti ||
children.translated_text: Just as people climb down from a tree here, so they descend from it in return. Having climbed to the heavenly world, they stand firm in this world.

children.text: gauś cāyuś ca stomau bhavataḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Gau</s> and <s>Āyus</s> are the two <s>stomas</s>.

children.text: dvipād yajamānaḥ pratiṣṭhityai
children.translated_text: The sacrificer is two-footed; this is for firm standing.

children.text: ūnātiriktau bhavata ūnātiriktaṃ vā anu prajāḥ prajāyante prajātyai
children.translated_text: They are deficient and excessive; creatures are born in accord with deficiency and excess, for procreation.

children.text: vairājau bhavato 'nnaṃ virāḍ annādya eva pratitiṣṭhanti
children.translated_text: They are <s>Vairāja</s>. <s>Virāj</s> is food; they stand firm in food and the eating of food.

children.text: dvādaśāhasya daśāhāni bhavanti
children.translated_text: There are ten days of the twelve-day rite.

children.text: virāḍ vā eṣā samṛddhā yad daśāhāni virājy eva samṛddhāyāṃ pratitiṣṭhanti
children.translated_text: This <s>Virāj</s> is complete, namely the ten days; they stand firm in the complete <s>Virāj</s>.

children.text: pṛṣṭhāni bhavanti vīryaṃ vai pṛṣṭhāni vīrya eva pratitiṣṭhanti chandomā bhavanti paśavo vai chandomāḥ paśuṣv eva pratitiṣṭhanty athaitad daśamam ahar āptastomam āptacchanda āptavibhaktikam aniruktaṃ prājāpatyam
children.translated_text: There are <s>Pṛṣṭhas</s>; the <s>Pṛṣṭhas</s> are vigor, and they stand firm in vigor. There are <s>Chandomas</s>; the <s>Chandomas</s> are cattle, and they stand firm among cattle. And this tenth day is one whose <s>stoma</s> has been attained, whose metre has been attained, whose division has been attained; it is undefined and belongs to <s>Prajāpati</s>.

children.text: yad adhyāhur ati tad recayanti tasmān na vyucyam
children.translated_text: Whatever they might say in addition about it, they would make excessive. Therefore it should not be elaborated.

children.text: parokṣam anuṣṭubham upayanti prajāpatir vā anuṣṭub yat pratyakṣam upeyuḥ prajāpatim ṛccheyuḥ
children.translated_text: They approach the <s>Anuṣṭubh</s> indirectly. <s>Prajāpati</s> is the <s>Anuṣṭubh</s>; if they approached it directly, they would strike against <s>Prajāpati</s>.

children.text: yo vai sattrasya sad veda sad bhavati vāmadevyaṃ vai sāmnāṃ sad agnir devatānāṃ virāṭ chandasāṃ trayastriṃśaḥ stomānāṃ tāny eva tad ekadhā saṃbhṛtyottiṣṭhanti
children.translated_text: He who knows the <s>sat</s> (real being) of the <s>sattra</s> becomes <s>sat</s>. The <s>Vāmadevya</s> is the <s>sat</s> of the <s>sāmans</s>, <s>Agni</s> of the deities, <s>Virāj</s> of the metres, and the <s>Trayastriṃśa</s> of the <s>stomas</s>. Gathering these into one, they rise up.

children.text: brahmavādino vadanti yataḥ sattrād udasthātā3sthitā3d iti
children.translated_text: The <s>brahmavādins</s> say, "From what <s>sattra</s> have they risen, from an unestablished one or from an established one?"

children.text: ye rathantareṇa stutvottiṣṭhanti te yata uttiṣṭhanti tān brūyād apratiṣṭhānā bhaviṣyantīti ye bṛhatā stutyottiṣṭhanti te sthitād uttiṣṭhanti tān brūyāt sthāyukaiṣāṃ śrīr bhaviṣyati na vasīyāṃso bhaviṣyantīti
children.translated_text: Those who rise after praising with the <s>Rathantara</s>, from whatever they rise, one should say to them, "They will be without foundation." Those who rise after praise with the <s>Bṛhat</s> rise from what is established; one should say to them, "Their prosperity will be lasting, but they will not become richer."

children.text: ye vāmadevyena stutvottiṣṭhanti te sataḥ sad abhyuttiṣṭhanti pūrṇāt pūrṇam āyatanād āyatanam antarikṣāyatanā hi prajā
children.translated_text: Those who rise after praising with the <s>Vāmadevya</s> rise from being to being, from fullness to fullness, from abode to abode; for creatures have the midspace as their abode.

children.text: trayastriṃśadakṣarāsu bhavati trayastriṃśaddevatāsv eva pratiṣṭhāyottiṣṭhanti
children.translated_text: It occurs in verses of thirty-three syllables; having stood firm among the thirty-three deities, they rise up.

children.text: prājāpatyaṃ vai vāmadevyaṃ prajāpatāv eva pratiṣṭhāyottiṣṭhanti paśavo vai vāmadevyaṃ paśuṣv eva pratiṣṭhāyottiṣṭhanti
children.translated_text: The <s>Vāmadevya</s> belongs to <s>Prajāpati</s>; having stood firm in <s>Prajāpati</s>, they rise up. The <s>Vāmadevya</s> is cattle; having stood firm among cattle, they rise up.

children.text: patnīḥ saṃyājya prāñca udetyāyaṃ sahasramānava ity aticchandasāhavanīyam upatiṣṭhante
children.translated_text: After performing the <s>patnīsaṃyājas</s> (wives' offerings), they go eastward and stand by the <s>Āhavanīya</s> with the <s>Aticchandas</s> verse, "This thousandfold man."

children.text: ime vai lokā aticchandā eṣv eva lokeṣu pratitiṣṭhanti
children.translated_text: These worlds are indeed the <s>Aticchandas</s> metres; in these very worlds they become established.

children.text: gor iti nidhanaṃ bhavati virājo vā etad rūpaṃ yad gaur virājy eva pratitiṣṭhanti
children.translated_text: The <s>nidhana</s> (closing refrain) is "goḥ." The cow is indeed this form of the <s>Virāj</s>; in the <s>Virāj</s> they become established.

children.text: pratyañcaḥ prapadya sārparājñyā ṛgbhiḥ stuvanti
children.translated_text: Having stepped back westward, they praise with the Ṛg-verses of the <s>Sārparājñī</s>.

children.text: arbudaḥ sarpa etābhir mṛtāṃ tvacam apāhata mṛtām evaitābhis tvacam apaghnate
children.translated_text: <s>Arbuda</s>, the serpent, cast off his dead skin with these verses; with these they cast off just the dead skin.

children.text: iyaṃ vai sārparājñy asyām eva pratitiṣṭhanti
children.translated_text: This earth is indeed the <s>Sārparājñī</s>; in this very earth they become established.

children.text: tisṛbhiḥ stuvanti traya ime lokā eṣv eva pratitiṣṭhanti
children.translated_text: They praise with three verses; these worlds are three; in these very worlds they become established.

children.text: manasopāvartayati
children.translated_text: He turns back mentally.

children.text: manasā hiṅkaroti manasā prastauti manasodgāyati manasā pratiharati manasā nidhanam upayanty asamāptasya samāptyai
children.translated_text: With the mind he makes the <s>hiṅ</s>; with the mind he begins the praise; with the mind he sings aloud; with the mind he responds; with the mind they reach the <s>nidhana</s>, for the completion of what is incomplete.

children.text: yad vai vācā na samāpnuvanti manasā tat samāpnuvanti
children.translated_text: What they do not complete with speech, they complete with the mind.

children.text: pariśrite stuvanti brahmaṇaḥ parigṛhītyai
children.translated_text: They praise within an enclosure, for the enclosing of <s>brahman</s> (sacred power).

children.text: brahmodyaṃ vadanti brahmavarcasa eva pratitiṣṭhanti
children.translated_text: They speak a <s>brahmodya</s> (sacred riddle-dialogue); in <s>brahmavarcas</s> (sacred brilliance) itself they become established.

children.text: caturhotāraṃ hotā vyācaṣṭe stutam eva tad anuśaṃsati nahi tat stutaṃ yad ananuśastam
children.translated_text: The <s>Hotṛ</s> sets forth the <s>Caturhotṛ</s> formula; thereby he recites after what has been praised, for what has not been followed by recitation is not truly praised.

children.text: prajāpatiṃ parivadanty āptvevainaṃ tad vyācakṣate tāvad āpāmainam iti
children.translated_text: They speak all around <s>Prajāpati</s>; having attained him, they thereby declare him: "Thus far have we attained him."

children.text: gṛhapatir audumbarīṃ dhārayati gṛhapatir vā ūrjo yantorjam evaibhyo yacchati
children.translated_text: The <s>gṛhapati</s> holds the <s>audumbarī</s> (fig-wood implement). The <s>gṛhapati</s> is the controller of vital strength; he thereby grants them vital strength.

children.text: vācaṃ yacchanti
children.translated_text: They restrain speech.

children.text: dugdhānīva vai tarhi chandāṃsi yātayāmāny antargatāni tāny eva tad rasenāpyāyayanti
children.translated_text: For then the metres are like milked-out, spent things that have gone inward; with essence they replenish those very metres.

children.text: atho śvastanam evābhisaṃtanvanti
children.translated_text: And further, they extend it toward the following day.

children.text: ātmadakṣiṇaṃ vā etad yat sattram
children.translated_text: That which is a <s>sattra</s> is indeed a rite whose sacrificial fee is the self.

children.text: yadā vai puruṣa ātmano 'vadyati yaṃ kāmaṃ kāmayate tam abhyaśnute
children.translated_text: When a person cuts off something from himself, he obtains whatever desire he desires.

children.text: dvābhyāṃ lomāvadyati dvābhyāṃ tvacaṃ dvābhyāṃ māṃsaṃ dvābhyām asthi dvābhyāṃ majjānaṃ dvābhyāṃ pīvaś ca lohitaṃ ca
children.translated_text: With two he cuts off hair; with two, skin; with two, flesh; with two, bone; with two, marrow; with two, fat and blood.

children.text: śikhā anupravapante pāpmānam eva tad apaghnate laghīyāṃsaḥ svargaṃ lokam ayāmeti
children.translated_text: They shave off the topknots in succession; thereby they drive away evil, thinking, "Being lighter, we shall go to the heavenly world."

children.text: atho gavām evānurūpā bhavanti sarvasyānnādyasyāvaruddhyai ||
children.translated_text: And further, they become conformable to cows, for the securing of every kind of food.

children.text: prajāpatiḥ prajā asṛjata so 'ricyata so 'padyata taṃ devā abhisamagacchanta te 'bruvan mahad asmai vrataṃ saṃbharāma yad imaṃ dhinavad iti tasmai yat saṃvvatsaram annaṃ pacyate tat samabharaṃs tad asmai prāyacchaṃs tad avrajayat tad enam adhinon mahan maryā vrataṃ yad imam adhinvīd iti tan mahāvratasya mahāvratatvam
children.translated_text: <s>Prajāpati</s> created creatures. He was emptied out and fell into distress. The gods gathered around him and said, "Let us collect a great <s>vrata</s> (rite) for him, one that will satisfy him." For him they collected whatever food is cooked in a year; they offered it to him. It set him going and satisfied him. "Great indeed is the <s>vrata</s> that satisfied him"; that is the greatness of the <s>Mahāvrata</s>.

children.text: prajāpatir vāva mahāṃs tasyaitad vratam annam eva
children.translated_text: <s>Prajāpati</s> himself is the great one, and this <s>vrata</s> of his is food itself.

children.text: tad āhur madhyaḥ saṃvvatsarasyopetyaṃ madhyato vā annaṃ jagdhaṃ dhinoti
children.translated_text: They say, "It should be approached in the middle of the year," for food eaten from the middle satisfies.

children.text: tad vāhur yan madhyata upayanty ardham annādyasyāpnuvanty ardhaṃ sambaṭ kurvantīty upariṣṭād eva saṃvvatsarasyopetyaṃ saṃvvatsare vā annaṃ sarvaṃ pacyate
children.translated_text: But they say, "If they approach it from the middle, they obtain half of food and make only half complete." Therefore it should be approached only at the end of the year, for in the year all food is cooked.

children.text: caturviṃśaṃ bhavati caturviṃśo vai saṃvvatsaro 'nnaṃ pañcaviṃśam
children.translated_text: It is the <s>Caturviṃśa</s> (twenty-fourfold stoma). The year is indeed twenty-fourfold; food is the twenty-fifth.

children.text: yad vā adaś caturviṃśaṃ prāyaṇīyaṃ tad etad udayanīyam
children.translated_text: What that <s>Caturviṃśa</s> is as the opening rite, this one is as the concluding rite.

children.text: yat saṃvvatsaram annaṃ saṃbharanti saiṣā pañcaviṃśyupajāyate ||
children.translated_text: When they collect food for the year, this <s>Pañcaviṃśī</s> (twenty-fifth) arises.

children.text: Chapter 5
vāmadevyaṃ mahāvrataṃ kāryam
children.translated_text: The <s>Mahāvrata</s> should be performed with the <s>Vāmadevya</s>.

children.text: trivṛcchiro bhavati
children.translated_text: The head is the <s>Trivṛt</s>.

children.text: trivṛddhyeva śiro loma tvag asthi
children.translated_text: For the head is threefold: hair, skin, and bone.

children.text: pāṅkta itara ātmā loma tvaṅ māṃsam asthi majjā
children.translated_text: The rest of the body is <s>Pāṅkta</s> (fivefold): hair, skin, flesh, bone, and marrow.

children.text: sakṛddhiṃkṛtena śirasā pārācā stuvate
children.translated_text: With the head, after a single <s>hiṅ</s> has been made, they praise turned away.

children.text: tasmācchiro 'ṅgāni medyanti nānumedyati na kṛśyantyanukṛśyati
children.translated_text: Therefore, when the limbs grow fat, the head does not grow fat along with them; when they grow thin, it does not grow thin along with them.

children.text: punar abhyāvartam itareṇātmanā stuvate tasmād itara ātmā medyati ca kṛśyati ca
children.translated_text: With the rest of the body they praise in a return; therefore the rest of the body both grows fat and grows thin.

children.text: arkavatīṣu gāyatrīṣu śiro bhavati
children.translated_text: The head consists of <s>Gāyatrī</s> verses containing <s>arka</s>.

children.text: annaṃ vā arko brahmavarcasaṃ gāyatry annādyaṃ caivaibhyo brahmavarcasaṃ ca mukhato dadhāti
children.translated_text: <s>Arka</s> is food, and <s>Gāyatrī</s> is <s>brahmavarcas</s> (sacred brilliance); he thereby places both food and <s>brahmavarcas</s> for them at the mouth.

children.text: pañcadaśasaptadaśau pakṣau bhavataḥ prakṣābhyāṃ vai yajamāno vayo bhūtvā svargaṃ lokam eti
children.translated_text: The <s>Pañcadaśa</s> and <s>Saptadaśa</s> are the two wings. With wings the sacrificer, having become a bird, goes to the heavenly world.

children.text: tāv āhuḥ samau kāryau pañcadaśau vā saptadaśau vā savīvadhatvāya
children.translated_text: They say, "The two should be made equal, either both <s>Pañcadaśa</s> or both <s>Saptadaśa</s>, for balanced bearing."

children.text: tadvāhur yat samau bhavata ekavīryau tarhi bhavata iti pañcadaśasaptadaśāv eva kāryau sācīva vai vayaḥ pakṣau kṛtvāpatīyaḥ patati
children.translated_text: But they say, "If they are equal, then they have one and the same vigor." Therefore they should be made a <s>Pañcadaśa</s> and a <s>Saptadaśa</s>; a bird flies on after making its wings oblique.

children.text: dakṣiṇato bṛhat kāryaṃ dakṣiṇo vā ardha ātmano vīryavattaraḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>Bṛhat</s> should be performed on the right side, for the right half of the self is the stronger.

children.text: atho khalv āhur uttarata eva kāryaṃ brāhmaṇācchaṃsino 'rdhāt traiṣṭubhaṃ vai bṛhat traiṣṭubho vai brāhmaṇācchaṃsī traiṣṭubhaḥ pañcadaśastomaḥ
children.translated_text: Yet they say, "It should be performed on the northern side, from the half of the <s>Brāhmaṇācchaṃsin</s>." The <s>Bṛhat</s> is <s>Triṣṭubh</s>; the <s>Brāhmaṇācchaṃsin</s> is <s>Triṣṭubh</s>; the <s>Pañcadaśa-stoma</s> is <s>Triṣṭubh</s>.

children.text: dakṣiṇato rathantaraṃ kāryaṃ maitrāvaruṇasyārdhād gāyatraṃ vai rathantaraṃ gāyatro maitrāvaruṇo gāyatraḥ saptadaśastomaḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>Rathantara</s> should be performed on the right side, from the half of the <s>Maitrāvaruṇa</s>. The <s>Rathantara</s> is <s>Gāyatra</s>; the <s>Maitrāvaruṇa</s> is <s>Gāyatra</s>; the <s>Saptadaśa-stoma</s> is <s>Gāyatra</s>.

children.text: ekaviṃśaṃ pucchaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: The tail is the <s>Ekaviṃśa</s>.

children.text: ekaviṃśo vai stomānāṃ pratiṣṭhā tasmād vayaḥ pucchena pratiṣṭhāyotpatati pucchena pratiṣṭhāya niṣīdati
children.translated_text: The <s>Ekaviṃśa</s> is indeed the foundation of the <s>stomas</s>. Therefore a bird takes off after steadying itself with its tail, and settles after steadying itself with its tail.

children.text: yajñāyajñīyaṃ pucchaṃ kāryaṃ yajñāyajñīyaṃ hy eva mahāvratasya puccham
children.translated_text: The tail should be made the <s>Yajñāyajñīya</s>, for the <s>Yajñāyajñīya</s> is indeed the tail of the <s>Mahāvrata</s>.

children.text: atho khalv āhur atiśayaṃ vai dvipadāṃ yajñāyajñīyaṃ bhadram kāryaṃ samṛddhyai ||
children.translated_text: Now indeed they say, "The <s>Yajñāyajñīya</s> is the excellence of bipeds; what is auspicious should be performed for prosperity."

children.text: vāmadevyaṃ mahāvrataṃ kāryaṃ tasya gāyatraṃ śiro bṛhadrathantare pakṣau yajñāyajñīyaṃ puccham
children.translated_text: The <s>Vāmadevya</s> should be made the <s>Mahāvrata</s>. Its head is the <s>Gāyatra</s>, its two wings are the <s>Bṛhat</s> and <s>Rathantara</s>, and its tail is the <s>Yajñāyajñīya</s>.

children.text: yo vai mahāvrate sahasraṃ protaṃ veda pra sahasraṃ paśūn āpnoti
children.translated_text: Whoever knows the thousand woven into the <s>Mahāvrata</s> obtains a full thousand animals.

children.text: tasya prācī dik śiras tac chandobhiḥ sahasram asāv anyataraḥ pakṣaḥ sanakṣatraiḥ sāhasro 'yam anyataraḥ pakṣaḥ sa oṣadhibhiś ca vanaspatibhiś ca sāhasro 'ntarikṣam ātmā tad vayobhiḥ sāhasraṃ pratīcī dik pucchaṃ tad agnibhiś ca raśmibhiś ca sāhasraṃ pra sahasraṃ paśūn āpnoti ya evaṃ veda
children.translated_text: Its head is the eastern direction; that, with the metres, is a thousand. Yonder world is one wing; with the stars it is a thousand. This world is the other wing; with herbs and trees it is a thousand. The atmosphere is the body; with birds it is a thousand. The western direction is the tail; that, with fires and rays, is a thousand. Whoever knows thus obtains a full thousand animals.

children.text: tad āhur apṛṣṭhaṃ vai vāmadevyam anidhanaṃ hīti
children.translated_text: Concerning that they say, "The <s>Vāmadevya</s> is without a <s>pṛṣṭha</s>, for it is without a <s>nidhana</s>."

children.text: anāyatanaṃ vā etat sāma yad anidhanam
children.translated_text: For that <s>sāman</s> which is without a <s>nidhana</s> is without a support.

children.text: rājanaṃ mahāvrataṃ kāryam
children.translated_text: The <s>Rājana</s> should be made the <s>Mahāvrata</s>.

children.text: etad vai sākṣād annaṃ yad rājanaṃ pañcavidhaṃ bhavati pāṅktaṃ hy annam
children.translated_text: This, namely the <s>Rājana</s>, is food directly. It is fivefold, for food is <s>pāṅkta</s> (fivefold).

children.text: hiṅkāravad bhavati tena vāmadevyasya rūpam
children.translated_text: It has a <s>hiṅkāra</s>; by that it has the form of the <s>Vāmadevya</s>.

children.text: nidhanavad bhavati tena pṛṣṭhasya rūpam
children.translated_text: It has a <s>nidhana</s>; by that it has the form of the <s>pṛṣṭha</s>.

children.text: aticchandaḥsu pañcanidhanaṃ vāmadevyaṃ brahmasāma kāryam
children.translated_text: Among the <s>Aticchandas</s> metres, the five-<s>nidhana</s> <s>Vāmadevya</s> should be made the <s>brahmasāman</s>.

children.text: ati vā eṣānyāni chandāṃsi yad aticchandā aty etad anyāny ahāny ahar yan mahāvratam
children.translated_text: For what is <s>Aticchandas</s> exceeds the other metres; this day, the <s>Mahāvrata</s>, exceeds the other days.

children.text: brahmasāmnaiva tad anyāny ahāny atimedayati
children.translated_text: With the <s>brahmasāman</s> itself he thereby makes that day exceed the other days.

children.text: pañcanidhanaṃ bhavati pāṅktaṃ hy annam
children.translated_text: It has five <s>nidhanas</s>, for food is <s>pāṅkta</s> (fivefold).

children.text: ilāndam agniṣṭomasāma kāryam
children.translated_text: The <s>Ilānda</s> should be made the <s>Agniṣṭoma-sāman</s>.

children.text: etad vai sākṣād annaṃ yad ilāndam irānnaṃ etad irāyām evānnādye 'ntataḥ pratitiṣṭhanti
children.translated_text: This, namely the <s>Ilānda</s>, is food directly; <s>irā</s> is food. In nourishment itself, in what is fit to be eaten, they finally establish themselves.

children.text: samudro vā etac chandaḥ salilaṃ lomaśaṃ samudra iva khalu vai sa bhavati salila iva lomaśa iva yo bhavati
children.translated_text: This metre is the ocean, the waters, the hairy one. Indeed whoever becomes so becomes like the ocean, like the waters, like one covered with hair.

children.text: tasmād etāsu kāryaṃ samṛddhyai
children.translated_text: Therefore it should be performed among these, for prosperity.

children.text: vratam iti nidhanaṃ bhavati mahāvratasyaiva tad rūpaṃ kriyate svar iti bhavati svargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai śakuna iti bhavati śakuna iva vai yajamāno vayo bhūtvā svargaṃ lokam eti
children.translated_text: The <s>nidhana</s> is "<s>vratam</s>"; thereby the very form of the <s>Mahāvrata</s> is made. It is "<s>svar</s>," for the attainment of the heavenly world. It is "<s>śakuna</s>," for the sacrificer, like a bird, having become winged, goes to the heavenly world.

children.text: yajñāyajñīyam agniṣṭomasāma kāryam
children.translated_text: The <s>Yajñāyajñīya</s> should be made the <s>Agniṣṭoma-sāman</s>.

children.text: yad vā anyā vāṅ nātivadet tad agniṣṭomasāma kāryaṃ na vai vāg vācam ativadati vāg yajñāyajñīyaṃ vācy evāntataḥ pratitiṣṭhanti
children.translated_text: Whatever other speech would not speak beyond, that should be made the <s>Agniṣṭoma-sāman</s>. Speech indeed does not over-speak speech; speech is the <s>Yajñāyajñīya</s>. In speech itself they finally establish themselves.

children.text: vāravantīyam agniṣṭomasāma kāryam
children.translated_text: The <s>Vāravantīya</s> should be made the <s>Agniṣṭoma-sāman</s>.

children.text: agnir vā idaṃ vaiśvānaro 'dahan naitasmād devā abibhayus taṃ varaṇaśākhayāvārayanta yad avārayanta tasmād vāravantīyam
children.translated_text: <s>Agni Vaiśvānara</s> was burning this world, and the gods were afraid of him. They warded him off with a branch of the <s>varaṇa</s> tree. Because they warded him off, therefore it is the <s>Vāravantīya</s>.

children.text: tasmād varaṇo bhiṣajya etena hi devā ātmānam atrāyanta
children.translated_text: Therefore the <s>varaṇa</s> is medicinal, for with it the gods protected themselves.

children.text: tasmād brāhmaṇo vāraṇena na pibed vaiśvānaraṃ necchamayā iti
children.translated_text: Therefore a <s>brāhmaṇa</s> should not drink with <s>varaṇa</s> wood, thinking, "May I not bring <s>Vaiśvānara</s> upon myself."

children.text: paśavo vai vāravantīyaṃ śāntiḥ paśavaḥ śāntād eva tat saṃvvatsarād uttiṣṭhanti ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Vāravantīya</s> is animals; animals are peace. From a pacified year they thereby rise up.

children.text: prāṇena purastād āhavanīyam upatiṣṭhante prāṇam eva taj jayanti
children.translated_text: With <s>Prāṇa</s> they attend upon the <s>Āhavanīya</s> in front; thereby they win breath.

children.text: apānena paścāt puccham upatiṣṭhante apānam eva taj jayanti
children.translated_text: With <s>Apāna</s> they attend upon the tail behind; thereby they win the downward breath.

children.text: vratapakṣābhyāṃ pakṣāv upatiṣṭhante diśa eva taj jayanti
children.translated_text: With the two <s>Vratapakṣas</s> they attend upon the wings; thereby they win the directions.

children.text: prajāpater hṛdayenāpikakṣam upatiṣṭhante jyaiṣṭhyam eva taj jayanti
children.translated_text: With the heart of <s>Prajāpati</s> they attend upon the flank; thereby they win preeminence.

children.text: vasiṣṭhasya nihavena cātvālam upatiṣṭhante svargam eva tal lokam āotvā śriyaṃ vadante
children.translated_text: With <s>Vasiṣṭha</s>'s <s>Nihava</s> they attend upon the <s>Cātvāla</s>; having attained that heavenly world, they speak of splendor.

children.text: vaiśvadevyām ṛci bhavati viśvarūpaṃ vai paśūnāṃ rūpaṃ paśūn eva taj jayanti
children.translated_text: It occurs in a <s>Vaiśvadevī</s> verse. The form of animals is indeed manifold; thereby they win animals.

children.text: sattrasyarddhyāgnīdhram upatiṣṭhanta ṛddhāv eva pratitiṣṭhanti
children.translated_text: They attend upon the <s>Agnīdhra</s> with the prosperity of the <s>sattra</s>; they stand firm in prosperity itself.

children.text: caturakṣarāṇidhanaṃ bhavati catuṣpādāḥ paśavaḥ paśuṣv eva pratitiṣṭhanti
children.translated_text: It has a <s>nidhana</s> of four syllables. Animals are four-footed; they establish themselves among animals.

children.text: ātamitor nidhanam upayanty āyur eva sarvam āpnuvanti
children.translated_text: They approach the <s>nidhana</s> of the <s>Ātamitor</s>; they obtain the whole span of life.

children.text: ślokānuślokābhyāṃ havirdhāne upatiṣṭhante kīrtim eva taj jayanti
children.translated_text: With the <s>Śloka</s> and <s>Anuśloka</s> they attend upon the <s>Havirdhāna</s> sheds; thereby they win fame.

children.text: yāmena mārjālīyam upatiṣṭhante pitṛlokam eva taj jayanti
children.translated_text: With the <s>Yāma</s> they attend upon the <s>Mārjālīya</s>; thereby they win the world of the Fathers.

children.text: āyurṇavastobhābhyāṃ sada upatiṣṭhante brahma caiva tat kṣatraṃ ca jayanti
children.translated_text: With <s>Āyus</s> and <s>Navastobha</s> they attend upon the <s>Sadas</s>; thereby they win both <s>brahman</s> and <s>kṣatra</s>.

children.text: ṛśyasya sāmnā gārhapatyam upatiṣṭhante
children.translated_text: With the <s>sāman</s> of <s>Ṛśya</s> they attend upon the <s>Gārhapatya</s>.

children.text: indraṃ sarvāṇi bhūtāny astuvaṃs tasyarśya ekam aṅgam astutam acāyat tad asyaitenāstaut tenāsya priyaṃ dhāmopāgacchat priyam evāsyaitena dhāmopagacchanti
children.translated_text: All beings praised <s>Indra</s>. <s>Ṛśya</s> perceived that one limb of his had not been praised; he praised that part of him with this. By it he reached his dear abode; with this they reach his dear abode.

children.text: yat parokṣaṃ nidhanam upeyur hrītamukhaṃ pratimuñceran pratyakṣam upayanti hrītamukham evāpajayanti ||
children.translated_text: If they were to approach the <s>nidhana</s> in hidden fashion, they would put on an ashamed face. They approach it directly; they thereby drive away the ashamed face.

children.text: āsandīm āruhyodgāyati devasākṣya eva tad upariṣadyaṃ jayati
children.translated_text: He sings the <s>udgītha</s> after mounting a seat; thereby he wins a higher seat in the presence of the gods.

children.text: audumbarī bhavaty ūrg udumbara ūrjam evāvarunddhe
children.translated_text: It is made of <s>udumbara</s> wood. The <s>udumbara</s> is nourishment; he secures nourishment itself.

children.text: prādeśamātrī bhavaty asya lokasyānuddhānāya
children.translated_text: It is a span in measure, so that this world is not lifted away.

children.text: chandobhir ārohati svargam eva tal lokam ārohati
children.translated_text: He ascends by means of the metres; he ascends the heavenly world itself.

children.text: chandobhir upāvarohaty asmiṃlloke pratitiṣṭhati
children.translated_text: He descends by means of the metres; he establishes himself in this world.

children.text: sarveṇātmanā samuddhṛtyodgeyam eṣu lokeṣu ned vyāhito 'sānīti
children.translated_text: It should be sung after raising it with the whole self, thinking, "May I not be separated in these worlds."

children.text: ekasyāṃ stotrīyāyām astutāyāṃ pādāv upāharati
children.translated_text: When one <s>stotrīyā</s> has not yet been sung, he draws his feet in.

children.text: saha nidhanena pratiṣṭhām upayanty eṣeṣv eva lokeṣu pratitiṣṭhante
children.translated_text: Together with the <s>nidhana</s> they approach firm standing; they establish themselves in these very worlds.

children.text: preṅkhām āruhya hotā śaṃsati mahasa eva tad rūpaṃ kriyate
children.translated_text: The <s>Hotṛ</s> recites after mounting the swing; thereby the form of greatness is made.

children.text: yadā vai prajā maha āviśati preṅkhās tarhy ārohanti
children.translated_text: When the people enter upon the <s>Mahāvrata</s>, then they mount the swings.

children.text: phalakam āruhyādhvaryuḥ pratigṛṇāti
children.translated_text: Having mounted a plank, the <s>Adhvaryu</s> gives the response.

children.text: kūrcān itare 'dhyāsata ūrdhvā eva tad utkrāmanto yanti
children.translated_text: The others sit upon bunches of grass; thus, moving upward, they go forth.

children.text: abhigarāpagarau bhavato nindaty enān anyaḥ prānyaḥ śaṃsati ya enān nindati pāpmānam eṣāṃ so 'pahanti yaḥ praśaṃsati yad evaiṣāṃ suṣṭutaṃ suśastaṃ tat so 'bhigṛṇāti
children.translated_text: There are an <s>abhigara</s> and an <s>apagara</s>: one reviles them, another praises them. The one who reviles them drives away their evil; the one who praises them proclaims whatever in them has been well sung and well recited.

children.text: śūdrāryau carmaṇi vyāyacchete tayor āryaṃ varṇam ujjāpayanti
children.translated_text: A <s>Śūdra</s> and an <s>Ārya</s> contend on a hide; of the two, they cause the <s>Ārya</s> social order to prevail.

children.text: devāś ca vā asurāś cāditye vyāyacchantas taṃ devā abhyajayaṃs tato devā abhavan
children.translated_text: The gods and the <s>Asuras</s> contended over the sun; the gods won it, and from that they became gods.

children.text: parāsurā abhavann ātmanā parāsya bhrātṛvyo bhavati ya evaṃ veda ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Asuras</s> became defeated. The rival of the one who knows this becomes defeated in his own person.

children.text: yadāryaṃ varṇam ujjāpayanty ātmānam eva tad ujjāpayanti
children.translated_text: When they cause the <s>Ārya</s> social order to prevail, they thereby cause themselves to prevail.

children.text: parimaṇḍalaṃ carma bhavaty ādityasyaiva tad rūpaṃ kriyate
children.translated_text: The hide is round; thereby the very form of the sun is made.

children.text: sarvāsu sraktiṣu dundubhayo vadanti yā vanaspatiṣu vāk tām eva taj jayanti
children.translated_text: Drums sound at all the corners; whatever speech is in the trees, that they win thereby.

children.text: bhūmidundubhir bhavati yā pṛthivyāṃ vāk tām eva taj jayanti
children.translated_text: There is an earth-drum; whatever speech is in the earth, that they win thereby.

children.text: sarvā vāco vadanti yeṣu lokeṣu vāk tām eva taj jayanti
children.translated_text: All voices sound; in whatever worlds speech exists, that they win thereby.

children.text: saṃnaddhāḥ kavacinaḥ pariyantīndriyasyaiva tad rūpaṃ kriyate 'tho mahāvratam eva mahayanti ||
children.translated_text: Armed and wearing armor, they go around; thereby the form of strength is made, and also they magnify the <s>Mahāvrata</s> itself.

children.text: sarve sahartvijo mahāvratena stuvīran
children.translated_text: All the <s>ṛtvij</s> priests together should chant with the <s>Mahāvrata</s>.

children.text: adhvaryuḥ śirasodgāyan maitrāvaruṇo dakṣiṇena pakṣeṇa brāhmaṇācchaṃsy uttareṇa gṛhapatiḥ pucchenodgātātmanā
children.translated_text: The <s>Adhvaryu</s> sings with the head, the <s>Maitrāvaruṇa</s> with the right wing, the <s>Brāhmaṇācchaṃsin</s> with the left wing, the householder with the tail, and the <s>Udgātṛ</s> with the body.

children.text: tad yady evaṃ kuryur ekaikayā stotrīyayāstutayodgātāram abhisameyuḥ
children.translated_text: If they were to do it in this way, after each <s>stotrīyā</s> verse had been sung they should come together around the <s>Udgātṛ</s>.

children.text: tisṛbhir udgātātmana udgīyātha yā śirasaḥ stotrīyā tāṃ dadhyād aparābhis tisṛbhir udgīyātha yā dakṣiṇasya pakṣasya stotrīyā tāṃ dadhyād aparābhis tisṛbhir udgīyātha yottarasya pakṣasya stotrīyā tāṃ dadhyāt tisṛbhir vaikayā vā stutaṃ syād atha yā pucchasya stotrīyā tāṃ dadhyāt
children.translated_text: With three verses he should sing for the body of the <s>Udgātṛ</s>; then he should set in place the <s>stotrīyā</s> belonging to the head. With the next three he should sing; then he should set in place the <s>stotrīyā</s> belonging to the right wing. With the next three he should sing; then he should set in place the <s>stotrīyā</s> belonging to the left wing. It may be sung with three or with one; then he should set in place the <s>stotrīyā</s> belonging to the tail.

children.text: ātmany eva tad aṅgāni pratidadhati svargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai
children.translated_text: Thus they place the limbs back into the body itself, for the complete attainment of the heavenly world.

children.text: atho khalv āhuḥ katham adhvaryur bahvṛcaḥ sāma gāyed ity udgātaiva sarveṇodgāyet tad eva samṛddhaṃ samṛddhāv eva pratitiṣṭhanti
children.translated_text: Now, however, they say, "How could an <s>Adhvaryu</s> or a <s>Bahvṛca</s> sing a <s>sāman</s>?" The <s>Udgātṛ</s> alone should sing it with the whole; that alone is complete, and they stand firm in completeness.

children.text: havirdhāne śirasā stutvā saṃrabdhāḥ pratyañca eyus te dakṣiṇena dhiṣṇyān parītya paścān maitrāvaruṇasya dhiṣṇyasyopaviśya rathantareṇa pañcadaśena stuvīraṃs ta udañcaḥ saṃsarpeyur jaghanena hotur dhiṣṇyaṃ paścād brāhmaṇācchaṃsino dhiṣṇyasyopaviśya bṛhatā saptadaśena stuvīraṃs te yenaiva prasarpeyus tena punar niḥsṛpyottareṇāgnīdhraṃ parītya paścād gārhapatyasyopaviśya pucchenaikaviṃśena stuvīraṃs te yenaiva niḥsarpeyus tena punaḥ prasṛpya yathāyatanam upaviśyāsandīm āruhyodgātātmanodgāyati
children.translated_text: Having chanted with the head in the <s>Havirdhāna</s>, they should go westward in close formation. Passing the <s>dhiṣṇya</s> hearths on the south and sitting down behind the <s>Maitrāvaruṇa</s>'s <s>dhiṣṇya</s>, they should chant with the <s>Rathantara</s> in the fifteenfold form. Then they should creep northward behind the <s>Hotṛ</s>'s <s>dhiṣṇya</s>; sitting down behind the <s>Brāhmaṇācchaṃsin</s>'s <s>dhiṣṇya</s>, they should chant with the <s>Bṛhat</s> in the seventeenfold form. Then, by the very way by which they had crept forward, they should go out again, pass north of the <s>Āgnīdhra</s>, sit down west of the <s>Gārhapatya</s>, and chant with the tail in the twenty-onefold form. Then, by the very way by which they had gone out, they should creep back again, sit down in their proper places, mount the seat, and the <s>Udgātṛ</s> chants with the body.

children.text: taṃ patnyo 'paghāṭilābhir upagāyanty ārtvijyam eva tat patnyaḥ kurvanti saha svargaṃ lokam ayāmeti
children.translated_text: The wives accompany him in song with the <s>apaghāṭilā</s> verses; the wives thereby perform priestly service, thinking, "Together we have gone to the heavenly world."

children.text: kule kule 'nnaṃ kriyate tad yat pṛccheyuḥ kim idaṃ kurvantītīme yajamānā annam atsyantīti brūyuḥ
children.translated_text: Food is prepared in every household. If they should ask, "What are they doing?" they should say, "These sacrificers will eat food."

children.text: yo vai dīkṣitānāṃ pāpaṃ kīrtayati tṛtīyam evāṃśaṃ pāpmano haraty annādas tṛtīyaṃ pipīlikās tṛtīyam
children.translated_text: Whoever mentions the evil of consecrated sacrificers carries off one third share of the evil; the eater of the food carries off one third, and the ants one third.

children.text: parimādbhiś caranti tvak ca vā etal loma ca mahāvratasya yat parimādas tvacaṃ caiva tal loma ca mahāvratasyāptvāvarundhate
children.translated_text: They go about with <s>parimāda</s> objects. What the <s>parimādas</s> are is the skin and hair of the <s>Mahāvrata</s>; having obtained the skin and hair of the <s>Mahāvrata</s>, they secure them.

children.text: vāṇaṃ vitanvanty anto vai vāṇo 'nto mahāvratam antenaiva tad antam abhivādayanti
children.translated_text: They stretch out the <s>vāṇa</s> (lute). The <s>vāṇa</s> is an end, and the <s>Mahāvrata</s> is an end; with an end itself they address the end.

children.text: śatatantrīko bhavati śatāyur vai puruṣaḥ śatavīryaḥ
children.translated_text: It is hundred-stringed; a man indeed has a hundred years of life and a hundredfold vigor.

children.text: tam ullikhet prāṇāya tvāpānāya tvā vyānāya tveti prāṇāpānavyānān eva tad āptvāvarundhate
children.translated_text: He should pluck it, saying, "For <s>prāṇa</s> you, for <s>apāna</s> you, for <s>vyāna</s> you." Thereby they obtain and secure <s>prāṇa</s>, <s>apāna</s>, and <s>vyāna</s>.

children.text: pari kumbhinyo mārjālīyaṃ yantīdaṃ madhv idaṃ madhv iti saghoṣā eva tad vayo bhūtvā saha svargaṃ lokaṃ yanti ||
children.translated_text: The women with pots go around the <s>Mārjālīya</s>, saying, "This is honey, this is honey." Thus, becoming noisy birds, they go together to the heavenly world.

children.text: devā vai vācaṃ vyabhajanta tasyā yo raso 'tyaricyata tad gaurīvitam abhavad anuṣṭubham anu pariplavate vāg anuṣṭub vāco raso gaurīvitam
children.translated_text: The gods divided speech. The essence of it that was left over became the <s>Gaurīvita</s>. It follows along after the <s>Anuṣṭubh</s>; speech is the <s>Anuṣṭubh</s>, and the <s>Gaurīvita</s> is the essence of speech.

children.text: yad gaurīvitenānvahaṃ stuvate vācy eva tad vācā rasaṃ dadhati
children.translated_text: When they chant day after day with the <s>Gaurīvita</s>, they thereby place essence in speech by means of speech itself.

children.text: rasavad vācā vadati ya evaṃ vedeti
children.translated_text: With speech full of essence does the one who knows this speak.

children.text: dvyudāsaṃ bhavati svargasya vā etau lokasyāvasānadeśau pūrveṇaiva pūrvam ahaḥ saṃsthāpayanty uttareṇottaram ahar abhyativadanti
children.translated_text: It has two <s>udāsa</s> sections. These two are the terminal regions of the heavenly world; by the former they bring the former day to completion, and by the latter they speak beyond toward the following day.

children.text: etad vai yajñasya śvastanaṃ yad gaurīvitaṃ yad gaurīvitam anusṛjeyur aśvastanā aprajasaḥ syuḥ
children.translated_text: This <s>Gaurīvita</s> is the sacrifice's provision for tomorrow. If they were to let the <s>Gaurīvita</s> go, they would be without a tomorrow and without offspring.

children.text: saṃ vā anyo yajñas tiṣṭhata ity āhur vāg eva na saṃtiṣṭhata iti yad gaurīvitam anvahaṃ bhavati vācam eva tat punaḥ prayuñjate
children.translated_text: They say, "The rest of the sacrifice does come to completion, but speech itself does not come to completion." When the <s>Gaurīvita</s> is performed day after day, they thereby yoke speech again.

children.text: svarṇidhanam anvahaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: Day after day it has <s>svar</s> as its <s>nidhana</s> (finale).

children.text: devakṣetraṃ vā ete 'bhyārohanti ye svarṇidhanam upayanti sa u vai sattriṇaḥ sattram upanayed ity āhur ya enān devakṣetram abhyārohed iti na vai devakṣetra āsīna ārtim ārchati yat svarṇidhanam anvahaṃ bhavati naiva kāṃ canārtim ārchanti
children.translated_text: Those who approach the <s>svarṇidhana</s> ascend the gods' field. They say, "Only he should lead the <s>sattrins</s> in a <s>sattra</s> who would bring them up to the gods' field." One sitting in the gods' field does not meet with distress. Because the <s>svarṇidhana</s> occurs every day, they meet no distress whatever.

children.text: cyavante vā ete 'smāllokād ity āhur ye svarṇidhanam upayantīti yad ṛcā svarūpaṃ yanty asmiṃlloke pratitiṣṭhanti yad ekāro 'ntarikṣe yat sāmnāmuṣmin sarveṣu lokeṣu pratitiṣṭhanti svarṇidhanena tuṣṭuvānāḥ
children.translated_text: They say, "Those who approach the <s>svarṇidhana</s> fall away from this world." In that they go to their own form by the Ṛc, they become established in this world; in that they go by the e-syllable, in the midspace; in that they go by the <s>sāman</s>, in that world. Praising with the <s>svarṇidhana</s>, they become established in all the worlds.

children.text: sujñānaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: The <s>Sujñāna</s> occurs.

children.text: devā vai svargaṃ lokaṃ yanto 'jñātād abibhayus ta etat saṃjñānam apaśyaṃs tena jñātram agacchan yat sujñānam anvahaṃ bhavati jñātram eva gacchanti ||
children.translated_text: The gods, as they were going to the heavenly world, were afraid of what was unknown. They saw this recognition-sign; by it they came to what was known. Because the <s>Sujñāna</s> occurs every day, they go precisely to what is known.

children.text: ye vai vācam annam ādayanty annādā bhavanti ye vitarṣayanti rukṣā bhavanti
children.translated_text: Those who give speech food to eat become eaters of food; those who make it thirst become dry.

children.text: gaurīvitaṃ śyāvāśvaṃ nihava etāni vai sāmāni vāco 'nnam eteṣāṃ vāg annaṃ yad etāni na cyavante vācam eva tad annam ādayanti tena sarve 'nnādā bhavanti
children.translated_text: <s>Gaurīvita</s>, <s>Śyāvāśva</s>, and <s>Nihava</s>: these <s>sāmans</s> are the food of speech; speech is the food of these. Because these are not dropped, they thereby give speech food to eat; therefore all become eaters of food.

children.text: abhikrāntāpakrāntāni bhavanty abhikrāntāpakrāntaṃ vai vāco rūpam
children.translated_text: They are made advancing and receding; advancing and receding is indeed the form of speech.

children.text: plavo 'nvahaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: The <s>Plava</s> occurs every day.

children.text: samudraṃ vā ete prasnānti ye saṃvvatsaram upayanti yo vā aplavaḥ samudraṃ prasnāti na sa tata udeti yat plavo bhavati svargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai
children.translated_text: Those who undertake the year plunge into the ocean. Whoever plunges into the ocean without a raft does not come up from it. Because the <s>Plava</s> is present, it serves for the attainment of the heavenly world.

children.text: ati viśvāni duritā taremeti yad evaiṣāṃ duṣṭutaṃ duḥśastaṃ tad etena taranti
children.translated_text: With "May we cross beyond all difficulties," whatever among them has been badly praised or badly recited, they cross over by this.

children.text: okonidhanaṃ ṣaḍahamukhe bhavati
children.translated_text: The <s>okonidhana</s> occurs at the opening of the <s>ṣaḍaha</s> (six-day rite).

children.text: parāṃ vā ete parāvataṃ gacchanti ye ṣaḍahasyāntaṃ gacchanti yadokonidhanaṃ ṣaḍahamukhe bhavati prajñātyai
children.translated_text: Those who go to the end of the <s>ṣaḍaha</s> go to a far remoteness. Because the <s>okonidhana</s> occurs at the opening of the <s>ṣaḍaha</s>, it serves for recognition.

children.text: yadā vai puruṣaḥ svam oka āgacchati sarvaṃ tarhi prajānāti sarvam asmai divā bhavati ||
children.translated_text: When a person comes to his own home, then he knows everything; everything is daylight for him.

children.text: ekāṣṭakāyāṃ dīkṣeran
children.translated_text: They should be initiated on the <s>Ekāṣṭakā</s>.

children.text: eṣā vai saṃvvatsarasya patnī yad ekāṣṭakaitasyāṃ vā gatāṃ rātriṃ vasati sākṣād eva tat saṃvvatsaram ārabhya dīkṣante
children.translated_text: The <s>Ekāṣṭakā</s> is the wife of the year; with her the year spends the night after going to her. Thus they are initiated after taking hold of the year directly.

children.text: tasya sā niryā yad apo 'nabhinandanto 'bhyavayanti
children.translated_text: That has this drawback: they approach the waters without delighting in them.

children.text: vicchinnaṃ vā ete saṃvvatsarasyābhidīkṣante ya ekāṣṭakāyāṃ dīkṣante 'ntanāmānāv ṛtū bhavete
children.translated_text: Those who are initiated on the <s>Ekāṣṭakā</s> are initiated upon a cut-off part of the year; the two seasons at the ends have different names.

children.text: ārtaṃ vā ete saṃvvatsarasyābhidīkṣante ye 'ntanāmānāv ṛtū abhidīkṣante
children.translated_text: Those who are initiated upon two seasons with different names are initiated upon an afflicted part of the year.

children.text: tasmād ekāṣṭakāyāṃ na dīkṣyam
children.translated_text: Therefore one should not be initiated on the <s>Ekāṣṭakā</s>.

children.text: phālgune dīkṣeran
children.translated_text: They should be initiated in <s>Phālguna</s>.

children.text: mukhaṃ vā etat saṃvvatsarasya yat phālguno mukhata eva tat saṃvvatsaram ārabhya dīkṣante
children.translated_text: This, <s>Phālguna</s>, is the mouth of the year; thus they are initiated after taking hold of the year from the mouth itself.

children.text: tasya sā niryā yat saṃmeghe viṣuvān saṃpadyate
children.translated_text: That has this drawback: the <s>Viṣuvant</s> falls when the clouds have gathered.

children.text: citrāpūrṇamāse dīkṣeran
children.translated_text: They should be initiated at the <s>Citrāpūrṇamāsa</s>.

children.text: cakṣur vā etat saṃvvatsarasya yaccitrāpūrṇamāso mukhato vai cakṣur mukhata eva tat saṃvvatsaram ārabhya dīkṣante tasya na niryāsti
children.translated_text: The <s>Citrāpūrṇamāsa</s> is the eye of the year; the eye is in the face. Thus they are initiated after taking hold of the year from the face itself. It has no drawback.

children.text: caturahe purastāt paurṇamāsyā dīkṣeran
children.translated_text: They should be initiated four days before the full moon.

children.text: teṣām ekāṣṭakāyāṃ krayaḥ saṃpadyate tenaikāṣṭakāṃ na saṃ baṭ kurvanti
children.translated_text: For them the purchase of Soma falls on the <s>Ekāṣṭakā</s>; by that they do not make the <s>Ekāṣṭakā</s> their initiation day.

children.text: teṣāṃ pūrvapakṣe sutyā saṃpadyate pūrvapakṣe māsāḥ saṃtiṣṭhamānā yanti pūrvapakṣa uttiṣṭhanti tān uttiṣṭhataḥ paśava oṣadhayo 'nūttiṣṭhanti tān kalyāṇī vāg abhivadaryarātsur ime sattriṇa iti te rādhnuvanti ||
children.translated_text: For them the Soma-pressing falls in the bright fortnight. In the bright fortnight the months go as they are coming to completion; in the bright fortnight they rise up. As they rise up, cattle and plants rise up after them. An auspicious voice addresses them, saying, "These <s>sattrins</s> have succeeded." They attain success.

children.text: ā vā ete saṃvvatsaraṃ pyāyayanti ya utsṛjanti
children.translated_text: Those who perform the release make the year swell full.

children.text: yathā vai dṛtir ādhmāta evaṃ saṃvvatsaro 'nutsṛṣṭo yan notsṛjeyur amehena pramāyukāḥ syuḥ
children.translated_text: As an inflated leather bag is, so is the year when it has not been released. If they did not release it, they would be liable to die prematurely from urinary obstruction.

children.text: prāṇo vai saṃvvatsara udānā māsā yad utsṛjanti prāṇa evodānān dadhati yo dīkṣitaḥ pramīyate yā saṃvvatsarasyānutsṛṣṭasya śuk sā tam ṛcchati
children.translated_text: The year is <s>prāṇa</s> (in-breath); the months are <s>udānas</s> (up-breaths). When they release, they place the <s>udānas</s> in the <s>prāṇa</s>. If one who is initiated dies, the pain of the unreleased year reaches him.

children.text: tad āhur utsṛjyā3ṃ notsṛjyā3m iti
children.translated_text: Concerning this they say, "Should it be released, or should it not be released?"

children.text: yady utsṛjeyur ukthāny utsṛjeyus tad evotsṛṣṭaṃ tad anutsṛṣṭam
children.translated_text: If they were to release, they should release the <s>ukthas</s>; that is both released and unreleased.

children.text: atho khalv āhur ekatrikaṃ kāryaṃ tad eva sākṣād utsṛṣṭam abhyutṣuṇvanti
children.translated_text: But then they say, "An <s>ekatrika</s> should be performed; that alone is release in direct form." They press Soma in addition.

children.text: chidro vā eteṣāṃ saṃvvatsara ity āhur ye stomam utsṛjantīti
children.translated_text: They say, "The year of those who release the <s>stoma</s> has a breach."

children.text: paśum ālabhante stomam eva tad ālabhante stomo hi paśuḥ
children.translated_text: They take an animal victim; thereby they take the <s>stoma</s> itself, for the <s>stoma</s> is the animal.

children.text: śva utsṛṣṭāḥ sma iti vatsān apākurvanti prātaḥ paśum ālabhante tasya vapayā pracaranti tatas savanīyenāṣṭākapālena tata āgneyenāṣṭākapālena tato dadhnaindreṇa tataś caruṇā vaiśvadevena tat prātaḥsavanaṃ saṃtiṣṭhante
children.translated_text: Saying, "Tomorrow we are released," they drive the calves away.
