In the morning they take the animal victim; they proceed with its omentum, then with the <s>savanīya</s> eight-potsherd cake, then with the <s>Āgneya</s> eight-potsherd cake, then with the curds for <s>Indra</s>, then with the <s>Vaiśvadeva</s> <s>caru</s> (boiled offering). In that way they complete the morning pressing.

children.text: tataḥ paśupuroḍāśenaikādaśakapālena tataḥ savanīyenaikādaśakapālena tato marutvatīyenaikādaśakapālena tataś caruṇaindreṇa tan mādhyandinaṃ savanaṃ saṃtiṣṭhante
children.translated_text: Then with the animal's <s>puroḍāśa</s> (sacrificial cake) of eleven potsherds, then with the <s>savanīya</s> of eleven potsherds, then with the <s>Marutvatīya</s> of eleven potsherds, then with the <s>Aindra</s> <s>caru</s>; in that way they complete the midday pressing.

children.text: paśunā pracaranti tataḥ savanīyena dvādaśakapālena tato vaiśvadevena dvādaśakapālena tataś caruṇāgnimārutena tat tṛtīyaṃ savanaṃ saṃtiṣṭhante
children.translated_text: They proceed with the animal victim; then with the <s>savanīya</s> twelve-potsherd cake, then with the <s>Vaiśvadeva</s> twelve-potsherd cake, then with the <s>Agnimāruta</s> <s>caru</s>. In that way they complete the third pressing.

children.text: pṛṣadājyena pracarya patnīs saṃyājayanti ||
children.translated_text: After proceeding with the <s>pṛṣadājya</s> (speckled ghee), they perform the <s>patnīsaṃyājas</s> (wives' offerings).

children.text: Chapter 6
prajāpatir akāmayata bahu syāṃ prajāyeyeti sa etam agniṣṭomam apaśyat tam āharat tenemāḥ prajā asṛjata
children.translated_text: <s>Prajāpati</s> desired, "May I become many; may I be propagated." He saw this <s>Agniṣṭoma</s>, brought it forth, and with it created these creatures.

children.text: ekādaśena ca vai satā stotreṇāgniṣṭomasyāsṛjataikādaśena ca māsā saṃvvatsarasya tā dvādaśena ca stotreṇāgniṣṭomasya paryagṛhṇād dvādaśena ca māsā saṃvvatsarasya
children.translated_text: By means of the eleventh <s>stotra</s> of the <s>Agniṣṭoma</s>, and by means of the eleventh month of the year, he created them; by means of the twelfth <s>stotra</s> of the <s>Agniṣṭoma</s>, and by means of the twelfth month of the year, he enclosed them.

children.text: tasmāt prajā daśamāso garbhaṃ bhṛtvaikādaśam anu prajāyante tasmād dvādaśaṃ nābhyatiharanti dvādaśena hi parigṛhītās tad ya evaṃ veda pari jātāḥ prajā gṛhṇāti pra jātā janayanti
children.translated_text: Therefore creatures, after carrying the embryo for ten months, are born in the eleventh; therefore they do not pass beyond the twelfth, for they were enclosed by the twelfth. Whoever knows thus takes hold of creatures as they are born; once born, they generate offspring.

children.text: tāsāṃ parigṛhītānām aśvatary atyakrāmat tasyā anuhāya reta ādattā tad vaḍavāyāṃ nyamāḍ yasmād vaḍavā dviretās tasmād aśvatary aprajā āttaretā hi
children.translated_text: While they were being enclosed, a she-mule stepped beyond them. Having followed her, he took her seed and deposited it in a mare. Because the mare has twofold seed, therefore the she-mule is barren, for her seed has been taken away.

children.text: tasmād v adakṣiṇīyāti hi sā yajñam aricyatātiriktasya dakṣiṇā syāt salomatvāya ṣoḍaśinaḥ stotredeyātirikto vai ṣoḍaśy atirikta evātiriktāṃ dadāti
children.translated_text: Therefore she is not suitable as a <s>dakṣiṇā</s> (sacrificial fee), for she outstripped the sacrifice. The sacrificial fee should belong to what is extra. For making the <s>Ṣoḍaśin</s>'s <s>stotra</s> complete with hair, an extra fee should be given; the <s>Ṣoḍaśin</s> is extra, and to the extra he gives an extra one.

children.text: so 'kāmayata yajñaṃ sṛjeyeti sa mukhata eva trivṛtam asṛjata taṃ gāyatrīchando 'nvasṛjyatāgnir devatā brāhmaṇo manuṣyo vasanta ṛtus tasmāt trivṛt stomānāṃ mukhaṃ gāyatrī chandasām agnir devatānāṃ brāhmaṇo manuṣyāṇāṃ vasanta ṛtūnāṃ tasmād brāhmaṇo mukhena vīryaṃ karoti mukhato hi sṛṣṭaḥ
children.translated_text: He desired, "May I create the sacrifice." From his mouth itself he created the <s>Trivṛt</s>; the <s>Gāyatrī</s> metre was created after it, <s>Agni</s> as deity, the <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> as human being, and spring as season. Therefore the <s>Trivṛt</s> is the mouth of the <s>stomas</s>, <s>Gāyatrī</s> of the metres, <s>Agni</s> of the deities, the <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> of human beings, and spring of the seasons. Therefore a <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> performs vigor by the mouth, for he was created from the mouth.

children.text: karoti mukhena vīryaṃ ya evaṃ veda
children.translated_text: Whoever knows thus performs vigor by the mouth.

children.text: sa urasta eva bāhubhyāṃ pañcadaśam asṛjata taṃ triṣṭupchando 'nvasṛjyatendro devatā rājanyo manuṣyo grīṣma ṛtus tasmād rājanyasya pañcadaśa stomas triṣṭup chanda indro devatā grīṣma ṛtus tasmād u bāhuvīryo bāhubhyāṃ hi sṛṣṭaḥ
children.translated_text: From his breast itself, with his two arms, he created the <s>Pañcadaśa</s>; the <s>Triṣṭubh</s> metre was created after it, <s>Indra</s> as deity, the <s>Rājanya</s> as human being, and summer as season. Therefore the <s>Pañcadaśa</s> is the <s>stoma</s> of the <s>Rājanya</s>, <s>Triṣṭubh</s> his metre, <s>Indra</s> his deity, and summer his season. Therefore he is strong in the arms, for he was created from the arms.

children.text: karoti bāhubhyāṃ vīryaṃ ya evaṃ veda
children.translated_text: Whoever knows thus performs vigor by the arms.

children.text: sa madhyata eva prajananāt saptadaśam asṛjata taṃ jagatīchando 'nvasṛjyata viśve devā devatā vaiśyo manuṣyo varṣā ṛtus tasmād vaiśyo 'dyamāno na kṣīyate prajananāddhi sṛṣṭas tasmād u bahupaśur vaiśvadevo hi jāgato varṣā hy asyartus tasmād brāhmaṇasya ca rājanyasya cādyo 'dharo hi sṛṣṭaḥ
children.translated_text: From his middle itself, from the organ of generation, he created the <s>Saptadaśa</s>; the <s>Jagatī</s> metre was created after it, the <s>Viśve Devāḥ</s> as deity, the <s>Vaiśya</s> as human being, and the rainy season as season. Therefore the <s>Vaiśya</s>, though being consumed, is not exhausted, for he was created from generation; therefore he also has much cattle, for he is connected with the <s>Viśve Devāḥ</s>, is <s>Jāgata</s>, and the rains are his season. Therefore he is food for the <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> and the <s>Rājanya</s>, for he was created lower down.

children.text: sa patta eva pratiṣṭhāyā ekaviṃśam asṛjata tam anuṣṭupchando 'nvasṛjyata na kācana devatā śūdro manuṣyas tasmācchūdra uta bahupaśur ayajñiyo videvo hi na hi taṃ kācana devatā 'nvasṛjyata tasmāt pādāv anejyaṃ nātivardhate patto hi sṛṣṭas tasmād ekaviṃśastomānāṃ pratiṣṭhā pratiṣṭhāyā hi sṛṣṭas tasmād anuṣṭubhaṃ chandāṃsi nānuvyūhanti
children.translated_text: From his foot itself, from the foundation, he created the <s>Ekaviṃśa</s>; the <s>Anuṣṭubh</s> metre was created after it, no deity at all, and the <s>Śūdra</s> as human being. Therefore a <s>Śūdra</s>, even if rich in cattle, is not fit for sacrifice, for he is without a deity; indeed no deity at all was created after him. Therefore the feet are not venerable and do not grow beyond measure, for he was created from the foot. Therefore the <s>Ekaviṃśa</s> is the foundation of the <s>stomas</s>, for it was created from the foundation. Therefore they do not rearrange the metres after the <s>Anuṣṭubh</s>.

children.text: pāpavasīyaso vidhṛtyai
children.translated_text: For the holding apart of what is evil and worse.

children.text: vidhṛtiḥ pāpavasīyaso bhavati ya evaṃ veda ||
children.translated_text: There is a holding apart of what is evil and worse for one who knows thus.

children.text: yo vai stomān upadeśanavato vedopadeśanavān bhavati
children.translated_text: Whoever knows the <s>stomas</s> as furnished with <s>upadeśana</s> (indication) becomes furnished with <s>upadeśana</s>.

children.text: prāṇo vai trivṛd ardhamāsaḥ pañcadaśaḥ saṃvvatsaraḥ saptadaśa āditya ekaviṃśa ete vai stomā upadeśanavanta upadeśanavān bhavati ya evaṃ veda
children.translated_text: The vital breath is the <s>Trivṛt</s>, the half-month is the <s>Pañcadaśa</s>, the year is the <s>Saptadaśa</s>, and the sun is the <s>Ekaviṃśa</s>. These <s>stomas</s> are indeed furnished with <s>upadeśana</s>; whoever knows thus becomes furnished with <s>upadeśana</s>.

children.text: ime vai lokās triṇavas triṇavasya vai brāhmaṇeneme lokās triṣ punar navā bhavanti
children.translated_text: These worlds are the <s>Triṇava</s>; by the sacred explanation of the <s>Triṇava</s>, these worlds become renewed three times.

children.text: eṣu lokeṣu pratitiṣṭhati ya evaṃ veda
children.translated_text: Whoever knows thus becomes established in these worlds.

children.text: devatā vāva trayastriṃśo 'ṣṭau vasava ekādaśa rudrā dvādaśādityāḥ prajāpatiś ca vaṣaṭkāraś ca trayastriṃśau
children.translated_text: The <s>Trayastriṃśa</s> is in truth the deities: the eight <s>Vasus</s>, the eleven <s>Rudras</s>, the twelve <s>Ādityas</s>, and <s>Prajāpati</s> and the <s>Vaṣaṭkāra</s> as the two thirty-third ones.

children.text: sa devena yajñena yajate ya evaṃ veda
children.translated_text: Whoever knows thus sacrifices with a divine sacrifice.

children.text: yo vā adhipatiṃ vedādhipatir bhavati trayastriṃśo vai stomānām adhipatiḥ puruṣaḥ paśumān
children.translated_text: Whoever knows the overlord becomes an overlord. The <s>Trayastriṃśa</s> is the overlord of the <s>stomas</s>; the person is possessed of cattle.

children.text: tasmān nyañco 'nye paśavo 'danty ūrdhvaḥ puruṣo 'dhipatir hi saḥ
children.translated_text: Therefore other animals eat bending downward, while the person is upright, for he is the overlord.

children.text: adhipatiḥ samānānāṃ bhavati ya evaṃ veda ||
children.translated_text: Whoever knows thus becomes overlord among his equals.

children.text: eṣa vāva yajño yad agniṣṭomaḥ
children.translated_text: This indeed is the sacrifice, namely the <s>Agniṣṭoma</s>.

children.text: ekasmā anyo yajñaḥ kāmāyāhriyate sarvebhyo 'gniṣṭomaḥ
children.translated_text: Another sacrifice is brought for a single desire; the <s>Agniṣṭoma</s> is brought for all desires.

children.text: dvādaśa stotrāṇy agniṣṭomo dvādaśamāsāḥ saṃvvatsaraḥ saṃvvatsaraṃ paśavo 'nu prajāyante tena paśavyaḥ samṛddhaḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>Agniṣṭoma</s> has twelve <s>stotras</s>; the year has twelve months. Cattle are born in accordance with the year; therefore it is favorable to cattle and complete.

children.text: dvādaśa stotrāṇi dvādaśa śastrāṇi taccaturviṃśatiś caturviṃśatir ardhamāsāḥ saṃvvatsaraḥ saṃvvatsaraṃ paśavo 'nuprajāyante tena paśavyaḥ samṛddhaḥ
children.translated_text: There are twelve <s>stotras</s> and twelve <s>śastras</s>; that is twenty-four. There are twenty-four half-months in the year. Cattle are born in accordance with the year; therefore it is favorable to cattle and complete.

children.text: agnau stotram agnau śastraṃ pratitiṣṭhati tena brahmavarcasasya
children.translated_text: The <s>stotra</s> is established in fire, and the <s>śastra</s> is established in fire; by that it has <s>brahmavarcas</s> (sacred brilliance).

children.text: kiṃ jyotiṣṭomasya jyotiṣṭomatvam ity āhur virājaṃ saṃstutaḥ sampadyate virāḍ vai chandasāṃ jyotiḥ
children.translated_text: They say, "What is the <s>Jyotiṣṭoma</s>-nature of the <s>Jyotiṣṭoma</s>?" When fully praised, it attains the <s>Virāj</s>; the <s>Virāj</s> is indeed the light of the metres.

children.text: jyotiḥ samānānāṃ bhavati ya evaṃ veda
children.translated_text: Whoever knows thus becomes a light among his equals.

children.text: jyeṣṭhayajño vā eṣa yad agniṣṭomaḥ
children.translated_text: This is the eldest sacrifice, namely the <s>Agniṣṭoma</s>.

children.text: prajāpatiḥ prajā asṛjata tā asmai śraiṣṭhyāya nātiṣṭhanta sa etam agniṣṭomam apaśyat tam āharat tato 'smai prajāḥ śraiṣṭhyāyātiṣṭhanta
children.translated_text: <s>Prajāpati</s> created creatures. They did not stand by him for supremacy. He saw this <s>Agniṣṭoma</s> and brought it forth; then the creatures stood by him for supremacy.

children.text: tiṣṭhante 'smai samānāḥ śraiṣṭhyāya ya evaṃ veda
children.translated_text: Whoever knows thus has his equals stand by him for supremacy.

children.text: yat tv ity āhur gāyatraṃ prātaḥsavanaṃ traiṣṭubhaṃ mādhyandinaṃ savanaṃ jāgataṃ tṛtīyasavanaṃ kva tarhi turīyaṃ chando 'nuṣṭub iti
children.translated_text: Now as to what they say: "The morning pressing is <s>Gāyatra</s>, the midday pressing is <s>Traiṣṭubha</s>, and the third pressing is <s>Jāgata</s>; where, then, is the fourth metre, <s>Anuṣṭubh</s>?"

children.text: chandasāṃ vā anvavaluptiṃ yajamāno 'nvavalupyate
children.translated_text: When there is a diminution of the metres, the sacrificer is diminished along with them.

children.text: aṣṭākṣarā gāyatrī hiṅkāro navama ekādaśākṣarā triṣṭub dvādaśākṣarā jagatī chandobhirevānuṣṭubham āpnoti yajamānasyānavalopāya
children.translated_text: The <s>Gāyatrī</s> has eight syllables, and the <s>hiṅkāra</s> is the ninth; the <s>Triṣṭubh</s> has eleven syllables, and the <s>Jagatī</s> has twelve syllables. By the metres themselves he obtains the <s>Anuṣṭubh</s>, so that the sacrificer may not be diminished.

children.text: yo vā anuṣṭubhaṃ sarvatrāpiṃ savanāny anvāyattāṃ veda sarvatrāsyāpir bhavaty eṣā vā anuṣṭup sarvatrāpiḥ savanāny anvāyattā tad ya evaṃ veda sarvatrāpir bhavati
children.translated_text: Whoever knows the <s>Anuṣṭubh</s> as present everywhere, with the pressings dependent on it, has access everywhere. This <s>Anuṣṭubh</s> is indeed present everywhere, and the pressings are dependent on it. Therefore one who knows thus becomes one who has access everywhere.

children.text: yad vai rājāno 'dhvānaṃ dhāvayanti ye 'śvānāṃ vīryavattamās tān yuñjate trivṛt pañcadaśa ekaviṃśa ete vai stomānāṃ vīryavattamās tān eva yuṅkte svargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai
children.translated_text: When kings set out on a road, they yoke those horses that have the greatest strength. The <s>Trivṛt</s>, <s>Pañcadaśa</s>, and <s>Ekaviṃśa</s> are indeed the strongest of the <s>stomas</s> (chant-forms). He yokes just them, for the attainment of the heavenly world.

children.text: catuṣṭomo bhavati pratiṣṭhā vai catuṣṭomaḥ pratiṣṭhityai ||
children.translated_text: It is a <s>Catuṣṭoma</s> (fourfold stoma); the <s>Catuṣṭoma</s> is indeed a foundation, for establishment.

children.text: prajāpatir devebhya ūrjaṃ vyabhajat tata udumbaraḥ samabhavat prājāpatyo vā udumbaraḥ prājāpatya udgātā yad udgātaudumbarīṃ prathamena karmaṇānvārabhate svayaiva tad devatayātmānam ārtvijyāya vṛṇīte
children.translated_text: <s>Prajāpati</s> distributed nourishment among the gods; from that the <s>udumbara</s> tree came into being. The <s>udumbara</s> belongs to <s>Prajāpati</s>, and the <s>Udgātā</s> belongs to <s>Prajāpati</s>. When the <s>Udgātā</s> takes hold of the <s>audumbarī</s> as his first ritual act, he thereby chooses himself for priestly service through his own deity.

children.text: tām ucchrayati dyutānas tvā māruta ucchrayatūd divaṃ stabhānāntarikṣaṃ pṛṇa dṛṃha pṛthivīm
children.translated_text: He raises it up with the formula: "May the radiant <s>Marut</s> raise you up; support heaven, fill the midspace, and make firm the earth."

children.text: tām anvārabhata āyoṣ ṭvā sadane sādayāmy avataś chāyāyāṃ samudrasya hṛdaya iti
children.translated_text: He takes hold of it with the formula: "I set you in the seat of life, in the shade of protection, in the heart of the ocean."

children.text: yajño vā āyus tasya tat sadanaṃ kriyate
children.translated_text: The sacrifice is life; that seat is made for it.

children.text: yajño vā avati tasya sā chāyā kriyate
children.translated_text: The sacrifice protects; that shade is made for it.

children.text: madhyato vā ātmano hṛdayaṃ tasmān madhye sadasa audumbarī mīyate
children.translated_text: The heart is in the middle of the body; therefore the <s>audumbarī</s> is set up in the middle of the <s>sadas</s> (sacrificial hall).

children.text: namaḥ samudrāya namaḥ samudrasya cakṣuṣa ity āha vāg vai samudro manaḥ samudrasya cakṣus tābhyām eva tan namas karoti
children.translated_text: He says, "Homage to the ocean, homage to the eye of the ocean." Speech is the ocean, and mind is the eye of the ocean. To those two he thereby pays homage.

children.text: sāmā yūnarvāhāsīd ity āha sāma vai yūnarvā sāmna eva tan namaskaroty ārtvijyaṃ kariṣyan
children.translated_text: He says, "The <s>Sāman</s> was <s>Yūnarvāha</s>." The <s>Sāman</s> is indeed <s>Yūnarvāha</s>; he thereby pays homage to the <s>Sāman</s> itself when he is about to perform the priestly office.

children.text: yo vā evaṃ sāmne namaskṛtya sāmnārtvijyaṃ karoti na sāmno hīyate nainaṃ sāmāpahate
children.translated_text: Whoever, having thus paid homage to the <s>Sāman</s>, performs the priestly office with the <s>Sāman</s>, is not deprived of the <s>Sāman</s>, and the <s>Sāman</s> does not strike him down.

children.text: ya enam anuvyāharati sa ārtim ārchati
children.translated_text: Whoever speaks against him falls into distress.

children.text: ūrg asy ūrjodā ūrjaṃ me dehy ūrjaṃ me dhehy annaṃ me dehy annaṃ me dhehi prajāpater vā etad udaraṃ yat sada ūrg udumbaro yad audumbarī madhye sadaso mīyate madhyata eva tat prajābhyo 'nnam ūrjaṃ dadhāti
children.translated_text: "You are nourishment, giver of nourishment; give me nourishment, place nourishment in me; give me food, place food in me." The <s>sadas</s> is indeed the belly of <s>Prajāpati</s>; the <s>udumbara</s> is nourishment. When the <s>audumbarī</s> is set up in the middle of the <s>sadas</s>, he thereby places food and nourishment for creatures from the middle.

children.text: tasmād yatraiṣā yātayāmā kriyate tat prajā aśanāyavo bhavanti
children.translated_text: Therefore, wherever this is made stale and spent, the creatures there become hungry.

children.text: sāma devānām annaṃ sāmany eva tad devebhyo 'nna ūrjaṃ dadhāti sa eva tad ūrji śritaḥ prajābhya ūrjaṃ vibhajati
children.translated_text: The <s>Sāman</s> is the food of the gods. In the <s>Sāman</s> itself he thereby places food and nourishment for the gods. Resting in that nourishment, he distributes nourishment to creatures.

children.text: udaṅṅ āsīna udgāyaty udīcīṃ tādṛśam ūrjā bhājayati pratyaṅṅ āsīnaḥ prastauti pratīcīṃ tādṛśam ūrjā bhājayati dakṣiṇāsīnaḥ pratiharati dakṣiṇāṃ tādṛśam ūrjā bhājayati prāñco 'nya ṛtvija ārtvijyaṃ kurvanti tasmād eṣā diśāṃ vīryavattamaitāṃ hi bhūyiṣṭhāḥ prīṇanti
children.translated_text: Sitting facing north, he sings the <s>udgītha</s>; he makes the northern direction and those corresponding to it share in nourishment. Sitting facing west, he begins the chant; he makes the western direction and those corresponding to it share in nourishment. Sitting facing south, he responds; he makes the southern direction and those corresponding to it share in nourishment. The other priests perform their priestly service facing east; therefore this is the strongest of the directions, for the greatest number gratify it.

children.text: brahmavādino vadanti kasmāt satyāt prāñco 'nya ṛtvija ārtvijyaṃ kurvantīti viparikramyodgātāra iti diśām abhīṣṭyai diśām abhiprītyā iti brūyāt tasmāt sarvāsu dikṣv annaṃ vidyate sarvā hy abhīṣṭāḥ prītāḥ ||
children.translated_text: The expounders of <s>brahman</s> say, "Because of what truth do the other priests perform their priestly service facing east, while the <s>Udgātṛs</s> have gone round in reverse?" He should answer, "For the winning of the directions, for the pleasing of the directions." Therefore food is found in all directions, for all have been won and pleased.

children.text: prajāpatir akāmayata bahu syāṃ prajāyeyeti so 'śocat tasya śocata ādityo mūrdhno 'sṛjyata so 'sya mūrdhānam udahan sa droṇakalaśo 'bhavat tasmin devāḥ śukram agṛhṇata tāṃ vai sa āyuṣārtim atyajīvat
children.translated_text: <s>Prajāpati</s> desired, "May I become many; may I propagate." He became heated. From him, as he was heated, the <s>Āditya</s> was created from his head. It struck off his head, and that became the <s>droṇakalaśa</s>. In it the gods drew the bright Soma. He indeed lived beyond that affliction through life.

children.text: āyuṣārtim atijīvati ya evaṃ veda
children.translated_text: One who knows thus lives beyond affliction through life.

children.text: raṃ prohed vānaspatyo 'si bārhaspatyo 'si prājāpatyo 'si prajāpater mūrdhāsy atyāyupātram asīdam ahaṃ māṃ prāñcaṃ prohāmi tejase brahmavarcasāyeti
children.translated_text: He should push it forward with the formula: "You are of the trees; you are <s>Bārhaspatya</s>; you are <s>Prājāpatya</s>; you are the head of <s>Prajāpati</s>; you are the vessel of surpassing life. Here I push myself forward eastward, for splendor and for <s>brahmavarcas</s> (sacred brilliance)."

children.text: yad āha vānaspatya iti satyenaivainaṃ tat prohati
children.translated_text: When he says, "You are of the trees," he thereby pushes it forward by truth.

children.text: yad āha bārhaspatya iti bṛhaspatir vai devānām udgātā tam eva tad yunakti
children.translated_text: When he says, "You are <s>Bārhaspatya</s>," <s>Bṛhaspati</s> is indeed the <s>Udgātā</s> of the gods; him he thereby yokes.

children.text: yad āha prājāpatya iti prājāpatyo hy eṣa devatāyā yad droṇakalaśo yad āha prajāpater mūrdheti prajāpater hy eṣa mūrdhna udahanyata
children.translated_text: When he says, "You are <s>Prājāpatya</s>," this <s>droṇakalaśa</s> is indeed <s>Prājāpatya</s> by deity. When he says, "You are the head of <s>Prajāpati</s>," it is because this was struck off from <s>Prajāpati</s>'s head.

children.text: yad āhātyāyupātram ity ati hy etad anyāni pātrāṇi yad droṇakalaśo devapātraṃ droṇakalaśaḥ
children.translated_text: When he says, "You are the vessel of surpassing life," this, namely the <s>droṇakalaśa</s>, surpasses the other vessels; the <s>droṇakalaśa</s> is a divine vessel.

children.text: devapātrī bhavati ya evaṃ veda
children.translated_text: One who knows thus becomes possessed of a divine vessel.

children.text: brāhmaṇaṃ pātre na mīmāṃseta yaṃ brāhmaṇam iva manyate pra devapātram āpnoti na manuṣyapātrāc chidyate
children.translated_text: One should not examine a <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> in regard to a vessel. The one whom he regards as like a <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> reaches the divine vessel and is not cut off from the human vessel.

children.text: vāg vai devebhyo 'pakrāmat sāpaḥ prāviśat tāṃ devāḥ punar ayācaṃs tā abruvan yat punar dadyāma kiṃ nas tataḥ syād iti yat kāmayadhva ity abruvaṃs tā abruvan yad evāsmāsu manuṣyā apūtaṃ praveśayāṃs tenāsaṃsṛṣṭā asāmeti
children.translated_text: Speech withdrew from the gods and entered the waters. The gods asked for it back. They said, "If we were to give it back, what would be ours from that?" The gods said, "Whatever you desire." They said, "May we remain unmixed with whatever impure thing human beings put into us."

children.text: śuddhā asmā āpaḥ pūtā bhavanti ya evaṃ veda
children.translated_text: For one who knows thus, the waters become clean and purified.

children.text: sā punartātyakrāmat sā vanaspatīn prāviśat tān devāḥ punar ayācaṃs tāṃ na punar adadus tān aśapan svena vaḥ kiṣkuṇā vajreṇa vṛścān iti tasmād vanaspatīn svena kiṣkuṇā vajreṇa vṛścanti devaśaptā hi
children.translated_text: That speech again went beyond that; she entered the forest trees. The gods again asked them for her, but they did not give her back. They cursed them: "With your own <s>kiṣku</s> as a thunderbolt, may one cut you." Therefore people cut forest trees with their own <s>kiṣku</s> as a thunderbolt, for they have been cursed by the gods.

children.text: tāṃ vanaspatayaś caturdhā vācaṃ vinyadadhur dundubhau vīṇāyām akṣe tūṇave tasmād eṣā vadiṣṭhaiṣā valgutamā vāg vā vanaspatīnāṃ devānāṃ hy eṣā vāg āsīt
children.translated_text: The forest trees distributed speech fourfold: in the <s>dundubhi</s> (drum), in the <s>vīṇā</s> (lute), in the dice, and in the <s>tūṇava</s> (flute). Therefore this is the most articulate, this is the most charming speech of the forest trees, for it had been the speech of the gods.

children.text: adho 'dho 'kṣaṃ droṇakalaśaṃ prohanti tasyā vāco 'varudhyā uparyupary akṣaṃ pavitraṃ prayacchanty ubhayata eva vācaṃ parigṛhṇanti
children.translated_text: They set the <s>droṇakalaśa</s> below, below the axle, in order to secure that speech. They stretch the <s>pavitra</s> above, above the axle. Thus they take hold of speech from both sides.

children.text: yasya kāmayetāsuryam asya yajñaṃ kuryāṃ vācaṃ vṛñjīyeti droṇakalaśaṃ prohan bāhubhyām akṣan upaspṛśed asuryam asya yajñaṃ karoti vācaṃ vṛṅkte yo 'sya priyaḥ syād anupaspṛśann akṣaṃ prohet prāṇā vai droṇakalaśaḥ prāṇān evāsya kalpayati
children.translated_text: If he should wish, "May I make his sacrifice demonic; may I deprive him of speech," then, while setting the <s>droṇakalaśa</s> in place, he should touch the axle with his arms. He makes his sacrifice demonic and deprives him of speech. For one who is dear to him, he should set it in place without touching the axle. The <s>droṇakalaśa</s> is the vital breaths; he thereby arranges the vital breaths for him.

children.text: yan nv ity āhur vācānyān ṛtvijo vṛṇate kasmād udgātāro vṛtā ārtvijyaṃ kurvantīti
children.translated_text: Now when they say, "They choose the other officiating priests by speech; how then do the <s>Udgātṛs</s> perform priestly service as chosen ones?"

children.text: yad droṇakalaśam upasīdanti tenodgātāro vṛtāḥ
children.translated_text: In that they sit down beside the <s>droṇakalaśa</s>, by that the <s>Udgātṛs</s> are chosen.

children.text: prājāpatyā vā udgātāraḥ prājāpatyo droṇakalaśo droṇakalaśa evainām ārtvijyāya vṛṇīte
children.translated_text: The <s>Udgātṛs</s> belong to <s>Prajāpati</s>; the <s>droṇakalaśa</s> belongs to <s>Prajāpati</s>. The <s>droṇakalaśa</s> itself chooses them for priestly service.

children.text: prāñca upasīdanti prāñco yajñasyāgre karavāmeti
children.translated_text: They sit down facing east, thinking, "Facing east we shall act at the front of the sacrifice."

children.text: anabhijitā vā eṣodgātṝṇāṃ dig yat prācī yad droṇakalaśaṃ prāñcaṃ prohanti diśo 'bhijityai
children.translated_text: This eastern direction is one not yet conquered by the <s>Udgātṛs</s>. When they set the <s>droṇakalaśa</s> eastward, it is for conquering the direction.

children.text: yannvityāhur antarāśvaḥ prāsevau yujyate 'ntarā śamya anaḍvān ka udgātṝṇāṃ yoga iti yad droṇakalaśam upasīdanti sa eṣāṃ yogas tasmād yuktair evopasadyaṃ na hy ayukto vahati ||
children.translated_text: Now when they say, "A horse is yoked between the two <s>prāsevas</s>, an ox between the two <s>śamyās</s>; what is the yoking of the <s>Udgātṛs</s>?" In that they sit by the <s>droṇakalaśa</s>, that is their yoking. Therefore one should approach only when yoked, for one who is not yoked does not draw.

children.text: grāvṇaḥ saṃsādya droṇakalaśam adhyūhanti viḍ vai grāvāṇo 'nnaṃ somo rāṣṭraṃ droṇakalaśo yad grāvasu droṇakalaśam adhyūhanti viśy eva tad rāṣṭram adhyūhanti
children.translated_text: After placing the pressing stones together, they set the <s>droṇakalaśa</s> upon them. The pressing stones are the people, <s>Soma</s> is food, and the <s>droṇakalaśa</s> is the realm. When they set the <s>droṇakalaśa</s> upon the pressing stones, they thereby set the realm upon the people.

children.text: yaṃ dviṣyād vimukhān grāvṇaḥ kṛtvedam aham amum amuṣyāyaṇam amuṣyāḥ putram amuṣyā viśo 'muṣmād annādyān nirūhāmīti nirūhed viśa evainam annādyān nirūhati
children.translated_text: Whomever he hates, having turned the pressing stones away from each other, he should remove him, saying, "I remove this one, N.N. descendant of N.N., son of N.N., from this people and from this food." He removes him from the people and from food.

children.text: yo 'sya priyaḥ syāt saṃmukhān grāvṇaḥ kṛtvedam aham amuṣyāyaṇam amuṣyāḥ putram amuṣyāṃ viśy amuṣminn annādye 'dhyūhāmīty adhyūhed viśy evainam annādye 'dhyūhati
children.translated_text: For one who is dear to him, having made the pressing stones face each other, he should set him there, saying, "I set this one, N.N. descendant of N.N., son of N.N., in this people and in this food." He sets him within the people and within food.

children.text: atho tad ubhayam anādṛtyedam ahaṃ māṃ tejasi brahmavarcase 'dhyūhāmīty adhyūhet tejasy eva brahmavarcasa ātmānam adhyūhati
children.translated_text: Or, disregarding both of those, he should set himself there, saying, "I set myself in vigor and <s>brahmavarcas</s> (sacred brilliance)." He sets himself in vigor and sacred brilliance.

children.text: yaḥ kāmayeta viśā rāṣṭraṃ hanyām iti vyūhya grāvṇo 'dho droṇakalaśaṃ sādayitvopāṃśusavanam upariṣṭād abhinidadhyād idam aham amuyā viśā 'do rāṣṭraṃ hanmīti viśaiva tad rāṣṭraṃ hanti
children.translated_text: Whoever should wish, "May I strike the realm by means of the people," after spreading apart the pressing stones and setting the <s>droṇakalaśa</s> below, should place the <s>upāṃśusavana</s> above it, saying, "With this people I strike that realm." By the people he thereby strikes the realm.

children.text: yo vai daivāni pavitrāṇi veda pūto yajñiyo bhavati chandāṃsi vai daivāni pavitrāṇi tair droṇakalaśaṃ pāvayanti
children.translated_text: Whoever knows the divine <s>pavitras</s> becomes purified and fit for sacrifice. The metres are the divine <s>pavitras</s>; with them they purify the <s>droṇakalaśa</s>.

children.text: vasavas tvā gāyatreṇa chandasā punantu rudrās tvā traiṣṭubhena chandasā punantv ādityās tvā jāgatena chandasā punantv etāni vai daivāni pavitrāṇi pūto yajñiyo bhavati ya evaṃ veda
children.translated_text: May the <s>Vasus</s> purify you with the <s>Gāyatra</s> metre; may the <s>Rudras</s> purify you with the <s>Traiṣṭubha</s> metre; may the <s>Ādityas</s> purify you with the <s>Jāgata</s> metre. These indeed are the divine <s>pavitras</s>. Whoever knows thus becomes purified and fit for sacrifice.

children.text: svarbhānur vā āsura ādityaṃ tamasāvidhyat taṃ devā na vyajānaṃs te 'trim upādhāvaṃs tasyātrir bhāsena tamo 'pāhan yat prathamam apāhan sā kṛṣṇāvir abhavad yad dvitīyaṃ sā rajatā yat tṛtīyaṃ sā lohinī yayā varṇam abhyatṛṇat sā śuklāsīt
children.translated_text: <s>Svarbhānu</s> the <s>Asura</s> pierced the <s>Āditya</s> (sun) with darkness. The gods could not discern him, so they ran to <s>Atri</s>. <s>Atri</s> struck away the darkness with brilliance. What he struck away first became a black ewe; what he struck away second became a silver-colored one; what third, a red one; the one by which he pierced through to the color was white.

children.text: tasmācchuklaṃ pavitraṃ śukraḥ somaḥ sa śukratvāya
children.translated_text: Therefore the <s>pavitra</s> is white; <s>Soma</s> is bright, for the sake of brightness.

children.text: yaṃ dviṣyāt tasyaiteṣāṃ varṇānām api pavitre kuryāt pāpmanaivainaṃ tamasā vidhyati kṛṣṇam iva hi tamo yo 'sya priyaḥ syād āsaktiśuklaṃ kuryāj jyotir vai hiraṇyaṃ jyotir evāsmin dadhāti
children.translated_text: For one he hates, he should make the <s>pavitra</s> with one of these colors; with evil darkness he pierces him, for darkness is, as it were, black. For one who is dear to him, he should make it white with a gold attachment; gold is light, and he thereby places light in him.

children.text: tasmād ātreyaṃ candreṇecchanty atrir hi tasya jyotiḥ
children.translated_text: Therefore they seek an <s>Ātreya</s> in connection with the moon, for <s>Atri</s> is its light.

children.text: abhyatṛṇat pavitraṃ vigṛhṇanti hastakāryam eva tad yajñasya kriyata etad vā udgātṝṇāṃ hastakāryaṃ yat pavitrasya vigrahaṇam
children.translated_text: At "he pierced through," they hold the <s>pavitra</s> apart. That is the hand-work of the sacrifice being performed. This indeed is the hand-work of the <s>Udgātṛs</s>, namely the holding apart of the <s>pavitra</s>.

children.text: na hastaveṣyān nirṛcchati ya evaṃ veda
children.translated_text: Whoever knows thus does not lose what belongs to hand-service.

children.text: yo 'pi na vigṛhṇāti prāṇād enam antaryanti
children.translated_text: Even the one who does not hold it apart, they shut him off from the vital breath.

children.text: taṃ brūyād vepamānaḥ prameṣyasa iti vepamāna eva pramīyate
children.translated_text: One should say to him, "Trembling, you will die." Trembling indeed he dies.

children.text: pra śukraitu devī manīṣāsmad rathaḥ sutaṣṭo na vājīty udgātā dhārām anumantrayate
children.translated_text: With "Let the bright, divine inspiration go forth from us, like a well-fashioned chariot, like a racehorse," the <s>Udgātṛ</s> addresses the stream.

children.text: āyuṣe me pavasva varcase me pavasva viduḥ pṛthivyā divo janitrācchṛṇvantv āpo 'dhaḥ kṣarantīḥ somehodgāyety āha mahyaṃ tejase brahmavarcasāyeti
children.translated_text: He says, "Flow purified for my life; flow purified for my lustre. They have known from earth, from heaven, from the birthplace; let the waters flowing downward hear. O <s>Soma</s>, sing the <s>udgītha</s> here," meaning, "for me, for vigor and <s>brahmavarcas</s> (sacred brilliance)."

children.text: eṣa vai somasyodgītho yat pavate somodgītham eva sāma gāyati
children.translated_text: This indeed is <s>Soma</s>'s <s>udgītha</s>, namely that he flows purified. He sings a <s>sāman</s> that is just the <s>Soma-udgītha</s>.

children.text: ācchinnaṃ pāvayanti yajñaṃ caiva prāṇāṃś ca saṃtanvanti saṃtataṃ pāvayanti yajñasya saṃtatyai ||
children.translated_text: They purify it when it has been interrupted; they thereby extend both the sacrifice and the vital breaths. They purify it continuously, for the continuity of the sacrifice.

children.text: bṛhaspatir vai devānām udagāyat taṃ rakṣāṃsy ajighāṃsan sa ya eṣāṃ lokānām adhipatayas tān bhāgadheyenopādhāvat
children.translated_text: <s>Bṛhaspati</s> sang as <s>udgātṛ</s> for the gods. The demons wanted to kill him. He ran for help to those who are the overlords of these worlds, each with his sacrificial share.

children.text: sūryo mā divābhyo nāṣṭrābhyaḥ pātu vāyur antarikṣābhyo 'gniḥ pārthivābhyaḥ svāheti juhoti
children.translated_text: He offers, saying, "May <s>Sūrya</s> protect me from the heavenly destroyers; may <s>Vāyu</s> protect me from those of the midspace; may <s>Agni</s> protect me from the earthly ones. Svāhā."

children.text: ete vā eṣāṃ lokānām adhipatayas tān bhāgadheyenopāsarat
children.translated_text: These indeed are the overlords of these worlds; he approached them with their share.

children.text: karoti vācā vīryaṃ na sadasyām ārtim ārchati ya evaṃ veda
children.translated_text: Whoever knows thus produces strength through speech and does not incur injury in the <s>sadas</s> (priests' hall).

children.text: vāg vai devebhyo 'pākrāmat tāṃ devā anvamantrayanta sābravīd abhāgāsmi bhāgadheyaṃ me 'stv iti kas te bhāgadheyaṃ kuryād ity udgātāra ity abravīd udgātāro vai vāce bhāgadheyaṃ kurvanti
children.translated_text: <s>Vāc</s> (Speech) went away from the gods. The gods addressed her, and she said, "I am without a share; let there be a share for me." "Who would make a share for you?" they asked. "The <s>Udgātṛs</s>," she said. The <s>Udgātṛs</s> indeed make a share for Speech.

children.text: tasyai juhuyād bekurānāmāsi juṣṭā devebhyo namo vāce namo vācaspataye devi vāg yat te vāco madhumat tasmin mā dhāḥ sarasvatyai svāheti
children.translated_text: For her he should offer: "You are <s>Bekurā</s> by name, pleasing to the gods. Homage to Speech, homage to <s>Vācaspati</s>. O goddess <s>Vāc</s>, whatever sweetness of speech is yours, set me in that. To <s>Sarasvatī</s>, svāhā."

children.text: vāh vai sarasvatī tām eva tad bhāgadheyenārabhate
children.translated_text: Speech indeed is <s>Sarasvatī</s>; thereby he takes hold of her with her sacrificial share.

children.text: yaṃ dviṣyāt tasyaitām āhutiṃ juhuyād vācaṃ manasā dhyāyed vācam evāsya vṛṅkte
children.translated_text: For a man whom he hates he should offer this oblation, meditating on speech with his mind; he thereby takes away that man's speech.

children.text: bahiṣpavamānaṃ sarpanti svargam eva tallokaṃ sarpanti
children.translated_text: They creep to the <s>Bahiṣpavamāna</s>; thereby they creep to the heavenly world itself.

children.text: prakvāṇā iva sarpanti pratikūlam iva hītaḥ svargo lokaḥ tsaranta iva sarpanti mṛgadharmo vai yajño yajñasya śāntyā apratrāsāya
children.translated_text: They creep as if calling out; for the heavenly world is, as it were, upstream from here. They creep as if slipping along. The sacrifice has the nature of a wild animal; this is for the calming of the sacrifice, so that it may not be startled.

children.text: vācaṃ yacchanti yajñam eva tad yacchanti yad vyavavadeyur yajñaṃ nirbrūyus tasmān na vyavavadyam
children.translated_text: They restrain speech; thereby they restrain the sacrifice itself. If they were to converse, they would speak the sacrifice away; therefore there should be no conversing.

children.text: pañcartvijaḥ saṃrabdhāḥ sarpanti pāṅkto yajño yāvān yajñas tam eva saṃtanvanti
children.translated_text: The five priests creep in close formation. The sacrifice is fivefold; whatever the extent of the sacrifice is, that they extend.

children.text: yadi prastotāvacchidyate yajñasya śiraś chidyate brahmaṇe varaṃ dattvā sa eva punar vartavyaś chinnam eva tat pratidadhāti
children.translated_text: If the <s>Prastotṛ</s> is interrupted, the head of the sacrifice is cut off. After giving a gift to the <s>Brahman</s> priest, that same one should go back again; thereby he restores what was cut off.

children.text: yady udgātāvacchidyate yajñena yajamāno vyṛdhyate 'dakṣiṇaḥ sa yajñakratuḥ saṃsthāpyo 'thānya āhṛtyas tasmin deyaṃ yāvad dāsyan syāt
children.translated_text: If the <s>Udgātṛ</s> is interrupted, the sacrificer fails with respect to the sacrifice. That sacrificial performance is to be brought to completion without a sacrificial fee; then another should be brought in, and in that one as much should be given as he had intended to give.

children.text: yadi pratihartāvacchidyate paśubhir yajamāno vyṛdhyate paśavo vai pratihartā sarvavedasaṃ deyaṃ yadi sarvavedasaṃ na dadāti sarvajyāniṃ jīyate
children.translated_text: If the <s>Pratihartṛ</s> is interrupted, the sacrificer fails with respect to cattle; the <s>Pratihartṛ</s> indeed is cattle. All property should be given. If he does not give all property, he is defeated by total loss.

children.text: adhvaryuḥ prastaraṃ harati
children.translated_text: The <s>Adhvaryu</s> carries the <s>prastara</s>.

children.text: yajamāno vai prastaro yajamānam eva tat svargaṃ lokaṃ harati
children.translated_text: The <s>prastara</s> is the sacrificer; thereby he carries the sacrificer to the heavenly world.

children.text: yajño vai devebhyo 'śvo bhūtvāpākrāmat taṃ devāḥ prastareṇāsamayaṃs tasmād aśvaḥ prastareṇa saṃmṛjyamāna upāvarabhate yad adhvaryuḥ prastaraṃ harati yajñasya śāntyā apratrāsāya
children.translated_text: The sacrifice, having become a horse, went away from the gods. The gods calmed it with the <s>prastara</s>; therefore a horse, when rubbed with the <s>prastara</s>, draws near. When the <s>Adhvaryu</s> carries the <s>prastara</s>, it is for the calming of the sacrifice, so that it may not be startled.

children.text: prajāpatiḥ paśūn asṛjata te 'smāt sṛṣṭā aśanāyanto 'pākrāmaṃs tebhyaḥ prastaram annaṃ prāyacchat enam upāvartanta tasmād adhvaryuṇā prastara īṣad iva vidhūyo vidhūtim iva hi tṛṇaṃ paśava upāvartante
children.translated_text: <s>Prajāpati</s> created animals. Once created from him, they went away hungry. He offered the <s>prastara</s> to them as food, and they turned back to him. Therefore, when the <s>Adhvaryu</s> shakes the <s>prastara</s> slightly, the animals turn toward it, for animals turn toward grass when it is shaken.

children.text: upainaṃ paśava āvartante ya evaṃ veda
children.translated_text: Animals turn toward one who knows thus.

children.text: prastaram āsadyodgāyeddhaviṣo 'skandāya
children.translated_text: Having approached the <s>prastara</s>, he should chant, so that the oblation may not be spilled.

children.text: yajamānaṃ tu svargāl lokā avagṛhṇāti
children.translated_text: But it holds the sacrificer back from the heavenly world.

children.text: aṣṭhīvatopaspṛśatodgeyaṃ tenāsya havir askannaṃ bhavati na yajamānaṃ svargāl lokād avagṛhṇāti
children.translated_text: The chant should be sung while touching it with the bony part; by that his oblation is not spilled, and it does not hold the sacrificer back from the heavenly world.

children.text: cātvālam avekṣya bahiṣpavamānaṃ stuvanty atra vā asāv āditya āsīt te devā bahiṣpavamānena svargaṃ lokam aharan yac cātvālam avekṣya bahiṣpavamānaṃ stuvanti yajamānam eva tat svargaṃ lokaṃ haranti ||
children.translated_text: They chant the <s>Bahiṣpavamāna</s> while looking at the <s>cātvāla</s> pit. There indeed that <s>Āditya</s> once was. The gods carried off the heavenly world by means of the <s>Bahiṣpavamāna</s>. When they chant the <s>Bahiṣpavamāna</s> while looking at the <s>cātvāla</s>, they thereby carry the sacrificer to the heavenly world.

children.text: sa tu vai yajñena yajetety āhur yasya virājaṃ yajñamukhe dadhyur iti
children.translated_text: They say, "He truly would sacrifice by the sacrifice, in whose sacrificial opening they place the <s>Virāj</s>."

children.text: navabhiḥ stuvanti hiṅkāro daśamo daśākṣarā virāḍ virājam evāsya yajñamukhe dadhāti
children.translated_text: They chant with nine; the <s>hiṅkāra</s> is the tenth. The <s>Virāj</s> has ten syllables; thus he places the <s>Virāj</s> at his sacrificial opening.

children.text: navabhiḥ stuvanti prāṇāḥ prāṇair evainaṃ samardhayanti hiṅkāro daśamas tasmān nābhir anavatṛṇṇā daśamī prāṇānām
children.translated_text: They chant with nine; these are the <s>prāṇas</s> (vital breaths). With the vital breaths they make him prosper. The <s>hiṅkāra</s> is the tenth; therefore the navel, as the tenth among the vital breaths, is unpierced.

children.text: navabhiḥ stuvanti navādhvaryuḥ prātaḥsavane grahān gṛhṇāti tān eva tat pāvayanti teṣāṃ prāṇān utsṛjanti
children.translated_text: They chant with nine. At the morning pressing the <s>Adhvaryu</s> takes nine <s>grahas</s> (libation cups); those they thereby purify, and they release their breaths.

children.text: prajāpatir vai hiṅkāras trayo bahiṣpavamānyo yaddhiṃkṛtya prastauti mithunam evāsyā yajñamukhe dadhāti prajananāya
children.translated_text: <s>Prajāpati</s> indeed is the <s>hiṅkāra</s>, and the <s>Bahiṣpavamāna</s> verses are three. When he begins the praise after uttering hiṅ, he places a pairing at the opening of the sacrifice for generation.

children.text: eṣa vai stomasya yogo yaddhiṅkāro yaddhiṃkṛtya prastauti yuktenaiva stomena prastauti
children.translated_text: This indeed is the yoking of the <s>stoma</s>, namely the <s>hiṅkāra</s>. When he begins the praise after uttering hiṅ, he begins with a yoked <s>stoma</s>.

children.text: eṣa vai sāmnāṃ raso yaddhiṅkāro yaddhiṃkṛtya prastauti rasenaivaitā abhyudya prastauti
children.translated_text: This indeed is the essence of the <s>sāmans</s>, namely the <s>hiṅkāra</s>. When he begins the praise after uttering hiṅ, he raises them with essence and begins the praise.

children.text: āraṇyebhyo vā etat paśubhyaḥ stuvanti yad bahiṣpavamānam ekārūpābhiḥ stuvanti tasmād ekarūpā āraṇyāḥ paśavaḥ
children.translated_text: They chant this for the wild animals, namely the <s>Bahiṣpavamāna</s>. They chant with uniform forms; therefore wild animals are uniform in form.

children.text: parācībhiḥ stuvanti tasmāt parāñcaḥ prajāyante parāñco vitiṣṭhante
children.translated_text: They chant with verses turned away; therefore they are born turned away and stand apart turned away.

children.text: apariśrite stuvanti tasmād aparigṛhītā āraṇyāḥ paśavaḥ
children.translated_text: They chant in an unenclosed place; therefore wild animals are unconfined.

children.text: bahiḥ stuvanty antar anuśaṃsanti tasmād grāmam āhṛtair bhuñjate
children.translated_text: They chant outside and recite the response inside; therefore people feed on those brought into the village.

children.text: grāmebhyo vā etat paśubhyaḥ stuvanti yad ājyair nānārūpaiḥ stuvanti tasmān nānārūpā grāmyāḥ paśavaḥ
children.translated_text: They chant this for the village animals, when they chant with the varied <s>ājya</s> chants; therefore village animals are varied in form.

children.text: punarabhyāvartaṃ stuvanti tasmāt pretvaryaḥ pretya punar āyanti
children.translated_text: They chant with a return again; therefore, after going away, the animals come back again.

children.text: pariśrite stuvanti tasmāt parigṛhītā grāmyāḥ paśavaḥ
children.translated_text: They chant in an enclosed place; therefore domestic animals are kept enclosed.

children.text: amuṣmai vā etal lokāya stuvanti yad bahiṣpavamānaṃ sakṛddhiṃkṛtābhiḥ parācībhiḥ stuvanti sakṛddhīto 'sau parāṅ lokaḥ
children.translated_text: It is for that world that they chant when they chant the <s>Bahiṣpavamāna</s> with outward-facing verses marked by a single <s>hiṃkāra</s>; that farther world is once sounded with <s>hiṃ</s> and turned away.

children.text: asmai vā etal lokāya stuvanti yad ājyaiḥ punarabhyāvartaṃ stuvanti tasmād ayaṃ lokaḥ punaḥ punaḥ prajāyate
children.translated_text: It is for this world that they chant when they chant the <s>Ājya</s> chants with a turning back again; therefore this world is born again and again.

children.text: parāñco vā eteṣāṃ prāṇā bahvantīty āhur ye parācībhir bahiṣpavamānībhiḥ stuvata ity āvatīm uttamāṃ gāyet prāṇānāṃ dhṛtyai
children.translated_text: They say, "The breaths of those who chant with outward-facing <s>Bahiṣpavamānī</s> verses go away." He should sing the last as an <s>āvatī</s> verse, for the support of the breaths.

children.text: cyavante vā ete 'smāl lokād ity āhur ye parācībhir bahiṣpavamānībhiḥ stuvata iti rathantaravarṇam uttamāṃ gāyed iyaṃ vai rathantaram asyām eva pratitiṣṭhati ||
children.translated_text: They say, "Those who chant with outward-facing <s>Bahiṣpavamānī</s> verses fall away from this world." He should sing the last in the color of <s>Rathantara</s>; this world is <s>Rathantara</s>, and in this very world he stands firm.

children.text: upāsmai gāyata nara iti grāmakāmāyapratipadaṃ kuryāt
children.translated_text: He should make "Sing unto him, O men" the <s>pratipad</s> (opening verse) for one who desires a village.

children.text: naro vai devānāṃ grāmo grāmam evāsmā upākaḥ
children.translated_text: Men are indeed the gods' village; he has thereby brought a village near to him.

children.text: upa vā annamannam evāsmā upākaḥ
children.translated_text: And food is what is near; he has thereby brought food near to him.

children.text: upoṣu jātam apturam iti prajākāmāya pratipadaṃ kuryāt
children.translated_text: He should make "Near among them the active one is born" the <s>pratipad</s> for one who desires offspring.

children.text: upa vai prajā tāṃ jātam ity evājījanat
children.translated_text: Offspring is indeed what is near; by saying "born" he has caused that offspring to be born.

children.text: sa naḥ pavasva śaṃ gava iti pratipadaṃ kuryāt
children.translated_text: He should make "Purify yourself for us as blessing for cattle" the <s>pratipad</s>.

children.text: yāṃ samāṃ mahādevaḥ paśūn hanyāt sa naḥ pavasva śaṃ gava iti catuṣpade bheṣajaṃ karoti
children.translated_text: In whatever year <s>Mahādeva</s> kills the cattle, by "Purify yourself for us as blessing for cattle" he makes a remedy for four-footed animals.

children.text: śaṃ janāyeti dvipade śam arvata ity ekaśaphāya
children.translated_text: By "blessing for the people" he makes one for bipeds, and by "blessing for the steed" for one-hoofed animals.

children.text: viṣeṇa vai tāṃ samām oṣadhayo 'ktā bhavanti yāṃ samāṃ mahādevaḥ paśūn hanti yacchaṃ rājann oṣadhībhya ity āhauṣadhīr evāsmai svadayaty ubhayyo 'smai svaditāḥ pacyante 'kṛṣṭapacyāś ca kṛṣṭapacyāś ca
children.translated_text: The plants are smeared with poison in any year in which <s>Mahādeva</s> kills the cattle. When he says, "Blessing, O king, for the plants," he makes the plants palatable for him. Both kinds, those ripened without cultivation and those ripened by cultivation, ripen palatably for him.

children.text: pavasva vāco 'griya iti pratipadaṃ kuryād yaṃ kāmayeta samānānāṃ śīreṣṭhaḥ syād iti
children.translated_text: He should make "Purify yourself, foremost of speech" the <s>pratipad</s> for one whom he wishes to become foremost among his equals.

children.text: pavasva vāco 'griya ity agram evainaṃ pariṇayati
children.translated_text: By "Purify yourself, foremost of speech" he conducts him to the front.

children.text: śrīr vai vāco 'graṃ śriyam evāsmin dadhāti
children.translated_text: The forefront of speech is splendor; he thereby places splendor in him.

children.text: ete asṛgram indava iti bahubhyaḥ pratipadaṃ kuryāt
children.translated_text: He should make "These drops have streamed forth" the <s>pratipad</s> for many people.

children.text: eta iti sarvān evainān ṛddhyai bhūtyā abhivadati
children.translated_text: By "these" he addresses all of them for success and flourishing.

children.text: eta iti vai prajāpatir devān asṛjatāsṛgram iti manuṣyān indava iti pitṝṃs tiraḥ pavitra iti grahān āśava iti stotraṃ viśvānīti śastram abhi saubhagety anyāḥ prajāḥ
children.translated_text: By "these" <s>Prajāpati</s> created the gods; by "have streamed forth" human beings; by "drops" the Fathers; by "through the filter" the <s>grahas</s> (soma cups); by "swift" the <s>stotra</s> (chant); by "all" the <s>śastra</s> (recitation); and by "toward good fortune" the other creatures.

children.text: yad eta iti tasmād yāvanta evāgre devās tāvanta idānīm
children.translated_text: Because he says "these," therefore as many gods as there were at the beginning, so many there are now.

children.text: sarvān vṛddhim ārdhnuvan sthiteva hy eṣā vyāhṛtiḥ
children.translated_text: They all attained increase; for this utterance is as though fixed in place.

children.text: yad asṛgram iti tasmān manuṣyāḥ śvaḥ śvaḥ sṛjyante
children.translated_text: Because he says "have streamed forth," therefore human beings are created day after day.

children.text: yad indava itīndava iva hi pitaraḥ
children.translated_text: Because he says "drops," it is because the Fathers are like drops.

children.text: mana iva
children.translated_text: Like thought.

children.text: yāntāḥ prajāḥ sṛṣṭā ṛddhim ārdhnuvaṃs tām ṛdhnuvanti yeṣām evaṃ vidvān etāṃ pratipadaṃ karoti
children.translated_text: As they went forth, the creatures, once created, attained success; those for whom one who knows thus makes this <s>pratipad</s> attain that success.

children.text: chandāṃsi vai somam āharaṃs taṃ gandharvo viśvāvasuḥ paryamuṣṇāt tenāpaḥ prāviśat taṃ devatā anvaicchaṃs taṃ viṣṇur apsu paryapaśyat sa vyakāṅkṣad ayaṃ nū3 nā3 iti taṃ padā prāsphurat tasmāt pṛthag indavo 'sṛjyanta sa devatābhyo 'bhitas tiṣṭhantībhya ete asṛgram indava iti prābravīd bahiṣpavamānena vai yajñaḥ sṛjyate yad ete asṛgram indava iti prastauti yajñam eva tat sṛṣṭaṃ devatābhyaḥ prāha
children.translated_text: The metres brought <s>Soma</s>; the <s>Gandharva</s> <s>Viśvāvasu</s> stole him away. With him he entered the waters. The deities sought him. <s>Viṣṇu</s> saw him in the waters. He doubted, "Is this indeed he, or not?" He struck him with his foot; therefore the drops were released separately. While the deities stood around him, he said to them, "These drops have streamed forth." The sacrifice is created by the <s>Bahiṣpavamāna</s>; when he begins the chant with "These drops have streamed forth," he thereby announces to the deities that the sacrifice has been created.

children.text: vyṛddhaṃ vā etad apaśavyaṃ yat prātaḥsavanam aniḍaṃ hi yad iḍām asmabhyaṃ saṃyatam ity āha prātaḥsavanam eva tad iḍāvat paśumat karoti
children.translated_text: This morning pressing is incomplete and lacking cattle, for it is without <s>iḍā</s>. When he says, "<s>Iḍā</s> arranged for us," he thereby makes the morning pressing possessed of <s>iḍā</s> and cattle.

children.text: davidyūtatyā ruceti vrātāya pratipadaṃ kuryāt
children.translated_text: He should make "With flashing brightness" the <s>pratipad</s> for a <s>vrāta</s> (band).

children.text: davidyūtatyā receti vai gāyatryā rūpaṃ pariṣṭobhantyeti triṣṭubhaḥ kṛpety anuṣṭubhaḥ somāḥ śukrā gavāśira iti jagatyāḥ sarveṣāṃ vā eṣā chandasāṃ rūpaṃ chandāṃsīva khalu vai vratopadeṣā pratipad bhavati svenaivaināṃs tad rūpeṇa samardhayati
children.translated_text: The expression "with flashing brightness" is the form of <s>Gāyatrī</s>; "moving about with praise" is that of <s>Triṣṭubh</s>; "mercy" that of <s>Anuṣṭubh</s>; "the bright <s>Somas</s> mixed with cow's milk" that of <s>Jagatī</s>. This is the form of all the metres. The <s>pratipad</s> that indicates the <s>vrāta</s> becomes, as it were, the metres; by their own form he brings them to success.

children.text: vṛddhā vā eta indriyeṇa vīryeṇa yad vrāta indriyaṃ vīryaṃ chandāṃsīndriyeṇaivainān vīryeṇa samardhayati ||
children.translated_text: Those who are a <s>vrāta</s> are increased in faculty and strength; the metres are faculty and strength. By faculty and strength he brings them to success.

children.text: agna āyūṃṣi pavasa iti pratipadaṃ kuryād yeṣāṃ dīkṣitānāṃ pramīyate
children.translated_text: He should make "O <s>Agni</s>, purify the life-spans" the <s>pratipad</s> for those among whose consecrated sacrificers one dies.

children.text: apūtā iva vā ete yeṣāṃ dīkṣitānāṃ pramīyate yady eṣāgnipāvamānī pratipad bhavaty agnir evainān niṣṭapati pavamānaḥ punāti
children.translated_text: Those among whose consecrated sacrificers one dies are as if unpurified. If this <s>Agni-Pāvamānī</s> <s>pratipad</s> is used, <s>Agni</s> burns them clean and <s>Pavamāna</s> purifies them.

children.text: yad āyūṃṣīty āha ya eva jīvanti teṣv āyur dadhāti
children.translated_text: When he says "life-spans," he places life-span in those who are still living.

children.text: ā no mitrāvaruṇeti jyogāmayāvine pratipadaṃ kuryāt
children.translated_text: He should make "May <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s> come to us" the <s>pratipad</s> for one who has been ill for a long time.

children.text: apakrāntau vā etasya prāṇāpānau yasya jyog āmayati prāṇāpānau mitrāvaruṇau prāṇāpānāv evāsmin dadhāti
children.translated_text: The <s>prāṇa</s> and <s>apāna</s> have departed from one who is ill for a long time. <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s> are the <s>prāṇa</s> and <s>apāna</s>; he thereby places <s>prāṇa</s> and <s>apāna</s> in him.

children.text: apaghnan pavate mṛdho 'pa somo 'rāvṇa ity anṛtam abhiśasyamānāya pratipadaṃ kuryāt
children.translated_text: He should make "Driving away enemies he purifies himself; <s>Soma</s> drives away the hostile one" the <s>pratipad</s> for one who is falsely accused.

children.text: arāvāṇo vā ete ye 'nṛtam abhiśaṃsanti tān evāsmād apahanti
children.translated_text: Those who accuse falsely are indeed hostile; he drives them away from him.

children.text: gacchann indrasya niṣkṛtam iti pūtam evainaṃ yajñiyam indrasya niṣkṛtaṃ gamayati
children.translated_text: By "going to <s>Indra</s>'s release," he makes him, purified and fit for sacrifice, go to <s>Indra</s>'s release.

children.text: vṛṣā pavasva dhārayeti rājanyāya pratipadaṃ kuryād vṛṣā vai rājanyo vṛṣāṇam evainaṃ karoti
children.translated_text: He should make "Purify yourself as a bull with the stream" the <s>pratipad</s> for a <s>Rājanya</s>; the <s>Rājanya</s> is a bull, and he thereby makes him a bull.

children.text: marutvate ca matsara iti maruto vai devānāṃ viśo viśam evāsmā anu niyunakty anapakrāmukāsmād viḍ bhavati
children.translated_text: And with "to the one accompanied by the <s>Maruts</s>, the exhilarant one": the <s>Maruts</s> are the clans of the gods; he thereby assigns the clan to him in succession. His people do not depart from him.

children.text: viśvā dadhāna ojasety ojasaivāsmai vīryeṇa viśaṃ purastāt parigṛhṇāty anapakrāmukāsmād viḍ bhavati
children.translated_text: With "bearing all strength," by strength and vigor he surrounds the people for him in front. His people do not depart from him.

children.text: pavasvendo vṛṣāsuta iti pratipadaṃ kuryād yaḥ kāmayeta jane ma ṛdhyeteti
children.translated_text: He should make "Flow, O <s>Indu</s>, bull, pressed out" the opening verse for one who desires, "May I prosper among the people."

children.text: kṛdhī no yaśaso jana iti janatāyām evāsmā ṛdhyate
children.translated_text: With "make us a people of renown," he causes him to prosper precisely among the populace.

children.text: yuvaṃ hi sthaḥ svaḥ patī iti dvābhyāṃ pratipadaṃ kuryāt samāvadbhājāv evainau yajñasya karoty ubhau yajñayaśasenārpayati
children.translated_text: He should make the opening verse with the two verses beginning "For you two are lords of heaven." He thereby makes those two equal sharers in the sacrifice and brings both to the glory of the sacrifice.

children.text: prāsya dhārā akṣarann iti vṛṣṭikāmāya pratipadaṃ kuryāt
children.translated_text: For one who desires rain, he should make "Forth his streams have flowed" the opening verse.

children.text: prāsya dhārā akṣarann iti divo vṛṣṭiṃ cyāvayati vṛṣṇaḥ sutasyaujasa ity antarikṣāt
children.translated_text: With "forth his streams have flowed," he makes rain fall from heaven; with "by the vigor of the pressed bull," from the midspace.

children.text: devāṃ anu prabhūṣata ity asmin loke pratiṣṭhāpayati
children.translated_text: With "they adorn themselves after the gods," he establishes it in this world.

children.text: ojasā vā etad vīryeṇa pradīyate yad aprattaṃ bhavati yad vṛṣṇaḥ sutasyaujasa ity āhaujasaivāsmai vīryeṇa divo vṛṣṭiṃ prayacchati
children.translated_text: For what has not been given is given forth by strength and vigor. When he says "by the vigor of the pressed bull," by strength and vigor he gives rain from heaven to him.

children.text: tayā pavasva dhārayā yayā gāva ihāgamañ janyāsa up no gṛham iti pratipadaṃ kuryād yaḥ kāmayetopa mā janyā gāvo nameyur vindeta me janyā gā rāṣṭram iti yad eṣā pratipad bhavaty upainaṃ janyā gāvo namanti vindate 'sya janyā gā rāṣṭram ||
children.translated_text: He should make the opening verse "Flow with that stream by which the cows, the kindred ones, came here to our house" for one who desires, "May the kindred cows bow toward me; may I obtain kindred cattle and dominion." When this is the opening verse, the kindred cows bow toward him; he obtains kindred cattle and dominion.

children.text: Chapter 7
ime vai lokā gāyatraṃ tryāvṛd geyaṃ trayo hīme lokā yat tryāvṛd gāyaty ebhir evainaṃ lokaiḥ saṃmimīte
children.translated_text: These worlds are the <s>Gāyatra</s>; it is to be sung threefold, for these worlds are three. When he sings it threefold, he thereby measures him together with these worlds.

children.text: dvir avanardeddhiṅkuryāt tṛtīyam
children.translated_text: He should make the deep utterance twice, and the <s>hiṅkāra</s> should be the third.

children.text: yat trir avanardaty ati tad gāyatraṃ recayati
children.translated_text: If he makes the deep utterance three times, he thereby makes the <s>Gāyatra</s> exceed its measure.

children.text: yo vai gāyatreṇāpratihṛtenodgāyaty apratiṣṭhāno bhavati hiṅkāro vai gāyatrasya pratihāraḥ
children.translated_text: Whoever sings the <s>udgītha</s> with the <s>Gāyatra</s> without a <s>pratihāra</s> becomes without foundation; for the <s>hiṅkāra</s> is the <s>pratihāra</s> of the <s>Gāyatra</s>.

children.text: sa manasā dhyeyaḥ pratihṛtena gāyatreṇodgāyati pratitiṣṭhati
children.translated_text: It should be contemplated mentally. With the <s>Gāyatra</s> furnished with its <s>pratihāra</s>, he sings the <s>udgītha</s> and becomes established.

children.text: yo vā ebhyo lokebhyo gāyatraṃ gāyati naibhyo lokebhya āvṛścyata ima enaṃ lokā ūrjābhisaṃvasate
children.translated_text: Whoever sings the <s>Gāyatra</s> for these worlds is not cut off from these worlds; these worlds clothe him round about with nourishment.

children.text: mandram ivāgra ādadītātha tārataram atha tāratamaṃ tad ebhyo lokebhyo 'gāsīt
children.translated_text: He should take it up low, as it were, at first, then higher, then highest; thus he has sung it for these worlds.

children.text: aniruktaṃ geyam etad vai gāyatrasya krūraṃ yan niruktaṃ yad aniruktaṃ gāyati krūram evāsya parivṛṇakti
children.translated_text: It should be sung indistinctly. For what is articulated is the harsh part of the <s>Gāyatra</s>. When he sings it indistinctly, he thereby wards off its harshness.

children.text: prāṇo gāyatraṃ na vyavānyāt prāṇasyāvicchedāya yadi vyavāniti pramāyuko bhavati yadi na vyavāniti sarvam āyur eti
children.translated_text: The <s>Gāyatra</s> is the vital breath. He should not make a break, for the non-interruption of the breath. If he makes a break, he becomes short-lived; if he does not make a break, he reaches the full length of life.

children.text: yadi vyavānyān madhya ṛco vyavānyāt prāṇo vai gāyatraṃ prāṇaḥ svaraḥ prāṇam eva tan madhyata ātman dadhāti sa sarvam āyur eti
children.translated_text: If he should make a break, he should make it in the middle of the verse. The <s>Gāyatra</s> is breath, and the tone is breath; he thereby places breath in the middle of himself, and he reaches the full length of life.

children.text: iḍāṃ paśukāmāya nidhanaṃ kuryāt svaḥ svargakāmāya yaśo brahmavarcasakāmāyāyur āmayāvine haṃsīty abhicarate
children.translated_text: He should make "<s>Iḍā</s>" the <s>nidhana</s> for one desiring cattle, "svaḥ" for one desiring heaven, "yaśas" for one desiring <s>brahmavarcas</s> (sacred brilliance), and "āyus" for one who is sick; with "haṃsi" he performs hostile rites.

children.text: ete vai gāyatrasya dohāḥ
children.translated_text: These are the milkings of the <s>Gāyatra</s>.

children.text: brahmavarcasī paśumān bhavati ya evaṃ veda ||
children.translated_text: One who knows thus becomes possessed of <s>brahmavarcas</s> (sacred brilliance) and cattle.

children.text: prajāpatir devebhya ātmānaṃ yajñaṃ kṛtvā prāyacchat te 'nyonyasmā agrāya nātiṣṭhanta tān abravīd ājim asminn iteti ta ājim āyan yad ājim āyaṃs tad ājyānām ājyatvam
children.translated_text: <s>Prajāpati</s>, having made himself into the sacrifice, offered himself to the gods. They did not stand by one another for the foremost place. He said to them, "Go into a contest in this." They went into a contest. Because they went into a contest, that is the <s>ājya</s>-nature of the <s>ājyas</s>.

children.text: sa indro 'ved agnir vā idam agra ujjeṣyatīti so 'bravīd yataro nāv idam agra ujjayat tan nau saheti so 'gnir agra udajayad atha mitrāvaruṇāv athendro 'thaiṣaikā hotrānujjitāsīt sa indro 'gnim abravīd yat sahāvocāvahī yan nau tad iti saiṣaindrāgny adhyardham agne stotram adhyardham indrasya
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> knew, "<s>Agni</s> will win this first." He said, "Whichever of us two wins this first, let that be shared by us." <s>Agni</s> won first, then <s>Mitrāvaruṇa</s>, then <s>Indra</s>. Then this one <s>Hotrā</s> remained unwon. <s>Indra</s> said to <s>Agni</s>, "What we two agreed together is ours." This is the <s>Aindrāgna</s> stotra: one and a half of the stotra belong to <s>Agni</s>, and one and a half to <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: catvāri santi ṣaḍ devatyāni
children.translated_text: There are four, but they have six deities.

children.text: ṣaḍdhā vihito yajño yāvān yajñas tam evārabhate
children.translated_text: The sacrifice is arranged sixfold; he thereby undertakes the whole extent of the sacrifice.

children.text: sarvāṇi svārāṇy ājyāni taj jāmi nānādevatyaiḥ stuvanty ajāmitāyai
children.translated_text: All the <s>ājyas</s> have the same chant-tone; that is kinship. They praise with different deities for the sake of non-kinship.

children.text: grāmyebhyo vā etat paśubhyaḥ stuvanti yad ājyaiḥ punarabhyāvartaṃ stuvanti tasmāt parāñcaḥ prājyante pratyañcaḥ prajāyante tasmād u pretya punar āyanti ||
children.translated_text: When they praise with the <s>ājyas</s>, they praise for domestic animals; they praise with a return. Therefore they go forth away, are born turned back, and therefore, having gone away, they return again.

children.text: etāvatā vāva mādhyandinaṃ savanaṃ pupuve
children.translated_text: With just this much he has purified the midday pressing,

children.text: tribhiś ca chandobhiḥ pañcabhiś ca sāmabhiḥ
children.translated_text: namely with three metres and five <s>Sāmans</s>.

children.text: yan mādhyandinena pavamānena stuvanti mādhyandinam eva tat savanaṃ pāvayanti
children.translated_text: When they praise with the midday <s>Pavamāna</s>, they thereby purify the midday pressing itself.

children.text: etāvanti vāva sarvāṇi sāmāni yāvanti mādhyandine pavamāne
children.translated_text: Just so many are all the <s>Sāmans</s> as there are in the midday <s>Pavamāna</s>.

children.text: gāyatraṃ nidhanavad anidhanam aiḍam
children.translated_text: The <s>Gāyatra</s> has a <s>nidhana</s>; the <s>Aiḍa</s> has no <s>nidhana</s>.

children.text: yan mādhyandinena pavamānena stuvanti sarvair eva tat sāmabhiḥ stuvanti
children.translated_text: When they praise with the midday <s>Pavamāna</s>, they thereby praise with all the <s>Sāmans</s>.

children.text: ātmā vai yajñasya pavamāno mukhaṃ gāyatrī prāṇo gāyatraṃ yad gāyatryāṃ gāyatreṇa stuvanti mukhata eva tat prāṇān dadhati
children.translated_text: The <s>Pavamāna</s> is the self of the sacrifice, the <s>Gāyatrī</s> is the mouth, and the <s>Gāyatra</s> is breath. When they praise with the <s>Gāyatra</s> in the <s>Gāyatrī</s>, they thereby place the breaths at the mouth.

children.text: prāṇāpānā vā etāni chandāṃsi prāṇo gāyatrī vyāno bṛhaty apānas triṣṭub yad etaiś chandobhiḥ stuvanti prāṇāpānānām avicchedāya
children.translated_text: These metres are the breaths, the in-breaths and out-breaths: the <s>Gāyatrī</s> is the <s>prāṇa</s>, the <s>Bṛhatī</s> is the <s>vyāna</s>, and the <s>Triṣṭubh</s> is the <s>apāna</s>. When they praise with these metres, it is for the non-interruption of the breaths and out-breaths.

children.text: ime vai lokā etāni chandāṃsy ayam eva gāyatry ayaṃ madhyamo bṛhaty asāv uttamas triṣṭub yad etaś chandobhiḥ saṃhitaiḥ stuvanty eṣāṃ lokānām avicchedāya
children.translated_text: These worlds are these metres: this one is the <s>Gāyatrī</s>, this middle one the <s>Bṛhatī</s>, and that upper one the <s>Triṣṭubh</s>. When they praise with these metres joined together, it is for the non-interruption of these worlds.

children.text: yad anyac chando 'ntarā vyaveyād imāṃl lokān vicchindyāt
children.translated_text: If another metre were interwoven in between, he would cut apart these worlds.

children.text: gāyatreṇa stutvā nidhanavatā stuvantīyaṃ vai gāyatry asyām eva tad āyatanaṃ kriyate
children.translated_text: Having praised with the <s>Gāyatra</s>, they praise with one that has a <s>nidhana</s>. This earth is indeed the <s>Gāyatrī</s>; in this very world that abode is made.

children.text: yad anidhanenāgre stuyur anāyatano yajamānaḥ syāt
children.translated_text: If they were to praise first with one without a <s>nidhana</s>, the sacrificer would be without an abode.

children.text: nidhanavatā stuvanti vīryaṃ vai gāyatrī vīryaṃ nidhanaṃ vīryeṇaiva tad vīryaṃ samardhayati
children.translated_text: They praise with one that has a <s>nidhana</s>. The <s>Gāyatrī</s> is vigor, and the <s>nidhana</s> is vigor; with vigor he thereby strengthens vigor.

children.text: aiḍena bṛhatīm ārabhante
children.translated_text: With the <s>Aiḍa</s> they begin the <s>Bṛhatī</s>.

children.text: paśavo vā iḍā paśavo bṛhatī paśuṣv eva tat paśūn dadhāti
children.translated_text: <s>Iḍā</s> is cattle, and the <s>Bṛhatī</s> is cattle; he thereby places cattle among cattle.

children.text: bṛhatyāṃ bhūyiṣṭhāni sāmāni bhavanti
children.translated_text: In the <s>Bṛhatī</s> there are the greatest number of <s>sāmans</s>.

children.text: tatrāpi triṇidhanam
children.translated_text: There too there is the <s>Triṇidhana</s>.

children.text: abaliṣṭha iva vā ayaṃ madhyami lokas tasyaiva tad āyatanaṃ kriyate
children.translated_text: This middle world is, as it were, rather weak; for it itself that abode is made.

children.text: triṇidhanaṃ bhavati trīṇi savanānāṃ chidrāṇi tāni tenāpidhīyante
children.translated_text: It is the <s>Triṇidhana</s>; there are three gaps in the pressings, and by it they are covered over.

children.text: triṇidhanaṃ bhavati traya ime lokā eṣv eva lokeṣu pratitiṣṭhati
children.translated_text: It is the <s>Triṇidhana</s>; these worlds are three, and in these very worlds he becomes established.

children.text: triṇidhanaṃ bhavaty etena vai mādhyandinaṃ savanaṃ pratiṣṭhitaṃ yat triṇidhanaṃ yat triṇidhanaṃ na syād apratiṣṭhitaṃ mādhyandinaṃ savanaṃ syāt
children.translated_text: It is the <s>Triṇidhana</s>; by this, namely by the <s>Triṇidhana</s>, the midday pressing is established. If it were not the <s>Triṇidhana</s>, the midday pressing would be unestablished.

children.text: dvyakṣarāṇi nidhanāni bhavanti dvipād yajamāno yajamānam eva yajñe paśuṣu pratiṣṭhāpayati
children.translated_text: The <s>nidhanas</s> are two-syllabled; the sacrificer is two-footed. He thereby establishes the sacrificer in the sacrifice, among cattle.

children.text: anidhanam antato bhavati svargasya lokasyānatipādāya
children.translated_text: At the end it is without a <s>nidhana</s>, so that the heavenly world may not be overstepped.

children.text: yan nidhanavat syād yajamānaṃ svargāl lokān nirhanyāt
children.translated_text: If it had a <s>nidhana</s>, it would strike the sacrificer out of the heavenly world.

children.text: svāraṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: It is the <s>Svāra</s>.

children.text: svareṇa vai devebhyo 'ntato 'nnādyaṃ pradīyate svareṇaiva tad devebhyo 'ntato 'nnādyaṃ prayacchati
children.translated_text: By the <s>svara</s>, final food is given to the gods; by the <s>Svāra</s> he thereby presents final food to the gods.

children.text: gāyatraṃ purastād bhavati svāram antataḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>Gāyatra</s> is at the beginning, and the <s>Svāra</s> is at the end.

children.text: prāṇo vai gāyatraṃ prāṇaḥ svaraḥ prāṇān evatad ubhayato dadhāti tasmād ubhayataḥ prāṇāḥ paśavaḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>Gāyatra</s> is breath, and the <s>svara</s> is breath; he thereby places breaths on both sides. Therefore cattle have breaths on both sides.

children.text: yad gāyatraṃ purastād bhavati svāram antataḥ prāṇair eva praity apāne pratitiṣṭhati ||
children.translated_text: Because the <s>Gāyatra</s> is at the beginning and the <s>Svāra</s> at the end, he goes forward by the breaths and becomes established in the out-breath.

children.text: etad vai yajñasya svargyaṃ yan mādhyandinaṃ savanaṃ mādhyandinasya pavamānaḥ pavamānasya bṛhatī yad bṛhatyāḥ stotre dakṣiṇā dīyante svargasyaiva tal lokasyāyatane dīyante
children.translated_text: This indeed is the heavenly part of the sacrifice: the midday pressing; of the midday pressing, the <s>Pavamāna</s>; of the <s>Pavamāna</s>, the <s>Bṛhatī</s>. When sacrificial fees are given at the <s>stotra</s> of the <s>Bṛhatī</s>, they are given in the very abode of the heavenly world.

children.text: devā vai chandāṃsyabruvan yuṣmābhiḥ svargyaṃ lokam ayāmeti te gāyatrīṃ prāyuñjata tayā na vyāpnuvaṃs triṣṭubhaṃ prāyuñjata tayā na vyāpnuvañ jagatīṃ prāyuñjata tayā na vyāpnuvann anuṣṭubhaṃ prāyuñjata tayālpakādi na vyāpnuvaṃs ta āsāṃ diśāṃ rasān prabṛhya catvāry akṣarāṇy upādadhuḥ sā bṛhaty abhavat tayemāṃl lokān vyāpnuvan
children.translated_text: The gods said to the metres, "Through you let us go to the heavenly world." They employed the <s>Gāyatrī</s>, but with it they did not attain it. They employed the <s>Triṣṭubh</s>, but with it they did not attain it. They employed the <s>Jagatī</s>, but with it they did not attain it. They employed the <s>Anuṣṭubh</s>, but with it, because of its smallness, they did not attain it. Drawing forth the essences of these directions, they added four syllables; it became the <s>Bṛhatī</s>. With it they pervaded these worlds.

children.text: bṛhatī maryā yayemāṃl lokān vyāpāmeti tad bṛhatyā bṛhattvam
children.translated_text: It is the <s>Bṛhatī</s>, for they said, "By it we have pervaded these worlds." That is the greatness of the <s>Bṛhatī</s>.

children.text: paśūn vā asyāntān upādadhuḥ paśavo vai bṛhatī yad bṛhatyāḥ stotre dakṣiṇā dīyante sva eva tad āyatane dīyante
children.translated_text: Or they added cattle as its ends; cattle indeed are the <s>Bṛhatī</s>. When sacrificial fees are given at the <s>stotra</s> of the <s>Bṛhatī</s>, they are given in their own abode.

children.text: yan nv ity āhur anyāni chandāṃsi varṣīyāṃsi kasmād bṛhaty ucyata eṣā hīmāṃl lokān vyāpnon nānyacchandaḥ kiṃcana yāni sapta caturuttarāṇi chandāṃsi tāni bṛhatīm abhisaṃpadyante tasmād bṛhaty ucyate
children.translated_text: Now when they say, "Other metres are longer; why is this called <s>Bṛhatī</s>?" it is because this one pervaded these worlds, and no other metre at all did so. The seven metres that increase by four syllables come together in the <s>Bṛhatī</s>; therefore it is called <s>Bṛhatī</s>.

children.text: yan nv ity āhur gāyatraṃ prātaḥsavanaṃ traiṣṭubhaṃ mādhyandinaṃ savanaṃ jāgataṃ tṛtīyasavanaṃ kasmād bṛhatyā madhyandine stuvantīti
children.translated_text: Now when they say, "The morning pressing is <s>Gāyatra</s>, the midday pressing is <s>Traiṣṭubha</s>, and the third pressing is <s>Jāgata</s>; why do they praise with the <s>Bṛhatī</s> at midday?"

children.text: bahiṣpavamānena vai devā ādityaṃ svargaṃ lokam aharan sa nādhriyata taṃ bṛhatyā madhyandine 'stabhnuvaṃs tasmād bṛhatyā madhyandinaṃ stuvanty ādityaṃ hy eṣā madhyandine dādhāra
children.translated_text: With the <s>Bahiṣpavamāna</s> the gods carried the sun to the heavenly world. It did not hold firm, so at midday they propped it up with the <s>Bṛhatī</s>. Therefore they praise the midday pressing with the <s>Bṛhatī</s>, for she held the sun at midday.

children.text: yair u kaiśca chandobhir madhyandine stuvanti tāni triṣṭubham abhisaṃpadyante tasmāt triṣṭubho nayanti mādhyandināt savanāt ||
children.translated_text: With whatever metres they praise at midday, those come together in the <s>Triṣṭubh</s>; therefore they lead them from the midday pressing to the <s>Triṣṭubh</s>.

children.text: prajāpatir akāmayata bahu syāṃ prajāyeyeti sa śocann amahīyamāno 'tiṣṭhat sa etad āmahīyavam apaśyat tenemāḥ prajā asṛjata tāḥ sṛṣṭā amahīyanta yad amahīyanta tasmād āmahīyavam
children.translated_text: <s>Prajāpati</s> desired, "May I become many; may I propagate." Grieving and not becoming great, he stood still. He saw this <s>Āmahīyava</s>; with it he created these creatures. Created, they became great; because they became great, it is called <s>Āmahīyava</s>.

children.text: tā asmāt sṛṣṭā apākrāmaṃs tāsāṃ divi sad bhūmy ādada iti prāṇān ādatta tā enaṃ prāṇeṣv ātteṣu punar upāvartanta tābhya ugraṃ śarma mahi śrava iti punaḥ prāṇān prāyacchat tā asmād ud evāyodhaṃs tāsāṃ stauṣa iti manyūn avāśṛṇāt tato vai tasmai tāḥ śraiṣṭhyāyātiṣṭhanta
children.translated_text: Created by him, they went away from him. With the words "sitting in heaven, taking the earth," he took away their breaths. When their breaths had been taken, they turned back to him again. With the words "fierce shelter, great fame," he gave their breaths back to them again. They then rose up and fought away from him. With the word "I will praise," he loosened their angers; then indeed they stood by him for supremacy.

children.text: tiṣṭhante 'smai samānāḥ śraiṣṭhyāya ya evaṃ veda
children.translated_text: His equals stand by him for supremacy, the one who knows thus.

children.text: prajānāṃ ca vā eṣā sṛṣṭiḥ pāpavasīyaś ca vidhṛtir yad āmahīyavam
children.translated_text: This, namely the <s>Āmahīyava</s>, is both the creation of creatures and the holding off of what is worse and evil.

children.text: vidhṛtiḥ pāpavasīyaso bhavati ya evaṃ veda
children.translated_text: For one who knows thus, there is a holding off of what is worse and evil.

children.text: devā vai yaśaskāmāḥ sattram āsatāgnir indro vāyur makhas te 'bruvan yan no yaśa ṛchāt tan naḥ sahāsad iti teṣā makhaṃ yaśa ārchat tad ādāyāpākrāmat tad asya prāsahāditsanta taṃ paryayatanta svadhanuḥ pratiṣṭhābhyātiṣṭhat tasya dhanurārtnir ūrdhvā patitvā śiro 'chinat sa pravargyo 'bhavad yajño vai makho yat pravargyaṃ pravṛñjanti yajñasyaiva tacchiraḥ pratidadhati
children.translated_text: The gods, desiring glory, sat in a <s>sattra</s> (sacrificial session): <s>Agni</s>, <s>Indra</s>, <s>Vāyu</s>, and <s>Makha</s>. They said that whatever glory should come to them should remain together with them. Glory came to <s>Makha</s> among them. Taking it, he went away. They wished to take it from him by force and pursued him. He stood firm with his own bow and support; the end of his bow flew upward and cut off his head. That became the <s>Pravargya</s> (rite). <s>Makha</s> is the sacrifice; when they perform the <s>Pravargya</s>, they put back the head of the sacrifice itself.

children.text: tad devā yaśo vyabhajanta tasyāgnī rauravaṃ prābṛhata
children.translated_text: Then the gods divided the glory. From it <s>Agni</s> took up the <s>Raurava</s>.

children.text: tad vai sa paśuvīryaṃ prābṛhata paśavo vai rauravam
children.translated_text: By it he took up the vigor of cattle; cattle indeed are the <s>Raurava</s>.

children.text: paśumān bhavati ya evaṃ veda
children.translated_text: One who knows thus becomes possessed of cattle.

children.text: agnir vai rūras tasyaitad rauravam
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> is <s>Rūra</s>; this is his <s>Raurava</s>.

children.text: asurā vai devān paryayatanta tata etāv agnī rūrau viṣvañcau stobhāv apaśyat tābhyām enān pratyauṣat te pratyuṣyamāṇā aravanta yad aravanta tasmād rauravam
children.translated_text: The <s>Asuras</s> pursued the gods. Then <s>Agni</s> saw these two <s>Rūra</s> stobhas going in opposite directions, and with them he burned them back. As they were being burned, they cried out; because they cried out, it is called <s>Raurava</s>.

children.text: athendro yaudhājayaṃ prābṛhata tad vai sa vajraṃ prābṛhata vajro vai yaudhājayam
children.translated_text: Then <s>Indra</s> took up the <s>Yaudhājaya</s>. By it he took up the thunderbolt; the <s>Yaudhājaya</s> indeed is the thunderbolt.

children.text: vajraṃ bhrātṛvyāya praharati ya evaṃ veda
children.translated_text: One who knows thus hurls the thunderbolt against his rival.

children.text: indro vai yudhājit tasyaitad yaudhājayam
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> is <s>Yudhājit</s>; this is his <s>Yaudhājaya</s>.

children.text: yudhā maryā ajaiṣmeti tasmād yaudhājayam
children.translated_text: Because he said, 'I have conquered the men by battle,' therefore it is called <s>Yaudhājaya</s>.

children.text: atha vāyur auśanaṃ prābṛhata
children.translated_text: Then <s>Vāyu</s> took up the <s>Auśana</s>.

children.text: tad vai sa prāṇvīryaṃ prābṛhata prāṇā vā auśanam
children.translated_text: By it he took up the vigor of the vital breaths; the vital breaths indeed are the <s>Auśana</s>.

children.text: sarvam āyur eti ya evaṃ veda
children.translated_text: One who knows thus reaches the full span of life.

children.text: vāyur vā uśanaṃs tasyaitad auśanam
children.translated_text: <s>Vāyu</s> is <s>Uśanas</s>; this is his <s>Auśana</s>.

children.text: uśanā vai kāvyo 'surāṇāṃ purohita āsīt taṃ devāḥ kāmadughābhir apāmantrayanta tasmā etāny auśanāni prāyacchan kāmadughā vā auśanāni
children.translated_text: <s>Uśanā Kāvya</s> was the domestic priest of the <s>Asuras</s>. The gods enticed him away with wish-milking gifts. They presented these <s>Auśana</s> chants to him. The <s>Auśanas</s> are wish-milking.

children.text: kāmadughā enam upatiṣṭhante ya evaṃ veda ||
