children.translated_text: Wish-milking powers attend upon one who knows thus.

children.text: prajāpatir akāmayata bahu syāṃ prajāyeyeti sa tūṣṇīṃ manasādhyāyat tasya yan manasy āsīt tad bṛhat samabhavat
children.translated_text: <s>Prajāpati</s> desired, 'May I become many; may I be propagated.' Silently he meditated with his mind. What was in his mind became the <s>Bṛhat</s>.

children.text: sa ādadhīta garbho vai me 'yam antarhitas taṃ vācā prajanayā iti
children.translated_text: He resolved, 'This embryo is hidden within me; I will bring it forth with speech.'

children.text: sa vācaṃ vyasṛjata sā vāg rathantaram anvapadyata
children.translated_text: He sent forth Speech, and that Speech followed the <s>Rathantara</s>.

children.text: ratham aryāḥ kṣeplātārīd iti tad rathantarasya rathantaratvam
children.translated_text: Because the chariot carried the noble ones swiftly across, that is the <s>Rathantara</s>'s being <s>Rathantara</s>.

children.text: tato bṛhad anuprājāyata bṛhan maryā idaṃ sa jyog antarabhūd iti tad bṛhato bṛhattvam
children.translated_text: After that the <s>Bṛhat</s> was born forth: 'Great, O men, this one has long been inside.' That is the <s>Bṛhat</s>'s being <s>Bṛhat</s>.

children.text: yathā vai putro jyeṣṭha evaṃ bṛhat prajāpateḥ
children.translated_text: As a son is the eldest, so the <s>Bṛhat</s> is for <s>Prajāpati</s>.

children.text: jyeṣṭhabrāhmaṇaṃ vā etat
children.translated_text: This indeed is the foremost <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>.

children.text: pra jyaiṣṭhyam āpnoti ya evaṃ veda
children.translated_text: One who knows thus attains preeminence.

children.text: yan nv ity āhur bṛhat pūrvaṃ prajāpatau samabhavat kasmād rathantaraṃ pūrvaṃ yogam ānaśa iti
children.translated_text: Now when they say, 'The <s>Bṛhat</s> first came into being in <s>Prajāpati</s>; why did the <s>Rathantara</s> first attain the yoking?'

children.text: bṛhad eva pūrvaṃ samabhavad rathantaraṃ tu pūrvaṃ sṛṣṭyāsṛjata tasmāt pūrvaṃ yogam ānaśe
children.translated_text: The <s>Bṛhat</s> itself came into being first, but he sent forth the <s>Rathantara</s> first in creation. Therefore it first attained the yoking.

children.text: tayoḥ samānaṃ nidhanam āsīt tasmin nātiṣṭhetāṃ ta ājim aitāṃ tayor has iti bṛhat prāṇam udajayad as iti rathantaram apānam abhisamaveṣṭata
children.translated_text: The two had a common <s>nidhana</s> (final refrain). They could not stand firm in it, so they went to this contest. Of the two, with the syllable 'has' the <s>Bṛhat</s> won the <s>prāṇa</s> (up-breath), and with 'as' the <s>Rathantara</s> enclosed the <s>apāna</s> (down-breath).

children.text: prāṇāpānau vai bṛhadrathantare jyog āmayāvina ubhe kuryād apakrāntau vā etasya prāṇāpānau yasya jyog āmayati prāṇāpānāv evāsmin dadhāti
children.translated_text: The <s>Bṛhat</s> and <s>Rathantara</s> are the <s>prāṇa</s> and <s>apāna</s>. For a person who has long been ill, he should perform both; the <s>prāṇa</s> and <s>apāna</s> have gone away from one who has long been ill. He thereby places the <s>prāṇa</s> and <s>apāna</s> in him.

children.text: yan nv ity āhur ubhe bṛhadrathantare bahirṇidhane kasmād bṛhad bahirṇidhanāni bhajate 'ntarṇidhanāni rathantaram iti
children.translated_text: Now when they say, 'Both the <s>Bṛhat</s> and the <s>Rathantara</s> have external <s>nidhanas</s>; why does the <s>Bṛhat</s> partake of outer <s>nidhanas</s>, and the <s>Rathantara</s> of inner <s>nidhanas</s>?'

children.text: prāṇo bṛhat tasmād bahirṇidhanāni bhajate bahir hi prāṇo 'pāno rathantaraṃ tasmād antarṇidhanāni bhajate 'ntar hy apānaḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>Bṛhat</s> is the <s>prāṇa</s>; therefore it partakes of outer <s>nidhanas</s>, for the <s>prāṇa</s> is outside. The <s>Rathantara</s> is the <s>apāna</s>; therefore it partakes of inner <s>nidhanas</s>, for the <s>apāna</s> is inside.

children.text: mahāvṛkṣau vai bṛhadrathantare nidhanena samarpye
children.translated_text: The <s>Bṛhat</s> and <s>Rathantara</s> are two great trees to be joined by the <s>nidhana</s>.

children.text: yad vai mahāvṛkṣau samṛcchete bahu tatra vibhagnaṃ prabhagnaṃ śete
children.translated_text: When two great trees come together, much there lies broken and shattered.

children.text: airaṃ vai bṛhad aiḍaṃ rathantaraṃ mano vai bṛhad vāg rathantaraṃ sāma vai bṛhad ṛg rathantaraṃ prāṇo vai bṛhad apāno rathantaram asau vai loko bṛhad ayaṃ rathantaram etāni manasānvīkṣyodgāyet kﾱptābhyām evābhyām udgāyati ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Bṛhat</s> is <s>Aira</s>; the <s>Rathantara</s> is <s>Aiḍa</s>. The mind is the <s>Bṛhat</s>; speech is the <s>Rathantara</s>. The <s>sāman</s> is the <s>Bṛhat</s>; the <s>ṛc</s> is the <s>Rathantara</s>. The <s>prāṇa</s> is the <s>Bṛhat</s>; the <s>apāna</s> is the <s>Rathantara</s>. The yonder world is the <s>Bṛhat</s>; this world is the <s>Rathantara</s>. Having contemplated these with the mind, he should chant as <s>Udgātṛ</s>; with these two properly arranged he chants.

children.text: paśavo vai bṛhadrathantare aṣṭākṣareṇa prathamāyā ṛcaḥ prastauty aṣṭāśaphāṃs tat paśūn avarundhe
children.translated_text: Cattle are the <s>Bṛhat</s> and <s>Rathantara</s>. He begins the praise with the eight syllables of the first <s>ṛc</s>; thereby he secures the eight-hoofed cattle.

children.text: dvyakṣareṇottarayor ṛcoḥ prastauti dvipād yajamāno yajamānam eva yajñe paśuṣu pratiṣṭhāpayati
children.translated_text: He begins the praise with two syllables from each of the following two <s>ṛcs</s>; the sacrificer is two-footed, and thus he establishes the sacrificer himself among the cattle in the sacrifice.

children.text: pañcākṣareṇa rathantarasya pratiharati pāṅktāṃs tat paśūn avarundhe
children.translated_text: He makes the response to the <s>Rathantara</s> with five syllables; thereby he secures the fivefold cattle.

children.text: caturakṣareṇa bṛhataḥ pratiharati catuṣpadas tat paśūn avarundhe
children.translated_text: He makes the response to the <s>Bṛhat</s> with four syllables; thereby he secures the four-footed cattle.

children.text: na vai bṛhan na rathantaram ekaṃ chando 'yacchat tataḥ kakubhāv uttare upādadhus tasmād bṛhatī prathamā kakubhāv uttare tasmād bṛhadrathantare ekarcena kurvanti na hi te ekaṃ chando 'yacchat
children.translated_text: Neither the <s>Bṛhat</s> nor the <s>Rathantara</s> was fitted by a single metre. Therefore they added two <s>Kakubh</s> verses after it. Thus the first is a <s>Bṛhatī</s>, and the following two are <s>Kakubh</s> verses. Therefore they perform the <s>Bṛhat</s> and <s>Rathantara</s> with a single <s>ṛc</s>, for a single metre did not fit those two.

children.text: nava bṛhato rohān rohati nava prāṇāḥ prāṇān evāvarundhe
children.translated_text: He climbs the nine ascents of the <s>Bṛhat</s>. There are nine vital breaths; he thereby secures the vital breaths.

children.text: trīn prathamāyāṃ rohati bhūtaṃ bhavad bhaviṣyat tān evāvarundhe trīn madhyamāyāṃ rohaty ātmānaṃ prajāṃ paśūṃs tān evāvarundhe trīn uttamāyāṃ rohati traya ime lokā eṣv eva lokeṣu pratitiṣṭhati
children.translated_text: He climbs three in the first portion: the past, the present, and the future; he secures just these. He climbs three in the middle portion: himself, offspring, and cattle; he secures just these. He climbs three in the last portion: these worlds are three, and he becomes established in these worlds.

children.text: sarvān kāmān avarundhe ya evaṃ vidvān bṛhato rohān rohati
children.translated_text: He secures all desires, the one who, knowing thus, ascends the ascents of the <s>Bṛhat</s>.

children.text: vajreṇa vā etat prastotodgātāram abhipravartayati yad rathantaraṃ prastauti samudram antardhāyodgāyed vāg ity ādeyaṃ vāg vai samudraḥ samudram evāntardadhāty ahiṃsāyai
children.translated_text: When the <s>Prastotṛ</s> begins the <s>Rathantara</s>, he in effect sets the <s>Udgātṛ</s> in motion against a thunderbolt. The <s>Udgātṛ</s> should sing after placing the ocean between; the word "speech" is to be taken up, for speech is the ocean. He thereby places the ocean between, for non-injury.

children.text: balavad geyaṃ vajram evaṃ pravṛttaṃ pratyudgṛhṇāti
children.translated_text: It should be sung powerfully; he thereby receives the thunderbolt that has been set in motion.

children.text: balvalā kurvatā geyam abhilobhayateva vajram evābhilobhayati
children.translated_text: It should be sung while making the <s>balvalā</s> sound; as though he entices it toward himself, he thereby entices the thunderbolt itself.

children.text: kṣipraṃ geyaṃ svargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai
children.translated_text: It should be sung quickly, for the complete attainment of the heavenly world.

children.text: devaratho vai rathantaram akṣareṇākṣareṇa pratiṣṭhāpayatodgeyam areṇāreṇa hi rathaḥ pratitiṣṭhati
children.translated_text: The <s>Rathantara</s> is the chariot of the gods. It should be sung establishing it syllable by syllable, for a chariot stands firm spoke by spoke.

children.text: yo vai devaratham ananvālabhyātiṣṭhaty avāsmāt padyata iyaṃ vai devaratha imām ālabhyodgāyen nāsmād avapadyate
children.translated_text: Whoever stands on the chariot of the gods without taking hold of it falls down from it. This earth is the chariot of the gods. Taking hold of this earth, he should sing; he does not fall down from it.

children.text: īśvaraṃ vai rathantaram udgātuś cakṣuḥ pramathitoḥ prastūyamāne saṃmīlet svardṛśaṃ prativīkṣeta nainaṃ cakṣur jahāti
children.translated_text: The <s>Rathantara</s> is capable of tearing away the <s>Udgātṛ</s>'s eye. When it is being introduced, he should close his eyes; he should look back toward the heavenly light. His sight does not abandon him.

children.text: prajananaṃ vai rathantaraṃ yat tasthuṣa ity āhāsthāyukodgātur vāg bhavaty api prajananaṃ hanty asthuṣa iti vaktavyaṃ susthuṣa iti vā sthāyukodgātur vāg bhavati na prajananam api hanti
children.translated_text: The <s>Rathantara</s> is procreation. If he says "tasthuṣa," the <s>Udgātṛ</s>'s speech becomes unsteady and he even injures procreation. He should say "asthuṣa," or else "susthuṣa"; the <s>Udgātṛ</s>'s speech becomes steady and he does not injure procreation.

children.text: pṛṣṭhāni vā asṛjyanta tair devāḥ svargaṃ lokam āyaṃs teṣāṃ rathantaraṃ mahimnā nāśaknod utpatat
children.translated_text: The <s>Pṛṣṭhas</s> were created. By them the gods went to the heavenly world. Among them the <s>Rathantara</s>, because of its greatness, was not able to remain; it flew up.

children.text: tasya vaśiṣṭho mahimno vinidhāya tena stutvā svargaṃ lokam ait tān saṃbhṛtyodgāyet
children.translated_text: <s>Vaśiṣṭha</s> laid aside its greatness; having praised with that, he went to the heavenly world. Having gathered those portions, he should sing.

children.text: yas te goṣu mahimā yas te apsu rathe vā te stanayitnau ya u te yas te agnau mahimā tena saṃbhava rathantara draviṇavan na edhi ||
children.translated_text: Whatever greatness of yours is among cows, whatever is yours in the waters, in the chariot or in thunder, whatever of yours there is, whatever greatness of yours is in fire: with that come together, O <s>Rathantara</s>; be rich in wealth for us.

children.text: apo vā ṛtvyam ārchat tāsāṃ vāyuḥ pṛṣṭhe vyavartata tato vasu vāmaṃ samabhavat tasmin mitrāvaruṇau paryapaśyatāṃ tāv abrūtāṃ vāmaṃ maryā idaṃ deveṣv ājānīti tasmād vāmadevyam
children.translated_text: The waters reached the proper season; <s>Vāyu</s> turned upon their back. From that a lovely good thing arose. In it <s>Mitrāvaruṇa</s> discerned something; the two said, "This lovely thing, young men, has been born among the gods." Therefore it is the <s>Vāmadevya</s>.

children.text: tat parigṛhṇantāv abrūtām idam avidāvedaṃ nau mābhyartiḍhvam iti tat prajāpatir abravīn mad vā etaddhy ajani mama vā etad iti tad agnir abravīn māṃ vā etad annam ajani mama vā etad iti tad indro 'bravīcchreṣṭhasthā vā etad ahaṃ vaḥ śreṣṭho 'smi mama vā etad iti tad viśve devā abruvann asmaddevatyaṃ vā etad yad adbhyo 'dhi samabhūd asmākaṃ vā etad iti tat prajāpatir abravīt sarveṣāṃ na idam astu sarva idam upajīvāmeti tat pṛṣṭheṣu nyadadhuḥ sarvadevatyaṃ vai vāmadevyam
children.translated_text: Taking hold of it, the two said, "We have found this; do not take this away from us." <s>Prajāpati</s> said, "From me indeed this was born; mine indeed it is." <s>Agni</s> said, "For me this food was born; mine indeed it is." <s>Indra</s> said, "This stands in the highest place; I am the highest of you; mine indeed it is." The <s>Viśve Devāḥ</s> said, "This has all of us as its deities, since it arose from the waters; ours indeed it is." <s>Prajāpati</s> said, "Let this belong to all of us; let us all live from it." They placed it among the <s>Pṛṣṭhas</s>. The <s>Vāmadevya</s> belongs to all the deities.

children.text: yat kavatīṣu tena prājāpatyaṃ ko hi prajāpatir yad aniruktāsu tena prājāpatyam anirukto hi prajāpatiḥ
children.translated_text: Because it is in <s>kavatī</s> verses, by that it belongs to <s>Prajāpati</s>, for <s>Ka</s> is <s>Prajāpati</s>. Because it is in unexpressed verses, by that it belongs to <s>Prajāpati</s>, for <s>Prajāpati</s> is unexpressed.

children.text: yad gāyatrīṣu tenāgneyaṃ gāyatracchandā hy agniḥ
children.translated_text: Because it is in <s>Gāyatrī</s> verses, by that it belongs to <s>Agni</s>, for <s>Agni</s> has the <s>Gāyatra</s> metre.

children.text: yat pṛṣṭheṣu nyadadadhus tenaindraṃ sarvāṇi hi pṛṣṭhānīndrasya niṣkaivalyāni
children.translated_text: Because they placed it among the <s>Pṛṣṭhas</s>, by that it belongs to <s>Indra</s>, for all the <s>Pṛṣṭhas</s> are <s>Indra</s>'s exclusive chants.

children.text: yan maitrāvaruṇo 'nuśaṃsati tena maitrāvaruṇam
children.translated_text: Because the <s>Maitrāvaruṇa</s> recites the accompanying praise, by that it is <s>Maitrāvaruṇa</s>.

children.text: yad bahudevatyam uttamaṃ padaṃ tena vaiśvadevaṃ sarveṣv eva rūpeṣu pratitiṣṭhati
children.translated_text: Because the last pada has many deities, by that it belongs to the <s>Viśve Devāḥ</s>. It becomes established in all forms.

children.text: prajāpatir vā etāṃ gāyatrīṃ yonim apaśyat sa ādīdhītāsmād yoneḥ pṛṣṭhāni sṛjā iti
children.translated_text: <s>Prajāpati</s> saw this <s>Gāyatrī</s> as a womb. He thought, "From this womb I will create the <s>Pṛṣṭhas</s>."

children.text: sa rathantaram asṛjata tad rathasya ghoṣo 'nvasṛjyata
children.translated_text: He created the <s>Rathantara</s>; after it the sound of a chariot was created.

children.text: sa bṛhad asṛjata tat stanayitnor ghoṣo 'nvasṛjyata sa vairūpam asṛjata tad vā tasya ghoṣo 'nvasṛjyata
children.translated_text: He created the <s>Bṛhat</s>; after it the sound of thunder was created. He created the <s>Vairūpa</s>; after it, indeed, its sound was created.

children.text: sa vairūpam asṛjata tad agner ghoṣo 'nvasṛjyata
children.translated_text: He created the <s>Vairūpa</s>; after it the sound of <s>Agni</s> was created.

children.text: sa śakvarīr asṛjata tad apāṃ ghoṣo 'nvasṛjyata
children.translated_text: He created the <s>Śakvarī</s> verses; after them the sound of the waters was created.

children.text: sa revatīr asṛjata tad gavāṃ ghoṣo 'nvasṛjyata
children.translated_text: He created the <s>Revatī</s> verses; after them the sound of cows was created.

children.text: etair vā etāni saha ghoṣair asṛjyanta
children.translated_text: These, then, were created together with these sounds.

children.text: sarve 'smin ghoṣāḥ sarvāḥ puṇyā vāco vadanti ya evaṃ veda ||
children.translated_text: All sounds and all auspicious voices speak in the one who knows thus.

children.text: pitā vai vāmadevyaṃ putrāḥ pṛṣṭhāni
children.translated_text: The <s>Vāmadevya</s> is the father; the <s>Pṛṣṭhas</s> are the sons.

children.text: etasmād vā etāni yoner asṛjyanta
children.translated_text: From this womb these were created.

children.text: tasmāt pṛṣṭhānāṃ stotraṃ vāmadevyenānuṣṭuvanti śāntyai
children.translated_text: Therefore they accompany the <s>stotra</s> (chant) of the <s>Pṛṣṭhas</s> with the <s>Vāmadevya</s>, for appeasement.

children.text: yaddhi putro 'śāntaṃ carati pitā tacchamayati
children.translated_text: For when a son acts in an unappeased way, the father appeases him.

children.text: ayaṃ vai loko madhyamo vāmadevyam etasmād vā imau lokau viṣvañcāv asṛjyetāṃ bṛhac ca rathantaraṃ ca
children.translated_text: This middle world is the <s>Vāmadevya</s>. From this, these two worlds were created apart from one another: the <s>Bṛhat</s> and the <s>Rathantara</s>.

children.text: yad rathantareṇa stuvanti ye rathantarāḥ paśavo 'ntarīkṣaṃ ta upaśrayanti yad bṛhatā stuvanti ye bārhatāḥ paśavo 'ntarīkṣaṃ ta upaśrayanti te vāmadevyasya stotreṇāvaruddhāḥ
children.translated_text: When they praise with the <s>Rathantara</s>, whatever cattle are connected with the <s>Rathantara</s> take refuge in the midspace. When they praise with the <s>Bṛhat</s>, whatever cattle are connected with the <s>Bṛhat</s> take refuge in the midspace. They are secured by the <s>stotra</s> of the <s>Vāmadevya</s>.

children.text: dhruva āsīno vāmadevyenodgāyet paśūnām upavṛtyai
children.translated_text: Sitting firm, he should sing with the <s>Vāmadevya</s>, for the turning of cattle toward him.

children.text: upainaṃ paśava āvartante ya evaṃ veda
children.translated_text: Cattle turn back toward the one who knows thus.

children.text: antarikṣaṃ vai vāmadevyam adhūnvatevodgeyam adhūtam ivāntarikṣaṃ paśavo vai vāmadevyam ahiṃsatevodgeyaṃ paśūnām ahiṃsāyai
children.translated_text: The <s>Vāmadevya</s> is the midspace. It should be sung as if not shaking; the midspace is as if unshaken. The <s>Vāmadevya</s> is cattle. It should be sung as if not injuring, for the non-injury of cattle.

children.text: katham iva vāmadevyaṃ geyam ity āhuḥ
children.translated_text: They ask, "How should the <s>Vāmadevya</s> be sung?"

children.text: yathāṅkulī putrān saṃdaśyāsaṃbhindantī harati yathā vāto 'psu śanair vāti
children.translated_text: As a female <s>aṅkulī</s> carries her young by gripping them with her teeth without breaking them, and as the wind blows gently upon the waters.

children.text: svadhūr vāmadevyaṃ geyam
children.translated_text: The <s>Vāmadevya</s> is to be sung as <s>svadhūr</s> (smoothly and properly borne).

children.text: yo vai svadhūr vāmadevyaṃ gāyati svadhūr bhavati
children.translated_text: Whoever sings the <s>Vāmadevya</s> as <s>svadhūr</s> becomes <s>svadhūr</s> (well borne and steady).

children.text: yāty asyānyo niyānena nānyasya niyānena yāti
children.translated_text: Each other chant proceeds by its own <s>niyāna</s> (course); it does not proceed by the <s>niyāna</s> of another.

children.text: na bṛhato na rathantarasyānurūpaṃ geyaṃ svenaivāyatanena geyam āyatanavān bhavati
children.translated_text: No <s>anurūpa</s> (corresponding chant) is to be sung for the <s>Bṛhat</s> or for the <s>Rathantara</s>; it is to be sung only with its own <s>āyatana</s> (basis). He becomes possessed of an <s>āyatana</s>.

children.text: devā vai paśūn vyabhajanta te rudram antarāyaṃs tān vāmadevyasya stotra upekṣate
children.translated_text: The gods divided the cattle. They left <s>Rudra</s> aside, and he lies in wait for them at the <s>stotra</s> of the <s>Vāmadevya</s>.

children.text: aniruktaṃ geyam
children.translated_text: It should be sung indistinctly.

children.text: yan nirāha rudrāya paśūn apidadhāti rudras tāṃ samāṃ paśūn dhātuko bhavati
children.translated_text: If he utters it distinctly, he shuts the cattle up for <s>Rudra</s>; <s>Rudra</s> becomes liable to lay waste to the cattle that year.

children.text: revatīṣu vāmadevyena paśukāmaḥ stuvīta
children.translated_text: One who desires cattle should praise with the <s>Vāmadevya</s> on the <s>Revatī</s> verses.

children.text: āpo vai revatyaḥ paśavo vāmadevyam adbhya evāsmai paśūn prajanayati
children.translated_text: The <s>Revatīs</s> are the waters, and the <s>Vāmadevya</s> is cattle; from the waters themselves he generates cattle for him.

children.text: anavartiḥ paśuto bhavati prajā svasya mīliteva bhavati
children.translated_text: There is no turning back for him in respect to cattle; his offspring becomes, as it were, joined with his own.

children.text: kavatībhyo hy eti prajāpateḥ ||
children.translated_text: For it goes from the <s>Kavatī</s> verses of <s>Prajāpati</s>.

children.text: imau vai lokau sahāstāṃ tau viyantāv abrūtāṃ vivāhaṃ vivahāvahai saha nāv astv iti
children.translated_text: These two worlds were together. As they were separating, they said, "Let us make a marriage; let there be union for us."

children.text: tayor ayam amuṣmai śyaitaṃ prāyacchan naudhasam asāv asmai
children.translated_text: Of the two, this world gave the <s>Śyaita</s> to that one, and that one gave the <s>Naudhasa</s> to this one.

children.text: tata enayor nidhane viparyakrāmatāṃ devavivāho vai śyaitanaudhase
children.translated_text: Then their <s>nidhanas</s> (concluding refrains) crossed over. The <s>Śyaita</s> and <s>Naudhasa</s> are the gods' marriage.

children.text: pravasīyāṃsaṃ vivāham āpnoti ya evaṃ veda
children.translated_text: One who knows thus obtains a more eminent marriage.

children.text: ito vā ime lokā ūrdhvāḥ kalpamānā yanty amuto 'rvāñcaḥ kalpamānā āyanti
children.translated_text: For from here these worlds go upward as they are set in order, and from there they come downward as they are set in order.

children.text: yad rathantareṇa stuvantīmaṃ lokaṃ tena yunakty antarikṣaṃ vāmadevyena naudhasenāmuṃ yad bṛhatā stuvanty amuṃ lokaṃ tena yunakty antarikṣaṃ vāmadevyena śyaitenemam
children.translated_text: When they praise with the <s>Rathantara</s>, by it he joins this world, the midspace with the <s>Vāmadevya</s>, and that world with the <s>Naudhasa</s>. When they praise with the <s>Bṛhat</s>, by it he joins that world, the midspace with the <s>Vāmadevya</s>, and this world with the <s>Śyaita</s>.

children.text: kﾱptān imāl lokān upāste ya evaṃ veda
children.translated_text: One who knows thus attends upon these worlds as set in order.

children.text: bṛhadrathantare vai śyaitanaudhase yad rathantarāya naudhasaṃ prati prayuñjanti bṛhad evāsmai tat prati prayuñjanti bṛhaddhy etat parokṣaṃ yan naudhasaṃ yad bṛhate śyaitaṃ prati prayuñjanti rathantaram evāsmai tat prati prayuñjanti rathantaraṃ hy etat parokṣaṃ yacchyaitam
children.translated_text: The <s>Śyaita</s> and <s>Naudhasa</s> are the <s>Bṛhat</s> and <s>Rathantara</s>. When they apply the <s>Naudhasa</s> in response to the <s>Rathantara</s>, they thereby apply the <s>Bṛhat</s> for him, for the <s>Naudhasa</s> is the <s>Bṛhat</s> in hidden form. When they apply the <s>Śyaita</s> in response to the <s>Bṛhat</s>, they thereby apply the <s>Rathantara</s> for him, for the <s>Śyaita</s> is the <s>Rathantara</s> in hidden form.

children.text: ubhabhyāṃ bṛhadrathantarābhyāṃ stute ya evaṃ veda
children.translated_text: One who knows thus praises with both, with the <s>Bṛhat</s> and the <s>Rathantara</s>.

children.text: devā vai brahma vyabhajanta tāṃ nodhāḥ kākṣīvata āgacchat te 'bruvann ṛṣir na āgaṃstasmai brahma dadāmeti tasmā etat sāma prāyacchaṃs tasmān naudhasaṃ brahma vai naudhasam
children.translated_text: The gods were dividing <s>brahman</s> (sacred power). <s>Nodhā Kākṣīvata</s> came to them. They said, "A seer has come to us; let us give him <s>brahman</s>." They offered him this <s>sāman</s>. Therefore it is the <s>Naudhasa</s>; the <s>Naudhasa</s> is <s>brahman</s>.

children.text: brahmavarcasakāma etena stuvīta brahmavarcasī bhavati
children.translated_text: One who desires <s>brahmavarcas</s> (sacred brilliance) should praise with this; he becomes possessed of <s>brahmavarcas</s>.

children.text: athaitacchyaitam
children.translated_text: Now this is the <s>Śyaita</s>.

children.text: prajāpatiḥ paśūn asṛjata te 'smāt sṛṣṭā apākrāmaṃs tān etena sāmnābhivyāharat te 'smā atiṣṭhanta te śetyā abhavan yacchetyā abhavaṃs tasmācchyaitaṃ paśavo vai śyaitam
children.translated_text: <s>Prajāpati</s> created cattle. Created, they went away from him. He addressed them with this <s>sāman</s>; they stood by him. They became settled, and because they became settled, therefore it is the <s>Śyaita</s>. The <s>Śyaita</s> is cattle.

children.text: paśukāma etena stuvīta paśumān bhavati
children.translated_text: One who desires cattle should praise with this; he becomes possessed of cattle.

children.text: prajāpatiḥ prajā asṛjata tāḥ sṛṣṭā aśocaṃs tāḥ śyaitena huṃmā ity abhyajighrat tato vai tāḥ samaidhanta samedhante tāṃ samāṃ prajā yatraivaṃ vidvāñchyaitenodgāyati
children.translated_text: <s>Prajāpati</s> created creatures. Created, they grieved. He breathed over them with the <s>Śyaita</s>, saying "huṃ mā." Then they prospered. In that year creatures prosper wherever one who knows thus sings the <s>udgītha</s> with the <s>Śyaita</s>.

children.text: eṣa vai yajamānasya prajāpatir yad udgātā yacchyaitena hiṅkaroti prajāpatir eva bhūtvā prajā abhijighrati
children.translated_text: For the sacrificer, the <s>Udgātṛ</s> is <s>Prajāpati</s>. When he makes the <s>hiṅ</s> sound with the <s>Śyaita</s>, having become <s>Prajāpati</s> himself, he breathes over the creatures.

children.text: vasunidhanaṃ bhavati paśavo vai vasu paśuṣv eva pratitiṣṭhati ||
children.translated_text: It has <s>vasu</s> as its <s>nidhana</s>. Cattle are <s>vasu</s> (wealth); he becomes established in cattle.

children.text: Chapter 8
āṣkāraṇidhanaṃ kāṇvaṃ vaṣaṭkāraṇidhanam abhicaraṇīyasya brahmasāma kuryād abhinidhanaṃ mādhyandine pavamāne
children.translated_text: For one against whom a hostile rite is to be performed, one should make the <s>Kāṇva</s> with an <s>āṣkāra</s>-<s>nidhana</s> and the <s>brahmasāman</s> with a <s>vaṣaṭkāra</s>-<s>nidhana</s>, an <s>abhinidhana</s> in the midday <s>Pavamāna</s>.

children.text: deveṣur vā eṣā yad vaṣaṭkāro 'bhīti vā indro vṛtrāya vajraṃ prāharad abhītyevāsmai vajraṃ prahṛtya deveṣv ā vaṣaṭkāreṇa vidhyati
children.translated_text: The <s>vaṣaṭkāra</s> is the gods' arrow. With "abhi!" <s>Indra</s> hurled the thunderbolt at <s>Vṛtra</s>; having hurled the thunderbolt at him with "abhi," he pierces him with the <s>vaṣaṭkāra</s> among the gods.

children.text: traikakubhaṃ paśukāmāya brahmasāma kuryāt tvam aṅga praśaṃsiṣa ity etāsu
children.translated_text: One should make the <s>Traikakubha</s> the <s>brahmasāman</s> for one who desires cattle, on these verses beginning "tvam aṅga praśaṃsiṣa."

children.text: indro yatīn sālāvṛkebhyaḥ prāyacchat teṣāṃ traya udaśiṣyanta rāyovājo bṛhadgiriḥ pṛthuraśmis te 'bruvan ko naḥ putrān bhariṣyantīty aham itīndro 'bravīt tāṃs trikakub adhinidhāyācarat sa etat sāmāpaśyad yat trikakub apaśyat tasmāt traikakubham
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> gave the <s>Yatis</s> to the <s>Sālāvṛkas</s>. Three of them survived: <s>Rāyovāja</s>, <s>Bṛhadgiri</s>, and <s>Pṛthuraśmi</s>. They said, "Who will support our sons?" <s>Indra</s> said, "I will." He went about after placing the <s>Trikakub</s> over them. He saw this <s>sāman</s>; because he saw the <s>Trikakub</s>, therefore it is the <s>Traikakubha</s>.

children.text: sa ātmānam eva punar upādhāvat tvam aṅga praśaṃsiṣo devaḥ śaviṣṭha martyaṃ na tvad anyo maghavann asti ca marḍitendra bravīmi te vaca iti sa etena ca pragāthenaitena sāmnā sahasraṃ paśūn asṛjata tān ebhyaḥ prāyacchat te pratyatiṣṭhan
children.translated_text: He again had recourse only to himself: "You indeed have praised, O most powerful god, a mortal. There is no one other than you, O <s>Maghavan</s>, who shows favor. O <s>Indra</s>, I speak this word to you." With this <s>pragātha</s> and with this <s>sāman</s> he created a thousand cattle, gave them to these ones, and they became established.

children.text: yaḥ paśukāmaḥ syād yaḥ pratiṣṭhākāma etasmin pragātha etena sāmnā stuvīta pra sahasraṃ paśūn āpnoti pratitiṣṭhati
children.translated_text: Whoever desires cattle, whoever desires firm standing, should praise on this <s>pragātha</s> with this <s>sāman</s>; he obtains a full thousand cattle and becomes established.

children.text: trivīryaṃ vā etat sāma trīndriyam aindrya ṛca aindraṃ sāmaindreti nidhanam indriya eva vīrye pratitiṣṭhati
children.translated_text: This <s>sāman</s> has threefold vigor and threefold power: the verses are <s>Indra</s>'s, the <s>sāman</s> is <s>Indra</s>'s, and the <s>nidhana</s> is "Indra." He becomes established in power and vigor.

children.text: traiśokaṃ jyogāmayāvine brahmasāma kuryāt
children.translated_text: For one long afflicted with illness, one should make the <s>Traiśoka</s> the <s>brahmasāman</s>.

children.text: ime vai lokāḥ sahāsaṃs te 'śocantaṃsteṣām indra etena sāmnā śucam apāhan yat trayāṇāṃ śocatām apāhaṃs tasmāt traiśokam
children.translated_text: These worlds were together, and they grieved. <s>Indra</s> drove away their grief with this <s>sāman</s>. Because he drove away the grief of the three grieving ones, therefore it is the <s>Traiśoka</s>.

children.text: yāsmād apāhan sā puṃścalīṃ prāviśad yām antarikṣāt sā klībaṃ yām amuṣmāt sainasvinam
children.translated_text: The grief that he drove away from this world entered a promiscuous woman; the grief from the midspace entered a eunuch; the grief from that world entered a sinful man.

children.text: tasmāt teṣāṃ nāśaitavyā ya eṣām āśāmeti tasmā eva śuco 'pabhajate
children.translated_text: Therefore one should not lie with them. Whoever lies with one of them takes a portion of grief from that very one.

children.text: śucā vā eṣa viddho yasya jyog āmayati yat traiśokaṃ brahmasāma bhavati śucam evāsmād apahanti
children.translated_text: Pierced by grief indeed is the man who is sick for a long time. When the <s>Traiśoka</s> is the <s>brahmasāman</s>, it drives grief away from him.

children.text: diveti nidhanam upayanti vyuṣṭir vai divā vy evāsmai vāsayati ||
children.translated_text: They approach the <s>nidhana</s> with the word "divā." Day is indeed daybreak; he thereby makes it dawn for him.

children.text: āṣkāraṇidhanaṃ kāṇvaṃ pratiṣṭhākāmāya brahmasāma kuryāt
children.translated_text: For one who desires firm standing, he should make the <s>Āṣkāraṇidhana Kāṇva</s> the <s>brahmasāman</s>.

children.text: kaṇvo vā etat sāmarte nidhanam apaśyat sa na pratyatiṣṭhat sa vṛṣadaṃśasyāṣiti kṣuvata upāśṛṇot sa tad eva nidhanam apaśyat tato vai sa pratyatiṣṭhad yad etat sāma bhavati pratiṣṭhityai
children.translated_text: <s>Kaṇva</s> saw this <s>nidhana</s> in the <s>sāman</s>, but he did not become established. He heard <s>Vṛṣadaṃśa</s> sneezing with the sound "āṣi"; he saw that very <s>nidhana</s>, and from then he became established. When this <s>sāman</s> is used, it is for firm establishment.

children.text: vasiṣṭhasya janitraṃ prajākāmāya brahmasāma kuryāt
children.translated_text: For one who desires offspring, he should make <s>Vasiṣṭha</s>'s <s>Janitra</s> the <s>brahmasāman</s>.

children.text: vasiṣṭho vā etat putrahataḥ sāmāpaśyat sa prajayā paśubhiḥ prājāyata yad etat sāma bhavati prajātyai
children.translated_text: <s>Vasiṣṭha</s>, after his sons had been killed, saw this <s>sāman</s>. He was brought forth again with offspring and cattle. When this <s>sāman</s> is used, it is for procreation.

children.text: ātharvaṇaṃ lokakāmāya brahmasāma kuryāt
children.translated_text: For one who desires a world, he should make the <s>Ātharvaṇa</s> the <s>brahmasāman</s>.

children.text: atharvāṇo vā etal lokākāmāḥ sāmāpaśyaṃs tenāmartyaṃ lokam apaśyan yad etat sāma bhavati svargasya lokasya prajātyai
children.translated_text: The <s>Atharvans</s>, desiring worlds, saw this <s>sāman</s>; by it they saw the immortal world. When this <s>sāman</s> is used, it is for the bringing forth of the heavenly world.

children.text: abhīvartaṃ bhrātṛvyavate brahmasāma kuryāt
children.translated_text: For one who has a rival, he should make the <s>Abhīvarta</s> the <s>brahmasāman</s>.

children.text: abhīvartena vai devā asurān abhyavartanta yad abhīvarto brahmasāma bhavati bhrātṛvyasyābhivṛtyai
children.translated_text: With the <s>Abhīvarta</s> the gods turned upon the <s>Asuras</s>. When the <s>Abhīvarta</s> is the <s>brahmasāman</s>, it is for turning upon the rival.

children.text: śrāyantīyaṃ yajñavibhraṣṭāya brahmasāma kuryāt
children.translated_text: For one who has fallen away from the sacrifice, he should make the <s>Śrāyantīya</s> the <s>brahmasāman</s>.

children.text: prajāpatir uṣasam adhyait svāṃ duhitaraṃ tasya retaḥ parāpatat tad asyāṃ nyaṣicyata tad aśrīṇād idaṃ me mā duṣad iti tat sad akarot paśūn eva
children.translated_text: <s>Prajāpati</s> approached <s>Uṣas</s>, his own daughter. His seed fell away; it was poured down into her. He ripened it, saying, "May this not spoil for me." He made it into something real, namely cattle.

children.text: yacchrāyantīyaṃ brahmasāma bhavati śrīṇāti caivainaṃ sac ca karoti ||
children.translated_text: When the <s>Śrāyantīya</s> is the <s>brahmasāman</s>, he both ripens him and makes him real and settled.

children.text: devāś ca vā asurāś caiṣu lokeṣv aspardhanta te devāḥ prajāpatim upādhāvaṃs tebhya etat sāma prāyacchad etenainān kālayiṣyaddham iti tenainān ebhyo lokebhyo 'kālayanta yad akālayanta tasmāt kāleyam
children.translated_text: The gods and the <s>Asuras</s> competed for these worlds. The gods ran to <s>Prajāpati</s>; he gave them this <s>sāman</s>, saying, "With this you shall drive them out." With it they drove them out from these worlds. Because they drove them out, it is called <s>Kāleya</s>.

children.text: ebhyo vai lokebhyo bhrātṛvyaṃ kālayate ya evaṃ veda
children.translated_text: He drives his rival out from these worlds, the one who knows thus.

children.text: stomo vai deveṣu taro nāmāsīd yajño 'sureṣu vidadvasus te devās tarobhir vo vidadvasum iti stomena yajñam asurāṇām āvṛñjata
children.translated_text: Among the gods the <s>stoma</s> had the name <s>Tara</s>; among the <s>Asuras</s> the sacrifice was <s>Vidadvasu</s>. With the formula "with the <s>Taras</s>, <s>Vidadvasu</s> for you," the gods, by means of the <s>stoma</s>, took away the sacrifice of the <s>Asuras</s>.

children.text: stomena yajñaṃ bhrātṛvyasya vṛṅkte ya evaṃ veda
children.translated_text: By means of the <s>stoma</s> he takes away the sacrifice of his rival, the one who knows thus.

children.text: sādhyā vai nāma devā āsaṃs te 'vacchidya tṛtīyasavanaṃ mādhyandinena savanena saha svargaṃ lokam āyaṃs tad devāḥ lokeyena samatanvan yat kāleyaṃ bhavati tṛtīyasavanasya saṃtatyai
children.translated_text: There were gods named the <s>Sādhyas</s>. Having cut off the third pressing, they went to the heavenly world together with the midday pressing. The gods extended that by means of the <s>Lokeya</s>. When the <s>Kāleya</s> is used, it is for the continuity of the third pressing.

children.text: vidadvasu vai tṛtīyasavanaṃ yat tarobhir vo vidadvasum iti prastauti tṛtīyasavanam eva tad abhyativadati
children.translated_text: <s>Vidadvasu</s> is the third pressing. When he begins the chant with "with the <s>Taras</s>, <s>Vidadvasu</s> for you," he thereby speaks in favor of the third pressing itself.

children.text: sarvāṇi vai rūpāṇi kāleyaṃ yat padaprastāvaṃ tena rāthantaraṃ yad bṛhato rohān rohati tena bārhataṃ yat stobhavān pratihāras tena bārhataṃ yad dravadiḍaṃ tena rāthantaraṃ sarveṣv eva rūpeṣu pratitiṣṭhati ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Kāleya</s> has all forms: because it has a <s>padaprastāva</s>, by that it is <s>Rāthantara</s>; because it ascends the <s>rohans</s> of the <s>Bṛhat</s>, by that it is <s>Bārhata</s>; because the <s>pratihāra</s> has <s>stobhas</s>, by that it is <s>Bārhata</s>; because it is <s>Dravadiḍa</s>, by that it is <s>Rāthantara</s>. Thus he becomes established in all forms.

children.text: sādhyā vai nāma devā āsaṃs te sarveṇa yajñena saha svargaṃ lokam āyaṃs te devāśīchandāṃsy abruvan somam āharateti te jagatīṃ prāhiṇvan sā trīṇy akṣarāṇi hitvaikākṣarā bhūtvāgacchat triṣṭubhaṃ prāhiṇvan saikam akṣaraṃ hitvā tryakṣarā bhūtvāgacchad gāyatrīṃ prāhiṇvaṃś caturakṣarāṇi vai tarhi chandāṃsy āsan sā tāni cākṣarāṇi haranty āgacchad aṣṭākṣarā bhūtvā trīṇi ca savanāni hastābhyāṃ dve savane dantair daṃṣṭvā tṛtīyasavanaṃ tasmād dve aṃśumatī savane dhītaṃ tṛtīyasavanaṃ dantair hi tad daṃṣṭvā dhayanty aharat tasya ye hriyamāṇasyāṃśavaḥ parāpataṃs te pūtīkā abhavan yāni puṣpāṇy avāśīyanta tāny arjunāni yat prāprothat te praprothās tasmāt tṛtīyasavana āśiram avanayanti yam eva taṃ gāvaḥ somam adanti tasya taṃ rasam avanayanti sasomatvāya
children.translated_text: There were gods named the <s>Sādhyas</s>. They went to the heavenly world together with the whole sacrifice. Those gods said to the metres, "Bring Soma." They sent <s>Jagatī</s>; leaving three syllables behind, she came back as one-syllabled. They sent <s>Triṣṭubh</s>; leaving one syllable behind, she came back as three-syllabled. They sent <s>Gāyatrī</s>; at that time the metres were four-syllabled. She came back bringing those four syllables also, becoming eight-syllabled, and bringing the three pressings: two pressings in her hands, and the third pressing bitten fast with her teeth. Therefore the two pressings have Soma-stalks, while the third pressing is sucked, for they suck it after biting it with the teeth. The shoots that fell from that Soma as it was being carried became the <s>pūtīkas</s>; the flowers that were scattered became the <s>arjunas</s>; what sprouted forth became the <s>praprothas</s>. Therefore at the third pressing they pour in the <s>āśira</s>: they pour in the juice of that very Soma which cows eat, so that it may possess Soma.

children.text: te triṣṭub jagatyai gāyatrīm abrūtām upa tvāyāveti sābravīt kiṃ me tataḥ syād iti yat kāmayasa ity abrūtāṃ sābravīn mama sarvaṃ prātaḥsavanam aham uttare savane praṇayānīti tasmād gāyatraṃ prātaḥsavanaṃ gāyatry uttare savane praṇayati
children.translated_text: Then <s>Triṣṭubh</s> and <s>Jagatī</s> said to <s>Gāyatrī</s>, "Let us come to you." She said, "What would be mine from that?" They said, "Whatever you desire." She said, "Let the whole morning pressing be mine; I will lead the later pressings onward." Therefore the morning pressing is <s>Gāyatra</s>, and <s>Gāyatrī</s> leads the later pressings onward.

children.text: tān triṣṭup tribhir akṣarair upait saikādaśākṣarā bhūtvā prājāyata tāṃ jagaty ekenākṣareṇopait sā dvādaśākṣarā bhūtvā prājāyata
children.translated_text: <s>Triṣṭubh</s> came to her with three syllables; becoming eleven-syllabled, she was brought forth. <s>Jagatī</s> came to her with one syllable; becoming twelve-syllabled, she was brought forth.

children.text: tasmād āhur gāyatrī vāva sarvāṇi chandāṃsi gāyatrī hy etān poṣān puṣyanty aid iti
children.translated_text: Therefore they say, "<s>Gāyatrī</s> indeed is all the metres, for <s>Gāyatrī</s> came bearing these nourishments."

children.text: indras tṛtīyasavanād bībhatsamāna udakrāmat tad devāḥ svādiṣṭhayeti asvadayan madiṣṭhayeti madvad akurvan pavasva soma dhārayety apāvayann indrāya pātave suta iti tato vai tad indra upāvartata yat svādiṣṭhayā madiṣṭhayeti prastauti tṛtīyasavanasya sendratvāya
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s>, shrinking from the third pressing, went away from it. The gods sweetened it with "svādiṣṭhayā"; with "madiṣṭhayā" they made it intoxicating; with "pavasva soma dhārayā" they purified it; with "pressed for <s>Indra</s> to drink" they offered it. Then <s>Indra</s> turned back to it. When he begins the chant with "svādiṣṭhayā madiṣṭhayā," it is so that the third pressing may be with <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: svādiṣṭhā vai deveṣu paśava āsan madiṣṭhā asureṣu te devāḥ svādiṣṭhayā madiṣṭhayeti paśūn asurāṇām avṛñjata
children.translated_text: Cattle among the gods were indeed the sweetest, and among the <s>Asuras</s> the most exhilarating. The gods, by means of the words "with the sweetest, with the most exhilarating," took away the cattle of the <s>Asuras</s>.

children.text: paśūn bhrātṛvyasya vṛṅkte ya evaṃ veda
children.translated_text: One who knows thus takes away the cattle of his rival.

children.text: tāsu saṃhitam
children.translated_text: Among these is the <s>Saṃhita</s>.

children.text: sādhyā vai nāma devā āsaṃs te 'vacchidya tṛtīyasavanaṃ mādhyandinena savanena saha svargaṃ lokam āyaṃs tad devāḥ saṃhitena samadadhur yat samadadhus tasmāt saṃhitam
children.translated_text: There were gods called the <s>Sādhyas</s>. Having cut off the third pressing, they went to the heavenly world together with the midday pressing. The gods joined it together with the <s>Saṃhita</s>; because they joined it together, therefore it is called <s>Saṃhita</s>.

children.text: kāleyaṃ purastād bhavati saṃhitam upariṣṭād etābhyāṃ hi tṛtīyasavanaṃ saṃtāyate
children.translated_text: The <s>Kāleya</s> is before, and the <s>Saṃhita</s> after; for by these two the third pressing is continued.

children.text: sarvāṇi vai rūpāṇi saṃhitaṃ yat padaprastāvaṃ tena rāthantaraṃ yad bṛhato rohān rohati tena bārhataṃ yat padanidhanaṃ tena rāthantaraṃ sarveṣv eva rūpeṣu pratitiṣṭhati ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Saṃhita</s> is all forms. In that it has a <s>padaprastāva</s>, by that it is <s>Rāthantara</s>; in that it ascends the ascents of the <s>Bṛhat</s>, by that it is <s>Bārhata</s>; in that it has a <s>padanidhana</s>, by that it is <s>Rāthantara</s>. He becomes established in all forms.

children.text: uṣṇikkakubhāv ete bhavataḥ
children.translated_text: These two are the <s>Uṣṇih</s> and the <s>Kakubh</s>.

children.text: uṣṇikkakubbhyāṃ vā indro vṛtrāya vajraṃ prāharat kakubhi parākramatoṣṇihā prāharat tasmāt kakubho madhyamaṃ padaṃ bhūyiṣṭhākṣaraṃ parākramaṇaṃ hi tad abhisamauhat tasmād uṣṇiha uttamaṃ padaṃ bhūyiṣṭhākṣaraṃ puro gurur iva hi vajraḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> hurled the thunderbolt at <s>Vṛtra</s> with the <s>Uṣṇih</s> and the <s>Kakubh</s>. Striding forward with the <s>Kakubh</s>, he struck with the <s>Uṣṇih</s>. Therefore the middle foot of the <s>Kakubh</s> has the greatest number of syllables, for that gathered up the stride; therefore the last foot of the <s>Uṣṇih</s> has the greatest number of syllables, for the thunderbolt is heavy in front.

children.text: vajraṃ bhrātṛvyāya praharati ya evaṃ veda
children.translated_text: One who knows thus hurls the thunderbolt at his rival.

children.text: nāsike vā ete yajñasya yad uṣṇikkakubhau tasmāt samānaṃ chandaḥ satī nānā yajñaṃ vahatas tasmāt samānāyā nāsikāyāḥ satyā nānā prāṇāv uccarataḥ
children.translated_text: These are the two nostrils of the sacrifice, namely the <s>Uṣṇih</s> and the <s>Kakubh</s>. Therefore, though they are the same metre, they carry the sacrifice separately; therefore, though the nose is one, two breaths issue separately.

children.text: prāṇā vā uṣṇikkakubhau tasmāt tābhyāṃ na vaṣaṭ kurvanti yad vaṣaṭ kuryuḥ prāṇān agnau pradadhyuḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>Uṣṇih</s> and the <s>Kakubh</s> are the breaths. Therefore they do not utter the <s>vaṣaṭ</s> with them. If they uttered the <s>vaṣaṭ</s>, they would put the breaths into the fire.

children.text: tāsu saphaṃ vipham iva vai tṛtīyasavanaṃ tṛtīyasavanasya saphatvāyāthauṣkalam etena vai prajāpatiḥ puṣkalān paśūn asṛjata teṣu rūpam adadhād yad etat sāma bhavati paśuṣv eva rūpaṃ dadhāti
children.translated_text: Among these is the <s>Sapha</s>. The third pressing is, as it were, hoofless; this is for making the third pressing hoofed. Next is the <s>Auṣkala</s>. With this <s>Prajāpati</s> created full cattle and placed form in them. When this <s>Sāman</s> is used, he thereby places form among cattle.

children.text: purojitī vo andhasa iti padyā cākṣaryā ca virājau bhavataḥ padyayā vai devāḥ svargaṃ lokam āyann akṣaryayā ṛṣayo nu prājānān yad ete padyā cākṣaryā ca virājau bhavataḥ svargasya lokasya prajñātyai
children.translated_text: With "purojitī vo andhasa," there are two <s>Virāj</s> forms, one in padas and one in syllables. By the pada-form the gods went to the heavenly world; by the syllabic form the seers afterward recognized it. Since these two <s>Virāj</s> forms are one in padas and one in syllables, it is for recognizing the heavenly world.

children.text: tāsu śyāvāśvam
children.translated_text: Among these is the <s>Śyāvāśva</s>.

children.text: śyāvāśvam ārvanānasaṃ sattram āsīnaṃ dhanvodavahan sa etat sāmāpaśyat tena vṛṣṭim asṛjata tato vai sa pratyatiṣṭhat tato gātum avindata gātuvid vā etat sāma
children.translated_text: <s>Śyāvāśva Ārvanānasa</s>, while seated in a sacrificial session, was borne away into a wilderness. He saw this <s>Sāman</s>; with it he created rain. Then he became established; then he found a path. This <s>Sāman</s> is indeed a finder of the path.

children.text: vindate gātuṃ pratitiṣṭhaty etena tuṣṭuvānaḥ
children.translated_text: One praising with it finds a path and becomes established.

children.text: indras tṛtīyasavanād bībhatsamāna udakrāmat taṃ devāḥ śyāvāślvenaihāyi ehiyety anvāhvayan sa upāvartata yad etat sāma bhavati tṛtīyasavanasya sendratvāya
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s>, shrinking from the third pressing, stepped away from it. The gods called after him with the <s>Śyāvāśva</s>, saying, "Come here! come!" He turned back. When this <s>Sāman</s> is used, it is so that the third pressing may be possessed of <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: athaitad āndhīgavam andhīgur vā etat paśukāmaḥ sāmāpaśyat tena sahasraṃ paśūn asṛjata yad etat sāma bhavati paśūnāṃ puṣṭyai madhye nidhanam aiḍaṃ bhavaty etena vai tṛtīyasavanaṃ pratiṣṭhitaṃ yan madhye nidhanam aiḍaṃ na syād apratiṣṭhitaṃ tṛtīyasavanaṃ syāt
children.translated_text: Next this is the <s>Āndhīgava</s>. <s>Andhīgu</s>, desiring cattle, saw this <s>Sāman</s>; with it he created a thousand cattle. When this <s>Sāman</s> is used, it is for the thriving of cattle. In the middle there is an <s>Aiḍa</s> <s>nidhana</s>; by this the third pressing is established. If there were not an <s>Aiḍa</s> <s>nidhana</s> in the middle, the third pressing would be unestablished.

children.text: daśākṣaraṃ madhyato nidhanam upayanti daśākṣarā virāḍ virājy eva pratitiṣṭhati
children.translated_text: They take up a ten-syllabled <s>nidhana</s> in the middle. The <s>Virāj</s> has ten syllables; he becomes established in the <s>Virāj</s> itself.

children.text: abhi priyāṇi pavata iti kāvaṃ prājāpatyaṃ sāma
children.translated_text: With "abhi priyāṇi pavata," it is the <s>Kāva</s>, a <s>Prājāpatya</s> <s>Sāman</s>.

children.text: prajā vai priyāṇi paśavaḥ priyāṇi prajāyām eva paśuṣu pratitiṣtśuṣu pratitiṣṭhati
children.translated_text: Offspring are indeed dear things; cattle are dear things. He becomes established precisely in offspring and in cattle.

children.text: raśmī vā etau yajñasya yad auśanakāve devakośo vā eṣa yajñam abhisamubjito yad ete antato bhavato yajñasyāriṣṭyai ||
children.translated_text: These two are the reins of the sacrifice, namely the two <s>Auśanakāva</s> Sāmans. This is a divine sheath drawn around the sacrifice, since these two occur at the end, for the sacrifice's freedom from harm.

children.text: devā vai brahma vyabhajanta tasya yo raso 'tyaricyata tad yajñāyajñīyam abhavat
children.translated_text: The gods divided <s>brahman</s> (sacred power). The essence of it that was left over became the <s>Yajñāyajñīya</s>.

children.text: brahmaṇo vā eṣa raso yad yajñāyajñīyaṃ yad yajñāyajñīyena stuvanti brahmaṇa eva rase yajñaṃ pratiṣṭhāpayati
children.translated_text: This is the essence of <s>brahman</s>, namely the <s>Yajñāyajñīya</s>. When they praise with the <s>Yajñāyajñīya</s>, he establishes the sacrifice in the very essence of <s>brahman</s>.

children.text: yonir vai yajñāyajñīyam etasmād vai yoneḥ prajāpatir yajñam asṛjata tasmād yajñāyajñīyam
children.translated_text: The <s>Yajñāyajñīya</s> is the womb. From this womb <s>Prajāpati</s> created the sacrifice; therefore it is the <s>Yajñāyajñīya</s>.

children.text: tasmād vā etena purā brāhmaṇā bahiṣpavamānam astoṣata yoner yajñaṃ pratanavāmahā iti yajñaṃ tataḥ stuvanti yonau yajñaṃ pratiṣṭhāpayati
children.translated_text: Therefore, in former times, the <s>Brāhmaṇas</s> praised the <s>Bahiṣpavamāna</s> with this, thinking, "Let us stretch the sacrifice forth from the womb." They praise the sacrifice from there; he establishes the sacrifice in the womb.

children.text: asureṣu vai sarvo yajña āsīt te devā yajñāyajñīyam apaśyaṃs teṣāṃ yajñā yajñā vo agnaya ity agnihotram avṛñjata girā girā ca dakṣasa iti darśapūrṇamāsau pra pra vayam amṛtaṃ jātavedasam iti cāturmāsyāni priyaṃ mitraṃ na śaṃsiṣam iti saumyam adhvaram
children.translated_text: The whole sacrifice was indeed among the <s>Asuras</s>. The gods saw the <s>Yajñāyajñīya</s>. With "yajñā yajñā vo agnaya" they took away from them the <s>Agnihotra</s>; with "girā girā ca dakṣasa," the new- and full-moon rites; with "pra pra vayam amṛtaṃ jātavedasam," the <s>Cāturmāsya</s> rites; with "priyaṃ mitraṃ na śaṃsiṣam," the <s>Saumya adhvara</s> (Soma sacrifice).

children.text: yajñā vo agnaye girā ca dakṣase pra vayam amṛtaṃ jātavedasaṃ priyaṃ mitraṃ na śaṃsiṣam iti vai tarhi chandāṃsy āsaṃs te devā abhyārambham abhinivartyaṃ chandobhir yajñam asurāṇām avṛñjata
children.translated_text: "Yajñā vo agnaye," "girā ca dakṣase," "pra vayam amṛtaṃ jātavedasam," and "priyaṃ mitraṃ na śaṃsiṣam" were indeed the metres at that time. The gods, having made an <s>abhyārambha</s> (initial grasping) and an <s>abhinivartya</s> (turning back) with the metres, took away the sacrifice of the <s>Asuras</s>.

children.text: chandobhir yajñaṃ bhrātṛvyasya vṛṅkte ya evaṃ veda
children.translated_text: One who knows thus takes away his rival's sacrifice with the metres.

children.text: etaddha sma vā āha kūśāmbaḥ svāyavo brahmā lātavyaḥ kaṃsvid adya śiśumārī yajñapathe 'pyastā gariṣyati
children.translated_text: This indeed is what <s>Kūśāmba Svāyava</s>, the <s>Brahman</s>-priest of <s>Lātavya</s>, used to say: "What, pray, will the <s>śiśumārī</s>, cast today into the path of the sacrifice, swallow?"

children.text: eṣā vai śiśumārī yajñapathe 'pyastā yajñāyajñīyaṃ yad girā girety āhātmānaṃ tad udgātā girati
children.translated_text: This <s>Yajñāyajñīya</s> is indeed the <s>Śiśumārī</s> cast into the path of the sacrifice. When he says, 'girā gire,' the <s>Udgātṛ</s> thereby swallows himself.

children.text: airaṃ kṛtvodgeyam irāyāṃ yajñaṃ pratiṣṭhāpayaty apramāyuka udgātā bhavati
children.translated_text: It should be sung after being made <s>Aira</s>. He establishes the sacrifice in <s>Irā</s>; the <s>Udgātṛ</s> becomes free from premature death.

children.text: vaiśvānare vā etad udgātātmānaṃ pradadhāti yat pra pra vayam ity āha praprīṃ vayam iti vaktavyaṃ vaiśvānaram eva parikrāmati
children.translated_text: The <s>Udgātṛ</s> places himself in <s>Vaiśvānara</s> when he says, 'pra pra vayam.' One should say, 'praprīṃ vayam'; he thereby goes around <s>Vaiśvānara</s>.

children.text: yo vai nihnuvānaṃ chanda upaiti pāpīyān ujjagivān bhavaty etad vai nihnuvānaṃ chando yan na śaṃsiṣam iti nu śaṃsiṣam iti vaktavyaṃ suśaṃsiṣam iti vā na nihnuvānaṃ chanda upaiti vasīyān ujjagivān bhavati
children.translated_text: Whoever approaches a metre that is denying itself comes forth worse off. This is a denying metre, namely 'na śaṃsiṣam.' One should say 'nu śaṃsiṣam,' or else 'suśaṃsiṣam.' Then he does not approach a denying metre; he comes forth better off.

children.text: yasya vai yajñā vāgantā bhavanti vācaś chidreṇa sravanty ete vai yajñā vāgantā ye yajñāyajñīyāntā etad vācaś chidraṃ yad anṛtaṃ yad agniṣṭomayājy anṛtam āha tad anv asya yajñaḥ sravaty akṣareṇāntataḥ pratiṣṭhāpyam akṣareṇaiva yajñasya chidram api dadhāti
children.translated_text: For the one whose sacrifices end in speech, they leak through a breach in speech. Those sacrifices indeed end in speech which end with the <s>Yajñāyajñīya</s>. This is the breach in speech, namely falsehood. When an <s>Agniṣṭoma</s>-sacrificer speaks what is false, his sacrifice leaks away after that. It should be set firm at the end with a syllable; with a syllable he closes up the breach of the sacrifice.

children.text: virājo vā etad rūpaṃ yad akṣaraṃ virājy evāntataḥ pratitiṣṭhati ||
children.translated_text: What is a syllable is a form of the <s>Virāj</s>; at the end he becomes established in the <s>Virāj</s>.

children.text: ito vai prātar ūrdhvāṇi chandāṃsi yujyante 'muto 'vāñci yajñāyajñīyasya stotre yujyante yajñā vo agnaye girā ca dakṣasa iti dvādaśākṣaraṃ pra vayam amṛtaṃ jātavedasam ity ekādaśākṣaraṃ priyaṃ mitraṃ na śaṃsiṣam ity aṣṭākṣaram
children.translated_text: From here, in the morning, the metres are yoked upward; from there, in the <s>Yajñāyajñīya</s> stotra, they are yoked downward. 'yajñā vo agnaye girā ca dakṣasa,' the formula to <s>Agni</s>, has twelve syllables; 'pra vayam amṛtaṃ jātavedasam,' to <s>Jātavedas</s>, has eleven syllables; 'priyaṃ mitraṃ na śaṃsiṣam,' to <s>Mitra</s>, has eight syllables.

children.text: anuṣṭubham uttamāṃ sampādayatīyaṃ vā anuṣṭub asyām eva pratitiṣṭhati
children.translated_text: He completes the last verse as an <s>Anuṣṭubh</s>. This earth is <s>Anuṣṭubh</s>; in this very earth he becomes established.

children.text: vāg vā anuṣṭub vācy eva pratitiṣṭhati jyaiṣṭhyaṃ vā anuṣṭub jyaiṣṭhya eva pratitiṣṭhati
children.translated_text: Speech is <s>Anuṣṭubh</s>; in speech itself he becomes established. <s>Anuṣṭubh</s> is preeminence; in preeminence itself he becomes established.

children.text: katham iva yajñāyajñīyaṃ geyam ity āhur yathānaḍvān prasrāvayamāṇa ittham iva cettham iva ceti
children.translated_text: They ask, 'How should the <s>Yajñāyajñīya</s> be sung?' Like an ox being made to pass water: 'this way, and this way.'

children.text: vaiśvānaraṃ vā etad udgātānu prasīdann etīty āhur yad yajñāyajñīyasyarcaṃ saṃpratyāheti parikrāmatevodgeyaṃ vaiśvānaram eva parikrāmati
children.translated_text: They say, 'The <s>Udgātṛ</s>, while settling upon it, goes after <s>Vaiśvānara</s> when he responds directly to the verse of the <s>Yajñāyajñīya</s>.' It should be sung as though going around; he thereby goes around <s>Vaiśvānara</s>.

children.text: vaiśvānare vā etad adhvaryuḥ sadasyān abhisṛjati yad yajñāyajñīyasya stotram upāvartayati prāvṛtenodgeyaṃ vaiśvānareṇānabhidāhāya
children.translated_text: The <s>Adhvaryu</s> exposes the <s>Sadasyas</s> to <s>Vaiśvānara</s> when he turns back to the <s>Yajñāyajñīya</s> stotra. It should be sung under cover, so that <s>Vaiśvānara</s> does not burn them.

children.text: na ha tu vai pitaraḥ prāvṛtaṃ jānanti yajñāyajñīyasya vai stotre pitaro yathāyathaṃ jijñāsanta ākarṇābhyāṃ prāvṛtyaṃ tad eva prāvṛtaṃ tad aprāvṛtaṃ jānanti pitaro na vaiśvānaro hinasti
children.translated_text: But the <s>Pitṛs</s> do not in fact recognize what is covered. In the <s>Yajñāyajñīya</s> stotra the <s>Pitṛs</s> wish to recognize each part in due order; it is to be covered up to the ears. That very covered thing the <s>Pitṛs</s> know as uncovered, and <s>Vaiśvānara</s> does not harm it.

children.text: apaḥ paścāt patnya upasṛjanti vaiśvānaram eva tacchamayanty āpo hi śāntiḥ
children.translated_text: The wives bring waters near from behind; thereby they quiet <s>Vaiśvānara</s>, for waters are pacification.

children.text: atho reta eva tat siñcanty āpo hi retaḥ
children.translated_text: And thereby they pour seed, for waters are seed.

children.text: dakṣiṇān ūrūn abhiṣiñcanti dakṣiṇato hi retaḥ sicyate
children.translated_text: They sprinkle the right thighs, for seed is poured from the right side.

children.text: mahad iva pratyūhyaṃ mana evāsya tajjanayanti
children.translated_text: Something large, as it were, is to be drawn back; with that they generate its mind.

children.text: udgātrā patnīḥ saṃkhyāpayanti retodheyāya
children.translated_text: They make the wives count with the <s>Udgātṛ</s>, for the depositing of seed.

children.text: hiṅkāraṃ prati saṃkhyāpayanti hiṅkṛtāddhi reto 'dhīyata
children.translated_text: They make them count at the <s>hiṅkāra</s>, for from what has been sounded with hiṅ seed is deposited.

children.text: ā tṛtīyāyāḥ saṃkhyāpayanti trivaddhi retaḥ ||
children.translated_text: They make them count up to the third, for seed is threefold.

children.text: devā vā agniṣṭomam abhijityokthāni nāśaknuvann abhijetuṃ te 'gnim abruvaṃs tvayā mukhenedaṃ cayāmeti so 'bravīt kiṃ me tataḥ syād iti yat kāmayasa ity abruvan so 'bravīn maddevatyāsūkthāni praṇayān iti
children.translated_text: The gods, after conquering the <s>Agniṣṭoma</s>, were not able to conquer the <s>ukthas</s>. They said to <s>Agni</s>, 'With you as the mouth we shall win this.' He said, 'What would there be for me from that?' They said, 'Whatever you desire.' He said, 'Let them lead forth the <s>ukthas</s> in verses having me as their deity.'

children.text: tasmād āgneyīṣūkthāni praṇayanti
children.translated_text: Therefore they lead forth the <s>ukthas</s> in <s>Āgneyī</s> verses.

children.text: tasmād u gāyatrīṣu gāyatracchandā hy agniḥ
children.translated_text: And therefore they do so in <s>Gāyatrī</s> verses, for <s>Agni</s> has the <s>Gāyatra</s> metre.

children.text: te 'gniṃ mukhaṃ kṛtvā sākam aśvenābhyakrāman yat sākam aśvenābhyakrāmaṃs tasmāt sākamaśvam
children.translated_text: Having made <s>Agni</s> the mouth, they advanced together with the horse. Because they advanced together with the horse, it is called <s>Sākamaśva</s>.

children.text: tasmāt sākamaśvenokthāni praṇayanty etena hi tāny agre 'bhyajayan
children.translated_text: Therefore they lead forth the <s>ukthas</s> with the <s>Sākamaśva</s>, for by this they first conquered them.

children.text: sa indro 'bravīt kaś cāhaṃ cedam anvavaiṣyāva ity ahaṃ ceti varuṇas taṃ varuṇo 'nvatiṣṭhad indra āharat tasmād aindrāvaruṇam anuśasyate
children.translated_text: Then <s>Indra</s> said, 'Who, together with me, will follow this?' 'I,' said <s>Varuṇa</s>. <s>Varuṇa</s> followed him, and <s>Indra</s> brought it. Therefore the <s>Aindrāvaruṇa</s> is recited afterward.

children.text: sa evābravīt kaś cāhaṃ cedam anvavaiṣyāva ity ahaṃ ceti bṛhaspatis taṃ bṛhaspatir anvatiṣṭhad indra āharat tasmād aindrābārhaspatyam anuśasyate sa evābravīt kaś cāhaṃ cedam anvavaiṣyāva ity ahaṃ ceti viṣṇus taṃ viṣṇur anvatiṣṭhad indra āharat tasmād aindrāvaiṣṇavam anuśasyate
children.translated_text: He again said, 'Who, together with me, will follow this?' 'I,' said <s>Bṛhaspati</s>. <s>Bṛhaspati</s> followed him, and <s>Indra</s> brought it. Therefore the <s>Aindrābārhaspatya</s> is recited afterward. He again said, 'Who, together with me, will follow this?' 'I,' said <s>Viṣṇu</s>. <s>Viṣṇu</s> followed him, and <s>Indra</s> brought it. Therefore the <s>Aindrāvaiṣṇava</s> is recited afterward.

children.text: paśūn vā ebhyas tān āharat paśavo vā ukthāni paśukāma ukthena stuvīta paśumān bhavati
children.translated_text: He brought those cattle for them; the <s>ukthas</s> are cattle. One who desires cattle should praise with an <s>uktha</s>; he becomes possessed of cattle.

children.text: bṛhatā vā indro vṛtrāya vajraṃ prāharat tasya tejaḥ parāpatat tat saubharam abhavat
children.translated_text: With the <s>Bṛhat</s>, <s>Indra</s> hurled the thunderbolt at <s>Vṛtra</s>. Its radiance fell away; that became the <s>Saubhara</s>.

children.text: jāmi vā etad yajñe kriyata ity āhur yad rathantaraṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ rathantaraṃ saṃdhir nāntarā bṛhatā stuvantīti yat saubhareṇa stuvanti bṛhataiva tad antarā stuvanti bṛhato hy etat tejo yat saubharam
children.translated_text: They say, 'Too-close kinship is produced in the sacrifice when the <s>Rathantara</s> is the <s>pṛṣṭha</s> and the <s>Rathantara</s> is the <s>saṃdhi</s>, and they do not praise with the <s>Bṛhat</s> in between.' When they praise with the <s>Saubhara</s>, they thereby praise in between with the <s>Bṛhat</s> itself, for the <s>Saubhara</s> is that radiance of the <s>Bṛhat</s>.

children.text: yadi bṛhat sāmātirātraḥ syāt saubharam ukthānāṃ brahma sāma kāryaṃ bṛhad eva tat tejasā samardhayati
children.translated_text: If the <s>Atirātra</s> has the <s>Bṛhat</s> as its <s>sāman</s>, the <s>Saubhara</s> should be made the <s>brahmasāman</s> of the <s>ukthas</s>; it thereby strengthens the <s>Bṛhat</s> with radiance.

children.text: yadi rathantarasāmnā saubharaṃ kuryād ajāmitāyai
children.translated_text: If it has the <s>Rathantara</s> as its <s>sāman</s>, he should use the <s>Saubhara</s>, so that there is no too-close kinship.

children.text: devānāṃ vai svargaṃ lokaṃ chyatāṃ diśo 'valīyanta tāḥ saubhareṇo ity udastabhnuvaṃs tato vai tā adṛṃhanta tataḥ pratyatiṣṭhaṃs tataḥ svargaṃ lokaṃ prājānan yaḥ svargakāmaḥ syād yaḥ pratiṣṭhākāmaḥ saubhareṇa stuvīta pra svargaṃ lokaṃ jānāti pratitiṣṭhati
children.translated_text: When the gods were slipping from the heavenly world, the quarters fell away. With the <s>Saubhara</s>, with the syllable "o," they propped them up. Then they became firm; then they became established; then they came to know the heavenly world. One who desires the heavenly world, or one who desires firm establishment, should praise with the <s>Saubhara</s>. He comes to know the heavenly world and becomes established.

children.text: prajāpatiḥ prajā asṛjata tāḥ sṛṣṭā āśanāyaṃs tābhyaḥ saubhareṇorg ity annaṃ prāyacchat tato vai tāḥ samaidhanta
children.translated_text: <s>Prajāpati</s> created creatures. Having been created, they became hungry. With the <s>Saubhara</s>, with the word "ūrj," he gave them food. Then they prospered.

children.text: samedhante tāṃ samāṃ prajā yatraivaṃ vidvān saubhareṇodgāyati
children.translated_text: The creatures prosper throughout that year in which one who knows thus sings the <s>udgītha</s> with the <s>Saubhara</s>.

children.text: tā abruvan subhṛtaṃ no 'bhārṣīr iti tasmāt saubharam
children.translated_text: They said, "You have borne it well for us." Therefore it is called <s>Saubhara</s>.

children.text: vṛṣṭiṃ vā abhyastāṃ prāyacchad annam eva
children.translated_text: He gave the rain that was sought, that is, food itself.

children.text: yo vṛṣṭikāmaḥ syād yo 'nnādyakāmo yaḥ svargakāmaḥ saubhareṇa stuvīta
children.translated_text: One who desires rain, one who desires food to eat, or one who desires the heavenly world should praise with the <s>Saubhara</s>.

children.text: hīṣiti vṛṣṭikāmāya nidhanaṃ kuryād ūrg ity annādyakāmāyo iti svargakāmāya
children.translated_text: For one who desires rain, he should make the <s>nidhana</s> "hīṣi"; for one who desires food to eat, "ūrj"; for one who desires the heavenly world, "o."

children.text: sarve vai kāmāḥ saubharaṃ sarveṣv eva kāmeṣu pratitiṣṭhati
children.translated_text: All desires indeed are the <s>Saubhara</s>; he becomes established in every desire.

children.text: athaitan nārmedham
children.translated_text: Now this is the <s>Nārmedha</s>.

children.text: nṛmedhasam āṅgirasaṃ sattram āsīnaṃ śvabhir abhyāhvayan so 'gnim upādhāvat pāhi no agna ekayeti taṃ vaiśvānaraḥ paryudatiṣṭhat tato vai sa pratyatiṣṭhat tato gātum avindata
children.translated_text: Dogs called out against <s>Nṛmedhas Āṅgirasa</s> while he was seated in a <s>sattra</s> session. He ran to <s>Agni</s> with the words, "Protect us, O <s>Agni</s>, with one." <s>Vaiśvānara</s> rose up around him. Then he became established; then he found a path.

children.text: gātuvid vā etat sāma vindate gātuṃ pratitiṣṭhaty etena tuṣṭuvānaḥ
children.translated_text: This <s>sāman</s> is indeed path-finding. One who praises with it finds a path and becomes established.

children.text: naiva hy etad ahno rūpaṃ na rātrer yad ukthānām
children.translated_text: For this, which belongs to the <s>ukthas</s>, is not exactly the form of day, nor that of night.

children.text: kakup prathamāthoṣṇig atha purauṣṇig anuṣṭup tenānuṣṭubho nayanty acchāvākasāmnaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The first is <s>Kakubh</s>, then <s>Uṣṇih</s>, then <s>Purauṣṇih</s>, and then <s>Anuṣṭubh</s>; by that they lead it toward the <s>Anuṣṭubhs</s> of the <s>Acchāvāka-sāman</s>.

children.text: hārivarṇaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: It is the <s>Hārivarṇa</s>.

children.text: asurā vā eṣu lokeṣv āsaṃs tān devā hariśriyam ity asmāl lokāt prāṇudanta virājasīty antarikṣād divo diva ity amuṣmāt
children.translated_text: The <s>Asuras</s> were in these worlds. The gods drove them from this world with "hariśriyam," from the midspace with "virājasī," and from yonder world with "divo diva."

children.text: tad ya evaṃ vedaibhyo lokebhyo bhrātṛvyaṃ praṇudyemāṃl lokān abhyārohati
children.translated_text: One who knows thus drives his rival from these worlds and ascends these worlds.

children.text: harivarṇo vā etat paśukāmaḥ sāmāpaśyat tena sahasraṃ paśūn asṛjata yad etat sāma bhavati paśūnāṃ puṣṭaiḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Harivarṇa</s>, desiring cattle, saw this <s>sāman</s>. With it he created a thousand cattle. When this <s>sāman</s> is used, it is for the thriving of cattle.

children.text: aṅgirasaḥ svargaṃ lokaṃ yato rakṣāṃsy anvasacanta tāny etena harivarṇo 'pāhanta yad etat sāma bhavati rakṣasām apahatyai
children.translated_text: When the <s>Aṅgirases</s> were going to the heavenly world, the <s>Rakṣases</s> followed after them. <s>Harivarṇa</s> struck them away with this. When this <s>sāman</s> is used, it is for striking away the <s>Rakṣases</s>.

children.text: pṛṣṭhāni vā asṛjyanta teṣāṃ yat tejo raso 'tyaricyata tad devāḥ samabharaṃs tad udvaṃśīyam abhavat
children.translated_text: The <s>Pṛṣṭhas</s> were created. The splendor and essence that overflowed from them, the gods gathered together; that became the <s>Udvaṃśīya</s>.

children.text: sarveṣāṃ vā etat pṛṣṭhānāṃ tejo yad udvaṃśīyaṃ tasmād vā etat purā sajātāya nākran pāpavasīyaso vidhṛtyai
children.translated_text: The <s>Udvaṃśīya</s> is the splendor of all the <s>Pṛṣṭhas</s>. Therefore in former times they did not perform it for a kinsman, for the warding off of one who was evil and worse.

children.text: eṣa hy eva pṛṣṭhais tuṣṭuvāno ya udvaṃśīyena stuvate
children.translated_text: For the one who praises with the <s>Udvaṃśīya</s> is truly praising with the <s>Pṛṣṭhas</s>.

children.text: sarvāṇi vai rūpāṇy udvaṃśīyam
children.translated_text: All forms indeed are the <s>Udvaṃśīya</s>.

children.text: gāyanti tvā gāyatriṇa eti rathantarasya rūpam eti hi rathantaram
children.translated_text: "The <s>Gāyatrī</s>-singers sing you" is the form of the <s>Rathantara</s>, for the <s>Rathantara</s> indeed proceeds.

children.text: ādir bṛhata ūrdhvam iva hi bṛhat
children.translated_text: The beginning belongs to the <s>Bṛhat</s>, for the <s>Bṛhat</s> is, as it were, upward.

children.text: pariṣṭobho vairūpasya pariṣṭubhaṃ hi vairūpam
children.translated_text: The <s>pariṣṭobha</s> belongs to the <s>Vairūpa</s>, for the <s>Vairūpa</s> has <s>pariṣṭubha</s>.

children.text: anutodo vairājasyānutunnaṃ hi vairājam
children.translated_text: The <s>anutoda</s> belongs to the <s>Vairāja</s>, for the <s>Vairāja</s> is <s>anutunna</s>.

children.text: ardheḍā śakvarīṇām atisvāro revatīnām
children.translated_text: The <s>ardheḍā</s> belongs to the <s>Śakvarī</s> verses; the <s>atisvāra</s> belongs to the <s>Revatī</s> verses.

children.text: ardheḍayā vai devā asurān avahatyātisvāreṇa svargaṃ lokam ārohan
children.translated_text: By the <s>ardheḍā</s> the gods struck down the <s>Asuras</s>, and by the <s>atisvāra</s> they ascended the heavenly world.

children.text: tad ya evaṃ vedārdheḍayaiva bhrātṛvyam avahatyātisvāreṇa svargaṃ lokam ārohati
children.translated_text: One who knows thus strikes down his rival by the <s>ardheḍā</s> itself and ascends the heavenly world by the <s>atisvāra</s>.

children.text: ardheḍayā vai pūrvaṃ yajñaṃ saṃsthāpayanty atisvāreṇottaram ārabhante
children.translated_text: By the <s>ardheḍā</s> they bring the earlier sacrifice to completion; by the <s>atisvāra</s> they begin the later one.

children.text: upainam uttaro yajño namati ya evaṃ veda
children.translated_text: The later sacrifice inclines toward the one who knows thus.

children.text: pāṅktaṃ vā etat sāma pāṅkto yajñaḥ pāṅktāḥ paśavo yajña eva paśuṣu pratitiṣṭhati
children.translated_text: This <s>sāman</s> is <s>pāṅkta</s> (fivefold); the sacrifice is <s>pāṅkta</s>; cattle are <s>pāṅkta</s>. In the sacrifice itself he becomes established among cattle.

children.text: āṣṭādaṃṣṭre ṛddhikāmāya kuryāt
children.translated_text: For one who desires prosperity, he should use the <s>Āṣṭādaṃṣṭra</s>.

children.text: aṣṭādaṃṣṭro vairūpo 'putro 'prajā ajīryat sa imāṃ lokān vicicchidvāṃ amanyata sa ete jarasi sāmanī apaśyat tayor aprayogād abibhet so 'bravīd ṛdhnavad yobhe sāmabhyāṃ stavatā iti
children.translated_text: <s>Aṣṭādaṃṣṭra Vairūpa</s>, sonless and without offspring, was growing old. He thought that he had been cut off from these worlds. In his old age he saw these two <s>sāmans</s>. He was afraid that they would not be used, so he said, "Prosperity will come to whoever praises with both <s>sāmans</s>."

children.text: ṛṣer vā etat prāśodbhūtaṃ yad aṣṭādaṃṣṭre bhavata ṛdhyā eva ||
children.translated_text: What occurs in the <s>Aṣṭādaṃṣṭra</s> has indeed arisen from the seer; it is precisely for prosperity.

children.text: gāyatrīṣu brahmavarcasakāmāyokthāni praṇayeyur gāyatryāṃ brahmasāmānuṣṭubhy acchāvākasāma saiṣā gāyatrī saṃpadyate
children.translated_text: For one who desires <s>brahmavarcas</s> (sacred authority and radiance), they should set forth the <s>ukthas</s> in <s>Gāyatrī</s> verses: the <s>brahmasāman</s> in a <s>Gāyatrī</s>, and the <s>Acchāvāka-sāman</s> in an <s>Anuṣṭubh</s>. Thus this becomes <s>Gāyatrī</s>.

children.text: tejo brahmavarcasaṃ gāyatrī teja eva brahmavarcasam avarundhe
children.translated_text: <s>Gāyatrī</s> is splendor and <s>brahmavarcas</s>; he secures splendor and <s>brahmavarcas</s> itself.

children.text: gāyatrīṣu paśukāmāyokthāni praṇayeyur uṣṇihi brahmasāmānuṣṭubhy acchāvākasāma saiṣoṣṇik saṃpadyate
children.translated_text: For one who desires cattle, they should set forth the <s>ukthas</s> in <s>Gāyatrī</s> verses: the <s>brahmasāman</s> in an <s>Uṣṇih</s>, and the <s>Acchāvāka-sāman</s> in an <s>Anuṣṭubh</s>. Thus this becomes <s>Uṣṇih</s>.

children.text: paśavo vā uṣṇik paśūn evāvarundhe
children.translated_text: <s>Uṣṇih</s> is cattle; he secures cattle itself.

children.text: gāyatrīṣu puruṣakāmāyokthāni praṇayeyuḥ kakubhi brahmasāmānuṣṭubhy acchāvākasāma saiṣā kakup saṃpadyate
children.translated_text: For one who desires men, they should set forth the <s>ukthas</s> in <s>Gāyatrī</s> verses: the <s>brahmasāman</s> in a <s>Kakubh</s>, and the <s>Acchāvāka-sāman</s> in an <s>Anuṣṭubh</s>. Thus this becomes <s>Kakubh</s>.

children.text: puruṣo vai kakup puruṣān evāvarundhe
children.translated_text: <s>Kakubh</s> is the man; he secures men themselves.

children.text: virāṭsv annādyakāmāyokthāni praṇayeyur uṣṇihi brahmasāmānuṣṭubhy acchāvākasāma saiṣā virāṭ saṃpadyate
children.translated_text: For one who desires food to eat, they should set forth the <s>ukthas</s> in <s>Virāj</s> verses: the <s>brahmasāman</s> in an <s>Uṣṇih</s>, and the <s>Acchāvāka-sāman</s> in an <s>Anuṣṭubh</s>. Thus this becomes <s>Virāj</s>.

children.text: annaṃ virāḍ annādyam evāvarundhe
children.translated_text: <s>Virāj</s> is food; he secures food to eat itself.

children.text: akṣarapaṅktiṣu jyaiṣṭhyakāmāyokthāni praṇayeyur uṣṇihi brahmasāmānuṣṭubhy acchāvākasāma saiṣānuṣṭup saṃpadyate
children.translated_text: For one who desires supremacy, they should set forth the <s>ukthas</s> in <s>Akṣarapaṅkti</s> verses: the <s>brahmasāman</s> in an <s>Uṣṇih</s>, and the <s>Acchāvāka-sāman</s> in an <s>Anuṣṭubh</s>. Thus this becomes <s>Anuṣṭubh</s>.

children.text: jyaiṣṭhyaṃ vā anuṣṭub jyaiṣṭhyam avāvarundhe ||
children.translated_text: <s>Anuṣṭubh</s> is supremacy; he secures supremacy itself.

children.text: Chapter 9

devā vā ukthāny abhijitya rātriṃ nāśaknuvann abhijetuṃ te 'surān rātriṃ tamaḥ praviṣṭāṃ nānuvyapaśyaṃs ta etam anuṣṭupśirasaṃ pragātham apaśyan virājaṃ jyotiḥ tān virājā jyotiṣānupaśyanto 'nuṣṭubhā vajreṇa rātrer nirāghnan
children.translated_text: The gods, after conquering the <s>ukthas</s> (laudations), could not conquer the night. They did not perceive the <s>Asuras</s>, who had entered the night as darkness. They saw this <s>pragātha</s> (paired chant) with <s>Anuṣṭubh</s> as its head, the <s>Virāj</s> as light. Seeing them by the <s>Virāj</s> as light, they drove them out of the night with <s>Anuṣṭubh</s> as a thunderbolt.

children.text: yad eṣo 'nuṣṭupśirāḥ pragātho bhavati virāḍ eva jyotiṣānupaśyann anuṣṭubhā vajreṇa rātrer bhrātṛvyaṃ nirhanti
children.translated_text: When this <s>pragātha</s> has <s>Anuṣṭubh</s> as its head, then, seeing his rival by the <s>Virāj</s> as light, he drives him out of the night with <s>Anuṣṭubh</s> as a thunderbolt.

children.text: tān samantaṃ paryāyaṃ prāṇudanta yat paryāyaṃ prāṇudanta tat paryāyāṇāṃ paryāyatvam
children.translated_text: They drove them away all around the circuit. Because they drove them away by a <s>paryāya</s> (ritual circuit), that is why the <s>paryāyas</s> are <s>paryāyas</s>.

children.text: prathamāni padāni punarādīni bhavanti prathamasya paryāyasya
children.translated_text: The first padas become the repeated openings of the first <s>paryāya</s>.

children.text: prathamair hi padaiḥ punar ādāya prathamarātrāt prāṇudanta
children.translated_text: For by taking up again with the first padas, they drove them away from the first part of the night.

children.text: pāntam ā vo andhasa iti prastauti
children.translated_text: He begins the chant with 'pāntam ā vo andhasa'.

children.text: ahar vai pāntam andho rātrir ahnaiva tad rātrim ārabhante
children.translated_text: The 'pāntam' is day, and the 'andhas' is night; by day they thereby take hold of the night.

children.text: tāsu vaitahavyam
children.translated_text: Among these verses there is the <s>Vaitahavya</s>.

children.text: vītahavyaḥ śrāyaso jyog niruddha etat sāmāpaśyat so 'vagacchat pratyatiṣṭhad avagacchati pratitiṣṭhaty etena tuṣṭuvānaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Vītahavya Śrāyasa</s>, after being kept back for a long time, saw this <s>sāman</s>. He gained access and became established. One who praises with it gains access and becomes established.

children.text: tam iva vā ete praviśanti ye rātrim upayanti yad eko nidhanaṃ rātrer mukhe bhavati prajñātyai
children.translated_text: Those who approach the night enter darkness, as it were. Since a single <s>nidhana</s> (final chant element) is at the mouth of the night, it serves for recognition.

children.text: yadā vai puruṣaḥ svam oka āgacchati sarvaṃ tarhi prajānāti sarvam asmai divā bhavati
children.translated_text: When a man comes to his own home, then he recognizes everything; everything is daylight for him.

children.text: te madhyamaṃ paryāyam aśrayanta teṣām aurdhvasadmanena vācam avṛñjata
children.translated_text: They resorted to the middle <s>paryāya</s>. With the <s>Aurdhvasadmana</s> they took away their speech.

children.text: vācaṃ bhrātṛvyasya vṛṅkte ya evaṃ veda
children.translated_text: One who knows thus takes away the speech of his rival.

children.text: triṇidhanaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: It has three <s>nidhanas</s>.

children.text: yathā vā ahno mādhyandinaṃ savanaṃ triṇidhanāyatanam evam eṣa rātrer madhyamaḥ paryāyas triṇidhanāyatanaḥ salokatvāya
children.translated_text: Just as the midday pressing of the day has the threefold <s>nidhana</s> as its place, so this middle <s>paryāya</s> of the night has the threefold <s>nidhana</s> as its place, for being in the same world.

children.text: madhyamāni padāni punarādīni bhavanti madhyamasya paryāyasya madhyamair hi padaiḥ punar ādāyaṃ madhyamarātrāt prāṇudanta
children.translated_text: The middle padas become the repeated openings of the middle <s>paryāya</s>. For by taking up again with the middle padas, they drove them away from the middle part of the night.

children.text: ta uttamaṃ paryāyam aśrayanta teṣāṃ ghṛtaścyun nidhanena paśūn avṛñjata paśavo vai ghṛtaścyutaḥ
children.translated_text: They resorted to the last <s>paryāya</s>. With the <s>Ghṛtaścyut</s> <s>nidhana</s> they took away their cattle; cattle indeed are ghee-dripping.

children.text: paśūn bhrātṛvyasya vṛṅkte ya evaṃ veda
children.translated_text: One who knows thus takes away the cattle of his rival.

children.text: uttamāni padāni punarādīni bhavanty uttamasya paryāyasyottamair hi padaiḥ punar ādāyam uttamarātrāt prāṇudanta
children.translated_text: The last padas become the repeated openings of the last <s>paryāya</s>. For by taking up again with the last padas, they drove them away from the last part of the night.

children.text: tān sandhinābhipalāyanta
children.translated_text: At the <s>sandhi</s> (junction) they fled from them.

children.text: tān āśvinenāsaṃhāyyam agamayan
children.translated_text: With the <s>Āśvina</s> they brought them into a condition in which they could not hold out.

children.text: asaṃhāyyaṃ bhrātṛvyaṃ gamayati ya evaṃ veda
children.translated_text: One who knows thus brings his rival into a condition in which he cannot hold out.

children.text: eṣā vā agniṣṭomasya saṃmā yad rātriḥ
children.translated_text: This, namely the night, is the correspondence of the <s>Agniṣṭoma</s>.

children.text: dvādaśa stotrāṇy agniṣṭomo dvādaśa stotrāṇi rātriḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>Agniṣṭoma</s> has twelve <s>stotras</s> (chants); the night has twelve <s>stotras</s>.

children.text: eṣā vā ukthasya saṃmā yad rātriḥ
children.translated_text: This, namely the night, is the correspondence of the <s>uktha</s>.

children.text: trīṇy ukthāni tridevatyaḥ sandhiḥ
children.translated_text: There are three <s>ukthas</s>; the <s>sandhi</s> belongs to three deities.

children.text: yathā vā ahna ukthāny evam eṣa rātreḥ sandhir nānārūpāṇy ahna ukthāni nānārūpā ete tṛcā bhavanti
children.translated_text: As the <s>ukthas</s> belong to the day, so this <s>sandhi</s> belongs to the night. The day's <s>ukthas</s> have varied forms; these sets of three verses have varied forms.

children.text: rathantaraṃ pratiṣṭhākāmāya sandhiṃ kuryāt
children.translated_text: For one who desires firm establishment, he should make the <s>Rathantara</s> the <s>sandhi</s>.

children.text: iyaṃ vai rathantaram asyām eva pratitiṣṭhati
children.translated_text: This earth is the <s>Rathantara</s>; on this very earth he becomes established.

children.text: bṛhat svargakāmāya sandhiṃ kuryāt
children.translated_text: For one who desires heaven, he should make the <s>Bṛhat</s> the <s>sandhi</s>.

children.text: svargo loko bṛhat svarga eva loke pratitiṣṭhati
children.translated_text: The <s>Bṛhat</s> is the heavenly world; in the heavenly world itself he becomes established.

children.text: vāravantīyaṃ vā vāmadevyaṃ vā śruddhyaṃ vai teṣām ekaṃ paśukāmāya sandhiṃ kuryāt
children.translated_text: For one who desires cattle, he should make one of these the <s>sandhi</s>: the <s>Vāravantīya</s>, the <s>Vāmadevya</s>, or the <s>Śruddhya</s>.

children.text: paśavo vā etāni sāmāni paśuṣv eva pratitiṣṭhati
children.translated_text: These <s>sāmans</s> are cattle; among cattle itself he becomes established.

children.text: āśvinaṃ hotānuśaṃsati
children.translated_text: The <s>hotṛ</s> recites the <s>Āśvina</s> praise.

children.text: prajāpatir vā etat sahasram asṛjata tad devebhyaḥ prāyacchat tasmin na samarādhayaṃs te sūryaṃ kāṣṭhāṃ kṛtvājim adhāvan
children.translated_text: <s>Prajāpati</s> created this thousand and gave it to the gods. They did not succeed with it. They made <s>Sūrya</s> the goal-post and ran a race.

children.text: teṣām aśvinau prathamāv adhāvatāṃ tāv anvavadan saha no 'stviti tāvabrūtāṃ kiṃ tataḥ syād iti yat kāmayethe ityabruvaṃs tāvabrūtām asmaddevatyam idam uktham ucyātā iti tasmād āśvinam ucyate
children.translated_text: Of them the two <s>Aśvins</s> ran first. The others called after them, 'Let it be shared with us.' The two said, 'What would come from that?'
