They replied, 'Whatever you desire.' The two said, 'Let this <s>uktha</s> be spoken as having us for its deities.' Therefore it is called <s>Āśvina</s>.

children.text: sarvāḥ khalu devatāḥ śasyante
children.translated_text: Certainly all the deities are praised.

children.text: kṣipraṃ śasyam ājim iva hy ete dhāvanty ā sūryasyodetoḥ śaṃset sūryaṃ hi kāṣṭhām akurvata ||
children.translated_text: The recitation should be quick, for they run as if in a race. He should recite until <s>Sūrya</s>'s rising, for they made <s>Sūrya</s> the goal-post.

children.text: pāntam ā vo andhasa iti vaitahavyam anyakṣetraṃ vā ete prayanti ye rātrim upayanti yad okonidhanaṃ rātrer mukhe bhavaty okaso 'pracyāvāya
children.translated_text: With 'pāntam ā vo andhasa' comes the <s>Vaitahavya</s>. Those who approach the night go to another field; since the <s>oko-nidhana</s> is at the mouth of the night, it is so that they may not fall away from their home.

children.text: pra va indrāya mādanam iti gaurīvitam
children.translated_text: With 'pra va indrāya mādanam' comes the <s>Gaurīvita</s>.

children.text: brahma yad devā vyakurvata tato yad atyaricyata tad gaurīvitam abhavat
children.translated_text: When the gods divided the <s>brahman</s> (sacred formulation), what was left over from it became the <s>Gaurīvita</s>.

children.text: atiriktaṃ gaurīvitam atiriktam etat stotraṃ yad rātrir atirikta evātiriktaṃ dadhāti
children.translated_text: The <s>Gaurīvita</s> is surplus; this <s>stotra</s>, namely the night, is surplus. Thus he places the surplus upon the surplus.

children.text: vayam u tvā tad id arthā iti kāṇvam
children.translated_text: With 'vayam u tvā tad id arthā' comes the <s>Kāṇva</s> sāman.

children.text: etena vai kaṇva indrasya sāṃvidyam agacchad indrasyaivaitena sāṃvidyaṃ gacchati
children.translated_text: By this <s>Kaṇva</s> attained communion with <s>Indra</s>; by this he attains communion with <s>Indra</s> himself.

children.text: indrāya madvane sutam iti śrautakakṣaṃ kṣatrasāma pra kṣatram evaitena bhavati
children.translated_text: With 'indrāya madvane sutam' comes the <s>Śrautakakṣa</s>, a <s>kṣatrasāman</s> (chant of sovereign power); by it he becomes pre-eminent in <s>kṣatra</s> (sovereign power).

children.text: ayaṃ ta indra soma iti daivodāsam
children.translated_text: With 'ayaṃ ta indra soma' comes the <s>Daivodāsa</s> sāman.

children.text: agniṣṭomena vai devā imaṃ lokam abhyajayann antarikṣam ukthenātirātreṇāmuṃ ta imaṃ lokaṃ punar abhyakāmayanta ta ihety asmiṃl loke pratyatiṣṭhan yad etat sāma bhavati pratiṣṭhityai
children.translated_text: By the <s>Agniṣṭoma</s> the gods conquered this world, by the <s>uktha</s> the midspace, and by the <s>Atirātra</s> that world. They desired this world again; they came here and became established in this world. When this <s>sāman</s> is used, it is for establishment.

children.text: ūrdhvasadmanam api śarvarīṣu prohanti
children.translated_text: They also put forward the <s>Ūrdhvasadman</s> among the night chants.

children.text: asurā vā eṣu lokeṣv āsaṃs tān devā ūrdhvasadmanenaibhyo lokebhyaḥ prāṇudanta
children.translated_text: The <s>Asuras</s> were in these worlds; the gods drove them out from these worlds with the <s>Ūrdhvasadman</s>.

children.text: tad ya evaṃ vedaibhyo lokebhyo bhrātṛvyaṃ praṇudya sva āyatane sattram āste
children.translated_text: The one who knows thus, having driven his rival out from these worlds, sits in a <s>sattra</s> (sacrificial session) in his own place.

children.text: ā tū na indra kṣumantam ity ākūpāram
children.translated_text: With "ā tū na indra kṣumantam," it is the <s>Ākūpāra</s>.

children.text: akūpārāṅgirasasyāsīt tasyā yathā godhāyās tvag eva tvag āsīt tām etena triḥsāmnendraḥ pūtvā sūryatvacasam akarot tad vāva sā tarhy akāmayata yatkāmā etena sāmnā stuvate sa ebhyaḥ kāmaḥ samṛdhyate
children.translated_text: It belonged to <s>Akūpāra Āṅgirasa</s>. Her skin was merely skin, like the skin of an iguana. <s>Indra</s>, having purified her with this threefold <s>sāman</s>, made her have the skin of the sun. Whatever desire she desired then, that desire is fulfilled for those who praise with this <s>sāman</s>.

children.text: abhi tvā vṛṣabhā sutaṃ ity ārṣabhaṃ kṣatrasāma kṣatram evaitena bhavati
children.translated_text: With "abhi tvā vṛṣabhā sutaṃ," it is the <s>Ārṣabha</s>, the <s>kṣatrasāman</s>; by this one becomes <s>kṣatra</s> (royal power).

children.text: idaṃ vaso sutam andha iti gāram etena vai gara indram aprīṇāt prīta evāsyaitenendro bhavati
children.translated_text: With "idaṃ vaso sutam andhaḥ," it is the <s>Gāra</s>. With this <s>Gara</s> pleased <s>Indra</s>; by this <s>Indra</s> is pleased for him.

children.text: idaṃ hy anv ojaseti mādhucchandasaṃ prajāpater vā eṣā tanūr ayātayāmnī prayujyate
children.translated_text: With "idaṃ hy anv ojasā," it is the <s>Mādhucchandasa</s>. This is an unworn body of <s>Prajāpati</s> that is set to use.

children.text: ā tv etā niṣīdateti daivātitham
children.translated_text: With "ā tv etā niṣīdata," it is the <s>Daivātitha</s>.

children.text: devātithiḥ saputro 'śanāyaṃś carann araṇya urvārūṇy avindat tāny etena sāmnopāsīdat tā asmai gāvaḥ pṛśnayo bhūtvodatiṣṭhan yad etat sāma bhavati paśūnāṃ puṣṭyai
children.translated_text: <s>Devātithi</s>, together with his son, was wandering hungry in the wilderness and found gourds. He approached them with this <s>sāman</s>; they rose up for him, having become speckled cows. When this <s>sāman</s> is used, it is for the thriving of cattle.

children.text: yoge yoge tavastaram iti saumedhaṃ rātriṣāma rātrer eva samṛddhyai
children.translated_text: With "yoge yoge tavastaram," it is the <s>Saumedha</s>, the night-<s>sāman</s>, for the success of the night itself.

children.text: indra suteṣu someṣv iti kautsam
children.translated_text: With "indra suteṣu someṣu," it is the <s>Kautsa</s>.

children.text: kutsaś ca luśaś cendraṃ vyahvayetāṃ sa indraḥ kutsam upāvartata taṃ śatena vārdhrībhir āṇḍayor abadhnāt taṃ luśo 'bhyavadat pramucyasva pari kutsād ihāgahi kim u tvāvān āṇḍayor baddha āsātā iti tāḥ saṃchidya prādravat sa etat kutsaḥ sāmāpaśyat tenainam anvavadat sa upāvartata
children.translated_text: <s>Kutsa</s> and <s>Luśa</s> both called upon <s>Indra</s> in rivalry. <s>Indra</s> turned to <s>Kutsa</s>. <s>Kutsa</s> bound him by the testicles with a hundred leather thongs. <s>Luśa</s> addressed him: "Free yourself; come here away from <s>Kutsa</s>. Why should one such as you sit bound by the testicles?" Cutting those thongs, he ran off. Then <s>Kutsa</s> saw this <s>sāman</s>; with it he called after him, and he turned back.

children.text: yad etat sāma bhavati sendratvāya ||
children.translated_text: When this <s>sāman</s> is used, it is for being accompanied by <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: yadi sattrāya dīkṣerann atha sāmy uttiṣṭhet somam apabhajya viśvajitātirātreṇa yajeta sarvavedasena sarvasmā eva dīkṣate sarvam āpnoti
children.translated_text: If they should consecrate themselves for a <s>sattra</s> and then it should break off midway, after apportioning the Soma he should sacrifice with the <s>Viśvajit Atirātra</s>, giving all his possessions. He is consecrated for everything and obtains everything.

children.text: yā id dakṣiṇā dadāti tābhir iti prayuṅkte
children.translated_text: He applies the verse "with whatever sacrificial gifts he gives."

children.text: yadi paryāyair astutam abhivyucchet pañcadaśabhir hotre stuyuḥ pañcabhiḥ pañcabhir itarebhyaḥ
children.translated_text: If dawn should overtake what has not been praised through the rounds, they should praise for the <s>Hotṛ</s> with fifteen, and for the others with five each.

children.text: agne vivasvad uṣasa iti sandhinā stuyuḥ prāṇā vai trivṛt stomānāṃ pratiṣṭhā rathantaraṃ sāmnāṃ prāṇāṃś caivopayanti pratiṣṭhāṃ ca
children.translated_text: They should praise with the <s>Sandhi</s> on "agne vivasvad uṣasaḥ." The <s>Trivṛt</s> is the breaths among the <s>stomas</s>, and the <s>Rathantara</s> is the foundation among the <s>sāmans</s>; thus they approach both the breaths and the foundation.

children.text: ṣaṣṭiṃ ca trīṇi ca śatāni hotā śaṃsati
children.translated_text: The <s>Hotṛ</s> recites three hundred and sixty verses.

children.text: tāvatyaḥ saṃvatsarasya rātrayaḥ saṃvatsarasaṃmitābhir eva tad ṛgbhir āśīvinam āpnoti
children.translated_text: So many are the nights of the year; with verses equal to the year he thereby obtains the <s>Āśīvina</s>.

children.text: yad arvāk stuvanti tad astutaṃ yat samprati stuvanti tat stutaṃ yad atiṣṭuvanti tat suṣṭutam
children.translated_text: What they praise short of the proper amount is unpraised; what they praise exactly is praised; what they praise beyond it is well praised.

children.text: yady arvāk stuyur yāvatībhir na stuyus tāvatībhir vātiṣṭuyur bhūyo 'kṣarābhir vā
children.translated_text: If they should praise short of the amount, then by as many as they failed to praise, by so many they should overpraise, or else with more syllables.

children.text: yady atiṣṭuyur yāvatībhir atiṣṭuyus tāvatībhir vā na stuyuḥ kanīyo 'kṣarābhir vā
children.translated_text: If they should overpraise, then by as many as they overpraised, by so many they should not praise, or else they should use fewer syllables.

children.text: yady arvāk stuyus trīḍam agniṣṭomasāma kāryaṃ nidhanam ekeḍayā ye dve tābhyām eva tat samaṃ kriyate
children.translated_text: If they should praise short of the amount, the <s>Trīḍa</s> <s>Agniṣṭomasāman</s> should be performed. Its <s>nidhana</s> has one <s>iḍā</s>; by the two that remain, it is made even.

children.text: yady atiṣṭuyuḥ svāram agniṣṭomasāma kāryam ūnam iva vā etat sāmno yat svaras tenaiva tat samaṃ kriyate ||
children.translated_text: If they should overpraise, the <s>Svara</s> <s>Agniṣṭomasāman</s> should be performed. That part of the <s>sāman</s> which is the <s>svara</s> is, as it were, deficient; by that very means it is made even.

children.text: yadi somau saṃsutau syātāṃ mahati rātreḥ prātaranuvākam upākuryāt
children.translated_text: If two Soma sacrifices should be pressed at the same time, he should begin the <s>prātaranuvāka</s> while the night is still great.

children.text: pūrvo vācaṃ pūrvaś chandāṃsi pūrvo devatā vṛṅkte
children.translated_text: The one who is first wins speech first, the metres first, and the deity first.

children.text: vṛṣaṇvatīṃ pratipadaṃ kuryād indro vai vṛṣā prātaḥsavanād evaiṣām indraṃ vṛṅkte
children.translated_text: He should make the opening verse one containing <s>vṛṣan</s>. <s>Indra</s> is the bull; from the morning pressing itself he wins <s>Indra</s> away from them.

children.text: atho khalv āhuḥ savanamukhe savanamukhe kāryā savanamukhāt savanamukhād evaiṣām indraṃ vṛṅkte
children.translated_text: But they also say: it should be done at the opening of each pressing; from the opening of each pressing he wins <s>Indra</s> away from them.

children.text: susamiddhe hotavyam agnir vai sarvā devatāḥ sarvā eva devatāḥ paśyañ juhoti
children.translated_text: He should offer on a well-kindled fire. <s>Agni</s> is all the deities; seeing all the deities, he offers.

children.text: saṃveśāyopaveśāya gāyatryai chandase 'bhibhūtaye svāhā saṃveśāyopaveśāya triṣṭubhe chandase 'bhibhūtaye svāhā saṃveśāyopaveśāya jagatyai chandase 'bhibhūtaye svāheti juhoti
children.translated_text: He offers, saying, "For settling in and sitting down, to the <s>Gāyatrī</s> metre, for overpowering, svāhā; for settling in and sitting down, to the <s>Triṣṭubh</s> metre, for overpowering, svāhā; for settling in and sitting down, to the <s>Jagatī</s> metre, for overpowering, svāhā."

children.text: chandāṃsi vā abhibhūtayas tair evainān abhibhavaty ubhe bṛhadrathantare kārye
children.translated_text: The metres are indeed overpowerings; with them he overpowers those rivals. Both the <s>Bṛhat</s> and the <s>Rathantara</s> should be performed.

children.text: yatra vā indrasya harī tad indraḥ indrasya vai harī bṛhadrathantare yad ubhe bṛhadrathantare bhavataḥ pūrva evendrasya harī ārabhante
children.translated_text: Where <s>Indra</s>'s two bay horses are, there is <s>Indra</s>. The <s>Bṛhat</s> and the <s>Rathantara</s> are <s>Indra</s>'s two bay horses. When both the <s>Bṛhat</s> and the <s>Rathantara</s> are used, they take hold of <s>Indra</s>'s two bay horses first.

children.text: tair aśravase kārye
children.translated_text: The two <s>Aśravasa</s> chants should be performed with them.

children.text: turaśravasaś ca vai pārāvatānāṃ ca somau saṃsutāv āstāṃ tata ete turaśravāḥ sāmanī apaśyat tābhyām asmā indraḥ śalmalināṃ yamunāyā havyaṃ nirāvahat yat tair aśravase bhavato havyam evaiṣāṃ vṛṅkte
children.translated_text: There were two Soma sacrifices pressed at the same time, one for <s>Turaśravas</s> and one for the <s>Pārāvatas</s>. Then <s>Turaśravas</s> saw these two <s>sāmans</s>; with them <s>Indra</s> carried off for him the oblation of the <s>Śalmalins</s> of the <s>Yamunā</s>. When those two are performed as <s>Aśravasa</s> chants, he wins their oblation.

children.text: pūrve 'bhiṣuṇuyuḥ
children.translated_text: They should press first.

children.text: yā vai pūrvāḥ prasnānti tāḥ pūrvās tīrthaṃ jayanti pūrva evendram ārabhante
children.translated_text: Those that press forth first win the ford first; being first, they take hold of <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: vihavyaṃ śasyam
children.translated_text: The <s>Vihavya</s> is to be recited.

children.text: jamadagneś ca vā ṛṣīṇāṃ ca somau saṃsutāv āstāṃ tata etajjamadagnir vihavyam apaśyat tam indra upāvartata yad vihavyaṃ hotā śaṃsatīndram evaiṣāṃ vṛṅkte
children.translated_text: There were two Soma sacrifices pressed at the same time, one for <s>Jamadagni</s> and one for the seers. Then <s>Jamadagni</s> saw this <s>Vihavya</s>; <s>Indra</s> turned to him. When the <s>Hotṛ</s> recites the <s>Vihavya</s>, he wins <s>Indra</s> away from them.

children.text: yadītaro 'gniṣṭomaḥ syād ukthaḥ kāryo yady uktho 'tirātro yo vai bhūyān yajñakratuḥ sa indrasya priyo bhūyasaivaiṣāṃ yajñakratunendraṃ vṛṅkte
children.translated_text: If the other sacrifice is an <s>Agniṣṭoma</s>, an <s>Uktha</s> should be performed; if it is an <s>Uktha</s>, an <s>Atirātra</s>. The greater sacrificial rite is dear to <s>Indra</s>; by the greater sacrificial rite he wins <s>Indra</s> away from them.

children.text: atho khalv āhur duṣprāpa iva vai paraḥ panthā yam evāgre yajñakratum ārabheta tasmān neyād iti
children.translated_text: Now they say: The further path is, as it were, hard to attain. From whatever sacrificial rite one begins at the start, from that one should not depart.

children.text: sajanīyaṃ śasyam agastyasya kayāśubhīyaṃ śasyam
children.translated_text: The <s>Sajanīya</s> is to be recited; <s>Agastya</s>'s <s>Kayāśubhīya</s> is to be recited.

children.text: asyā amuṣyā adyaśvān mithunād ahorātrābhyām evainān nirbhajati ||
children.translated_text: From this world and from yonder one, from today and tomorrow, from the pair of day and night, he thereby separates them.

children.text: yadi somam akrītam apahareyur anyaḥ kretavyaḥ
children.translated_text: If they carry off the <s>Soma</s> before it has been bought, another is to be bought.

children.text: yadi krītaṃ yo 'nyo 'bhyāśaṃ syāt sa āhṛtyaḥ somavikrayaṇe tu kiṃcid dadyāt
children.translated_text: If it has been bought, whatever other <s>Soma</s> is nearby should be brought; but at the sale of <s>Soma</s> he should give something.

children.text: yadi somaṃ na vindeyuḥ pūtīkān abhiṣuṇuyur yadi na pūtīkān arjunāni
children.translated_text: If they cannot find <s>Soma</s>, they should press <s>pūtīka</s> plants; if not <s>pūtīkas</s>, then <s>arjuna</s> plants.

children.text: gāyatrī somam āharat tasyā anu visṛjya somarakṣiḥ parṇam achinat tasya yo 'ṃśuḥ parāpatat sa pūtīko 'bhavat tasmin devā ūtim avindann ūtīko vā eṣa yat pūtīkān abhiṣuṇvanty ūtim evāsmai vindanti
children.translated_text: <s>Gāyatrī</s> brought <s>Soma</s>. When the guardian of <s>Soma</s>, after letting fly after her, cut off her feather, the shoot that fell away from it became the <s>pūtīka</s>. In that the gods found help; this is indeed a help-bringer. When they press <s>pūtīkas</s>, they find help for him.

children.text: pratidhuk ca prātaḥ pūtīkāś ca śṛtaṃ ca madhyandine pūtīkāś ca dadhi cāparāhṇe pūtīkāś ca
children.translated_text: In the morning there are freshly milked milk and <s>pūtīkas</s>; at midday, boiled milk and <s>pūtīkas</s>; in the afternoon, curds and <s>pūtīkas</s>.

children.text: somapītho vā etasmād apakrāmatīty āhur yasya somam apaharantīti sa oṣadhīś ca paśūṃś ca praviśati tam oṣadhibhyaś ca paśubhyaś cāvarundhe
children.translated_text: They say that the <s>Soma</s>-draught withdraws from the man whose <s>Soma</s> they carry off. It enters the plants and the animals; he secures it from the plants and from the animals.

children.text: indro vṛtram ahaṃs tasya yo nastaḥ somaḥ samadhāvat tāni babhrutūlāny arjunāni yo vapāyā utkhinnāyās tāni lohitatūlāni yāni babhrutūlāny arjunāni tāny abhiṣuṇuyād etad vai brahmaṇo rūpaṃ sākṣād eva somam abhiṣuṇoti
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> slew <s>Vṛtra</s>. The <s>Soma</s> that ran together from his nose became the brown-tufted <s>arjuna</s> plants; those from the torn-out omentum became the red-tufted ones. He should press those <s>arjunas</s> that are brown-tufted. This indeed is the form of <s>brahman</s>; he presses <s>Soma</s> directly.

children.text: śrāyantīyaṃ brahmasāma kāryaṃ sad evainaṃ karoti
children.translated_text: The <s>Śrāyantīya</s> should be made the <s>brahmasāman</s>; it makes him real and established.

children.text: yajñāyajñīyam anuṣṭubhi prohed vācaivainaṃ samardhayati vāravantīyam agniṣṭomasāma kāryam indriyasya vīryasya parigṛhītyai
children.translated_text: He should advance the <s>Yajñāyajñīya</s> in an <s>Anuṣṭubh</s>; by speech itself he brings it to fullness. The <s>Vāravantīya</s> should be made the <s>Agniṣṭoma-sāman</s>, for the securing of power and strength.

children.text: pañca dakṣiṇā deyāḥ
children.translated_text: Five gifts as <s>dakṣiṇā</s> are to be given.

children.text: pāṅkto yajño yāvān yajñas tam evārabhate
children.translated_text: The sacrifice is fivefold; as great as the sacrifice is, that very whole he undertakes.

children.text: avabhṛthād udetya punar dīkṣeta
children.translated_text: After coming up from the <s>avabhṛtha</s> bath, he should be consecrated again.

children.text: tatra tad dadyād yad dāsyaṃ syāt ||
children.translated_text: There he should give whatever is to be given.

children.text: yadi kalaśo dīryeta vaṣaṭkāraṇidhanaṃ brahmasāma kuryāt
children.translated_text: If the jar breaks, he should make the <s>brahmasāman</s> have the <s>vaṣaṭkāra</s> as its <s>nidhana</s>.

children.text: avaṣaṭkṛto vā etasya somaḥ parāsicyate yasya kalaśo dīryate yad vaṣaṭkāraṇīdhanaṃ brahmasāma bhavati vaṣaṭkṛta evāsya somo bhavati
children.translated_text: The <s>Soma</s> of the man whose jar breaks is poured away without a <s>vaṣaṭ</s> being uttered. When the <s>brahmasāman</s> has the <s>vaṣaṭkāra</s> as its <s>nidhana</s>, his <s>Soma</s> has had the <s>vaṣaṭ</s> uttered over it.

children.text: vidhuṃ dadrāṇaṃ samane bahūnām ity etāsu kāryam
children.translated_text: It should be performed with those verses beginning, "vidhuṃ dadrāṇaṃ samane bahūnām."

children.text: eṣa hi bahūnāṃ samane dīryate yat kalaśaḥ
children.translated_text: For this, namely the jar, breaks in the common gathering of many.

children.text: tad āhur na vā ārtyārtir anūdyārtyā vā eṣa ārtim anuvadati yaḥ kalaśo dīrṇe dadrāṇavatīṣu karotīti
children.translated_text: They say: An affliction is not to be recited after an affliction; for with an affliction this man repeats an affliction, who, when the jar has broken, performs the rite with the <s>dadrāṇavatī</s> verses.

children.text: śrāyantīyam eva kāryam
children.translated_text: The <s>Śrāyantīya</s> alone should be used.

children.text: prajāpatiḥ prajā asṛjata sa dugdho riricāno 'manyata sa etacchrāyantīyam apaśyat tenātmānaṃ samaśrīṇāt prajayā paśubhir indriyeṇa
children.translated_text: <s>Prajāpati</s> created creatures. Drained dry and emptied, he thought himself depleted. He saw this <s>Śrāyantīya</s>; with it he replenished himself with offspring, cattle, and power.

children.text: dugdha iva eṣa riricāno yasya kalaśo dīryate yacchrāyantīyaṃ brahmasāma bhavati punar evātmānaṃ saṃśrīṇāti prajayā paśubhir indriyeṇa
children.translated_text: Like one drained dry and emptied is the man whose jar breaks. When the <s>Śrāyantīya</s> is the <s>brahmasāman</s>, he replenishes himself again with offspring, cattle, and power.

children.text: yadi śrāyantīyaṃ brahmasāma syād vaiṣṇavīṣv anuṣṭupsu vaṣaṭkāraṇidhanaṃ kuryāt
children.translated_text: If the <s>Śrāyantīya</s> is already the <s>brahmasāman</s>, he should make one having the <s>vaṣaṭkāra</s> as its <s>nidhana</s> on <s>Vaiṣṇavī</s> <s>Anuṣṭubh</s> verses.

children.text: yad vai yajñasya sravati vācaṃ pratisravati vāg anuṣṭup yajño viṣṇur vācaiva yajñasya chidram apidadhāti
children.translated_text: What leaks from the sacrifice leaks toward speech. Speech is the <s>Anuṣṭubh</s>; <s>Viṣṇu</s> is the sacrifice. With speech itself he closes the breach in the sacrifice.

children.text: yad vai yajñasya sravaty antataḥ sravati vāravantīyam agniṣṭomasāma kāryaṃ yajñasyaiva chidraṃ vārayate ||
children.translated_text: What leaks from the sacrifice leaks at the end. The <s>Vāravantīya</s> should be made the <s>Agniṣṭoma-sāman</s>; he thereby wards off the breach in the sacrifice.

children.text: yadi prātassavanāt somo 'tiricyeta asti somo ayaṃ suta iti marutvatīṣu gāyatreṣu stuyuḥ
children.translated_text: If <s>Soma</s> is left over from the morning pressing, they should praise on <s>Marutvatī</s> <s>Gāyatrī</s> verses with the words, "There is <s>Soma</s>; this one has been pressed."

children.text: mādhyandinaṃ vā eṣa savanaṃ nikāmayamāno 'bhyatiricyate yaḥ prātassavanād atiricyate tasmān marutvatīṣu stuvanti marutvaddhi mādhyandinaṃ savanaṃ tasmād u gāyatrīṣu gāyatraṃ hi prātassavanam
children.translated_text: That which is left over from the morning pressing overflows because it desires the midday pressing. Therefore they praise on <s>Marutvatī</s> verses, for the midday pressing belongs to the <s>Maruts</s>; and therefore also on <s>Gāyatrī</s> verses, for the morning pressing is <s>Gāyatra</s>.

children.text: yasmāt stomād atiricyate sa eva stomaḥ kāryaḥ salomatvāya
children.translated_text: The very <s>stoma</s> from which it is left over should be used, for keeping it in proper continuity.

children.text: aindrāvaiṣṇavaṃ hotānuśaṃsati
children.translated_text: The <s>Hotṛ</s> recites the <s>Aindrāvaiṣṇava</s>.

children.text: vīryaṃ vā indro yajño viṣṇur vīrya eva yajñe pratitiṣṭhati
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> is vigor; <s>Viṣṇu</s> is the sacrifice. He becomes established in vigor within the sacrifice itself.

children.text: yadi mādhyandināt savanād atiricyeta baṇ mahāṃ asi sūryety ādityavatīṣu gaurīvitena stuyuḥ
children.translated_text: If it is left over from the midday pressing, they should praise with the <s>Gaurīvīta</s> on <s>Ādityavatī</s> <s>Bṛhatī</s> verses, beginning, "baṇ mahāṃ asi sūrya."

children.text: tṛtīyasavanaṃ vā eṣa nikāmayamāno 'bhyatiricyate yo mādhyandināt savanād atiricyate tasmād ādityavatīṣu stuvanty ādityaṃ hi tṛtīyasavanaṃ tasmād u bṛhatīṣu bārhataṃ hi mādhyandinaṃ savanam
children.translated_text: That which is left over from the midday pressing overflows because it desires the third pressing. Therefore they praise on <s>Ādityavatī</s> verses, for the third pressing belongs to the <s>Āditya</s>; and therefore also on <s>Bṛhatī</s> verses, for the midday pressing is <s>Bārhata</s>.

children.text: yasmāt stomād atiricyeta sa eva stomaḥ kāryaḥ salomatvāyaindrāvaiṣṇavaṃ hotānuśaṃsati vīryaṃ vā indro yajño viṣṇur vīrya eva yajñe pratitiṣṭhati
children.translated_text: The very <s>stoma</s> from which it is left over should be used, for keeping it in proper continuity. The <s>Hotṛ</s> recites the <s>Aindrāvaiṣṇava</s>. <s>Indra</s> is vigor; <s>Viṣṇu</s> is the sacrifice. He becomes established in vigor within the sacrifice itself.

children.text: yadi tṛtīyasavanād atiricyeta viṣṇoḥ śipiviṣṭavatīṣu gaurīvitena stuyuḥ
children.translated_text: If it is left over from the third pressing, they should praise with the <s>Gaurīvīta</s> on verses of <s>Viṣṇu</s> that contain <s>Śipiviṣṭa</s>.

children.text: yajño vai viṣṇuḥ śipiviṣṭo yajña eva viṣṇau pratitiṣṭhaty atiriktaṃ gaurīvitam atirikta evātiriktaṃ dadhāti
children.translated_text: The sacrifice is <s>Viṣṇu</s>; <s>Śipiviṣṭa</s> is the sacrifice. In the sacrifice, in <s>Viṣṇu</s>, he becomes established. The <s>Gaurīvīta</s> is an excess; on the excess he places the excess.

children.text: etad anyat kuryur ukthāni praṇayeyur ukthāni vā eṣa nikāmayamāno 'bhyatiricyate yo 'gniṣṭomād atiricyate yady ukthyebhyo 'tiricyetātirātraḥ kāryo rātriṃ vā eṣa nikāmayamāno 'bhyatiricyate ya ukthyebhyo 'tiricyate yadi rātrer atiricyeta viṣṇoḥ śipiviṣṭavatīṣu bṛhatā stuyur eṣu tu vā atiricyata ity āhur yo rātrer atiricyata iti
children.translated_text: They should do this other thing: they should set forth the <s>ukthas</s>. For one who goes beyond the <s>Agniṣṭoma</s> goes beyond it desiring the <s>ukthas</s>. If he should go beyond the <s>Ukthyas</s>, an <s>Atirātra</s> should be performed, for one who goes beyond the <s>Ukthyas</s> goes beyond them desiring the night. If he should go beyond the night, they should praise with the <s>Bṛhat</s> on the <s>Śipiviṣṭavatī</s> verses of <s>Viṣṇu</s>; for with these, they say, he exceeds, who exceeds the night.

children.text: amuṃ vā eṣa lokaṃ nikāmayamāno 'bhyatiricyate yo rātrer atiricyate bṛhatā stuvanti bṛhad amuṃ lokam āptum arhati tam evāpnoti ||
children.translated_text: For one who goes beyond the night goes beyond it desiring yonder world. They praise with the <s>Bṛhat</s>; the <s>Bṛhat</s> is able to reach yonder world. He reaches that very world.

children.text: yadi dīkṣitānāṃ pramīyate dagdhvāsthīny upanahya yo nediṣṭhī syāt taṃ dīkṣayitvā saha yajeran
children.translated_text: If one of the consecrated men dies, after burning and binding up the bones, they should consecrate whichever man is nearest and sacrifice together with him.

children.text: etad anyat kuryur abhiṣutyānyat somam agṛhītvā grahān yāsau dakṣiṇā sraktis tad vā stuyur mārjālīye vā
children.translated_text: They should do this other thing: after separately pressing another Soma, and without drawing the <s>grahas</s> (Soma cups), they should chant either at that southern corner or at the <s>Mārjālīya</s>.

children.text: api vā etasya yajñe yo dīkṣitaḥ pramīyate tam etena niravadayante
children.translated_text: For in the sacrifice of one who dies while consecrated, they remove the blemish from him by this.

children.text: yāmena stuvanti yamalokam evainaṃ gamayanti
children.translated_text: They chant with the <s>Yāma</s>; they thereby make him go to the world of <s>Yama</s>.

children.text: tisṛbhiḥ stuvanti tṛtīye hi loke pitaraḥ
children.translated_text: They chant with three verses, for the fathers are in the third world.

children.text: parācībhiḥ stuvanti parāṅ hīto 'sau lokaḥ
children.translated_text: They chant with verses turned away, for yonder world is turned away from here.

children.text: sarparājñyā ṛgbhiḥ stuvanti
children.translated_text: They chant with verses of the <s>Sarparājñī</s>.

children.text: arbudaḥ sarpa etābhir mṛtāṃ tvacam apāhata mṛtām evaitābhis tvacam apaghnate
children.translated_text: The serpent <s>Arbuda</s> drove off a dead skin with these verses; with these they drive off the dead skin itself.

children.text: tā ṛco 'nubruvantas trir mārjālīyaṃ pariyanti savyān ūrūn āghnānāḥ
children.translated_text: Reciting those verses, they go around the <s>Mārjālīya</s> three times, striking their left thighs.

children.text: stutam anuśaṃsaty amuṣminn evainaṃ loke nidhunvanti
children.translated_text: He recites after what has been sung; they thereby shake him free in yonder world.

children.text: yanti vā ete patha ity āhur ye mṛtāya kurvantīty aindravāyavāgrān grahān gṛhṇate punaḥ panthānam apiyanti
children.translated_text: They say, 'Those who perform rites for a dead man indeed go along the path.' They take the <s>grahas</s> beginning with the <s>Aindravāyava</s>; they come back again to the path.

children.text: agna āyūṃṣi pavasa iti pratipatkāryā ya eva jīvanti teṣv āyur dadhāti
children.translated_text: The opening verse should be '<s>Agni</s>, purify the life-spans'; he thereby places life among those who are alive.

children.text: saṃvatsare 'sthīni yājayeyuḥ saṃvvatsaro vai sarvasya śāntir yat purā saṃvvatsarād yājayeyur vācam aruṣkṛtāṃ krūrām ṛccheyuḥ
children.translated_text: After a year they should cause the bones to sacrifice; the year is the appeasement of everything. If they were to cause them to sacrifice before a year, they would meet with speech that is raw and cruel.

children.text: vṛtaḥ pavamānāḥ syuḥ saptadaśam itarat sarvam
children.translated_text: The <s>Pavamāna</s> chants should be threefold; all the rest should be seventeenfold.

children.text: yat trivṛtaḥ pavamānā bhavanti prāṇā vai trivṛt prāṇān evopayanti yat saptadaśam itarat sarvaṃ prajāpatir vai saptadaśaḥ prajāpatim evopayanti
children.translated_text: When the <s>Pavamāna</s> chants are threefold, the breaths are threefold; they thereby attain the breaths. When all the rest is seventeenfold, <s>Prajāpati</s> is seventeenfold; they thereby attain <s>Prajāpati</s>.

children.text: prāṇāpānair vā ete vyṛdhyanta ity āhur ye mṛtāya kurvantīti maitrāvaruṇāgrān grahān gṛhṇate prāṇāpānau mitrāvaruṇau prāṇāpānair eva samṛdhyante ||
children.translated_text: They say, 'Those who perform rites for a dead person become separated from <s>prāṇa</s> (vital breath) and <s>apāna</s> (downward breath).' They take the <s>grahas</s> beginning with the <s>Maitrāvaruṇa</s>; <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s> are <s>prāṇa</s> and <s>apāna</s>. Thus they prosper through <s>prāṇa</s> and <s>apāna</s>.

children.text: yasya kalaśa upadasyati kalaśam evāsyopadasyantaṃ prāṇo 'nūpadasyati prāṇo hi somaḥ
children.translated_text: When someone's <s>kalaśa</s> (Soma vessel) is exhausted, as his <s>kalaśa</s> is becoming exhausted, breath is exhausted along with it; for Soma is breath.

children.text: tad āhuḥ payo 'vanayed iti
children.translated_text: About that they say, 'He should pour in milk.'

children.text: atho khalv āhur antarhitam iva vā etad yat payo hiraṇyam evāpo'bhyavanayeddhiraṇyam abhyunnayed iti
children.translated_text: But they also say, 'This milk is, as it were, something interposed. Rather, he should pour the waters over gold; he should raise up the gold.'

children.text: prāṇā vā āpo 'mṛtaṃ hiraṇyam amṛta evāsya prāṇān dadhāti sa sarvam āyur eti
children.translated_text: The waters are breaths, and gold is immortality. He thereby places his breaths in immortality, and he reaches his full lifespan.

children.text: yasya nārāśaṃsa upavāyati nārāśaṃsam evāsyopachvāyantaṃ prāṇo 'nūpadasyati prāṇo hi somaḥ
children.translated_text: When someone's <s>Nārāśaṃsa</s> is wafted away, as his <s>Nārāśaṃsa</s> is being wafted away, breath is exhausted along with it; for Soma is breath.

children.text: yam adhvaryur antato grahaṃ gṛhṇīyāt tasyāptum avanayet
children.translated_text: Into whichever <s>graha</s> the <s>Adhvaryu</s> would draw last, he should pour enough to reach it.

children.text: prāyaścityai vai graho gṛhyate prāyaścityevāsmai prāyaścittiṃ karoti
children.translated_text: A <s>graha</s> is drawn for expiation; by expiation itself he performs an expiation for him.

children.text: yadi pītāpītau somau saṃgaccheyātām antaḥ paridhyaṅgārān nirvartya juhuyāt hutasya cāhutasya cāhutasya hutasya ca
children.translated_text: If Soma that has been drunk and Soma that has not been drunk should come together, he should set aside coals within the enclosing-sticks and offer: 'of the offered and of the unoffered, and of the unoffered and of the offered.'

children.text: prajāpataye svāhety abhakṣaṇīyasya juhuyād uttarārdhyapūrvārdhya uparavaḥ
children.translated_text: He should offer the inedible portion with 'To <s>Prajāpati</s>, svāhā'; the <s>uparava</s> pits are in the northern and eastern half.

children.text: indur indum avāgād ity avavṛṣṭasya bhakṣayet
children.translated_text: He should partake of what has fallen down like rain with 'Indu has gone down to Indu.'

children.text: tasya ta indravindrapītasyendriyavataḥ sarvagaṇasya sarvagaṇa upahūta upahūtasya bhakṣayāmi
children.translated_text: Of that, of you, O <s>Indra</s>, of what has been drunk by <s>Indra</s>, endowed with <s>indriya</s> (power), belonging to every host, invited among every host, I partake of the invited portion.

children.text: hiraṇyagarbhaḥ samavartatāgra ity ājyenābhyupākṛtasya juhuyād agnīdhraṃ paretya bhūtānāṃ jātaḥ patir eka āsīt sa dādhāra pṛthivīṃ dyām utemāṃ tasmai ta indo haviṣā vidhema svāheti saiva tasya prāyaścittiḥ
children.translated_text: For what has been prepared with ghee, he should make an offering with '<s>Hiraṇyagarbha</s> arose in the beginning'; having gone to the <s>Āgnīdhra</s>: 'He was the one lord of created beings; he upheld this earth and heaven also. To you, O <s>Indu</s>, let us pay worship with oblation, svāhā.' That is its expiation.

children.text: yadi grāvāpi śīryate paśubhir yajamāno vyṛdhyate paśavo vai grāvāṇo dyutānasya mārutasya sāmnā stuyuḥ
children.translated_text: If even a pressing stone breaks, the sacrificer becomes deprived of cattle; the pressing stones are cattle. They should praise with the <s>sāman</s> of <s>Dyutāna Māruta</s>.

children.text: mārutā vai grāvāṇaḥ svenaivaināṃs tad rūpeṇa samardhayati
children.translated_text: The pressing stones are the <s>Maruts</s>; by their own form he makes them prosper.

children.text: yadi somam abhidahed grahān adhvaryuḥ spāśayeta stotrāṇy udgātā śastrāṇi hotātha yathāpūrvaṃ yajñena careyuḥ pañca dakṣiṇā deyāḥ pāṅkto yajño yāvān yajñas tam ārabhate 'vabhṛthād udetya punar dīkṣate tatra tad dadyād yad dāsyaṃ syāt purā dvādaśyā dīkṣeta yad dvādaśīm atinayed antardhīyeta ||
children.translated_text: If the Soma should be burnt, the <s>Adhvaryu</s> should touch the <s>grahas</s>, the <s>Udgātṛ</s> the chants, and the <s>Hotṛ</s> the recitations; then they should proceed with the sacrifice as before. Five <s>dakṣiṇās</s> should be given; the sacrifice is <s>pāṅkta</s> (fivefold), and as great as the sacrifice is, that he takes hold of. Having come up from the <s>avabhṛtha</s> (final bath), he is consecrated again. There he should give whatever is to be given. He should be consecrated before the twelfth day; if he should go beyond the twelfth, he would be hidden away.

children.text: yadi mahāvīro bhidyeta taṃ bhinnam abhimṛśed ya ṛte cid abhiśriṣaḥ purā jatrubhya ātṛdaḥ
children.translated_text: If the <s>Mahāvīra</s> vessel breaks, he should touch it while broken with the verse, 'You who, even without a support, pierced before the collarbones.'

children.text: asuryaṃ vā etasmād varṇaṃ kṛtvā teja indriyaṃ vīryam annādyaṃ prajāḥ paśavo 'pakrāmanti yasya yūpo virohati sa īśvaraḥ pāpīyān bhavitoḥ
children.translated_text: When someone's <s>yūpa</s> (sacrificial post) sprouts, splendor, power, strength, food, offspring, and cattle depart from him after making an asuric color. He is liable to become worse.

children.text: tvāṣṭraṃ paśuṃ bahurūpam ālabheta tvaṣṭā vai paśūnāṃ rūpāṇāṃ vikartā tam eva tad upadhāvati sa enaṃ tejasendriyeṇa vīryeṇānnādyena prajayā paśubhiḥ punas samardhayati saiva tasya prāyaścittiḥ ||
children.translated_text: He should sacrifice a many-colored animal belonging to <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s>. <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s> is indeed the shaper of the forms of animals; to him he thereby has recourse. He again makes him prosper with brilliance, bodily power, vigor, food to eat, offspring, and cattle. That is his expiation.

children.text: Chapter 10
agninā pṛthivyauṣadhibhis tenāyaṃ lokas trivṛd vāyunāntarikṣeṇa vayobhis tenaiṣa lokās trivṛd yo 'yam antar ādityena divā nakṣatrais tenāsau lokas trivṛd etad eva trivṛta āyatanam eṣāsya bandhutā
children.translated_text: With <s>Agni</s>, earth, and the plants this world is <s>Trivṛt</s>; with <s>Vāyu</s>, the midspace, and the birds this world between is <s>Trivṛt</s>; with the <s>Āditya</s>, heaven, and the stars that world is <s>Trivṛt</s>. This is the very basis of the <s>Trivṛt</s>; this is its correspondence.

children.text: āyatanavān bandhumān bhavati ya evaṃ veda
children.translated_text: One who knows thus becomes possessed of a basis and possessed of correspondence.

children.text: tam u pratiṣṭhetyāhus trivṛddhy evaiṣu lokeṣu pratiṣṭhitaḥ
children.translated_text: They call it 'establishment,' for the <s>Trivṛt</s> is established in these worlds.

children.text: ardhamāsa eva pañcadaśasyāyatanam eṣāsya bandhutā
children.translated_text: The half-month itself is the basis of the <s>Pañcadaśa</s>; this is its correspondence.

children.text: āyatanavān bandhumān bhavati ya evaṃ veda
children.translated_text: One who knows thus becomes possessed of a basis and possessed of correspondence.

children.text: taṃ caujo balam ity āhur ardhamāsaśo hi prajāḥ paśava ojo balaṃ puṣyanti
children.translated_text: They call it 'vital force and strength,' for fortnight by fortnight creatures and cattle increase in vital force and strength.

children.text: saṃvatsara eva saptadaśasyāyatanaṃ dvādaśa māsāḥ pañcadartava etad eva saptadaśasyāyatanam eṣāsya bandhutā
children.translated_text: The year itself is the basis of the <s>Saptadaśa</s>: twelve months and five seasons. This is the very basis of the <s>Saptadaśa</s>; this is its correspondence.

children.text: āyatanavān bandhumān bhavati ya evaṃ veda
children.translated_text: One who knows thus becomes possessed of a basis and possessed of correspondence.

children.text: tam u prajāpatir ity āhuḥ saṃvatsaraṃ hi prajāḥ paśavo 'nuprajāyante
children.translated_text: They call it <s>Prajāpati</s>, for through the year creatures and cattle are born forth.

children.text: āditya evaikaviṃśasyāyatanaṃ dvādaśa māsāḥ pañcavartas traya ime lokā asāv āditya ekaviṃśa etad evaikaviṃśasyāyatanam eṣāsya bandhutā
children.translated_text: The <s>Āditya</s>, the sun, itself is the basis of the <s>Ekaviṃśa</s>: twelve months, five seasons, these three worlds, and yonder sun make the <s>Ekaviṃśa</s>. This is the very basis of the <s>Ekaviṃśa</s>; this is its correspondence.

children.text: āyatanavān bandhumān bhavati ya evaṃ veda
children.translated_text: One who knows thus becomes possessed of a basis and possessed of correspondence.

children.text: tam u devatalpa ity āhuḥ pra devatalpam āpnoti ya evaṃ veda
children.translated_text: They call it <s>Devatalpa</s>, 'the couch of the gods'; one who knows thus reaches the couch of the gods.

children.text: trivṛd eva triṇavasyāyatanam eṣāsya bandhutā
children.translated_text: The <s>Trivṛt</s> itself is the basis of the <s>Triṇava</s>; this is its correspondence.

children.text: āyatanavān bandhumān bhavati ya evaṃ veda
children.translated_text: One who knows thus becomes possessed of a basis and possessed of correspondence.

children.text: tam u puṣṭir ity āhus trivṛddhy evaiṣa puṣṭaḥ
children.translated_text: They call it nourishment, for this one is indeed nourished by the <s>Trivṛt</s>.

children.text: devatā eva trayastriṃśasyāyatanaṃ trayastriṃśad devatāḥ prajāpatiś catustriṃśa etad eva trayastriṃśasyāyatanam eṣāsya bandhutā
children.translated_text: The deities themselves are the basis of the <s>Trayastriṃśa</s>: there are thirty-three deities, and <s>Prajāpati</s> is the thirty-fourth. This is the very basis of the <s>Trayastriṃśa</s>; this is its correspondence.

children.text: āyatanavān bandhumān bhavati ya evaṃ veda
children.translated_text: One who knows thus becomes possessed of a basis and possessed of correspondence.

children.text: tam u nāka ity āhur na hi prajāpatiḥ kasmai canākam
children.translated_text: They call it <s>Nāka</s>; for <s>Prajāpati</s> is not sorrow for anyone.

children.text: chandāṃsy eva chandomānām āyatanam eṣaiṣāṃ bandhutā
children.translated_text: The metres themselves are the basis of the <s>Chandomas</s>; this is their correspondence.

children.text: āyatanavān bandhumān bhavati ya evaṃ veda
children.translated_text: One who knows thus becomes possessed of a basis and possessed of correspondence.

children.text: tān u puṣṭir ity āhuḥ paśavo hi chandomāḥ ||
children.translated_text: They call them nourishment, for the <s>Chandomas</s> are cattle.

children.text: prajāpatiḥ prajā asṛjata so 'tāmyat tasmai vājjyotir udagṛhṇāt so 'bravīt ko me 'yaṃ jyotir udagṛhṇād iti svaiva te vāg ity abravīt tām abravīd virājaṃ tvā chandasāṃ jyotiṣkṛtvā yajāntā iti
children.translated_text: <s>Prajāpati</s> created creatures. He became exhausted. <s>Vāc</s> raised up a light for him. He said, 'Who has raised up this light for me?' 'Your own <s>Vāc</s>,' she said. He said to her, 'Having made you, as <s>Virāj</s>, the light of the metres, let them sacrifice with you.'

children.text: tasmād yo virājaṃ stomaṃ sampadyate taṃ jyotiṣṭomo 'gniṣṭoma ity ācakṣate virāḍḍhi chandasāṃ jyotiḥ
children.translated_text: Therefore whatever <s>stoma</s> comes to be <s>Virāj</s>, they call it the <s>Jyotiṣṭoma</s>, the <s>Agniṣṭoma</s>; for <s>Virāj</s> is the light of the metres.

children.text: jyotiḥ samānānāṃ bhavati ya evaṃ veda
children.translated_text: One who knows thus becomes a light among his peers.

children.text: anuṣṭup ca vai saptadaśaś ca samabhavatāṃ sānuṣṭup caturuttarāṇi chandāṃsy asṛjata ṣaḍuttarān stomān saptadaśas tāv etān madhyataḥ prājanayatām
children.translated_text: <s>Anuṣṭubh</s> and the <s>Saptadaśa</s> came together. The <s>Anuṣṭubh</s> created the metres increasing by four, and the <s>Saptadaśa</s> the <s>stomas</s> increasing by six. Those two generated these from the middle.

children.text: trivṛcca triṇavaś ca rāthantarau tāv ajaś cāśvaś cānvasṛjyetāṃ tasmāt tau rāthantaraṃ prācīnaṃ pradhūnutaḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>Trivṛt</s> and the <s>Triṇava</s> belong to the <s>Rathantara</s>; the goat and the horse were created after them. Therefore those two shake themselves forward in the <s>Rathantara</s> manner.

children.text: pañcadaśaś caikaviṃśaś ca bārhatau tau gauś cāviś cānvasṛjyetāṃ tasmāt tau bārhataṃ prācīnaṃ bhāskurutaḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>Pañcadaśa</s> and the <s>Ekaviṃśa</s> belong to the <s>Bṛhat</s>; the cow and the sheep were created after them. Therefore those two call out forward in the <s>Bṛhat</s> manner.

children.text: evaṃ vai vidvāṃsam āhur api grāmyāṇāṃ paśūnāṃ vāca ājānāti ||
children.translated_text: Of a man who knows thus they say, 'He even understands the voices of domestic animals.'

children.text: prajāpatir akāmayata bahu syāṃ prajāyeyeti sa ātmann ṛtvyam apaśyat tata ṛtvijo 'sṛjata yad ṛtvyād asṛjata tad ṛtvijām ṛtviktvaṃ tair etaṃ dvādaśāham upāsīdat so 'rādhnot
children.translated_text: <s>Prajāpati</s> desired, 'May I become many; may I produce offspring.' He saw the <s>ṛtvya</s> (seasonal-sacrificial principle) in himself. From that he created the <s>ṛtvij</s> priests. Because he created them from the <s>ṛtvya</s>, that is the priesthood of the <s>ṛtvij</s> priests. With them he undertook this <s>Dvādaśāha</s> (twelve-day rite), and he succeeded.

children.text: pitā no 'rātsīd iti māsā upāsīdaṃs te dīkṣayaivārādhnuvann upasatsu trayodaśam adīkṣayan so 'nuvyam abhavat tasmād upasatsu didīkṣāṇo 'nuvyaṃ bhavaty eva ca hi trayodaśaṃ māsaṃ cakṣate naiva ca
children.translated_text: The months approached, saying, 'Our father has succeeded.' They succeeded by consecration alone. During the <s>Upasads</s> they consecrated a thirteenth; he became <s>anuvya</s> (additional). Therefore one who seeks consecration during the <s>Upasads</s> becomes <s>anuvya</s>; for they both speak of a thirteenth month and do not speak of one.

children.text: eko dīkṣetaiko hi prajāpatir arādhnod dvādaśa dīkṣeran dvādaśa hi māsā arādhnuvaṃś caturviṃśatir dīkṣeraṃś caturviṃśatir hy ardhamāsā arādhnuvan
children.translated_text: One should be consecrated singly, for <s>Prajāpati</s> alone succeeded. Twelve should be consecrated, for the twelve months succeeded. Twenty-four should be consecrated, for the twenty-four half-months succeeded.

children.text: yadi pañcadaśo dīkṣeteme pañceme pañceme pañceme pañceme catvāro 'sāv eka iti nirdiśeyur yasmā arāddhikāmāḥ syus tam evārāddhir anveti sarva itare rādhnuvanti
children.translated_text: If a fifteenth [the context suggests a twenty-fifth] were to be consecrated, they should designate them: 'these five, these five, these five, these five, these four, and that one.' The one for whom they desire success is the one whom success follows; all the others succeed.

children.text: yo vai devānāṃ gṛhapatiṃ vedāśnute gārhapataṃ pra gārhapatam āpnoti
children.translated_text: Whoever knows the house-lord of the gods attains the station of the house-lord and fully reaches the station of the house-lord.

children.text: saṃvatsaro vai devānāṃ gṛhapatiḥ sa eva prajāpatis tasya māsā eva saha dīkṣiṇaḥ
children.translated_text: The year is the house-lord of the gods; it is <s>Prajāpati</s> himself. Its fellow-consecrates are the months.

children.text: vindate saha dīkṣiṇo 'śnute gārhapatyaṃ pra gārhapatyaṃ āpnoti ya evaṃ veda ||
children.translated_text: One who knows thus finds fellow-consecrates, attains <s>Gārhapatya</s> (the householder's station), and fully reaches <s>Gārhapatya</s>.

children.text: yo vai chandasāṃ svarājaṃ vedāśnute svārājyaṃ pra svārājyaṃ āpnoti bṛhatī vāva chandasāṃ svarāḍ aśnute svārājyaṃ pra svārājyaṃ āpnoti ya evaṃ veda
children.translated_text: Whoever knows the self-ruling one among the metres obtains self-rule and fully reaches self-rule. The <s>Bṛhatī</s> is indeed the self-ruling one among the metres. One who knows thus obtains self-rule and fully reaches self-rule.

children.text: tām etām annādyāya vyāvṛjyāsate yad etaṃ dvādaśāhaṃ dvādaśa dīkṣā dvādaśopasado dvādaśa prasutaḥ ṣaṭtriṃśad etā rātrayo bhavanti ṣaṭtriṃśadakṣarā bṛhatī
children.translated_text: They sit through this rite, having set it apart for the securing of food, namely this <s>Dvādaśāha</s>: there are twelve <s>dīkṣā</s> (consecration) days, twelve <s>Upasad</s> days, and twelve Soma-pressing days. These become thirty-six nights; the <s>Bṛhatī</s> has thirty-six syllables.

children.text: jāyate vāva dīkṣayā punīta upasadbhir devalokam eva sutyayāpyeti
children.translated_text: By <s>dīkṣā</s> he is indeed born; by the <s>Upasad</s>s he is purified; by the Soma pressing he reaches the world of the gods.

children.text: etāvad vāva saṃvatsara indriyaṃ vīryaṃ yad etā rātrayo dvādaśa pūrṇamāsyo dvādaśaikaṣṭakā dvādaśāmāvāsyā yāvad eva saṃvatsara indriyaṃ vīryaṃ tad etenāptvāvarundhe dvādaśāhena
children.translated_text: These nights are indeed the measure of the year's power and vigor: twelve full-moon days, twelve <s>Ekāṣṭakā</s>s, and twelve new-moon days. As much power and vigor as belongs to the year, that he obtains and secures by this <s>Dvādaśāha</s>.

children.text: triṃśadakṣarā vā eṣā virāḍ ṣaḍ ṛtava ṛtuṣv eva virājā pratitiṣṭhaty ṛtubhir virāji
children.translated_text: This <s>Virāj</s> has thirty syllables; there are six seasons. By the <s>Virāj</s> he becomes established among the seasons, and by the seasons in the <s>Virāj</s>.

children.text: dvātriṃśadakṣarā vā eṣānuṣṭub vāg anuṣṭup catuṣpādaḥ paśavo vācā paśūn dādhāra tasmād vācā siddhā vācāhūtā āyanti tasmād u nāma jānate ||
children.translated_text: This <s>Anuṣṭubh</s> has thirty-two syllables. Speech is the <s>Anuṣṭubh</s>; cattle are four-footed. By speech he supported the cattle; therefore, mastered by speech and called by speech, they come, and therefore too they know a name.

children.text: bhūtaṃ pūrvo 'tirātro bhaviṣyad uttaraḥ pṛthivī pūrvo 'tirātro dyaur uttaro 'gniḥ pūrvo 'tirātra āditya uttaraḥ prāṇaḥ pūrvo 'tirātra udāna uttaraḥ
children.translated_text: The earlier <s>Atirātra</s> is what has been, the later one what will be; the earlier <s>Atirātra</s> is earth, the later one heaven; the earlier <s>Atirātra</s> is <s>Agni</s>, the later one the <s>Āditya</s>; the earlier <s>Atirātra</s> is <s>prāṇa</s> (in-breath), the later one <s>udāna</s> (up-breath).

children.text: cakṣuṣī atirātrau kanīnike agniṣṭomau yasmād antarā agniṣṭomāv atirātrābhyāṃ tasmād antare satyau kanīnike bhuṅktaḥ
children.translated_text: The two <s>Atirātra</s>s are the eyes; the two <s>Agniṣṭoma</s>s are the pupils. Because the <s>Agniṣṭoma</s>s are between the two <s>Atirātra</s>s, therefore the two pupils, being within, perceive.

children.text: saṃvatsarasya vā etau daṃṣṭrau yad atirātrau tayor na svaptavyaṃ saṃvatsarasya daṃṣṭrayor ātmānaṃ ned apidadhānīti
children.translated_text: These two <s>Atirātra</s>s are the fangs of the year. One should not sleep during them, thinking, "Let me not put myself between the fangs of the year."

children.text: tad āhuḥ ko 'svaptum arhati yad vāva prāṇo jāgāra tad eva jāgaritam iti
children.translated_text: On this they say, "Who is able not to sleep?" In truth, whatever <s>prāṇa</s> keeps awake, that alone is wakefulness.

children.text: gāyatrīṃ vā etāṃ jyotiḥpakṣām āsate yad etaṃ dvādaśāham aṣṭau madhya ukthā agniṣṭomāv abhito māsā svargaṃ lokam etyājarasaṃ brahmādyam annam atti dīpyamānaḥ
children.translated_text: They sit through this <s>Gāyatrī</s> with wings of light, namely this <s>Dvādaśāha</s>: the eight <s>Uktha</s>s are in the middle, and the two <s>Agniṣṭoma</s>s are on either side; they are the months. Shining, he reaches the heavenly world and eats ageless food belonging to <s>brahman</s>.

children.text: triṣpurastād rathantaraṃ upayanti tryāvṛd vai vāk sarvām eva vācam avarudhya sarvam annādyaṃ dvādaśāhaṃ tanvate
children.translated_text: They approach the <s>Rathantara</s> three times beforehand. Speech is threefold; having secured all speech, they extend the whole <s>Dvādaśāha</s> as food to be eaten.

children.text: jāmi vā etad yajñe kriyata ity āhur yat triṣpurastād rathantaram upayantīti saubharam ukthānāṃ brahmasāma bhavati tenaiva tad ajāmi
children.translated_text: They say, "Something too uniform is being made in the sacrifice when they approach the <s>Rathantara</s> three times beforehand." The <s>Saubhara</s> is the <s>brahmasāman</s> of the <s>Uktha</s>s; by that very means it becomes not uniform.

children.text: pratnavatyaḥ prāyaṇīyasyāhnaḥ pratipado bhavanti teno eva tad ajāmi
children.translated_text: The opening verses of the <s>Prāyaṇīya</s> day contain the word <s>pratna</s>; by that too it becomes not uniform.

children.text: trir vevopariṣṭād rathantaram upayanti tryāvṛd vai vāk sarvām eva vācam avarudhya sarvam annādyaṃ dvādaśāhād uttiṣṭhanti ||
children.translated_text: They approach the <s>Rathantara</s> three times afterward. Speech is threefold; having secured all speech, they rise from the <s>Dvādaśāha</s> with all food to be eaten.

children.text: trayo vā ete trirātrā yad eṣa dvādaśāho gāyatramukhaḥ prathamo gāyatramadhyo dvitīyo gāyatrottamas tṛtīyaḥ
children.translated_text: This <s>Dvādaśāha</s> is three <s>Trirātra</s>s: the first has the <s>Gāyatra</s> at its beginning, the second has the <s>Gāyatra</s> in its middle, and the third has the <s>Gāyatra</s> at its end.

children.text: yasmād gāyatramukhaḥ prathamas tasmād ūrdhvo 'gnir dīdāya yasmād gāyatramadhyo dvitīyas tasmāt tiryaṅ vāyuḥ pavate
children.translated_text: Because the first has the <s>Gāyatra</s> at its beginning, <s>Agni</s> blazes upward. Because the second has the <s>Gāyatra</s> in its middle, <s>Vāyu</s> blows crosswise.

children.text: tejasā vā ete prayanti tejo madhye dadhati tejo 'bhyudyanti jyotiṣā vā ete prayanti jyotir madhye dadhati jyotir abhyudyanti cakṣuṣā vā ete prayanti cakṣur madhye dadhati cakṣur abhyudyanti prāṇena vā ete prayanti prāṇaṃ madhye dadhati prāṇam abhyudyanti ye gāyatryā prayanti gāyatrīṃ madhye dadhati gāyatrim abhyudyanti
children.translated_text: With brilliance they set forth; they place brilliance in the middle; they rise up with brilliance. With light they set forth; they place light in the middle; they rise up with light. With sight they set forth; they place sight in the middle; they rise up with sight. With <s>prāṇa</s> they set forth; they place <s>prāṇa</s> in the middle; they rise up with <s>prāṇa</s>. Those who set forth with the <s>Gāyatrī</s> place the <s>Gāyatrī</s> in the middle and rise up with the <s>Gāyatrī</s>.

children.text: tantraṃ vā etad vitāyate yad eṣa dvādaśāhas tasyaitair mayūkhā yad gāyatry asaṃvyāthāya
children.translated_text: This <s>Dvādaśāha</s> is a warp stretched out; its pegs are these, namely the <s>Gāyatrī</s>s, so that it may not slip apart.

children.text: girikṣidauccāmanyaveti hovācābhipratārī kākṣaseniḥ kathaṃ dvādaśāha iti yathārān nemiḥ paryety evam enaṃ gāyatrī paryeti avisraṃsāya yathārā nābhau dhṛtā evam asyāṃ dvādaśāho dhṛtaḥ
children.translated_text: "<s>Girikṣit Aucchāmanyava</s>, how is the <s>Dvādaśāha</s>?" said <s>Abhipratārī Kākṣaseni</s>. "As a rim goes around the spokes, so the <s>Gāyatrī</s> goes around it to keep it from slipping away; as the spokes are held in the hub, so the <s>Dvādaśāha</s> is held in this <s>Gāyatrī</s>."

children.text: anuṣṭubhaṃ vā etām annādyāya vyāvṛjyāsate yad etaṃ dvādaśāham
children.translated_text: They sit through this <s>Anuṣṭubh</s>, having set it apart for the securing of food, namely this <s>Dvādaśāha</s>.

children.text: aṣṭābhir vā akṣair anuṣṭup prathamaṃ dvādaśāhasyāhar duyacchaty ekādaśabhir dvitīyaṃ dvādaśābhis tṛtīyam
children.translated_text: With eight syllables the <s>Anuṣṭubh</s> marks out the first day of the <s>Dvādaśāha</s>, with eleven the second, and with twelve the third.

children.text: akṣaraṃ tryakṣaram ucchiṣyate tad evottaraṃ trirātram anuvidadhāti
children.translated_text: A syllable, as a three-syllabled remainder, is left over; that very remainder provides for the following <s>Trirātra</s>.

children.text: chandāṃsy evāsyās tṛtīyaṃ trirātraṃ vahanti
children.translated_text: The metres themselves carry its third <s>Trirātra</s>.

children.text: tāṃ vā etāṃ pratīcīṃ tiraścīṃ parācīm āsate 'nnādyāya tasmāt pratyañcaṃ tiryañcaṃ parāñcaṃ prajāḥ paśum upajīvanti
children.translated_text: They sit through this rite turned back, crosswise, and forward, for the securing of food. Therefore creatures live on livestock whether it is turned toward them, crosswise, or away from them.

children.text: chandāṃsi vā anyonyasya lokam abhyadhyāyan gāyatrī triṣṭubhas triṣṭub jagatyā jagatī gāyatryās tāni vyauhan yathālokaṃ tato vai tāni yaṃ yaṃ kāmam akāmayanta tam asanvan
children.translated_text: The metres sought one another's place: the <s>Gāyatrī</s> sought that of the <s>Triṣṭubh</s>, the <s>Triṣṭubh</s> that of the <s>Jagatī</s>, and the <s>Jagatī</s> that of the <s>Gāyatrī</s>. They rearranged them according to their places; thereafter, whatever desire they desired, that they obtained.

children.text: yatkāmo vyūḍhacchandasā dvādaśāhena yajate so 'smai kāmaḥ samṛdhyate
children.translated_text: Whatever desire a man has when he sacrifices with the <s>Dvādaśāha</s> whose metres have been rearranged, that desire prospers for him.

children.text: oko vai devānāṃ dvādaśāho yatho vai manuṣyā imaṃ lokam āviṣṭā evaṃ devatā dvādaśāham āviṣṭā devatā ha vā etena yajate ya evaṃ vidvān dvādaśāhena yajate
children.translated_text: The <s>Dvādaśāha</s> is the dwelling of the gods. Just as human beings have entered this world, so the deities have entered the <s>Dvādaśāha</s>. He who, knowing thus, sacrifices with the <s>Dvādaśāha</s> indeed sacrifices with the deities.

children.text: gṛhā vai devānāṃ dvādaśāho nāgṛhatāyā bhayyam
children.translated_text: The <s>Dvādaśāha</s> is the house of the gods; there is no fear of being without a house.

children.text: yo vai dvādaśāham agniṣṭomena kalpamānaṃ veda kalpate 'smai prātaḥsavanenaiva prathamas trirātraḥ kalpate mādhyandinena dvitīyas tṛtīyasavanena tṛtīyo 'gniṣṭomasāmnaiva daśamam ahaḥ kalpate
children.translated_text: He who knows the <s>Dvādaśāha</s> as being made fit by the <s>Agniṣṭoma</s>, it is made fit for him. The first <s>Trirātra</s> is made fit by the morning pressing, the second by the midday pressing, the third by the third pressing, and the tenth day by the <s>Agniṣṭoma-sāman</s> itself.

children.text: kalpate 'smai ya evaṃ veda ||
children.translated_text: It is made fit for him who knows thus.

children.text: eti prety āśumad vītimad rukmat tejasvad yuñjānaṃ prathamasyāhno rūpaṃ trivṛtaḥ stomasya gāyatrasya chandaso rathantarasya sāmnaḥ
children.translated_text: Containing 'eti' and 'preti,' containing speed, approach, brilliance, and radiance, and joined, is the form of the first day, of the <s>Trivṛt</s> <s>stoma</s>, of the <s>Gāyatra</s> metre, and of the <s>Rathantara</s> <s>sāman</s>.

children.text: vṛṣavad vṛtravad rayimad viśvavad upasthitaṃ dvitīyasyāhno rūpaṃ pañcadaśasya stomasya traiṣṭubhasya chandaso bṛhataḥ sāmnaḥ
children.translated_text: Containing the bull, <s>Vṛtra</s>, wealth, and all, and being present, is the form of the second day, of the fifteenfold <s>stoma</s>, of the <s>Triṣṭubh</s> metre, and of the <s>Bṛhat</s> <s>sāman</s>.

children.text: udvat trivad digvat gomaṭ ṭaṣabhavat tṛtīyasyāhno rūpaṃ saptadaśasya stomasya jāgatasya chandaso vairūpasya sāmnaḥ
children.translated_text: Containing ascent, the threefold, the directions, cattle, and the bull is the form of the third day, of the seventeenfold <s>stoma</s>, of the <s>Jagatī</s> metre, and of the <s>Vairūpa</s> <s>sāman</s>.

children.text: rājanvaj janavadvat sūryavad virāḍanutodavac caturthasyāhno rūpam ekaviṃśasya stomasyānuṣṭubhasya chandaso rājasya vai sāmnaḥ
children.translated_text: Containing the king, the people, the sun, <s>Virāj</s>, and the following thrust is the form of the fourth day, of the twenty-onefold <s>stoma</s>, of the <s>Anuṣṭubh</s> metre, and of the royal <s>sāman</s>.

children.text: citravacchiśumat paṅktiḥ śakvarī dyūnākṣarā gomad ṛṣabhavad vajryabhimat pañcamasyāhno rūpaṃ triṇavasya stomasya pāṅktena chandaso śakvarīṇāṃ sāmnaḥ
children.translated_text: Containing brightness and offspring, the <s>Paṅkti</s>, the <s>Śakvarī</s> with heavenly syllables, cattle, the bull, and desire for the thunderbolt is the form of the fifth day, of the <s>Triṇava</s> <s>stoma</s>, of the <s>Paṅkti</s> metre, and of the <s>Śakvarī</s> <s>sāmans</s>.

children.text: parivat prativat saptapadā dvipadā vinārāśaṃsā gomad ṛṣabhavat ṣaṣṭhasyāhno rūpaṃ trayastriṃśasya stomasya sarveṣāṃ chandasāṃ rūpaṃ revatīnāṃ sāmnaḥ
children.translated_text: Containing 'pari' and 'prati,' seven-footed and two-footed, separated from the <s>Nārāśaṃsa</s>, containing cattle and the bull, is the form of the sixth day, of the thirty-threefold <s>stoma</s>, the form of all the metres, and of the <s>Revatī</s> <s>sāmans</s>.

children.text: yasmād eṣā samānā satī ṣaḍahavibhaktir nānārūpā tasmād virūpaḥ saṃvvatsaraḥ
children.translated_text: Because this six-day division, though being the same, has manifold forms, therefore the year is manifold in form.

children.text: virūpam enam anuprajāyate ya evaṃ veda ||
children.translated_text: Manifold offspring is born after the one who knows this.

children.text: agna iti prathamasyāhno rūpam agnivibhakter agnim iti dvitīyasyāgnineti tṛtīyasyāgnir iti caturthasya
children.translated_text: 'Agna' is the form of the first day in the division of <s>Agni</s>; 'agnim' is that of the second, 'agninā' that of the third, and 'agniḥ' that of the fourth.

children.text: devā vai śriyam aicchaṃstān na prathame 'hany avindan na dvitīye na tṛtīye tāṃścaturthe 'hany avindan vindate śriyaṃ ya evaṃ vedāgner iti pañcamasya teno śrīḥ pratyupoditety āhuḥ
children.translated_text: The gods desired prosperity. They did not find it on the first day, nor on the second, nor on the third; they found it on the fourth day. The one who knows this obtains prosperity. 'Agner' is the form of the fifth day; therefore they say, 'Prosperity has risen back toward him by that.'

children.text: aprativādy enaṃ bhrātṛvyo bhavati ya evaṃ veda
children.translated_text: A rival becomes unable to answer him who knows this.

children.text: agna iti ṣaṣṭhasya yenaiva rūpeṇa prayanti tad abhyudyanti
children.translated_text: 'Agna' is the form of the sixth day. With the very form with which they set out, they rise up again.

children.text: yasmād eṣā samānā saty agnivibhaktir nānārūpā tasmād yathartvādityas tapati ||
children.translated_text: Because this division of <s>Agni</s>, though being the same, has manifold forms, therefore the sun burns according to the seasons.

children.text: indreti prathamasyāhno rūpam indravibhakter indram iti dvitīyasyendreṇeti tṛtīyasyendra iti caturthasyendrād iti pañcamasyendreti ṣaṣṭhasya yenaiva rūpeṇa prayanti tad abhyudyanti yasmād eṣā samānā satīndravibhaktir nānārūpā tasmād yathartv oṣadhayaḥ pacyante ||
children.translated_text: 'Indra' is the form of the first day in the division of <s>Indra</s>; 'indram' that of the second, 'indreṇa' that of the third, 'indraḥ' that of the fourth, 'indrāt' that of the fifth, and 'indre' that of the sixth. With the very form with which they set out, they rise up again. Because this division of <s>Indra</s>, though being the same, has manifold forms, therefore the plants ripen according to the seasons.

children.text: yad ṛcā prastauti tat prathamasyāhno rūpam svaravibhakter yat purastāt stobhaṃ tad dvitīyasya yad ubhayataḥ stobhaṃ tat tṛtīyasya yad anutunnaṃ tac caturthasya yad abhyārabdhaṃ tat pañcamasya yad ihakāreṇābhyastaṃ tat ṣaṣṭhasyāhno rūpam
children.translated_text: When he begins the chant with a verse, that is the form of the first day in the division of <s>svara</s>; when the <s>stobha</s> is in front, that is of the second; when the <s>stobha</s> is on both sides, that is of the third; when it is unpierced, that is of the fourth; when it is taken up, that is of the fifth; when it is repeated with the sound 'iha,' that is the form of the sixth day.

children.text: svarāṇāṃ yasmād eṣā samānā satī svaravibhaktir nānārūpā tasmād yathartu vāyuḥ pavate ||
children.translated_text: Of the <s>svaras</s>, because this division of <s>svara</s>, though being the same, has manifold forms, therefore the wind blows according to the seasons.

children.text: padanidhanaṃ prathamasyāhno rūpam nidhanavibhakter bahirṇidhanaṃ dvitīyasya niṃnidhanaṃ tṛtīyasyenidhanañcaturthasyāthakāraṇidhanaṃ pañcamasya yad ihākāreṇābhyastaṃ tat ṣaṣṭhasyāhno rūpaṃ nidhanānāṃ yasmād eṣā samānā satī nidhanavibhaktir nānārūpā tasmād ime lokāḥ saha santo nānaiva ||
children.translated_text: <s>Padanidhana</s> is the form of the first day in the division of <s>nidhana</s>; <s>Bahirnidhana</s> of the second; <s>Diṅnidhana</s> of the third; <s>Īnidhana</s> of the fourth; <s>Athakāranidhana</s> of the fifth; and what is repeated with the sound 'iha' is the form of the sixth day among the <s>nidhanas</s>. Because this division of <s>nidhana</s>, though being the same, has manifold forms, therefore these worlds, though together, are as if separate.

children.text: dravadiḍaṃ prathamasyāhno rūpam iḍāvibhakter ūrdhveḍaṃ dvitīyasya pariṣṭubdheḍaṃ tṛtīyasyeḍābhir aiḍaṃ caturthasyādhyardheḍaṃ pañcamasya yad ihākāreṇābhyastaṃ tat ṣaṣṭhasyāhno rūpam iḍānāṃ yasmād eṣā samānā satīḍāvibhaktir nānārūpā tasmāt samānāḥ santaḥ paśavo nānārūpāḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Dravadiḍa</s> is the form of the first day in the division of <s>iḍā</s>; <s>Ūrdhveḍa</s> of the second; <s>Pariṣṭubdheḍa</s> of the third; the <s>Aiḍa</s> with <s>iḍās</s> of the fourth; <s>Adhyardheḍa</s> of the fifth; and what is repeated with the sound 'iha' is the form of the sixth day among the <s>iḍās</s>. Because this division of <s>iḍā</s>, though being the same, has manifold forms, therefore animals, though alike, have manifold forms.

children.text: bharadvājāyanā vai sattram āsata tān apṛcchan kiṃ prathamenāhnā kuruteti praivaimeti kiṃ dvitīyenety avasam evākurmahīti kiṃ tṛtīyeneti pary evāplavāmahīti kiṃ caturtheneti sataiva sad apyadadhmeti kiṃ pañcameneti prāṇān eva vicchindanta aimeti kiṃ ṣaṣṭhenetīdam evāgacchāmeti iti
children.translated_text: The descendants of <s>Bharadvāja</s> once sat in a <s>sattra</s>. They were asked, 'What do you do with the first day?' 'We go forward.' 'What with the second?' 'We have made only a dwelling place.' 'What with the third?' 'We have swum all around.' 'What with the fourth?' 'With being itself we have placed being upon being.' 'What with the fifth?' 'We go, cutting off the breaths themselves.' 'What with the sixth?' 'We come to this very place.' Thus they said.

children.text: yasya padena prastauty atha svāram abhi vāva tena devāḥ paśūn apaśyan yat purastāt stobhaṃ atha svāram ud eva tenāsṛjanta yad ubhayataḥ stobham atha svāram ebhya eva tena lokebhyo devāḥ paśubhyo 'nnādyaṃ prāyacchan yad anutunnam atha svāram upaiva tenāśikṣan yasya madhye nidhanam atha svāraṃ garbhāṃs tenādadhata tāni havatāsvāreṇa prājanayan
children.translated_text: When he begins the chant with a word and then the <s>svāra</s>, by that the gods truly saw the animals. Where there is a <s>stobha</s> in front and then the <s>svāra</s>, by that they sent them forth. Where there is a <s>stobha</s> on both sides and then the <s>svāra</s>, by that the gods gave food from these worlds to the animals. Where it is unpierced and then the <s>svāra</s>, by that they brought them near for training. Where the <s>nidhana</s> is in the middle and then the <s>svāra</s>, by that they placed embryos; and with that <s>svāra</s> they brought them to birth.

children.text: imaṃ vāva devā lokaṃ padanidhanenābhy ajayann amuṃ bahirṇidhanenāntarikṣaṃ diṅnidhanenāmṛtatvam īnidhanenāgacchan brahmavarcasam athanidhanenāvārundhatāsminn eva loka ihanidhanena pratyatiṣṭhan
children.translated_text: By the <s>Padanidhana</s> the gods conquered this world; by the <s>Bahirnidhana</s>, yonder world; by the <s>Diṅnidhana</s>, the midspace; by the <s>Īnidhana</s> they reached immortality; by the <s>Athanidhana</s> they secured sacred brilliance; and by the <s>Ihanidhana</s> they became established in this very world.

children.text: imaṃ vāva devā lokaṃ dravadiḍenābhyajayann amum ūrdhveḍenāntarikṣaṃ pariṣṭubdheḍena pratiṣṭhām iḍābhir aiḍenāvārundhata pratiṣṭhāyādhyardheḍena vyajayantāsminn eva loka iheḍena pratyatiṣṭhan
children.translated_text: With the <s>Dravadiḍa</s> the gods indeed conquered this world, with the <s>Ūrdhveḍa</s> yonder world, and with the <s>Pariṣṭubdheḍa</s> the midspace. With the <s>iḍās</s>, with the <s>Aiḍa</s>, they secured a foundation; having gained a foundation, they triumphed with the <s>Adhyardheḍa</s>; with the <s>Iheḍa</s> they became established here in this very world.

children.text: na vāk saṃvatsaram ativadatīḍaiva saṃvatsaram ativadati garbheṇa saṃvatsare paryāvṛtya prajāyete tenātivadati
children.translated_text: Speech does not speak beyond the year; the <s>Iḍā</s> alone speaks beyond the year. With an embryo, after turning around within a year, creatures are born; by that it speaks beyond.

children.text: tā vā etāś catasraḥ ṣaḍahaṃ parācya iḍā atiyanty eṣā nūtaiṣā viṣūcy eṣā pratīcy etad vīḍam
children.translated_text: These four <s>iḍās</s> pass through the six-day rite facing away: this one is <s>Nūtā</s>, this one <s>Viṣūcī</s>, this one <s>Pratīcī</s>; this is the <s>Vīḍa</s>.

children.text: saṃvatsaro 'gnir vāk saṃvatsaro yad agnir vibhajyate vācam eva tad vibhajanti
children.translated_text: The year is <s>Agni</s>; speech is the year. When <s>Agni</s> is divided, they are dividing speech itself.

children.text: dve dve akṣare vibhajanti dvau dvau hi māsāv ṛturatho māsānām eva tad rūpaṃ kriyate
children.translated_text: They divide two syllables at a time; for two months make a season, and so the form of the months is produced.

children.text: ṣaḍ ahāni vibhajanti ṣaḍ ṛtava ṛtūnāṃ dhṛtyā ṛtūnāṃ pratiṣṭhityā atho ṛtūnām eva tad rūpaṃ kriyate ṣaḍ u puruṣā yān agnir anuvihriyate
children.translated_text: They divide it over six days; there are six seasons. This is for the holding of the seasons, for the establishment of the seasons, and so the form of the seasons is produced. Six, moreover, are the men by whom <s>Agni</s> is carried around in succession.

children.text: yad idaṃ bahudhāgnir vihriyate tad asāv ādityaḥ sarvāḥ prajāḥ pratyaṅ tasmād ete devate vibhaktim ānaśāte nāto 'nyā kācana ||
children.translated_text: This <s>Agni</s>, which is carried about in many divisions, is yonder <s>Āditya</s>, facing all creatures. Therefore these two deities obtain division; there is no other deity besides these.

children.text: Chapter 11
stomo yujyate sattriyebhyo 'harbhyaḥ pratnavatībhiś copavatībhiś ca
children.translated_text: The <s>stoma</s> is yoked for the sattra days with the <s>Pratnavatī</s> and the <s>Upavatī</s> verses.

children.text: yat pratnavatyo upavatībhyaḥ pūrvā yujyante brahma tat pūrvaṃ kṣatrād yujyate brahma hi pūrvaṃ kṣatram
children.translated_text: When the <s>Pratnavatī</s> verses are yoked before the <s>Upavatī</s> verses, <s>brahman</s> is yoked before <s>kṣatra</s>; for <s>brahman</s> is prior, and <s>kṣatra</s> follows.

children.text: manas tat pūrvaṃ vāco yujyate mano hi yaddhi manasābhigacchati tad vācā vadati
children.translated_text: Mind is thereby yoked before speech, for what one reaches with the mind, that one says with speech.

children.text: bṛhat tat pūrvaṃ rathantarād yujyate bṛhaddhi pūrvaṃ rathantarād vijityā tu vai rathantaraṃ pūrvaṃ yogam ānaśe
children.translated_text: The <s>Bṛhat</s> is thereby yoked before the <s>Rathantara</s>; for the <s>Bṛhat</s> is prior to the <s>Rathantara</s>. But by conquest the <s>Rathantara</s> obtained the prior yoking.

children.text: saṃbhāryās tṛcā bhavanti yathāśiṣṭhān vahiṣṭhān saṃbhared evam evaitān saṃbharanti gatyai
children.translated_text: The triplets are to be gathered together. Just as one would gather together those that are left and most fit to carry, so they gather these together, for going forward.

children.text: nava bhavanti navāhasya yuktyā ṛcarcaivāhar yunakti yathāprārthasya śamyā avadadhyād evam evaitan navāhasya śamyā avadadhāti gatyai
children.translated_text: There are nine, for the yoking of the nine-day rite. With each verse he yokes a day. Just as one would set down the yoke-pin for one who is setting out, so he sets down the yoke-pin of the nine-day rite, for going forward.

children.text: trivṛd eva stomo bhavati tejase brahmavarcasāya ||
children.translated_text: The <s>stoma</s> is simply the <s>Trivṛt</s>, for <s>tejas</s> (radiant power) and <s>brahmavarcas</s> (sacred brilliance).

children.text: ubhābhyāṃ vai rūpābhyāṃ bahiṣpavamānyo yujyante yatsāmā stomo bhavati tad ājyeṣu
children.translated_text: The <s>Bahiṣpavamāna</s> chants are yoked with both forms. The <s>stoma</s> that has a <s>sāman</s> is in the <s>ājya</s> chants.

children.text: nirāhāvanty ājyāni bhavanti yuktam eva tair āhvayati
children.translated_text: The <s>ājya</s> chants are furnished with the <s>nirāhāva</s> formula; with them he calls the yoked one.

children.text: agna āyāhi vītaya ā no mitrāvaruṇāyāhi suṣamā hi ta indrāgnī āgataṃ sutam iti rāthantaram eva tad rūpaṃ nirdyotayati stomaḥ iti ||
children.translated_text: With the verses, "<s>Agni</s>, come for the feast," "<s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, come to us," and "<s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, come to the pressed <s>Soma</s>, for it is well prepared for you," he makes the <s>Rathantara</s> form itself shine forth, namely the <s>stoma</s>.

children.text: pra somāso vipaścita iti gāyatrī bhavati pretyā abhidroṇāni babhrava ity abhikrāntyai stutā indrāya vāyava iti saṃskṛtyai pra soma deva vītaya iti pretyai pra tu draveti pretyai pra vā etenāhnā yanti
children.translated_text: "pra somāso vipaścitaḥ" is in the <s>Gāyatrī</s>, for going forth; "abhidroṇāni babhravaḥ" is for stepping onward; "stutā indrāya vāyavaḥ" is for preparation; "pra soma deva vītaye" is for going forth; "pra tu drava" is for going forth. By this day they go forth indeed.

children.text: gāyatraṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: The <s>Gāyatra</s> is used.

children.text: yad eva gāyatrasya brāhmaṇam
children.translated_text: Whatever is the <s>brāhmaṇa</s> explanation of the <s>Gāyatra</s> applies here.

children.text: āśvaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: The <s>Āśva</s> is used.

children.text: aśvo vai bhūtvā prajāpatiḥ prajā asṛjata sa prājāyata bahur abhavat prajāyate bahur bhavaty āśvena tuṣṭuvānaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Prajāpati</s>, having become a horse, created creatures. He propagated himself and became many. The one who praises with the <s>Āśva</s> propagates himself and becomes many.

children.text: ekākṣaraṃ nidhanam upayanti rathantarasyānativādāya
children.translated_text: They come to a one-syllable <s>nidhana</s>, so as not to surpass the <s>Rathantara</s>.

children.text: anativādyenaṃ bhrātṛvyo bhavati ya evaṃ veda
children.translated_text: The rival of the one who knows thus becomes unable to surpass him.

children.text: somasāma bhavati
children.translated_text: The <s>Somasāman</s> is used.

children.text: yathā vā imā anyā oṣadhayaḥ evaṃ soma āsīt sa tapo 'tapyata sa etat somasāmāpaśyat tena rājyamādhipatyam agacchad yaśo 'bhavad rājyam ādhipatyaṃ gacchati yaśo bhavati somasāmnā tuṣṭuvānaḥ
children.translated_text: Once <s>Soma</s> was like these other plants. He practiced austerity; he saw this <s>Somasāman</s>. By it he attained kingdom and overlordship and became famous. The one who praises with the <s>Somasāman</s> attains kingdom and overlordship and becomes famous.

children.text: yaudhājayaṃ bhavati yad eva yaudhājayasya brāhmaṇam
children.translated_text: The <s>Yaudhājaya</s> is used; whatever is the <s>brāhmaṇa</s> explanation of the <s>Yaudhājaya</s> applies here.

children.text: auśanaṃ yad auśanasya stomaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Auśana</s> is used, since the <s>stoma</s> is that of the <s>Auśana</s>.

children.text: abhi tvā śūra no nu ma ity abhīti rathantarasya rūpaṃ rathantaraṃ hy etad ahaḥ
children.translated_text: "abhi tvā śūra no nu ma" contains the word <s>abhi</s>; this is the form of the <s>Rathantara</s>, for this day is the <s>Rathantara</s>.

children.text: kayā naś citra ābhuvad iti kavatyas tena prājāpatyāḥ ko hi prajāpatiḥ prajāpater āptyai
children.translated_text: "kayā naś citra ābhuvat" consists of verses containing <s>ka</s>; by that they belong to <s>Prajāpati</s>, for <s>Ka</s> is <s>Prajāpati</s>, for the attainment of <s>Prajāpati</s>.

children.text: taṃ vo dasmam ṛtīṣahaṃ vasor mandānam andhaso 'bhivatsaṃ na svasareṣu dhenava ity abhīti rathantarasya rūpaṃ rathantaraṃ hy etad ahaḥ
children.translated_text: "taṃ vo dasmam ṛtīṣahaṃ vasor mandānam andhaso 'bhivatsaṃ na svasareṣu dhenavaḥ" contains the word <s>abhi</s>; this is the form of the <s>Rathantara</s>, for this day is the <s>Rathantara</s>.

children.text: indraṃ gīrbhir havāmaha iti havanta evainam
children.translated_text: With "indraṃ gīrbhir havāmahe," they indeed call <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: tarobhir vo vidadvasum iti stomo vai taro yajño vidadvasuḥ stomena vai yajño yujyate yat tarobhir vo vidadvasum ity āha yajñam eva tad yunakti
children.translated_text: "tarobhir vo vidadvasum": the <s>stoma</s> is <s>taro</s>, the sacrifice is <s>vidadvasu</s>. The sacrifice is yoked by the <s>stoma</s>. When he says "tarobhir vo vidadvasum," he yokes the sacrifice itself.

children.text: rathantaraṃ bhavati brahma vai rathantaraṃ brahma prāyaṇīyam ahar brahmaṇa eva tad brahmākramya prayanti
children.translated_text: The <s>Rathantara</s> is used. The <s>Rathantara</s> is <s>brahman</s>; the opening day is <s>brahman</s>. Thus they set forth from <s>brahman</s> itself, having mounted <s>brahman</s>.

children.text: iyaṃ vai rathantaram asyām eva pratiṣṭhāya sattram āsate
children.translated_text: This earth is the <s>Rathantara</s>; established on this very earth, they sit in the <s>sattra</s>.

children.text: vāmadevyaṃ bhavati paśavo vai vāmadevyaṃ paśūnām avaruddhyai prājāpatyaṃ vai vāmadevyaṃ prajāpatāv eva pratiṣṭhāya sattram āsate
children.translated_text: The <s>Vāmadevya</s> is used. The <s>Vāmadevya</s> is cattle, for the securing of cattle. The <s>Vāmadevya</s> belongs to <s>Prajāpati</s>; established in <s>Prajāpati</s> himself, they sit in the <s>sattra</s>.

children.text: naudhasaṃ bhavati brahma vai naudhasaṃ brahma prāyaṇīyam ahar brahmaṇa eva tad rahmākramante
children.translated_text: The <s>Naudhasa</s> is used. The <s>Naudhasa</s> is <s>brahman</s>; the opening day is <s>brahman</s>. Thus from <s>brahman</s> itself they mount <s>brahman</s>.

children.text: kāleyaṃ bhavati samānaloke vai kāleyaṃ ca rathantaraṃ ceyaṃ vai rathantaraṃ paśavaḥ kāleyam asyāṃ caiva paśuṣu ca pratiṣṭhāya sattram āsate
children.translated_text: The <s>Kāleya</s> is used. The <s>Kāleya</s> and the <s>Rathantara</s> are indeed in the same world. This earth is the <s>Rathantara</s>; cattle are the <s>Kāleya</s>. Established both on this earth and among cattle, they sit in the <s>sattra</s>.

children.text: dravadiḍaṃ tathā hy etasyāhno rūpaṃ stomaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Dravadiḍa</s> is used; for that is the form of this day, the <s>stoma</s>.

children.text: pra somāso madacyuta iti gāyatrī bhavati madavad vai rasavṛt tṛtīyasavanaṃ madam eva tad rasaṃ dadhāty ayā pasvasva devayur ity eti rathantarasya rūpaṃ rāthantaraṃ hy etad ahaḥ pavate 'har yato harir iti bṛhato rūpaṃ bṛhad eva tad etasminn ahani yunakti tad yuktaṃ śva ārabhante pra sunvānāyāndhasa iti pravatyo bhavanti praṇinīṇyam iva hy etad ahar abhi priyāṇi pavate ca nohita ity abhīti rathantarasya rūpaṃ rāthantaraṃ hy etad ahaḥ
children.translated_text: 'Forward flow the <s>Somas</s>, dropping exhilaration' is a <s>Gāyatrī</s> verse. The third pressing is indeed full of exhilaration and rich in sap; thereby he places exhilaration and sap in it. 'By this, swell, desiring the gods' follows; it is the form of the <s>Rathantara</s>, for this day is <s>Rāthantara</s>. 'It purifies itself as the day, since it is tawny' is the form of the <s>Bṛhat</s>; he thereby joins the <s>Bṛhat</s> to this day. When that has been joined, they begin the next day. 'For the one pressing the draught' are verses containing 'pra', for this day is, as it were, to be led onward. 'And it purifies itself toward dear things for us, for our welfare' contains 'abhi'; it is the form of the <s>Rathantara</s>, for this day is <s>Rāthantara</s>.

children.text: yajñā yajñā vo agnaya ity agner vai yajño yajña eva tad yajñaṃ pratiṣṭhāpayati
children.translated_text: 'Sacrifice after sacrifice for you, O fires' is used. <s>Agni</s> is the sacrifice; thereby he establishes the sacrifice in the sacrifice itself.

children.text: gāyatraṃ bhavati yad eva gāyatrasya brāhmaṇam
children.translated_text: It is <s>Gāyatra</s>; this is precisely the <s>brāhmaṇa</s> explanation of the <s>Gāyatra</s>.

children.text: saṃhitaṃ bhavati vyakṣaraṇidhanaṃ pratiṣṭhāyai pratiṣṭhāyaiva sattram āsate
children.translated_text: The <s>Saṃhita</s> is used, with a <s>vyakṣara-nidhana</s>, for stability; through stability itself they sit through the <s>sattra</s>.

children.text: saphaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: The <s>Sapha</s> is used.

children.text: saphena vai devā imān lokān samāpnuvan yat samāpnuvaṃs tat saphasya saphatvam imān evaitena lokān samāpya sattram āsate
