children.translated_text: With the <s>Sapha</s> the gods reached these worlds. Because they reached them, that is the 'saphatva' of the <s>Sapha</s>. Having reached these worlds by means of it, they sit through the <s>sattra</s>.

children.text: ākṣāraṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: The <s>Ākṣāra</s> is used.

children.text: aṣṭau vā etāḥ kādughā āsaṃs tāsām ekā samaśīryata sā kṛṣir abhavad ṛdhyate 'smai kṛṣau ya evaṃ veda
children.translated_text: There were eight wish-yielding cows. One of them broke apart, and she became agriculture. Agriculture prospers for the one who knows this.

children.text: tāsu devāsurā aspardhanta te devā asurān kāmadughābhya ākṣāreṇānudanta nudate bhrātṛvyaṃ kāmadughābhya ākṣāreṇa tuṣṭuvānaḥ
children.translated_text: Over them the gods and the <s>Asuras</s> contended. With the <s>Ākṣāra</s> the gods drove the <s>Asuras</s> away from the wish-yielding cows. Praising with the <s>Ākṣāra</s>, one drives his rival away from the wish-yielding cows.

children.text: ebhyo vai lokebhyo raso 'pākrāmat taṃ prajāpatir ākṣāreṇākṣārayad yad ākṣārayat tad ākṣārasyākṣāratvam
children.translated_text: The sap withdrew from these worlds. <s>Prajāpati</s> made it flow with the <s>Ākṣāra</s>. Because he made it flow, that is the 'ākṣāratva' of the <s>Ākṣāra</s>.

children.text: tasmād yaḥ purā puṇyo bhūtvā paścāt pāpīyān syād ākṣāraṃ brahma sāma kurvītātmany eved indriyaṃ vīryaṃ rasam ākṣārayati
children.translated_text: Therefore, if someone who was formerly prosperous later becomes worse off, he should make the <s>Ākṣāra</s> the <s>brahma-sāman</s>; he makes power, strength, and sap flow into himself.

children.text: januṣaikarco bhavato 'hno dhṛtyai yad vā etasyāhno 'dhṛtaṃ tad etābhyāṃ dādhāra
children.translated_text: The two <s>Januṣaikarca</s> chants are used for the support of the day. Whatever of this day was unsupported, he supported with these two.

children.text: gaurīvitaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: The <s>Gaurīvīta</s> is used.

children.text: gaurīvitir vā etacchāktyo brāhmaṇo 'tiriktam apaśyat tad gaurīvitam abhavat
children.translated_text: <s>Gaurīvīti Śāktya</s>, the Brāhmaṇa, saw this excess; it became the <s>Gaurīvīta</s>.

children.text: atiriktaṃ vā etad atiriktena stuvanti yad gaurīvitenāhīnāñchavastanavad bhavaty api prajāyā upakﾱptam
children.translated_text: This is indeed an excess, and they praise the excess with the excess when they praise with the <s>Gaurīvīta</s>. The <s>ahīna</s> rite becomes possessed of a tomorrow; it is also fitted for offspring.

children.text: vṛṣā vā etad vājisāma vṛṣabho retodhā adya stuvanti śvaḥ prajāyate
children.translated_text: This <s>Vājisāman</s> is indeed a bull; the bull is seed-bearing. Today they praise; tomorrow offspring is born.

children.text: anuṣṭubhi chandasāṃ kriyate 'nuṣṭubbhi chandasāṃ yoniḥ svāyām eva tad yonau reto dhatte prajātyai
children.translated_text: It is performed in the <s>Anuṣṭubh</s> among the metres. The <s>Anuṣṭubh</s> is the womb of the metres; thereby he places seed in its own womb, for procreation.

children.text: prajāyate bahur bhavati ya evaṃ veda
children.translated_text: The one who knows this procreates and becomes numerous.

children.text: dvyudāsaṃ bhavaty etau vā udāsau svargasya lokasyāvasānadarśau pūrveṇa pūrvam ahaḥ saṃsthāpayanty uttareṇottaram ahar abhyativadanti
children.translated_text: The <s>Dvyudāsa</s> is used. These two <s>Udāsa</s> chants are seers of the resting-place of the heavenly world. With the former they bring the former day to completion; with the latter they address the following day.

children.text: tad yathādaḥ pūrvedyuḥ spaṣṭaṃ tṛṇodakam anvavasyanto yanty evam eva tābhyāṃ svargaṃ lokam anvavasyanto yanti
children.translated_text: Just as on the previous day people go on, seeking visible grass and water as a place to settle, so with these two they go on seeking the heavenly world as a place to settle.

children.text: gautamaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: The <s>Gautama</s> is used.

children.text: sāmārṣeyavat svargāya yujyate svargāllokānna cyavate tuṣṭuvānaḥ
children.translated_text: It is joined to heaven as possessing a lineage of <s>sāman</s> seers. Praising with it, one does not fall from the heavenly worlds.

children.text: yad u caivānuṣtṭubhasya madhye nidhanasya brāhmaṇaṃ tad du caitasya
children.translated_text: And whatever <s>brāhmaṇa</s> explanation belongs to the <s>nidhana</s> in the middle of the <s>Anuṣṭubh</s>, that too belongs to this one.

children.text: kāvaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: The <s>Kāva</s> is used.

children.text: lokabinduḥ sāma vindate lokaṃ kāvena tuṣṭuvānaḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>sāman</s> is a finder of a world. Praising with the <s>Kāva</s>, one finds a world.

children.text: svārasu svareṇa svareṇa hi devebhyo 'ntato 'nnādyaṃ pradīyate svareṇaiva tad devebhyo 'ntato 'nnādyaṃ prayacchati
children.translated_text: In the <s>Svāra</s> verses, it is by tone; for by tone, at the end, food is given to the gods. By tone itself, then, he finally offers food to the gods.

children.text: yajñāyajñīyaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: The <s>Yajñāyajñīya</s> is used.

children.text: vāg yajñāyajñīyaṃ vāci yajñaḥ pratiṣṭhito vācy eva tad yajñam antataḥ pratiṣṭhāpayanti taṃ vāco 'dhi śva ārabhante
children.translated_text: Speech is the <s>Yajñāyajñīya</s>; the sacrifice is established in speech. At the end they establish the sacrifice in speech itself. From speech they begin it tomorrow.

children.text: trivṛd eva stomo bhavati tejase brahmavarcasāya ||
children.translated_text: The <s>stoma</s> is just the <s>Trivṛt</s>, for radiance and <s>brahmavarcas</s> (priestly brilliance).

children.text: pratipad bhavati
children.translated_text: There is a <s>pratipad</s> (opening verse).

children.text: samārabhate dvirātrasyāvrisraṃsāya
children.translated_text: He begins it together, so that the two-night rite may not slip apart.

children.text: pavasvendo vṛṣāsuta ity anurūpo bhavati vṛṣāvad vā eta aindraṃ traiṣṭubham ahar yat dvitīyaṃ tad eva tad abhivadati
children.translated_text: 'Purify yourself, O <s>Indu</s>, bull-like, pressed' is the <s>anurūpa</s> verse. This second day is indeed bull-bearing, <s>Aindra</s>, and <s>Traiṣṭubha</s>; that verse proclaims just that.

children.text: pūrvam u tad rūpam apareṇa rūpeṇānuvadati yat pūrvaṃ rūpam apareṇa rūpeṇānuvadati tad anurūpasyānurūpatvam
children.translated_text: It repeats the earlier form with a later form. Because it repeats the earlier form with a later form, that is the corresponding character of the <s>anurūpa</s>.

children.text: anurūpa enaṃ putro jāyate ya evaṃ veda
children.translated_text: For the one who knows this, a son corresponding to him is born.

children.text: stotrīyānurūpau tṛcau bhavataḥ prāṇāpānānām avaruddhyai
children.translated_text: The <s>stotrīya</s> and <s>anurūpa</s> are two triplets, for securing <s>prāṇa</s> and <s>apāna</s>.

children.text: vṛṣaṇvantas tṛcā bhavatīndriyasya vīryasyāvaruddhyai
children.translated_text: The triplets contain 'vṛṣan' (bull), for securing power and strength.

children.text: tṛca uttamo bhavati
children.translated_text: The last one is a triplet.

children.text: yenaiva prāṇena prayanti tam abhyudyanti
children.translated_text: By the very breath with which they go forth, they rise up to it.

children.text: pañcadaśa eva stomo bhavati
children.translated_text: The <s>stoma</s> is just the <s>Pañcadaśa</s>.

children.text: ojasy eva tad vīrye pratitiṣṭhati ojo vīryaṃ pañcadaśaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Thereby he stands firm in vigor and strength; the <s>Pañcadaśa</s> is vigor and strength.

children.text: ubhābhyāṃ vai rūpābhyāṃ bahiṣpavamānyo yujyante yatsāmā stomo bhavati tad ājyeṣu
children.translated_text: The <s>Bahiṣpavamāna</s> chants are joined with both forms; whatever is <s>sāman</s> and <s>stoma</s>, that is in the <s>Ājya</s> chants.

children.text: nirāhopasthitāny ājyāni bhavanti
children.translated_text: The <s>Ājya</s> chants are placed without an <s>āhā</s>-call.

children.text: agniṃ dūtaṃ vṛṇīmahe mitraṃ vayaṃ havāmaha indram id gāthino bṛhad indro agnā namo bṛhad iti bārhatam eva tad rūpaṃ nirdyotayati stomaḥ ||
children.translated_text: 'We choose <s>Agni</s> as messenger; we invoke <s>Mitra</s>; <s>Indra</s> indeed, the singers, the <s>Bṛhat</s>; O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, homage, the <s>Bṛhat</s>.' Thereby the <s>stoma</s> displays precisely the <s>Bārhata</s> form.

children.text: vṛṣā pavasva dhārayeti gāyatrī bhavaty ahno dhṛtyai
children.translated_text: 'Bull, purify yourself with the stream' is a <s>Gāyatrī</s> verse, for the support of the day.

children.text: vṛṣaṇvatyas triṣṭubho rūpeṇa traiṣṭubhaṃ hy etad ahaḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>Triṣṭubh</s> verses containing 'vṛṣan' are used by form, for this day is <s>Traiṣṭubha</s>.

children.text: punānas soma dhārayeti dhṛtyai
children.translated_text: 'Purifying yourself, O <s>Soma</s>, with the stream' is for support.

children.text: vṛṣā śoṇo abhikanikradad gā iti
children.translated_text: 'The red bull, bellowing, has gone to the cows' is used.

children.text: vṛṣaṇvatyas triṣṭubho rūpeṇa samṛddhā vṛṣaṇvad vā etad aindraṃ traiṣṭubham ahar yat dvitīyaṃ tad eva tad abhivadati
children.translated_text: The <s>Triṣṭubh</s> verses containing 'vṛṣaṇ' are fulfilled by their form. For this second day is indeed <s>Aindra</s>, <s>Traiṣṭubha</s>, and containing 'vṛṣaṇ'; that is precisely what it states.

children.text: gāyatraṃ bhavati yad eva gāyatrasya brāhmaṇam
children.translated_text: It is the <s>Gāyatra</s>; just what is the brāhmaṇa explanation of the <s>Gāyatra</s> applies.

children.text: yauktāśvaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: It is the <s>Yauktāśva</s>.

children.text: yuktāśvo vā āṅgirasaḥ śiśū jātau viparyaharat tasmān mantro 'pākrāmat sa tapo 'tapyata sa etad yauktāśvam apaśyat taṃ mantra upāvartata tad vāva sa tarhy akāmayata kāmasani sāma yauktāśvaṃ kāmam evaitenāvarundhe
children.translated_text: <s>Yuktāśva Āṅgirasa</s> once transposed two children at birth; therefore the mantra went away from him. He practiced austerity, saw this <s>Yauktāśva</s>, and the mantra returned to him. That indeed was what he then desired: the <s>Yauktāśva</s> is a desire-winning <s>sāman</s>, and by it one secures desire.

children.text: āyāsye bhavataḥ
children.translated_text: The two <s>Āyāsya</s> chants are used.

children.text: ayāsyo vā āṅgirasa ādityānāṃ dīkṣitānām annādyam āśnāt taṃ śug ārchat sa tapo 'tapyata sa ete āyāsye apaśyat tābhyāṃ śucam apāhatāpa śucaṃ hata āyāsyābhyāṃ tuṣṭuvānaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Ayāsya Āṅgirasa</s> ate the food of the consecrated <s>Ādityas</s>; burning pain seized him. He practiced austerity and saw these two <s>Āyāsya</s> chants. With them he struck away that burning pain. One who praises with the two <s>Āyāsya</s> chants strikes away burning pain.

children.text: ebhyo vai lokebhyo vṛṣṭir apākrāmat tām ayāsya āyāsyābhyām acyāvayat cyāvayati vṛṣṭim āyāsyābhyāṃ tuṣṭuvānaḥ
children.translated_text: Rain went away from these worlds. <s>Ayāsya</s> set it in motion with the two <s>Āyāsya</s> chants. One who praises with the two <s>Āyāsya</s> chants sets rain in motion.

children.text: annādyaṃ vāva tad ebhyo lokebhyo 'pākrāmat tad ayāsya āyāsyābhyām acyāvayat cyāvayaty annādyam āyāsyābhyāṃ tuṣṭuvānaḥ
children.translated_text: Food for eating had indeed gone away from these worlds. <s>Ayāsya</s> set it in motion with the two <s>Āyāsya</s> chants. One who praises with the two <s>Āyāsya</s> chants sets food for eating in motion.

children.text: vāsiṣṭhaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: It is the <s>Vāsiṣṭha</s>.

children.text: vasiṣṭho vā etena vaiḍavaḥ stutvāñjasā svargaṃ lokam apaśyat svargasya lokasyānukhyātyai svargāl lokān na cyavate tuṣṭuvānaḥ stomaḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Vasiṣṭha Vaiḍava</s>, having praised with this, saw the heavenly world directly. It serves for the perception of the heavenly world. One who praises does not fall from the heavenly worlds. This is the <s>stoma</s>.

children.text: tvām iddhi havāmaha iti tvam iti bṛhato rūpaṃ bārhataṃ hy etad ahaḥ
children.translated_text: 'tvām id dhi havāmahe': the word 'tvam' is a form of the <s>Bṛhat</s>, for this day belongs to the <s>Bṛhat</s>.

children.text: abhipravaḥ surādhasam iti yuñjate vai pūrveṇāhnā hy etena prayanti
children.translated_text: 'abhipravaḥ surādhasam': they yoke them, for by means of this they set out with the preceding day.

children.text: tvām idā hyo nara ity adya caiva hyaś ca samārabhate dvirātrasyāvisraṃsāya
children.translated_text: 'tvām idā hyo naraḥ': he takes hold of both today and yesterday, so that the two-night rite may not fall apart.

children.text: bṛhad bhavati varṣma vai bṛhad varṣma dvitīyam ahar varṣmaṇa eva tad varṣmākramante
children.translated_text: The <s>Bṛhat</s> is used. The <s>Bṛhat</s> is stature; the second day is stature. Thus they step from stature onto stature.

children.text: śyetaṃ bhavati sāmnorvāho yajñasya santatyai
children.translated_text: The <s>Śyeta</s> is used; it is a conveyance of the <s>sāmans</s>, for the continuity of the sacrifice.

children.text: mādhucchandasaṃ bhavati sāmārṣeyavat svargāya yujyate svargāl lokān na cyavate tuṣṭuvānaḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>Mādhucchandasa</s> is used. Like a <s>sāman</s> provided with its seer lineage, it is yoked for heaven. One who praises does not fall from the heavenly worlds.

children.text: ūrdhveḍaṃ tathā hy etasyāhno rūpaṃ stomaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Ūrdhveḍa</s> is used, for such is the form of this day. This is the <s>stoma</s>.

children.text: yas te mado vareṇya iti gāyatrī bhavati
children.translated_text: 'yas te mado vareṇyaḥ': it is a <s>Gāyatrī</s>.

children.text: madavad vai rasavat tṛtīyasavanaṃ madam eva tad rasaṃ dadhāti
children.translated_text: The third pressing is filled with exhilaration and sap; by that it places exhilaration and sap there.

children.text: pavasva madhumattama iti pavanta iva hy etenāhnā madhumattama ity annaṃ vai madhv annādyam eva tad yajamāne dadhāti
children.translated_text: 'pavasva madhumattamaḥ': for on this day they are as if flowing and purifying. 'Most honeyed' means food, for honey is food; by that it places food for eating in the sacrificer.

children.text: indram accha sutā ima itīndriyasya vīryasyāvaruddhyai
children.translated_text: 'indram accha sutā ime': this is for securing strength and vigor.

children.text: ayaṃ pūṣā rayir bhaga iti
children.translated_text: The verse is, 'This <s>Pūṣan</s> is wealth and fortune.'

children.text: anuṣṭubhaḥ satyas triṣṭubho rūpeṇa traiṣṭubhaṃ hy etad ahaḥ
children.translated_text: Though they are truly <s>Anuṣṭubh</s> verses, they are <s>Triṣṭubh</s> by form, for this day is <s>Traiṣṭubha</s>.

children.text: vṛṣāmatīnāṃ pavate vicakṣaṇa iti jagatyaḥ satyas triṣṭubho rūpeṇa traiṣṭubhaṃ hy etad ahaḥ
children.translated_text: 'vṛṣāmatīnāṃ pavate vicakṣaṇaḥ': though they are truly <s>Jagatī</s> verses, they are <s>Triṣṭubh</s> by form, for this day is <s>Traiṣṭubha</s>.

children.text: gāyatraṃ bhavati yad eva gāyatrasya brāhmaṇam
children.translated_text: It is the <s>Gāyatra</s>; just what is the brāhmaṇa explanation of the <s>Gāyatra</s> applies.

children.text: hāviṣmataṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: It is the <s>Hāviṣmata</s>.

children.text: haviṣmāṃś ca vai haviṣkṛccāṅgirasāvāstāṃ dvitīye 'hani haviṣmān arādhnon navame 'hani haviṣkṛt
children.translated_text: <s>Haviṣmant</s> and <s>Haviṣkṛt</s>, two <s>Āṅgirasas</s>, existed: <s>Haviṣmant</s> succeeded on the second day, and <s>Haviṣkṛt</s> on the ninth day.

children.text: ayaṃ haviṣmān ity eva jātam ahar jātaṃ somaṃ prāha devebhyaḥ sāmnaivāsmā āśiṣam āśāste sāma hi saty āśīḥ
children.translated_text: By saying 'this is <s>Haviṣmān</s>,' he announces to the gods the day that has arisen and the soma that has arisen. With the <s>sāman</s> alone he wishes a blessing for him, for the <s>sāman</s>, being true, is a blessing.

children.text: śaṅku bhavaty ahno dhṛtyai yad vā adhṛtaṃ śaṅkunā tad dādhāra
children.translated_text: The <s>Śaṅku</s> is used, for the support of the day. Whatever is unsupported, he supports with a peg.

children.text: tad u sīdantīyam ity āhur etena vai prajāpatir ūrdhva imān lokān asīdad yad asīdat tat sīdantīyasya sīdantīyatvam ūrdhva imān lokān sīdati sīdantīyena tuṣṭuvānaḥ
children.translated_text: They call that the <s>Sīdantīya</s>. With this <s>Prajāpati</s> sat above these worlds; because he sat down, that is the <s>Sīdantīya</s>'s being <s>Sīdantīya</s>. One who praises with the <s>Sīdantīya</s> sits above these worlds.

children.text: sujñānaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: It is the <s>Sujñāna</s>.

children.text: svarvad vai rāthantaraṃ rūpaṃ svarṇadhanaṃ bārhatam
children.translated_text: The <s>Rathantara</s> form is possessed of heavenly light; the <s>Bārhata</s> has heavenly light as wealth.

children.text: svarṇadhanaṃ bhavati tathā hy etasyāhno rūpam
children.translated_text: The <s>Svarṇadhana</s> is used, for such is the form of this day.

children.text: pluvau vā etāv upohante svargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai
children.translated_text: They bring forward these two floats for the complete attainment of the heavenly world.

children.text: gaurīvitaṃ bhavati yad eva gaurīvitasya brāhmaṇam
children.translated_text: It is the <s>Gaurīvita</s>; just what is the brāhmaṇa explanation of the <s>Gaurīvita</s> applies.

children.text: krauñcaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: It is the <s>Krauñca</s>.

children.text: vāg vai krauñcaṃ vāg dvādaśāho vācy eva tad vācā stuvate yajñasya prabhūtyai
children.translated_text: Speech is the <s>Krauñca</s>; speech is the <s>Dvādaśāha</s>. Therefore with speech itself they praise in speech, for the prosperity of the sacrifice.

children.text: yāmaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: It is the <s>Yāma</s>.

children.text: etena vai yamo 'napajayyam amuṣya lokasyādhipatyam āśnutānapajayyam amuṣya lokasyādhipatyam aśnute yāmena tuṣṭuvānaḥ
children.translated_text: By this <s>Yama</s> attained the unconquerable lordship of yonder world. One who praises with the <s>Yāma</s> attains the unconquerable lordship of yonder world.

children.text: etena vai yamī yamaṃ svargaṃ lokam agamayat svargasya lokasyānukhyātyai svargāl lokān na cyavate tuṣṭuvānaḥ stomaḥ ||
children.translated_text: By this <s>Yamī</s> led <s>Yama</s> to the heavenly world. It serves for the perception of the heavenly world. One who praises does not fall from the heavenly worlds. This is the <s>stoma</s>.

children.text: ehy ū ṣu bravāṇi ta ity ehivatyai bhavanti tṛtīyasyāhna upahavāya santatyai
children.translated_text: 'ehi ū ṣu bravāṇi te': they contain 'ehi,' for the invocation of the third day and for continuity.

children.text: apacchid iva vā etad yajñakāṇḍaṃ yad ukthāni yad eti salomatvāya
children.translated_text: The section of the sacrifice that consists of the <s>ukthas</s> is as if cut off; when it contains 'eti,' it is for being furnished with hair.

children.text: evāhy asi vīrayur iti samānaṃ vadantīdam ittham asad iti
children.translated_text: 'evā hy asi vīrayuḥ': they say the same thing, 'May this be thus, in this way.'

children.text: indraṃ viśvā avīvṛdhann ity avardhanta hy etarhi yajamānam evaitayā vardhanti
children.translated_text: 'indraṃ viśvā avīvṛdhan': for at that time they increased; with this verse they increase the sacrificer himself.

children.text: sākam aśvaṃ bhavaty ukthānām abhijityā abhikrāntyai
children.translated_text: The <s>Sākamaśva</s> is used, for the conquest and advance of the <s>ukthas</s>.

children.text: etena hy agra ukthāny adhyajayann etenābhyakrāman
children.translated_text: For with this they first conquered the <s>ukthas</s>; with this they advanced upon them.

children.text: āmahīyavaṃ bhavati kﾱptiś cānnādyaṃ ca samānaṃ vadantīṣu kriyata idam ittham asad iti
children.translated_text: The <s>Āmahīyava</s> is used; the corrupt term kﾱptiś and food are effected among verses that say the same thing, 'May this be thus, in this way.'

children.text: kṣatraṃ vā etad ahar abhinirvadati yat pañcadaśaṃ yad gāyatrīṣu brahmasāma bhavati brahma caiva tat kṣatraṃ ca sayujī karoti brahmaiva kṣatrasya purastān nidadhati brahmaṇe kṣatraṃ ca viśaṃ cānuge karoti
children.translated_text: This day indeed proclaims <s>kṣatra</s> (royal power), because it is the <s>Pañcadaśa</s> <s>stoma</s>. When the <s>Brahmasāman</s> is on the <s>Gāyatrīs</s>, he thereby makes <s>brahman</s> (sacred authority) and <s>kṣatra</s> joined together; he places <s>brahman</s> in front of <s>kṣatra</s>, and makes <s>kṣatra</s> and the <s>viś</s> (the people) followers of <s>brahman</s>.

children.text: brahma vai pūrvam ahaḥ kṣatraṃ dvitīyaṃ yad gāyatrīṣu brahma sāma bhavati brahma tad yaśasārdhayati brahma hi gāyatrī
children.translated_text: The first day is indeed <s>brahman</s>, the second <s>kṣatra</s>. When the <s>Brahmasāman</s> is on the <s>Gāyatrīs</s>, he thereby increases <s>brahman</s> with glory; for the <s>Gāyatrī</s> is <s>brahman</s>.

children.text: tad u samānaṃ vadantīṣu kriyate samṛddhyai
children.translated_text: That, then, is performed among [verses] saying the same thing, for complete success.

children.text: āṣṭādaṃṣṭre bhavataḥ
children.translated_text: There are two <s>Āṣṭādaṃṣṭra</s> [sāmans].

children.text: aiyāhā iti vā indro vṛtram ahann aiyādohoveti nyagṛhṇād vārtraghne sāmanī vīryavatī
children.translated_text: For with 'aiyāhā' <s>Indra</s> slew <s>Vṛtra</s>, and with 'aiyādohove' he overpowered him. The two <s>sāmans</s> are Vṛtra-slaying and full of heroic power.

children.text: ojo evaitābhyāṃ vīryam avarundhe
children.translated_text: With these two he secures vigor and heroic power.

children.text: pañcadaśa eva stomo bhavaty ojasy eva tad vīrye pratitiṣṭhaty ojo vīryaṃ pañcadaśaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The <s>stoma</s> is precisely the <s>Pañcadaśa</s>; thereby he stands established in vigor and heroic power. The <s>Pañcadaśa</s> is vigor and heroic power.

children.text: Chapter 12
davidyutaty āruceti tṛtīyasyāhnaḥ pratipad bhavati
children.translated_text: 'Davidyutaty ārucā' is the opening verse of the third day.

children.text: davidyutatī vai gāyatrī pariṣṭobhantī triṣṭub gavāśīr jagatī trīṇi rūpāṇi samārabhate trirātrasyāvisraṃsāya
children.translated_text: The flashing one is the <s>Gāyatrī</s>; the one surrounded by <s>stobhas</s> is the <s>Triṣṭubh</s>; the cow-mixed one is the <s>Jagatī</s>. He takes up three forms, so that the <s>Trirātra</s> (three-night rite) may not fall apart.

children.text: ete asṛgram indava ity anurūpo bhavati
children.translated_text: 'Ete asṛgram indavaḥ' is the corresponding verse.

children.text: eta iti vai prajāpatir devān asṛjatāsṛgram iti manuṣyān indava iti pitṝṃs tad eva tad abhivadati
children.translated_text: With 'eta' <s>Prajāpati</s> created the gods, with 'asṛgram' human beings, and with 'indavaḥ' the <s>Pitṛs</s> (Fathers). This is what it thereby states.

children.text: pūrvam u caiva tad repam apareṇa rūpeṇānuvadati yat pūrvaṃ rūpam apareṇa rūpeṇo 'nuvadati tad anurūpasyānurūpatvam anurūpa enaṃ putro jāyate ya evaṃ veda
children.translated_text: And he repeats that earlier form with the later form. Because he repeats the earlier form with the later form, that is the correspondence of the corresponding verse. A son corresponding to him is born to one who knows thus.

children.text: stotrīyānurūpau tṛco bhavataḥ prāṇāpānānām avaruddhyai
children.translated_text: The <s>stotrīya</s> and the <s>anurūpa</s> are two triplets of verses, for securing the breaths and out-breaths.

children.text: rājā medhābhir īyate pavamāno manāv adhy antarikṣeṇa yātava iti
children.translated_text: 'The king moves by inspired powers; the purifying one, among men, is to go by way of the midspace.'

children.text: antarikṣadevatyas tṛco bhavaty antarikṣadevatyam etad ahar yat tṛtīyaṃ tad eva tad abhivadati
children.translated_text: The triplet has the midspace as its deity. This third day has the midspace as its deity; this is what it thereby states.

children.text: pañcarcau bhavati pañcapadā paṅktiḥ pāṅktam annam annādyasyāvaruddhyai
children.translated_text: It consists of five verses. The <s>Paṅkti</s> has five feet; food is <s>Paṅkti</s>-like. This is for securing food and the eating of food.

children.text: tṛca uttamo bhavati yenaiva prāṇena prayanti tam abhyupayānti
children.translated_text: The last is a triplet of verses. With the very breath with which they go forth, they return to it.

children.text: saptadaśa eva stomo bhavati pratiṣṭhāyai prajātyai ||
children.translated_text: The <s>stoma</s> is precisely the <s>Saptadaśa</s>, for stability and procreation.

children.text: agnināgniḥ samidhyata ity āgneyam ājyaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: 'By <s>Agni</s>, <s>Agni</s> is kindled' is the <s>ājya</s> addressed to <s>Agni</s>.

children.text: pūrve eva tad ahanī samiddhe tṛtīyam ahar abhisamindhe
children.translated_text: By that, when the two earlier days have been kindled, he kindles the third day as well.

children.text: mitraṃ huve pūtadakṣam iti rāthantaram maitrāvaruṇam
children.translated_text: 'I call <s>Mitra</s> of purified skill' is the <s>Rathantara</s> chant for <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>.

children.text: huva iti vai rāthantaraṃ rūpam
children.translated_text: 'Huve' is indeed the form of the <s>Rathantara</s>.

children.text: rathantaram etat parokṣaṃ yad vairūpaṃ rāthantaram eva tad rūpaṃ nirdyotayati
children.translated_text: This <s>Vairūpa</s> is the <s>Rathantara</s> in hidden form; thereby he makes the <s>Rathantara</s> form shine forth.

children.text: indreṇa saṃ hi dṛkṣusa ity aindram
children.translated_text: 'For together with <s>Indra</s> you are seen' is addressed to <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: sam iva vā ime lokā dadṛśire 'ntarikṣadevatyam etad ahar yat tṛtīyaṃ tad eva tad abhivadati
children.translated_text: These worlds seemed, as it were, to be seen together. This third day has the midspace as its deity; this is what it thereby states.

children.text: tā huve yayor idam iti rāthantaram aindrāgnam
children.translated_text: 'Those two I call, to whom this [belongs]' is the <s>Rathantara</s> chant addressed to <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>.

children.text: huva iti vai rāthantaraṃ rūpaṃ rathantaram etat parokṣaṃ yad vairūpaṃ rāthantaram eva tad rūpaṃ nirdyotayati stomaḥ ||
children.translated_text: 'Huve' is indeed the form of the <s>Rathantara</s>. This <s>Vairūpa</s> is the <s>Rathantara</s> in hidden form; thereby he makes the <s>Rathantara</s> form shine forth. This is the <s>stoma</s>.

children.text: uccā te jātam andhasa iti gāyatrī bhavati
children.translated_text: 'High for you has the Soma juice been born' is in the <s>Gāyatrī</s> metre.

children.text: udvad vā etad ahar yat tṛtīyaṃ tad eva tad abhivadati
children.translated_text: This day is upward-going, namely the third day; this is what it thereby states.

children.text: andhasvatī bhavaty ahar vā andho 'hna ārambhaḥ
children.translated_text: It contains <s>andhas</s> (Soma juice); for the day is <s>andhas</s>, and <s>andhas</s> is the beginning of the day.

children.text: abhi somāsa āyava iti
children.translated_text: 'The <s>Somas</s>, active, have gone toward' [is used].

children.text: abhīti rathantarasya rūpaṃ bṛhad iti bṛhata ubhayoḥ saha rūpam upaityubhau hi varṇāvetad ahaḥ
children.translated_text: 'Abhi' is the form of the <s>Rathantara</s>; 'bṛhat' is the form of the <s>Bṛhat</s>. It reaches the form of both together, for this day has both classes.

children.text: tisro vāca īrayati pravahnir iti tṛtīyasyāhno rūpaṃ tena tṛtīyam ahar ārabhante
children.translated_text: 'The carrier sets the three voices in motion' is the form of the third day; by it they begin the third day.

children.text: triṣṭubhaḥ satyo jagatyo rūpeṇa jāgataṃ hyetad ahaḥ
children.translated_text: Though a <s>Triṣṭubh</s>, it is truly in the form of a <s>Jagatī</s>, for this day belongs to the <s>Jagatī</s>.

children.text: gāyatraṃ bhavati yad eva gāyatrasya brāhmaṇam
children.translated_text: It is <s>Gāyatra</s>; whatever is the Brāhmaṇa explanation of the <s>Gāyatra</s> [applies].

children.text: vaiṣṭambhaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: It is the <s>Vaiṣṭambha</s>.

children.text: ahar vā etad avlīyata tad devā vaiṣṭambhair vyaṣṭabhnuvaṃs tad vaiṣṭambhasya vaiṣṭambhatvam
children.translated_text: This day was slipping away. The gods propped it up with the <s>Vaiṣṭambhas</s>; that is why the <s>Vaiṣṭambha</s> is called <s>Vaiṣṭambha</s>.

children.text: diśa iti nidhanam upayanti diśāṃ dhṛtyai
children.translated_text: They come to the <s>nidhana</s> with 'diśaḥ' ('the directions'), for the support of the directions.

children.text: paurūmadgaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: It is the <s>Paurūmadga</s>.

children.text: ahar vā etad avlīyamānaṃ tad rakṣāṃsy anvasacanta tasmād devāḥ paurūmadgena rakṣāṃsyapāghnann apa pāpmānaṃ hate paurūmadgena tuṣṭuvānaḥ
children.translated_text: As this day was slipping away, the <s>Rakṣases</s> followed after it. Therefore the gods drove away the <s>Rakṣases</s> with the <s>Paurūmadga</s>. One who praises with the <s>Paurūmadga</s> drives away evil.

children.text: devāś ca vāsurāś cāspardhanta te devā asurāṇāṃ paurūmadgena puro 'majjayan yat puro 'majjayaṃstasmāt paurūmadgaṃ pāpmānam evaitena bhrātṛvyaṃ majjayati
children.translated_text: The gods and the <s>Asuras</s> contended. With the <s>Paurūmadga</s> the gods sank the strongholds of the <s>Asuras</s>. Because they sank the strongholds, therefore it is called <s>Paurūmadga</s>. With this he sinks evil, the rival.

children.text: gautamaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: It is the <s>Gautama</s>.

children.text: yad eva gautamasya brāhmaṇam
children.translated_text: Whatever is the Brāhmaṇa explanation of the <s>Gautama</s> [applies].

children.text: ubhayataḥ stotraṃ tathā hy etasyāhno rūpam
children.translated_text: The <s>stotra</s> is on both sides; for such is the form of this day.

children.text: antarikṣaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: It is the midspace.

children.text: antarikṣadevatyam etad ahar yat tṛtīyam antarikṣa eva tad antarikṣeṇa stuvate pratiṣṭhāyai
children.translated_text: This third day has the midspace as its deity; thus they praise in the midspace with the midspace, for stability.

children.text: āṣkāraṇidhanaṃ kāṇvaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: It is the <s>Kāṇva</s> with the <s>āṣkāra</s> as its <s>nidhana</s>.

children.text: as iti vai rāthantaraṃ rūpaṃ has iti bārhataṃ tṛtīyam eva tad rūpam upayanti samṛddhyai
children.translated_text: 'As' is indeed the <s>Rathantara</s> form, and 'has' the <s>Bārhata</s> form. Thereby they reach that very third form, for complete success.

children.text: aṅgirasāṃ saṃkrośo bhavati
children.translated_text: There is the collective cry of the <s>Aṅgirases</s>.

children.text: etena vā aṅgirasaḥ saṃkrośamānāḥ svargaṃ lokam āpan svargasya lokasyānukhyātyai svargāllokān na cyavate tuṣṭuvānaḥ stomaḥ ||
children.translated_text: With this the <s>Aṅgirases</s>, crying out together, reached the heavenly world. It is for the proclamation of the heavenly world. One who praises does not fall from the heavenly world. This is the <s>stoma</s>.

children.text: yady āva indra te śatam iti śatavatyo bhavanti
children.translated_text: 'If your aids, O <s>Indra</s>, are a hundred' and the others contain the word 'hundred.'

children.text: śatavad vai paśūnāṃ rūpaṃ sahasravat paśūnām evaitābhī rūpam avarundhe
children.translated_text: The form of cattle is indeed hundredfold, and the form of cattle is thousandfold. With these [verses] he secures the form of cattle.

children.text: vayaṅghatvā sutāvanta iti satobṛhatyo varṣīyaś chanda ākramate 'napabhraṃśāya
children.translated_text: With the verses 'vayaṃ gha tvā' and 'sutāvantaḥ' as <s>Satobṛhatī</s>s, he steps onto the higher metre, so that there may be no slipping down.

children.text: taraṇir it siṣāsati vājaṃ purandhyā yujā
children.translated_text: 'The swift one indeed seeks to win the prize, yoked with abundant insight.'

children.text: āva indraṃ puruhūtaṃ na me girety āvad akṣaram uddhatam iva vai tṛtīyam ahar yad eva tāvad akṣaraṃ bhavaty ahar evaitena pratiṣṭhāpayati
children.translated_text: In 'āva <s>Indra</s>ṃ puruhūtaṃ na me gireti' there is, as it were, a raised syllable. The third day is indeed as if raised up; whatever syllable is of such extent, by that he establishes the day itself.

children.text: pañcanidhanaṃ vairūpaṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ bhavati diśāṃ dhṛtyai
children.translated_text: The <s>Vairūpa</s> <s>pṛṣṭha</s> has five <s>nidhana</s>s, for the support of the directions.

children.text: pañcapadā paṅktiḥ pāṅktam annam annāghasyāvaruddhyai
children.translated_text: The <s>Paṅkti</s> has five feet; food is connected with the <s>Paṅkti</s>, for the securing of food to be eaten.

children.text: diśāṃ vā etat sāma yad vairūpaṃ diśo hy evaitenābhivadati
children.translated_text: This <s>sāman</s> which is the <s>Vairūpa</s> belongs to the directions, for by it he addresses the directions.

children.text: atha yat pañcanidhanaṃ tenartūnāṃ pañca hy ṛtavaḥ
children.translated_text: And because it has five <s>nidhana</s>s, by that it belongs to the seasons, for there are five seasons.

children.text: ṛtubhiś ca vā ime lokā digbhiś cāvṛtās teṣv evobhayeṣu yajamānaṃ pratiṣṭhāpayati yajamānaṃ vā anupratitiṣṭhantam udgātā pratitiṣṭhati ya evaṃ vidvān vairūpeṇodgāyati
children.translated_text: These worlds are enclosed by the seasons and by the directions; in those two he establishes the sacrificer. The <s>udgātṛ</s> stands firm after the sacrificer as he stands firm, when, knowing thus, he chants with the <s>Vairūpa</s>.

children.text: digvad bhavati bhrātṛvyasyāpanuttyai
children.translated_text: It possesses the directions, for driving away the rival.

children.text: diśaṃ viśam iti nidhanam upayanti diśāṃ dhṛtyai
children.translated_text: They approach the <s>nidhana</s> with 'diśaṃ viśam', for the support of the directions.

children.text: has ity upariṣṭād diśāṃ nidhanam upayanti tena bārhatam
children.translated_text: Afterward they approach the <s>nidhana</s> of the directions with 'has'; by that it is <s>Bārhata</s>.

children.text: rāthantaro vā ayaṃ loko bārhato 'sāv ubhe eva tad bṛhadrathantarayo rūpeṇāparādhnoti
children.translated_text: This world is <s>Rathantara</s>; yonder world is <s>Bārhata</s>. Thus he obtains both in the form of the <s>Bṛhat</s> and the <s>Rathantara</s>.

children.text: anaḍvāhau vā etau devayānau yajamānasya yad bṛhadrathantare tāv eva tad yunakti svargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai
children.translated_text: The <s>Bṛhat</s> and <s>Rathantara</s> are the two oxen on the sacrificer's path to the gods. He yokes those very two for the attainment of the heavenly world.

children.text: aśvavad bhavati prajātyai
children.translated_text: It possesses the horse, for procreation.

children.text: yathā maṇḍūka āṭ karoty evaṃ nidhanam upayanty ayātayāmatāyai
children.translated_text: As a frog makes the sound 'āṭ', so they approach the <s>nidhana</s>, for unfailing freshness.

children.text: dvādaśa vairūpāṇi bhavanti dvādaśamāsāḥ saṃvatsaraḥ saṃvatsara eva pratitiṣṭhati
children.translated_text: There are twelve <s>Vairūpa</s>s; the year is twelve months. He becomes established in the year itself.

children.text: virūpaḥ saṃvatsaro virūpam annādyasyāvaruddhyai
children.translated_text: The year is varied; it is varied, for the securing of food to be eaten.

children.text: mahāvaiṣṭambhaṃ brahmasāma bhavaty annādyasyāvaruddhyai
children.translated_text: The <s>Mahāvaiṣṭambha</s> is the <s>brahmasāman</s>, for the securing of food to be eaten.

children.text: yadā vai puruṣo 'nnam atty athāntarato viṣṭabdhaḥ
children.translated_text: When a man eats food, then he is supported from within.

children.text: diśa iti nidhanam upayanti diśāṃ dhṛtyai
children.translated_text: They approach the <s>nidhana</s> with 'diśaḥ', for the support of the directions.

children.text: sato bṛhatīṣu stuvanti pūrvayor ahnoḥ pratyudyamāya
children.translated_text: They chant on the <s>Satobṛhatī</s> verses, for rising up from the two preceding days.

children.text: rauravam acchāvākasāma bhavati
children.translated_text: The <s>Raurava</s> is the <s>Acchāvāka-sāman</s>.

children.text: agnir vai rūro rūdro 'gniḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> is <s>Rūra</s>; <s>Rudra</s> is <s>Agni</s>.

children.text: agnir vā etasya paśūn apakramayati yasya paśavo 'pakrāmanty agnir eva tasya paśūn abhikramayati yasya paśavo 'bhikrāmanti
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> makes the cattle go away from the man whose cattle go away; <s>Agni</s> makes the cattle come near to the man whose cattle come near.

children.text: abhy abhy evāsya paśavaḥ krāmanti ya evaṃ vidvān rauraveṇa stuvate
children.translated_text: The cattle come near, nearer and nearer, to the man who, knowing thus, chants with the <s>Raurava</s>.

children.text: pariṣṭubdheḍaṃ tathā hy etasyāhno rūpaṃ stomaḥ ||
children.translated_text: It is the <s>Pariṣṭubdheḍa</s>; for in this way the <s>stoma</s> is the form of this day.

children.text: tisro vāca udīrata iti tṛtīyasyāhno rūpaṃ tena tṛtīyam ahar ārabhante
children.translated_text: 'tisro vāca udīrata' is the form of the third day; with that they begin the third day.

children.text: udvad vā etat trivad ahar yat tṛtīyaṃ tad eva tad abhivadati
children.translated_text: This third day is uplifted and threefold; that very fact he thereby declares.

children.text: ā sotā pariṣiñcata iti parivatyo bhavanti
children.translated_text: The verses containing 'pari' are used, beginning 'ā sotā pariṣiñcata'.

children.text: anto vai tṛtīyam ahas tasyaitāḥ paryāptyai
children.translated_text: The third day is the end; these serve for its completion.

children.text: sakhāya āniṣīdata ity uddhattam iva vai tṛtīyam ahar yad āha niṣīdatety ahar evaitena pratiṣṭhāpayati
children.translated_text: At 'sakhāya ā niṣīdata' the third day is indeed as if raised up; when he says 'sit down', by that he establishes the day itself.

children.text: sutāso madhumattamā ity anuṣṭubhaḥ satyo jagatyo rūpeṇa jāgataṃ hy etad ahaḥ
children.translated_text: 'sutāso madhumattamāḥ' are <s>Anuṣṭubh</s> verses, yet in form they are truly <s>Jagatī</s>s, for this day is <s>Jāgata</s>.

children.text: pavitraṃ te vitataṃ brahmaṇaspata iti
children.translated_text: 'Your filter is stretched out, O <s>Brahmaṇaspati</s>.'

children.text: vitatam iva vā idam antarikṣam antareme antarikṣadevatyam etad ahar yat tṛtīyaṃ tad eva tad abhivadati
children.translated_text: This midspace is as if stretched out; the midspace is between these worlds. This third day has the midspace as its deity; that very fact he thereby declares.

children.text: gāyatraṃ bhavati yad eva gāyatrasya brāhmaṇam
children.translated_text: The <s>Gāyatra</s> is used; whatever is the <s>brāhmaṇa</s> explanation of the <s>Gāyatra</s> applies.

children.text: pāṣṭhauhaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: The <s>Pāṣṭhauha</s> is used.

children.text: paṣṭhavāḍ vā etenāṅgirasaś caturthasyāhno vācaṃ vadantīm upāśṛṇot sa ho vāg iti nidhanam upait tad asyābhyuditaṃ tad ahar avasat
children.translated_text: With this, <s>Paṣṭhavāḍ Āṅgirasa</s> heard Speech speaking of the fourth day. He approached the <s>nidhana</s> with 'ho vāk'; that was uttered for him, and that day came to rest.

children.text: vācaḥ sāma bhavati
children.translated_text: It is the <s>sāman</s> of Speech.

children.text: vāg vai dvādaśāho vācy eva tad vācā stuvate yajñasya prabhūtyai
children.translated_text: The <s>Dvādaśāha</s> is speech; there, in speech itself, they chant with speech, for the mastery of the sacrifice.

children.text: niṣkirīyāḥ sattram āsata te tṛtīyam ahar na prājānaṃs tān etat sāma gāyamānān vāg upāplavat tena tṛtīyam ahaḥ prājānaṃs te 'bruvann iyaṃ vāva nas tṛtīyam ahar adīdṛśad iti tṛtīyasyaivaiṣāhno dṛṣṭiḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>Niṣkirīya</s>s sat in a <s>sattra</s>. They did not recognize the third day. Speech came near to them as they were singing this <s>sāman</s>; by it they recognized the third day. They said, 'This indeed has shown us the third day.' This is precisely the vision of the third day.

children.text: śauktaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: The <s>Śaukta</s> is used.

children.text: śuktir vā etenāṅgiraso 'ñjasā svargaṃ lokam apaśyat svargasya lokasyānukhyātyai svargāl lokān na cyavate tuṣṭuvānaḥ
children.translated_text: With this, <s>Śukti Āṅgirasa</s> saw the heavenly world directly. It is for the sighting of the heavenly world; the one who chants it does not fall from the heavenly world.

children.text: gaurīvitaṃ bhavati yad eva gaurīvitasya brāhmaṇam
children.translated_text: The <s>Gaurīvita</s> is used; whatever is the <s>brāhmaṇa</s> explanation of the <s>Gaurīvita</s> applies.

children.text: tvāṣṭrīsāma bhavati
children.translated_text: The <s>Tvāṣṭrī-sāman</s> is used.

children.text: indraṃ vā akṣyāmayiṇaṃ bhūtāni nāsvāpayaṃs tam etena tvāṣṭrayo 'svāpayaṃs tad vāva tās tarhy akāmayanta
children.translated_text: The beings did not put <s>Indra</s>, who was afflicted in the eyes, to sleep; the <s>Tvāṣṭra</s>s put him to sleep with this. That indeed was what they desired then.

children.text: kāmasani sāma tvāṣṭrīsāma kāmam evaitenāvarundhe
children.translated_text: The <s>Tvāṣṭrī-sāman</s> is a desire-winning <s>sāman</s>; by this he secures desire itself.

children.text: indro vṛtrād bibhyad gāṃ prāviśat taṃ tvāṣṭrayo 'bruvaṃ janayāmeti tam etaiḥ sāmabhir ajanayaṃ jāyāmahā iti vai sattram āsate jāyanta eva
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s>, fearing <s>Vṛtra</s>, entered a cow. The <s>Tvāṣṭra</s>s said to him, 'Let us bring you to birth.' They brought him to birth with these <s>sāman</s>s. Saying 'May we be born,' they sit in the <s>sattra</s>; they are indeed born.

children.text: ariṣṭaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: The <s>Ariṣṭa</s> is used.

children.text: devāś ca vā asurāś cāspardhanta yaṃ devānām aghnan na sa samabhavad yam asurāṇāṃ saṃ so 'bhavat te devās tapo 'tapyanta ta etad ariṣṭam apaśyaṃs tato 'yaṃ devānām aghnat saṃ so 'bhavad yam asurāṇāṃ na sa samabhavad anenāriṣāmeti tad ariṣṭasyāriṣṭatvam ariṣṭayā evāriṣṭam antataḥ kriyate
children.translated_text: The gods and the asuras contended. Whomever of the gods they struck down did not become whole again; whomever of the asuras they struck down became whole again. The gods performed austerity, and they saw this <s>Ariṣṭa</s>. After that, whomever of the gods they struck down became whole again, and whomever of the asuras they struck down did not become whole again. 'May we remain uninjured by this,' they thought; that is the uninjured nature of the <s>Ariṣṭa</s>. At the end the <s>Ariṣṭa</s> is performed with what is uninjured, precisely for freedom from injury.

children.text: trīḍaṃ bhavati trirātrasya dhṛtyai
children.translated_text: The <s>Trīḍa</s> is used, for the support of the <s>Trirātra</s>.

children.text: dravantīm iḍām uttamām upayanti caturthasyāhnaḥ santatyai stomaḥ ||
children.translated_text: They come to the final flowing <s>iḍā</s>; this <s>stoma</s> is for the continuity of the fourth day.

children.text: pramaṃhiṣṭhīyaṃ gāyateti
children.translated_text: He says, "Sing the <s>Pramaṃhiṣṭhīya</s>."

children.text: yad gāyateti mahasa eva tad rūpaṃ kriyate
children.translated_text: When he says, "Sing," that very form of greatness is produced.

children.text: taṃ te mad aṅgaṇīm asīti madavad vai rasavat tṛtīyasavanaṃ madam eva tad rasaṃ dadhāti
children.translated_text: "You are that exhilaration-bearing member for him": the third pressing is indeed full of exhilaration and sap; thereby he places exhilaration and sap in it.

children.text: śrudhī havaṃ tiraścyā iti śrutyā eva
children.translated_text: "Hear the call crosswise": this is simply for hearing.

children.text: pramaṃhiṣṭhīyaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: The <s>Pramaṃhiṣṭhīya</s> is used.

children.text: pramaṃhiṣṭhīyena vā indro vṛtrāya vajraṃ prāvartayat tam astṛṇuta bhrātṛvyavān pramaṃhiṣṭhīyenokthāni praṇayeta stṛṇute bhrātṛvyaṃ vasīyāṃ ātmanā bhavati
children.translated_text: With the <s>Pramaṃhiṣṭhīya</s>, <s>Indra</s> set the thunderbolt in motion against <s>Vṛtra</s> and struck him down. One who has a rival should lead forth the <s>ukthas</s> with the <s>Pramaṃhiṣṭhīya</s>; he strikes down his rival and becomes better in himself.

children.text: hārivarṇaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: The <s>Hārivarṇa</s> is used.

children.text: indraś ca vai namuciś cāsuraḥ samadadhātāṃ na no naktaṃ na divāhanan nārdreṇa na śuṣkeṇeti tasya vyuṣṭāyām anudita āditye 'pāṃ phenena śiro 'chinad etad vai na naktaṃ na divā yat vyuṣṭāyām anudita āditya etan nārdraṃ na śuṣkaṃ yad apāṃ phenas tad enaṃ pāpīyāṃ vācaṃ vadad anvavartata vīrahan na druho druha iti tan narcā na sāmnāpahantum aśaknot
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> and <s>Namuci</s> the <s>Asura</s> made an agreement: "Let neither of us kill the other by night or by day, nor with what is wet or dry." At daybreak, before the sun had risen, <s>Indra</s> cut off his head with the foam of water. That which is daybreak before the sun has risen is neither night nor day; the foam of water is neither wet nor dry. Then an evil utterance followed him, saying, "O killer of a hero, do not betray the betrayer." He could not drive it away either with a verse or with a <s>sāman</s>.

children.text: hārivarṇasyaiva nidhanenāpāhata
children.translated_text: He drove it away with the <s>nidhana</s> of the <s>Hārivarṇa</s> alone.

children.text: apaśucaṃhate hārivarṇasya nidhanena śriyaṃ ca haraś copaiti tuṣṭuvānaḥ
children.translated_text: With the <s>nidhana</s> of the <s>Hārivarṇa</s> he drives off affliction; praising with it, he attains both prosperity and radiance.

children.text: tairaścyaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: The <s>Tairaścya</s> is used.

children.text: aṅgirasaḥ svargaṃ lokaṃ yanto rakṣāṃsy anvasacanta tāny etena tiraścāṅgirasas tiryaṅ paryavaid yat tiryaṅ aparyavait tasmāt tairaścyaṃ pāpmā vāva sa tān asacata taṃ tairaścyenāpāghnatāpa pāpmānaṃ hate tairaścyena tuṣṭuvānaḥ
children.translated_text: When the <s>Aṅgirases</s> were going to the heavenly world, demons followed after them. With this chant the <s>Aṅgirases</s> went around them crosswise. Because it went around crosswise, it is called <s>Tairaścya</s>. It was in fact evil that followed them, and with the <s>Tairaścya</s> they struck it away. Praising with the <s>Tairaścya</s>, he strikes away evil.

children.text: saptadaśa eva stomo bhavati pratiṣṭhāyai prajātyai ||
children.translated_text: The <s>stoma</s> is exactly seventeenfold, for establishment and for procreation.

children.text: pra ta āśvinīḥ pavamānadhenava iti caturthasyāhnaḥ pratipad bhavati
children.translated_text: "pra ta āśvinīḥ pavamānadhenavaḥ" is the opening verse of the fourth day.

children.text: āpte trirātre rūpeṇa gāyatryo dvitīyaṃ prayanti prati vai gāyatryā rūpam
children.translated_text: When the three-night rite has been reached, the <s>Gāyatrī</s> verses proceed second by form; for the form corresponds to the <s>Gāyatrī</s>.

children.text: jagatī pratipad bhavati jāgatam etad ahar yat tṛtīyaṃ jagatyā eva taj jagatīm abhisaṃkrāmanti
children.translated_text: The opening verse is in the <s>Jagatī</s> meter. This day, insofar as it is the third, is <s>Jāgata</s>; by means of the <s>Jagatī</s> they pass over to the <s>Jagatī</s>.

children.text: yad ato 'nyā pratipatsyāt pratikūlaṃ vānukūlaṃ vā syāt
children.translated_text: If some other opening verse than this were used, it would be either contrary or merely following along.

children.text: pavamāno ajījanad ity anurūpo bhavati
children.translated_text: "pavamāno ajījanat" is the matching verse.

children.text: janadvad vā etad ahar yac caturtham annādyaṃ janayati virājaṃ janayaty ekaviṃśaṃ stomaṃ janayati
children.translated_text: This fourth day is indeed generative: it generates food to be eaten, it generates the <s>Virāj</s>, and it generates the twenty-onefold <s>stoma</s>.

children.text: pūrvam u caiva tad rūpam apareṇa rūpeṇānuvadati tad anurūpasyānurūpatvam
children.translated_text: Moreover, it repeats the earlier form by means of the later form; that is the matching verse's character as a matching verse.

children.text: anurūpa enaṃ putro jāyate ya evaṃ veda
children.translated_text: A son resembling him is born to the one who knows this.

children.text: stotrīyānurūpau tṛcau bhavataḥ prāṇāpānānām avaruddhyai
children.translated_text: The <s>stotrīya</s> and <s>anurūpa</s> are two triplets, for securing the in-breaths and out-breaths.

children.text: ṣaḍṛcau bhavata ṛtūnāṃ dhṛtyai
children.translated_text: They are two groups of six verses, for the stability of the seasons.

children.text: tṛca uttamo bhavati yenaiva prāṇena prayanti tam abhyudyanti
children.translated_text: The last is a triplet; with the very breath by which they set out, they rise up to it.

children.text: ekaviṃśa eva stomo bhavati pratiṣṭhāyai pratitiṣṭhati ||
children.translated_text: The <s>stoma</s> is exactly twenty-onefold, for establishment; he becomes established.

children.text: janasya gopā ajaniṣṭa jāgṛviḥ ity āgneyam ājyaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: "janasya gopā ajaniṣṭa jāgṛviḥ" is the <s>Āgneya</s> <s>ājya</s> chant.

children.text: janadvad vā etad ahar yac caturtham annādyaṃ janayati virājaṃ janayaty ekaviṃśaṃ stomaṃ janayati
children.translated_text: This fourth day is indeed generative: it generates food to be eaten, it generates the <s>Virāj</s>, and it generates the twenty-onefold <s>stoma</s>.

children.text: ayaṃ vāṃ mitrāvaruṇā iti bārhataṃ maitrāvaruṇam
children.translated_text: "ayaṃ vāṃ mitrāvaruṇā" is the <s>Maitrāvaruṇa</s> chant in the <s>Bārhata</s> form.

children.text: bṛhad etat parokṣaṃ yad vairājaṃ bārhatam eva tad rūpaṃ nirdyotayati
children.translated_text: The <s>Vairāja</s> is this <s>Bṛhat</s> in hidden form; by the <s>Bārhata</s> he makes that very form shine forth.

children.text: indro dadhīco asthibhir iti dādhīcas tṛco bhavati
children.translated_text: "indro dadhīco asthibhiḥ" is the <s>Dādhīca</s> triplet.

children.text: dadhyaṅ vā āṅgiraso devānāṃ purodhānīya āsīd annaṃ vai brahmaṇaḥ purodhā annādyasyāvaruddhyai
children.translated_text: <s>Dadhyañc Āṅgirasa</s> was fit to be appointed as household priest for the gods. Food is the priesthood of the <s>brahman</s>; this is for securing food to be eaten.

children.text: iyaṃ vāmasya manmana ity aindrāgnam
children.translated_text: "iyaṃ vāmasya manmana" is the chant for <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>.

children.text: indrāgnī pūrvyastutir abhrād vṛṣṭir ivājani ity ānuṣṭubhī vai vṛṣṭir ānuṣṭubham etad ahar yac caturthaṃ samīcyau virājau dadhāty annādyāya stomaḥ ||
children.translated_text: "O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, the ancient praise has arisen like rain from a cloud": rain is indeed connected with the <s>Anuṣṭubh</s>, and this fourth day is <s>Ānuṣṭubha</s>. He places two corresponding <s>Virāj</s> meters for the sake of food to be eaten; the <s>stoma</s> serves that end.

children.text: payasva dakṣasādhana iti gāyatrī bhavati siddhyai
children.translated_text: "payasva dakṣasādhana" is in the <s>Gāyatrī</s> meter, for accomplishment.

children.text: yat pavasveti tad bṛhato rūpaṃ bārhataṃ hy etad ahaḥ
children.translated_text: The word "pavasva" is the form of the <s>Bṛhat</s>, for this day belongs to the <s>Bṛhat</s>.

children.text: tavāhaṃ soma rarāṇa sakhya indo dive dive
children.translated_text: I enjoy your friendship, O <s>Soma</s>, O <s>Indu</s>, day by day.

children.text: ati hy āyañchakunā iva paptim ety ati hy apatat
children.translated_text: For he went beyond; like a bird he goes to flight, for he flew beyond.

children.text: punāno akramīd abhīti
children.translated_text: "Purifying himself, he strode across."

children.text: gāyatryaḥ satyas triṣṭubho rūpeṇa tasmāt triṣṭubhāṃ loke kriyante
children.translated_text: They are truly <s>Gāyatrī</s> verses, but in form they are <s>Triṣṭubh</s>; therefore they are performed in the place of the <s>Triṣṭubh</s> verses.

children.text: gāyatraṃ bhavati yad eva gāyatrasya brāhmaṇam
children.translated_text: The <s>Gāyatra</s> is used; whatever is the <s>brāhmaṇa</s> explanation of the <s>Gāyatra</s> applies here.

children.text: caturṇidhanam ātharvaṇaṃ bhavati catūrātrasya dhṛtyai
children.translated_text: The four-<s>nidhana</s> <s>Ātharvaṇa</s> is used, for the stability of the four-night rite.

children.text: catuṣpadānuṣṭubhānuṣṭubham etad ahar yaccaturtham
children.translated_text: The <s>Anuṣṭubh</s> has four feet; this fourth day is <s>Ānuṣṭubha</s>.

children.text: bheṣajaṃ vātharvaṇāni bheṣajam eva tat karoti
children.translated_text: The <s>Ātharvaṇa</s> chants are a remedy; he thereby makes a remedy.

children.text: nidhanakāmaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: The <s>Nidhanakāma</s> is used.

children.text: ekaṃ vā anyena niruktena nidhanena kāmaṃ sanoty athaitan nidhanakāmaṃ sarveṣāṃ kāmānām avaruddhyai
children.translated_text: With one particular, defined <s>nidhana</s> one gains one desire; but this <s>Nidhanakāma</s> is for securing all desires.

children.text: āṣṭādaṃṣṭraṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: The <s>Āṣṭādaṃṣṭra</s> is used.

children.text: yad evāṣṭādaṃṣṭrasya brāhmaṇam
children.translated_text: Whatever is the <s>brāhmaṇa</s> explanation of the <s>Āṣṭādaṃṣṭra</s> applies here.

children.text: ābhīśavaṃ bhavaty ahno dhṛtyai
children.translated_text: The <s>Ābhīśava</s> is used, for the stability of the day.

children.text: yad vā adhṛtam abhīśunā tad dādhāra
children.translated_text: Whatever was unsupported, he held firm with a rein.

children.text: anutunnaṃ gāyati tathā hy etasyāhno rūpam
children.translated_text: He sings it unpierced; for such is the form of this day.

children.text: caturṇidhanam āṅgirasaṃ bhavati catūrātrasya dhṛtyai
children.translated_text: The four-<s>nidhana</s> <s>Āṅgirasa</s> is used, for the stability of the four-night rite.

children.text: svaḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ tathā hy etasyāhno rūpam
children.translated_text: The <s>pṛṣṭha</s> is <s>svaḥ</s>; for such is the form of this day.

children.text: sattrāsāhīyaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: The <s>Sattrāsāhīya</s> is used.

children.text: yad vā asurāṇām asoḍham āsīt tad devāḥ sattrāsāhīyenāsahanta sattrainān asakṣmahīti tat sattrāsāhīyasya sattrāsāhīyatvam
children.translated_text: Whatever among the <s>Asuras</s> was unbearable, the gods overpowered with the <s>Sattrāsāhīya</s>, saying, "By the <s>sattra</s> we have overpowered them." That is why the <s>Sattrāsāhīya</s> is called <s>Sattrāsāhīya</s>.

children.text: sattrā bhrātṛvyaṃ sahate sattrāsāhīyena tuṣṭuvānaḥ
children.translated_text: Through the <s>sattra</s> he overcomes his rival when he chants with the <s>Sattrāsāhīya</s>.

children.text: gāyatrīṣu stuvanti pratiṣṭhāyai brahmavarcasāya yenaiva prāṇena prayanti tam abhyudyanti
children.translated_text: They chant on <s>Gāyatrī</s> verses for firm establishment and for <s>brahmavarcas</s> (sacred radiance); by the very breath with which they set forth, they rise up to it.

children.text: vṛṣaṇvatyo gāyatrayo bhavanti tad u traiṣṭubhād rūpān nayanti stomaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Gāyatrī</s> verses contain the word "vṛṣan"; thus they carry the <s>stoma</s> away from the form of the <s>Triṣṭubh</s>.

children.text: pibā somam indra mandatu tvā yante suṣāva haryaśvādriḥ
children.translated_text: "Drink the soma, O <s>Indra</s>; let it gladden you, which the stone has pressed for you, O <s>Haryaśva</s>."

children.text: viśvāḥ pṛtanā abhibhṛtarannara ity atijagatī varṣīyayaś chanda ākramate 'napabhraṃśāya
children.translated_text: With "viśvāḥ pṛtanā abhibhṛtarannaraḥ" there is an <s>Atijagatī</s>; he steps onto a longer metre so that there may be no slipping down.

children.text: apabhraṃśa iva vā eṣa yajjyāyasaś chandasaḥ kanīyaś chanda upaiti yad eṣā caturthe 'hany atijagatī kriyate 'napabhraṃśāya
children.translated_text: For this is like a slipping down: when one comes from a larger metre to a smaller metre. Since this <s>Atijagatī</s> is performed on the fourth day, it is for not slipping down.

children.text: yo rājā carṣaṇīnām iti
children.translated_text: The verse is "yo rājā carṣaṇīnām."

children.text: rājye hy etarhi vāco 'gacchan rājyam evaitayā yajamānaṃ gamayanti
children.translated_text: For at this point they reached the sovereignty of speech; with this verse they lead the sacrificer precisely to sovereignty.

children.text: chandobhir vai devā ādityaṃ svargaṃ lokam aharan sa nādhriyata taṃ vairājasya nidhanenādṛṃhaṃs tasmāt parāṅ cārvāṅ cādityas tapati parāṅ cārvāṅ cekāraḥ
children.translated_text: By means of the metres the gods carried <s>Āditya</s> to the heavenly world. He did not hold firm, so they made him firm with the <s>nidhana</s> of the <s>Vairāja</s>. Therefore <s>Āditya</s> shines both away and toward, and the syllable "e" is both away and toward.

children.text: prastāvaṃ prastutya viṣṭambhān viṣṭabhnoti mukhata eva tad annādyaṃ dhatte mukhaṃ hi sāmnaḥ prastāvaḥ
children.translated_text: Having begun the <s>prastāva</s>, he supports the <s>viṣṭambha</s>s; thereby he places food to be eaten at the mouth, for the <s>prastāva</s> is the mouth of the <s>sāman</s>.

children.text: daśakṛtvo viṣṭabhnoti daśākṣarā virāḍ vairājam annam annādyasyāvaruddhyai
children.translated_text: He supports it ten times. The <s>Virāj</s> has ten syllables; food is <s>Vairāja</s>, for the securing of food to be eaten.

children.text: triṃśatkṛtvo viṣṭabhnoti bhūyaso 'nnādyasyāvaruddhyai
children.translated_text: He supports it thirty times, for the securing of more food to be eaten.

children.text: vairājaṃ sāma bhavati virāṭsu stuvanti vairājā viṣṭambhāḥ samīcīr virājo dadhāty annādyāya
children.translated_text: The <s>Vairāja</s> <s>sāman</s> is used; they chant on <s>Virāj</s> verses; the <s>viṣṭambha</s>s are <s>Vairāja</s>. He sets the <s>Virāj</s> verses in proper order for food to be eaten.

children.text: anutunnaṃ gāyati retodheyāyānutunnāddhi reto dhīyate
children.translated_text: He sings it unbroken, for the placing of seed; for seed is placed from what is unbroken.

children.text: dakṣiṇa ūrāv udgātur agniṃ manthanti dakṣiṇato hi retaḥ sicyate
children.translated_text: They churn the fire on the right thigh of the <s>udgātṛ</s>, for seed is poured from the right side.

children.text: upākṛte 'hiṅkṛte manthanti jātam abhihiṅkaroti
children.translated_text: They churn it after it has been prepared, before the <s>hiṅkāra</s>; when it has been born, he utters the <s>hiṅkāra</s> over it.

children.text: tasmājjātaṃ putraṃ paśavo 'bhihiṅkurvanti
children.translated_text: Therefore the cattle low over a son when he has been born.

children.text: tasmai jātāyāmīmāṃsanta gārhapatye praharāmā3 āgnīdhrā3 āhavanīyā3 iti
children.translated_text: For that newborn one they debated, "Shall we cast it into the <s>Gārhapatya</s>? Into the <s>Āgnīdhra</s>? Into the <s>Āhavanīya</s>?"

children.text: āhavanīye praharanty etad āyatano vai yajamāno yadā havanīye svam eva tad āyatanaṃ jyotiṣmat karoti
children.translated_text: They cast it into the <s>Āhavanīya</s>. The <s>Āhavanīya</s> is the sacrificer's abode; thereby he makes his own abode luminous.

children.text: jyotiṣmān brahmavarcasī bhavati ya evaṃ veda
children.translated_text: The one who knows thus becomes luminous and possessed of <s>brahmavarcas</s>.

children.text: abhijuhoti śāntyai
children.translated_text: He offers over it, for pacification.

children.text: ājyenābhijuhoti tejo vā ājyaṃ teja eva tad ātman dhatte
children.translated_text: He offers over it with ghee. Ghee is brilliance; thereby he places brilliance in himself.

children.text: preddho agne dīdihi puro na iti virājābhijuhoty annaṃ virāḍ annādyasyāvaruddhyai
children.translated_text: With a <s>Virāj</s> verse, "Kindled forth, O <s>Agni</s>, shine before us," he offers over it. The <s>Virāj</s> is food, for the securing of food to be eaten.

children.text: traiśokaṃ brahmasāma bhavati
children.translated_text: The <s>Traiśoka</s> is the <s>brahmasāman</s>.

children.text: atijagatīṣu stuvanty ahna utkrāntyā ud vā etenāhnā krāmanti
children.translated_text: They chant on <s>Atijagatī</s> verses for the surpassing of the day; with this day they step upward.

children.text: diveti nidhanam upayanti pāpmano 'pahatyā apa pāpmānaṃ hate traiśokena tuṣṭuvānaḥ
children.translated_text: They approach the <s>nidhana</s> with "diva," for the smiting away of evil. The one who chants with the <s>Traiśoka</s> smites evil away.

children.text: bhāradvājasya pṛśny achāvākasāma bhavati
children.translated_text: The <s>Pṛśni</s> of <s>Bhāradvāja</s> is the <s>Acchāvāka-sāman</s>.

children.text: annaṃ vai devāḥ pṛśnīti vadanty annādyasyāvaruddhyai
children.translated_text: The gods call food "pṛśni"; this is for the securing of food to be eaten.

children.text: iḍābhir aiḍaṃ tathā hy etasyāhno rūpaṃ stomaḥ ||
children.translated_text: With <s>Iḍā</s> verses it is <s>Aiḍa</s>; for thus the <s>stoma</s> is the form of this day.

children.text: paripriyā divaḥ kavir iti parivatyo bhavanty anto vai caturtham ahas tasyaitāḥ paryāptyai
children.translated_text: The verses containing "pari" begin "paripriyā divaḥ kaviḥ." The fourth day is an end, and these are for its completion.

children.text: tvaṃ hy aṅga daivyeti tvam iti bṛhato rūpaṃ bārhataṃ hy etad ahaḥ
children.translated_text: With "tvaṃ hy aṅga daivya," the word "tvam" is the form of the <s>Bṛhat</s>, for this day is <s>Bārhata</s>.

children.text: somaḥ punāna ūrmiṇā vyaṃvāraṃ vidhāvati
children.translated_text: "Purifying himself, <s>Soma</s> runs with a wave through the filter."

children.text: agre vācaḥ pavamānaḥ kanikradad iti
children.translated_text: "At the forefront of speech, purifying himself, he roars."

children.text: agraṃ hy etarhi vāco 'gacchann agram evaitayā yajamānaṃ gamayanti
children.translated_text: For at this point they reached the forefront of speech; with this verse they lead the sacrificer precisely to the forefront.

children.text: puro jitīvo andhasā iti virājau vairājaṃ hy etad ahaḥ
children.translated_text: There are two <s>Virāj</s> verses beginning "puro jitīvo andhasā," for this day is <s>Vairāja</s>.

children.text: somaḥ pavate janitā matīnām iti prātassavane ṣoḍaśinaṃ gṛhītaṃ taṃ tṛtīyasavane prajanayanti
children.translated_text: With "<s>Soma</s> flows, begetter of inspirations," the <s>Ṣoḍaśin</s> that was taken at the morning pressing is brought to birth at the third pressing.

children.text: triṣṭubhaḥ satyo jagatyo rūpeṇa tasmājjagatīnāṃ loke kriyante
children.translated_text: They are truly <s>Triṣṭubh</s> verses but <s>Jagatī</s> in form; therefore they are performed in the place of <s>Jagatī</s> verses.

children.text: gāyatraṃ bhavati yad eva gāyatrasya brāhmaṇam
children.translated_text: The <s>Gāyatra</s> is used; whatever is the <s>brāhmaṇa</s> explanation of the <s>Gāyatra</s> applies.

children.text: aurṇāyavaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: The <s>Aurṇāyava</s> is used.

children.text: aṅgiraso vai sattram āsata teṣām āptaḥ spṛtaḥ svargo loka āsīt panthānaṃ tu devayānaṃ na prājānaṃs teṣāṃ kalyāṇa āṅgiraso dhyāyam udavrajat sa ūrṇāyuṃ gandharvam apsarasāṃ madhye preṅkhayamāṇam upait sa iyām iti yāṃ yām abhyadiśat sainam akāmayata tam abhyavadat kālyāṇā3 ity āso vai vaḥ spṛtaḥ svargo lokaḥ panthānaṃ tu devayānaṃ na prajānīthedaṃ sāma svargyaṃ lokam eṣy atha mā tu voco'ham adarśam iti
children.translated_text: The <s>Aṅgirases</s> sat in a <s>sattra</s>. The heavenly world was attained and within their reach, but they did not know the path leading to the gods. <s>Kalyāṇa Āṅgirasa</s>, one of them, went out pondering. He approached <s>Ūrṇāyu</s> the <s>Gandharva</s>, who was swinging among the <s>Apsarases</s>. Whichever one he pointed out, saying, "This one," she desired him. He said to him, "O <s>Kalyāṇa</s>, your heavenly world is attained and within reach, but you do not know the path leading to the gods. This <s>sāman</s> leads to the heavenly world; you will reach the heavenly world. But do not say of me, 'I showed it.'"

children.text: sa ait kalyāṇaḥ so 'bravīd āpto vai naḥ spṛtaḥ svargo lokaḥ panthānaṃ tu devayānaṃ prajānīma idaṃ sāma svargyaṃ tena stutvā svargaṃ lokam eṣyāma iti kas te 'vocad ity aham evādarśam iti tena stutvā svargaṃ lokam āyann ahīyata kalyāṇo 'nṛtaṃ hi so 'vadat sa eṣaḥ śvitraḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Kalyāṇa</s> went back. He said, "The heavenly world is attained and within our reach, but now we know the path leading to the gods. This <s>sāman</s> leads to the heavenly world; after chanting with it we shall reach the heavenly world." They asked, "Who told you?" He said, "I myself saw it." After chanting with it they went to the heavenly world, but <s>Kalyāṇa</s> was left behind, for he had spoken falsely. This is that <s>Śvitra</s>.

children.text: svargyaṃ vā etat sāma svargalokaḥ puṇyaloko bhavaty aurṇāyavena tuṣṭuvānaḥ
children.translated_text: This <s>sāman</s> indeed leads to heaven; the one who chants with the <s>Aurṇāyava</s> obtains the heavenly world, the world of merit.

children.text: bṛhatkaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: The <s>Bṛhatka</s> is used.

children.text: sāmārṣeyeṇa praśastaṃ tvaṃ hīty annādyasyāvaruddhyai hīti vā annaṃ pradīyate ṣoḍaśinam u caivaitenodyacchati
children.translated_text: It is praised in the <s>Sāmārṣeya</s> with "tvaṃ hi," for the securing of food to be eaten; for with "hi" food is given, and by this he also raises up the <s>Ṣoḍaśin</s>.

children.text: ātīṣādīyaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: The <s>Ātīṣādīya</s> is used.

children.text: āyur vā ātīṣādīyam āyuṣo 'varuddhyai
children.translated_text: The <s>Ātīṣādīya</s> is life, for the securing of life.

children.text: ātamitor nidhanam upayanty āyur eva sarvam āpnuvanti
children.translated_text: They approach the <s>nidhana</s> of the <s>Ātamitor</s>; thereby they obtain life in its entirety.

children.text: nānadaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: The <s>Nānada</s> is used.

children.text: jyāyo 'bhyārambham atihāya pañcam ahaḥ ṣaṣṭhasyāhna ārambhas tena ṣaṣṭham ahar ārabhante santatyai
children.translated_text: Having passed beyond the greater beginning, the fifth day is the beginning of the sixth day; by it they begin the sixth day, for continuity.

children.text: ṣoḍaśākṣareṇa prastauti ṣoḍaśinam u caivaitenodyacchati
children.translated_text: He makes the <s>prastāva</s> with a sixteen-syllable verse, and by this he also raises up the <s>ṣoḍaśin</s>.

children.text: āndhīgavaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: The <s>Āndhīgava</s> is used.

children.text: kayor annādyam avarūndha āndhīgavena tuṣṭuvānaḥ
children.translated_text: By chanting with the <s>Āndhīgava</s>, he secures food to be eaten for the two.

children.text: vātsapraṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: The <s>Vātsapra</s> is used.

children.text: etasmin vai vairājaṃ pratiṣṭhitaṃ pratitiṣṭhati vātsapreṇa tuṣṭuvānaḥ
children.translated_text: In this the <s>Vairāja</s> is established; he becomes established by chanting with the <s>Vātsapra</s>.

children.text: vatsaprīr bhālandanaḥ śraddhāṃ nāvindata sa tapo 'tapyata sa etad vātsapram apaśyat sa śraddhām avindata śraddhā vindāmahā iti vai sattram āsate vindate śraddhām
children.translated_text: <s>Vatsaprī Bhālandana</s> did not find faith. He performed austerity, and he saw this <s>Vātsapra</s>; then he found faith. They sit in the <s>sattra</s> thinking, 'May we find faith'; he finds faith.

children.text: īnidhanaṃ tathā hy etasyāhno rūpaṃ nidhanāntāḥ pavamānā bhavanty ahno dhṛtyai stomaḥ ||
children.translated_text: It has ī as its <s>nidhana</s>, for such is the form of this day. The <s>pavamāna</s>s have <s>nidhana</s>s at the end, for the support of the day. This is the <s>stoma</s>.

children.text: agniṃ vo vṛdhantam iti
children.translated_text: With the verse, 'Agniṃ vo vṛdhantam.'

children.text: avardhanta hy etarhi yajamānam eva tathā vardhayanti
children.translated_text: For at this point they increased; in just that way they make the sacrificer increase.

children.text: vayam u tvām apūrvya ity apūrvāṃ hy etarhi prajāpates tanūm agacchann apūrvam evaitayā yajamānaṃ gamayanti
children.translated_text: With 'vayam u tvām apūrvya'; for at this point they came to an unprecedented body of <s>Prajāpati</s>. By this verse they make the sacrificer come to what is unprecedented.

children.text: imam indra sutaṃ piba jyeṣṭham amartyaṃ madam iti jyaiṣṭhaṃ hy etarhi vāco 'gacchan jyaiṣṭhyam evaitayā yajamānaṃ gamayanti
children.translated_text: With 'Drink this pressed <s>Soma</s>, O <s>Indra</s>, the foremost immortal exhilaration'; for at this point they came to the preeminence of speech. By this verse they make the sacrificer come to preeminence.

children.text: saindhukṣitaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: The <s>Saindhukṣita</s> is used.

children.text: sindhukṣid vai rājanyarṣir jyog aparuddhaś caran sa etat saindhukṣitam apaśyat so 'vāgacchat pratyatiṣṭhad avagacchati pratitiṣṭhati saindhukṣitena tuṣṭuvānaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Sindhukṣit</s>, a royal seer, went about for a long time shut out. He saw this <s>Saindhukṣita</s>; then he came back and became established. He comes back and becomes established by chanting with the <s>Saindhukṣita</s>.

children.text: saubharaṃ bhavati bṛhatas tejaḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>Saubhara</s> is used; it is the brilliance of the <s>Bṛhat</s>.

children.text: pannam iva vai caturtham ahas tad etena bṛhatas tejasottabhnoti saubhareṇa
children.translated_text: The fourth day is, as it were, fallen down; with this <s>Saubhara</s> he props it up by the brilliance of the <s>Bṛhat</s>.

children.text: vasiṣṭhasya priyaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: The beloved <s>sāman</s> of <s>Vasiṣṭha</s> is used.

children.text: etena vai vasiṣṭha indrasya premāṇam agacchat premāṇaṃ devatānāṃ gacchati vāsiṣṭhena tuṣṭuvānaḥ stomaḥ ||
children.translated_text: With this <s>Vasiṣṭha</s> attained the favor of <s>Indra</s>. He attains the favor of the deities by chanting with the <s>Vāsiṣṭha</s>. This is the <s>stoma</s>.

children.text: indraśca bṛhacca samabhavatāṃ tam indraṃ bṛhad ekayā tanvātyaricyata tasyā abibhedanayā mābhibhaviṣyatīti so 'bravīt ṣoḍaśī te 'yaṃ yajñakratur astv iti sa ṣoḍaśy abhavat tad asya janma
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> and the <s>Bṛhat</s> came together. The <s>Bṛhat</s> exceeded <s>Indra</s> by one body; he was afraid of that body, thinking, 'It will overpower me with this.' He said, 'Let this sacrificial rite of yours be the <s>ṣoḍaśin</s>.' It became the <s>ṣoḍaśin</s>; that is its birth.

children.text: ati śriyā bhrātṛvyaṃ ricyate yo gāyatrīṣu dvipadāsu bṛhatā ṣoḍaśinā stute
children.translated_text: He surpasses his rival in prosperity who chants with the <s>Bṛhat</s> <s>ṣoḍaśin</s> among the two-footed <s>Gāyatrī</s> verses.

children.text: upa no haribhiḥ stutam ity etā vai gāyatryo dvipadā etāsu stotavyam
children.translated_text: These verses, beginning 'upa no haribhiḥ stutam,' are two-footed <s>Gāyatrī</s>s; one should chant on them.

children.text: indraḥ prajāpatim upādhāvad vṛtraṃ hanānīti tasmā etām anuṣṭubham apaharasaṃ prāyacchat tayā nāstṛṇuta yad astṛtā vyanadat tan nānadasya nānadatvam
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> ran to <s>Prajāpati</s>, saying, 'May I slay <s>Vṛtra</s>.' He gave him this <s>Anuṣṭubh</s>, with its force taken away; with it he did not strike him down. When, not struck down, he roared, that is the roaring character of the <s>Nānada</s>.

children.text: taṃ punar upādhāvat tasmai saptānāṃ hotrāṇāṃ haro nirmāya prāyacchat tam astṛṇuta
children.translated_text: He ran to him again. He fashioned the force of the seven <s>hotṛ</s>s and gave it to him; with that he struck him down.

children.text: stṛṇute taṃ yaṃ tustūrṣate ya evaṃ veda
children.translated_text: The one who knows thus strikes down the man whom he wishes to strike down.

children.text: tasmāddharivatīṣu stuvanti harivatīḥ śaṃsanti harivatīṣu graho gṛhyate haro hy asmai nirmāya prāyacchat
children.translated_text: Therefore they chant on <s>Harivatī</s> verses, recite <s>Harivatī</s> verses, and the <s>graha</s> is taken on <s>Harivatī</s> verses, for he fashioned force for him and gave it to him.

children.text: ekaviṃśāyatano vā eṣa yat ṣoḍaśī sapta hi prātassavane hotrā vaṣaṭkurvanti sapta mādhyandine savane sapta tṛtīyasavane
children.translated_text: This, namely the <s>ṣoḍaśin</s>, has a twenty-onefold base, for seven <s>hotṛ</s>s utter the <s>vaṣaṭ</s> at the morning pressing, seven at the midday pressing, and seven at the third pressing.

children.text: gaurīvitaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: The <s>Gaurīvita</s> is used.

children.text: gaurīvitirvā etacchāktyo brahmaṇo 'tiriktam apaśyat tad gaurīvitam abhavad atiriktaṃ etad atiriktena stuvanti yad gaurīvitena ṣoḍaśinaṃ śvastanavān bhavaty api prajāyā upakﾱptaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Gaurīviti Śāktya</s> saw this excess of sacred power; that became the <s>Gaurīvita</s>. This is something additional: with an additional element they chant the <s>ṣoḍaśin</s>, namely with the <s>Gaurīvita</s>. He becomes possessed of a body for tomorrow, and prepared even with progeny.

children.text: viśālaṃ libjayā śrutyābhyadhād iti hovācopoditir gopāleyo 'nuṣṭubhi nānadam akar gaurīvitena ṣoḍaśinam astoṣṭāñjasā śriyam upāgān na śriyā avapadyata iti
children.translated_text: 'He overlaid the spacious one with close-attaching sacred hearing,' so <s>Upoditi Gopāleya</s> said: 'he made the <s>Nānada</s> in the <s>Anuṣṭubh</s>, chanted the <s>ṣoḍaśin</s> with the <s>Gaurīvita</s>, came straight to prosperity, and did not fall away from prosperity.'

children.text: eṣa vai viśālaṃ libjayā bhūtyābhidadhāti yo 'nuṣṭubhi nānadaṃ kṛtvā gaurīvitena ṣoḍaśinā stute 'ñjasā śriyam upaiti na śriyā avapadyate
children.translated_text: He indeed overlays the spacious one with close-attaching prosperity who, having made the <s>Nānada</s> in the <s>Anuṣṭubh</s>, chants with the <s>Gaurīvita</s> <s>ṣoḍaśin</s>; he comes straight to prosperity and does not fall away from prosperity.

children.text: śakvarīṣu ṣoḍaśinā stuvīta yaḥ kāmayeta vajrī syām iti
children.translated_text: One who desires, 'May I possess a thunderbolt,' should chant with the <s>ṣoḍaśin</s> on <s>Śakvarī</s> verses.

children.text: vajro vai ṣoḍaśī vajraḥ śakvaryo vajreṇaivāsmai vajraṃ spṛṇoti vajrī bhavati
children.translated_text: The <s>ṣoḍaśin</s> is a thunderbolt; the <s>Śakvarī</s>s are a thunderbolt. With a thunderbolt he supplies a thunderbolt for him; he becomes possessed of a thunderbolt.

children.text: anuṣṭupsu ṣoḍaśinā stuvīta yaḥ kāmayeta na mā vāg ativadet
children.translated_text: One who desires, 'May speech not speak beyond me,' should chant with the <s>ṣoḍaśin</s> on <s>Anuṣṭubh</s> verses.

children.text: vajro vai ṣoḍaśī vāg anuṣṭub vajreṇaivāsmai vācaṃ spṛṇoti nainaṃ vāg ativadati
children.translated_text: The <s>ṣoḍaśin</s> is a thunderbolt; the <s>Anuṣṭubh</s> is speech. With a thunderbolt he supplies speech for him; speech does not speak beyond him.

children.text: asāvi soma indra ta ity etāsu stotavyam
children.translated_text: One should chant on these verses beginning 'asāvi soma indra te.'

children.text: virāṭsv annādyakāmaḥ ṣoḍaśinā stuvīta vajro vai ṣoḍaśī vairājam annaṃ vajreṇaivāsmā annaṃ spṛṇoty annādo bhavati
children.translated_text: One who desires food to eat should chant with the <s>ṣoḍaśin</s> on <s>Virāj</s> verses. The <s>ṣoḍaśin</s> is a thunderbolt; <s>Vairāja</s> food is food. With a thunderbolt he supplies food for him; he becomes an eater of food.

children.text: pra vo mahe vṛdhe bharadhvam ity etāsu stotavyam
children.translated_text: One should chant on these verses beginning 'pra vo mahe vṛdhe bharadhvam.'

children.text: trayastriṃśadakṣarā vā etā virājo yad ekaviṃśatiḥ pratiṣṭhā sā yad dvādaśa prajātiḥ sā
children.translated_text: These <s>Virāj</s> verses have thirty-three syllables: what is twenty-one is the foundation, and what is twelve is procreation.

children.text: pratiṣṭhāya prajāyate no cāntasthāyāṃ jīryate ya evaṃ veda
children.translated_text: The one who knows thus, having gained a foundation, is propagated, and he does not grow old in an intermediate state.

children.text: atha vā etā ekapadās tryakṣarā viṣṇoś chando bhurijaḥ śakvaryaḥ
children.translated_text: Or else these <s>Śakvarī</s>s are single-footed and three-syllabled; they are the <s>Bhurij</s>, the metre of <s>Viṣṇu</s>.

children.text: etābhir vā indro vṛtram ahan kṣipraṃ vā etābhiḥ pāpmānaṃ hanti kṣipraṃ vasīyān bhavati
children.translated_text: With these <s>Indra</s> slew <s>Vṛtra</s>. With these one swiftly strikes down evil; he swiftly becomes better off.

children.text: catustriṃśadakṣarāḥ saṃstuto bhavati trayastriṃśaddevattāḥ prajāpatiś catustriṃśo devatānāṃ prajāpatim evopayanty ariṣṭyai
children.translated_text: When fully chanted it has thirty-four syllables. There are thirty-three deities, and <s>Prajāpati</s> is the thirty-fourth; they thereby approach <s>Prajāpati</s> among the deities, for freedom from injury.

children.text: hiraṇyaṃ sampradāyaṃ ṣoḍaśinā stuvate jyotiṣmān asya ṣoḍaśī bhavati
children.translated_text: Having handed over gold, they praise with the <s>Ṣoḍaśin</s>; his <s>Ṣoḍaśī</s> becomes luminous.

children.text: aśvaḥ kṛṣṇa upatiṣṭhati sāmyekṣayāya bhrātṛvyalokam eva sa vidhamaṃs tiṣṭhati
children.translated_text: A black horse stands nearby for equal seeing; he stands there driving away the rival's world.

children.text: ekākṣaraṃ vai devānām avamaṃ chanda āsīt saptākṣaraṃ paramaṃ navākṣaram asurāṇām avamaṃ chanda āsīt pañcadaśākṣaraṃ paramaṃ devāś ca vā asurāś cāspardhanta tān prajāpatir ānuṣṭubho bhūtvāntarātiṣṭhat taṃ devāsurā vyahvayanta sa devān upāvartata tato devā abhavan parāsurāḥ
children.translated_text: The one-syllabled metre was the lowest among the gods, the seven-syllabled the highest; the nine-syllabled metre was the lowest among the Asuras, the fifteen-syllabled the highest. The gods and the Asuras contended, and <s>Prajāpati</s>, having become the <s>Anuṣṭubh</s>, stood between them. The gods and the Asuras called him over; he turned toward the gods. Then the gods prevailed and the Asuras were defeated.

children.text: bhavaty ātmanā parāsya bhrātṛvyo bhavati ya evaṃ veda
children.translated_text: He prevails in his own person; his rival is defeated, who knows thus.

children.text: te devā asurāṇām ekākṣareṇaiva pañcadaśākṣaram avṛñjata dvyakṣareṇa caturdaśākṣaraṃ tryakṣareṇa trayodaśākṣaraṃ caturakṣareṇa dvādaśākṣaraṃ pañcākṣareṇaikādaśākṣaraṃ ṣaḍakṣareṇa daśākṣaraṃ saptākṣareṇa navākṣaram aṣṭābhir evāṣṭāv avṛñjata
children.translated_text: Those gods, with the one-syllabled metre, took away the fifteen-syllabled metre of the Asuras; with the two-syllabled they took away the fourteen-syllabled, with the three-syllabled the thirteen-syllabled, with the four-syllabled the twelve-syllabled, with the five-syllabled the eleven-syllabled, with the six-syllabled the ten-syllabled, with the seven-syllabled the nine-syllabled; with the eight they took away the eight.

children.text: evam eva bhrātṛvyād bhūtiṃ vṛṅkte ya evaṃ veda
children.translated_text: In just this way he takes prosperity from his rival, who knows thus.

children.text: aparuddhayajña iva vā eṣa yat ṣoḍaśī kanīyasvina iva vai tarhi devā āsan bhūyasvino 'surāḥ kanīyasvinaḥ bhūyasvinaṃ bhrātṛvyaṃ vṛṅkte ya evaṃ veda
children.translated_text: This, namely the <s>Ṣoḍaśī</s>, is like a sacrifice from which one is shut out. At that time the gods were fewer, the Asuras more numerous. Though fewer, he takes hold of a more numerous rival, who knows thus.
