children.translated_text: <s>Cyavana Dādhīca</s> was dear to the <s>Aśvin</s>s. He grew old. With this <s>sāman</s> they immersed him in the waters and made him young again. That indeed was what they then desired. The <s>Vīṅka</s> is a desire-winning <s>sāman</s>; by it one secures desire.

children.text: caturviṃśa eva stomo bhavati tejase brahmavarcasāya ||
children.translated_text: The <s>stoma</s> is precisely the twenty-fourfold one, for splendor and for <s>brahmavarcasa</s>.

children.text: śiśuṃ jajñānaṃ haryataṃ mṛjanti ity aṣṭamasyāhnaḥ pratid bhavati
children.translated_text: The verse beginning 'They cleanse the lovely child who has just been born' is the <s>pratipad</s> of the eighth day.

children.text: śiśur iva vā eṣa saptamenāhnā jāyate tam aṣṭamenāhnā mṛjanti
children.translated_text: This one is born like a child on the seventh day; on the eighth day they cleanse him.

children.text: stotrīyas tṛco bhavati prāṇāpānānām avaruddhyai
children.translated_text: There is a <s>stotrīya</s> triplet, for securing the in-breaths and out-breaths.

children.text: harivatyo bhavanti chandomānām ayātayāmatāyai
children.translated_text: The <s>Harivatī</s> verses are used, for the unworn character of the <s>Chandoma</s>s.

children.text: navarcā bhavanti
children.translated_text: They consist of nine verses.

children.text: pañcarco bhavati pañcapadā paṅktiḥ pāṅktam annam annādyasyāvaruddhyai
children.translated_text: There is a five-versed set. The <s>Paṅkti</s> has five feet; food is <s>pāṅkta</s> (fivefold), for securing food and the eating of food.

children.text: bāṇavān bhavaty anto vai bāṇo 'nta etad aṣṭamam ahnām anta eva tad antena stuvate pratiṣṭhāyai
children.translated_text: The <s>Bāṇavat</s> is used. The <s>bāṇa</s> is the end, and this eighth day is the end of the days. Thus they praise at the end with the end, for stability.

children.text: trayas tṛcā bhavanti prāṇāpānānāṃ santatyai ||
children.translated_text: There are three triplets, for the continuity of the in-breaths and out-breaths.

children.text: agniṃ vo devam agnibhiḥ sajoṣā ity āgneyam ājyaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: The <s>Āgneya</s> <s>ājya</s> verse is 'O you, with the fires, to <s>Agni</s> the god, in common accord.'

children.text: agnibhir ity eva pūrvāṇy ahāni abhisamiddhānyaṣṭamam ahar abhisamindhe
children.translated_text: By the word 'with the fires,' after the previous days have been kindled, he kindles the eighth day.

children.text: mitraṃ vayaṃ havāmaha iti bārhataṃ maitrāvaruṇam
children.translated_text: The <s>Maitrāvaruṇa</s> in the <s>Bārhata</s> form is 'We call upon <s>Mitra</s>.'

children.text: ugragādham iva vā etacchandomāstad yathāta ugragādhe vyatiṣajya gāhanta evam evaitad rūpe vyatiṣajati chandomānām asaṃvyāthāya
children.translated_text: This <s>Chandoma</s> is like a difficult deep place. Just as, in such a difficult depth, they enter while interlacing with one another, so here he interlaces the forms, so that the <s>Chandoma</s>s may not be disturbed.

children.text: tam indraṃ vājayāmasi ityaindram
children.translated_text: The <s>Aindra</s> verse is 'We strengthen that <s>Indra</s>.'

children.text: aṣṭamena vai devā ahnendram avājayan navamena pāpmānam aghnann ahar evaitena vājayanti
children.translated_text: With the eighth day the gods strengthened <s>Indra</s>; with the ninth they slew evil. With this they strengthen the day itself.

children.text: indre agnā namo bṛhad iti bārhatam aindrāgnam
children.translated_text: The <s>Aindrāgna</s> in the <s>Bārhata</s> form is 'Homage, great, to <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>.'

children.text: ugragādham iva vā etad yacchandomās tad yathāta ugragādhe vyatiṣajya gāhanta evam evaitad rūpe vyatiṣajati chandomānām asaṃvyāthāya stomaḥ ||
children.translated_text: This is like a difficult deep place, namely the <s>Chandoma</s>s. Just as, in such a difficult depth, they enter while interlacing with one another, so here he interlaces the forms, so that the <s>Chandoma</s>s may not be disturbed. It is the <s>stoma</s>.

children.text: adhvaryo adribhiḥ sutam iti gāyatrī bhavaty ahno dhṛtyai
children.translated_text: The <s>Gāyatrī</s> verse beginning 'O <s>Adhvaryu</s>, the pressed one with the stones' is used, for the support of the day.

children.text: gāyatryaḥ satyas triṣṭubhorūpeṇa traiṣṭubhaṃ hy etad ahaḥ
children.translated_text: Though they are <s>Gāyatrī</s> verses, they have the form of <s>Triṣṭubh</s>, for this day is <s>traiṣṭubha</s> (Triṣṭubh in character).

children.text: abhi somāsa āyava ity abhīti rathantarasya rūpaṃ bṛhad iti bṛhata ubhayoḥ saha rūpam upaity ubhau hi varṇāv etad ahaḥ
children.translated_text: In the verse beginning 'The <s>Soma</s> drops approach,' the word 'approach' is the form of the <s>Rathantara</s>, and the word 'great' is the form of the <s>Bṛhat</s>. It assumes the form of both together, for this day has both colors.

children.text: dhartā divaḥ pavate kṛtvyo rasa ity adhṛta iva vā eṣas tryaho yad dharteti dhṛtyā eva
children.translated_text: The verse beginning 'The supporter of heaven, the active sap, flows' is used. This three-day period is as though unsupported; because it says 'supporter,' it is precisely for support.

children.text: jagatyaḥ satyas triṣṭubho rūpeṇa tasmāt triṣṭubho loke kriyante
children.translated_text: Though they are <s>Jagatī</s> verses, they have the form of <s>Triṣṭubh</s>; therefore they are performed in the place of the <s>Triṣṭubh</s>.

children.text: gāyatraṃ bhavati yad eva gāyatrasya brāhmaṇam
children.translated_text: The <s>Gāyatra</s> is used; whatever is the <s>brāhmaṇa</s> explanation of the <s>Gāyatra</s> applies.

children.text: vairūpaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: The <s>Vairūpa</s> is used.

children.text: paśavo vai vairūpaṃ paśūnām avaruddhyai virūpaḥ saṃvatsaro virūpam annam annādyasyāvaruddhyai
children.translated_text: The <s>Vairūpa</s> is cattle, for the securing of cattle. The year is manifold, and food is manifold; it is for the securing of food-eating.

children.text: āśu bhārgavaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: The <s>Āśu Bhārgava</s> is used.

children.text: ahar vā etad avlīyata tad devā āśunābhyadhinvaṃs tad āśor āśutvam
children.translated_text: This day was slipping away; the gods invigorated it with the <s>Āśu</s>. That is the swiftness of the <s>Āśu</s>.

children.text: mārgīyavaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: The <s>Mārgīyava</s> is used.

children.text: devaṃ vā etaṃ mṛgayur iti vadanty etena vai sa ubhayeṣāṃ paśūnām ādhipatyam āśnutobhayeṣāṃ paśūnām ādhipatyam aśnute mārgīyaveṇa tuṣṭuvānaḥ
children.translated_text: They say of this one, "He is the divine hunter." By this he attained lordship over both kinds of animals; one who praises with the <s>Mārgīyava</s> attains lordship over both kinds of animals.

children.text: saumitraṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: The <s>Saumitra</s> is used.

children.text: yad eva saumitrasya brāhmaṇam
children.translated_text: Whatever is the <s>brāhmaṇa</s> explanation of the <s>Saumitra</s> applies.

children.text: aiṭataṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: The <s>Aiṭata</s> is used.

children.text: iṭan vā etena kāvyo 'ñjasā svargaṃ lokam apaśyat svargasya lokasyānukhyātyai svargāl lokān na cyavate tuṣṭuvānaḥ
children.translated_text: With this <s>Iṭan Kāvya</s> directly saw the heavenly world. It is for the manifest vision of the heavenly world; one who praises with it does not fall from the heavenly world.

children.text: sākamaśvaṃ bhavati yad eva sākamaśvasya brāhmaṇam
children.translated_text: The <s>Sākamaśva</s> is used; whatever is the <s>brāhmaṇa</s> explanation of the <s>Sākamaśva</s> applies.

children.text: tad u dhurāṃ sāmety āhuḥ prāṇā vai dhuraḥ prāṇānām avaruddhyai
children.translated_text: They also say, "That is the <s>sāman</s> of the load-bearing poles." The vital breaths are the load-bearing poles; it is for securing the vital breaths.

children.text: vilambasauparṇaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: The <s>Vilambasauparṇa</s> is used.

children.text: ātmā vā eṣa sauparṇānāṃ yad aṣṭame 'hani pakṣāv etāv abhito bhavato ye saptamanavamayor vīva vā antarātmā pakṣau lambate yadantarātmā pakṣau vilambate tasmād vilambasauparṇam
children.translated_text: This is the self among the <s>Sauparṇa</s>s, namely what is on the eighth day. These two on either side, those on the seventh and ninth days, are the wings. Just as the inner self hangs between the wings, and because the inner self hangs between the wings, therefore it is the <s>Vilambasauparṇa</s>.

children.text: svargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai sauparṇaṃ kriyate
children.translated_text: The <s>Sauparṇa</s> is performed for complete attainment of the heavenly world.

children.text: dvitīyaṃ hy etad rūpaṃ yac chandomāḥ
children.translated_text: For this, namely the <s>Chandoma</s>s, is a second form.

children.text: paśavo vai vāmadevyaṃ paśavaś chandomāḥ paśuṣv eva tat paśūn saṃdadhāti
children.translated_text: The <s>Vāmadevya</s> is cattle; the <s>Chandoma</s>s are cattle. Thereby he joins cattle precisely to cattle.

children.text: gāyatrapārśvaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: The <s>Gāyatrapārśva</s> is used.

children.text: ahar vā etad avlīyata tad devā gāyatrapārśvena samatanvaṃs tasmād gāyatrapārśvam
children.translated_text: This day was slipping away; the gods stretched it together with the <s>Gāyatrapārśva</s>. Therefore it is the <s>Gāyatrapārśva</s>.

children.text: trirātro yad vyaśīryata tam etaiḥ sāmabhir abhiṣajyan gāyatrapārśvenopāyacchan santaninā samatanvan saṃkṛtinā samaskurvan pratiṣṭhitau pūrvau trirātrāv apratiṣṭhita eṣa yad etāny eva sāmāni kriyanta etasyaiva pratiṣṭhityai
children.translated_text: When the <s>Trirātra</s> had fallen apart, they healed it with these <s>sāman</s>s: with the <s>Gāyatrapārśva</s> they attached it, with the <s>Santanin</s> they stretched it together, and with the <s>Saṃkṛti</s> they put it back together. The two earlier <s>Trirātra</s>s are established; this one is unestablished. When these very <s>sāman</s>s are performed, it is for the establishment of this very one.

children.text: pauruhanmanaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: The <s>Pauruhanmana</s> is used.

children.text: puruhanmā vā etena vaikhānaso 'ñjasā svargaṃ lokam apaśyat svargasya lokasyānukhyātyai svargāl lokān na cyavate tuṣṭuvānaḥ
children.translated_text: With this <s>Puruhanman Vaikhānasa</s> directly saw the heavenly world. It is for the manifest vision of the heavenly world; one who praises with it does not fall from the heavenly world.

children.text: abhyāghātyaṃ bhavaty abhyāghātyasāmāno hi chandomāḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>Abhyāghātya</s> is used, for the <s>Chandoma</s>s have <s>Abhyāghātya</s> <s>sāman</s>s.

children.text: dvaigataṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: The <s>Dvaigata</s> is used.

children.text: dvigad vā etena bhārgavo dviḥ svargaṃ lokam agacchad āgatya punar agacchat dvayoḥ kāmayor avaruddhyai dvaigataṃ kriyate
children.translated_text: With this <s>Dvigad Bhārgava</s> went twice to the heavenly world: having gone, he went again. The <s>Dvaigata</s> is performed for the securing of two desires.

children.text: hārāyaṇaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: The <s>Hārāyaṇa</s> is used.

children.text: indras tejaskāmo haraskāmas tapo 'tapyata sa etaddhārāyaṇam apaśyat tena tejo haro 'vārundha tejasvī harasvī bhavati hārāyaṇena tuṣṭuvānaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s>, desiring brilliance and fiery force, practiced austerity. He saw this <s>Hārāyaṇa</s>; with it he secured brilliance and fiery force. One who praises with the <s>Hārāyaṇa</s> becomes brilliant and possessed of fiery force.

children.text: achidraṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: The <s>Acchidra</s> is used.

children.text: yad vā etasyāhnaś chidram āsīt tad devā acchidreṇāpy auhaṃs tad acchidrasyācchidratvam
children.translated_text: Whatever gap there was in this day, the gods filled it with the <s>Acchidra</s>. That is the gaplessness of the <s>Acchidra</s>.

children.text: bārhadukthaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: The <s>Bārhaduktha</s> is used.

children.text: bṛhaduktho vā etena vāmneyo 'nnasya purodhām agacchad annaṃ vai brahmaṇaḥ purodhām annādyasyāvaruddhyai
children.translated_text: With this <s>Bṛhaduktha Vāmneya</s> went to the precedence of food. Food is indeed the precedence of <s>brahman</s>; it is for securing food-eating.

children.text: udvad bhārgavaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: The <s>Udvad Bhārgava</s> is used.

children.text: pravatā vai devāḥ svargaṃ lokaṃ prāyann udvatodāyan
children.translated_text: By a downward path the gods set out for the heavenly world; by an upward path they ascended.

children.text: nidhanāntāḥ pavamānā bhavanty ahno dhṛtyai stomaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Pavamāna</s> chants have the <s>nidhana</s> as their ending, for the support of the day. It is the <s>stoma</s>.

children.text: ka īṃ veda sute sacā iti satobṛhatyaḥ
children.translated_text: The verses beginning "ka īṃ veda sute sacā" are <s>Satobṛhatī</s>s.

children.text: apabhraṃśa iva vā eṣa yas saptame 'hani satobṛhatyo bhavanti nāṣṭame tasmād aṣṭame kāryā anapabhraṃśāya
children.translated_text: This is like a slipping down, when <s>Satobṛhatī</s>s occur on the seventh day and not on the eighth. Therefore they are to be performed on the eighth day, so that there may be no slipping down.

children.text: tadāhuḥ śithilam iva vā etacchando yat satobṛhatītyeṣā vai pratiṣṭhitā bṛhatī yā punaḥpadā yad indra prāg apāg udag iti diśāṃ vimarśaḥ pratiṣṭhityai
children.translated_text: They say, "This metre, the <s>Satobṛhatī</s>, is as it were loose." That <s>Bṛhatī</s> which has a repeated foot is indeed established. The words "yad indra prāg apāg udag" are a touching of the directions, for stability.

children.text: tāsu naipātithaṃ brahmasāma
children.translated_text: Among them the <s>Naipātitha</s> is the <s>brahmasāman</s>.

children.text: sāmārṣeyavat svargāya yujyate svargāllokān na cyavate tuṣṭuvānaḥ
children.translated_text: It is employed like a <s>Sāmārṣeya</s> for heaven. One who praises with it does not fall from the heavenly world.

children.text: ubhayaṃ śṛṇavacca na iti
children.translated_text: It has the words, "and may he hear both for us."

children.text: yacca pṛṣṭhāni yāni caitānyahāni teṣām ubhayeṣāṃ santatyai
children.translated_text: It is for the continuity of both: the <s>Pṛṣṭha</s>s and these days.

children.text: tāsu vaiyaśvam
children.translated_text: Among them the <s>Vaiyaśva</s> is used.

children.text: vyaśvo vā etenāṅgiraso 'ñjasā svargaṃ lokam apaśyat svargasya lokasyānukhyātyā etat pṛṣṭhānām antataḥ kriyate stomaḥ ||
children.translated_text: With this <s>Vyaśva Āṅgirasa</s> directly saw the heavenly world. It is for the manifest vision of the heavenly world; this is performed at the end of the <s>Pṛṣṭha</s>s. It is the <s>stoma</s>.

children.text: pavasva deva āyuṣag indraṃ gacchatu te mada iti gāyatrī bhavati madavad vai rasavat tṛtīyasavanaṃ madam eva tad rasaṃ dadhāti
children.translated_text: The <s>Gāyatrī</s> verse beginning "pavasva deva āyuṣag, indraṃ gacchatu te madaḥ" is used. The third pressing is full of exhilaration and sap; thereby he places exhilaration and sap in it.

children.text: prāṇā śiśur mahīnām iti prāṇavatyo bhavanti prāṇān eva tad yajamāne dadhāti
children.translated_text: The verses beginning "prāṇā śiśur mahīnām" contain the vital breaths; thereby he places the vital breaths in the sacrificer.

children.text: abhī no vājasātamam ityabhīti rathantarasya rūpaṃ rāthantaraṃ hy etad ahaḥ
children.translated_text: The verse beginning "abhī no vājasātamam" has the word "abhī." The word "abhī" is the form of the <s>Rathantara</s>, for this day belongs to the <s>Rathantara</s>.

children.text: pavasva soma mahān samudra ity akṣarapaṅktiḥ stomānāṃ prabhūtir atho etaddhyevaitarhi chando 'yātayāma yad akṣarapaṅktis tena chandomā ayātayāmānaḥ kriyante brahmavādino vadanti yat ṣaḍahe stomāśchandāṃsyāpyante kiṃ chandasaśchandomā ityetacchandaso yad etā akṣarapaṅktaya iti brūyāt
children.translated_text: The <s>Akṣarapaṅkti</s> beginning "pavasva soma mahān samudraḥ" is the source of the <s>stoma</s>s. Moreover, this metre here is indeed unexhausted, namely the <s>Akṣarapaṅkti</s>; through it the <s>Chandoma</s>s are made unexhausted. The <s>Brahmavādin</s>s say, "Since in the <s>Ṣaḍaha</s> the <s>stoma</s>s and metres are attained, what metres do the <s>Chandoma</s>s have?" One should say, "These <s>Akṣarapaṅkti</s>s are that metre."

children.text: hinvanti sūram usraya iti gāyatryaḥ satyo jagatyo rūpeṇa tasmājjagatīnāṃ loke kriyante
children.translated_text: The verses beginning "hinvanti sūram usrayaḥ", though <s>Gāyatrī</s>s, are <s>Jagatī</s>s by form. Therefore they are performed in the place of the <s>Jagatī</s>s.

children.text: gāyatraṃ bhavati yad eva gāyatrasya brāhmaṇam
children.translated_text: The <s>Gāyatra</s> is used; whatever is the <s>brāhmaṇa</s> explanation of the <s>Gāyatra</s> applies.

children.text: svāśirām arko bhavati
children.translated_text: The <s>Arka</s> with a good <s>āśir</s> (milk-mixture) is used.

children.text: annaṃ vā arko 'nnādyasyāvaruddhyai prāṇā vai svāśiraḥ prāṇānām avaruddhyai
children.translated_text: The <s>Arka</s> is food; it is for securing food-eating. The <s>Svāśira</s>s are the vital breaths; it is for securing the vital breaths.

children.text: surūpaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: The <s>Surūpa</s> is used.

children.text: paśavo vai surūpaṃ paśūnām avaruddhyai
children.translated_text: Cattle are the <s>Surūpa</s>; it is for securing cattle.

children.text: bhāsaṃ bhavati bhāti tuṣṭuvānaḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>Bhāsa</s> is used; one who praises with it shines.

children.text: padanidhanaṃ rāthantaraṃ hy etad ahaḥ
children.translated_text: It has a <s>pada-nidhana</s> (word-ending), for this day is <s>Rāthantara</s>.

children.text: svarbhānur vā āsura ādityaṃ tamasāvidhyat sa na vyarocata tasyātrir bhāsena tamo 'pāhan sa vyarocata yad vai tad bhā abhavat tad bhāsasya bhāsatvam
children.translated_text: <s>Svarbhānu Āsura</s> struck the <s>Āditya</s> with darkness, and it did not shine. <s>Atri</s> drove away the darkness from it with the <s>Bhāsa</s>, and it shone. That which then became brightness is the <s>Bhāsa</s>'s being called <s>Bhāsa</s>.

children.text: tama iva vā etāny ahāni yacchandomās tebhya etena sāmnā vivāsayati
children.translated_text: These days, namely the <s>Chandoma</s>s, are like darkness. From them he dispels the darkness with this <s>sāman</s>.

children.text: kākṣīvataṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: The <s>Kākṣīvata</s> is used.

children.text: kākṣīvān vā etenauśijaḥ prajātiṃ bhūmānam agacchat prajāyate bahur bhavati kākṣīvatena tuṣṭuvānaḥ
children.translated_text: With this, <s>Kākṣīvān Auśija</s> attained propagation and abundance. One who praises with the <s>Kākṣīvata</s> propagates and becomes numerous.

children.text: āsitaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: The <s>Āsita</s> is used.

children.text: asito vā etena daivalas trayāṇāṃ lokānāṃ dṛṣṭim apaśyat trayāṇāṃ kāmānām avaruddhyā āsitaṃ kriyate
children.translated_text: With this, <s>Asita Daivala</s> perceived the sight of the three worlds. The <s>Āsita</s> is performed for securing the three desires.

children.text: aiṣiraṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: The <s>Aiṣira</s> is used.

children.text: traitaṃ bhavati pratiṣṭhāyai
children.translated_text: The <s>Traita</s> is used, for stability.

children.text: padanidhanaṃ rāthantaraṃ rāthantaraṃ hy etad ahaḥ
children.translated_text: It has a <s>pada-nidhana</s> (word-ending), for this day is <s>Rāthantara</s>.

children.text: nāthavindu sāma vindate nāthaṃ nāthavindūny etānyahāni yat chandomā nātham evaitair vindate
children.translated_text: The <s>Nāthavindu</s> <s>sāman</s> is used: he finds support. These days that are the <s>Chandoma</s>s are <s>Nāthavindu</s>s; by these he finds support itself.

children.text: gaurīvitaṃ bhavati yad eva gaurīvitasya brāhmaṇam
children.translated_text: The <s>Gaurīvita</s> is used; whatever is the <s>brāhmaṇa</s> explanation of the <s>Gaurīvita</s> applies.

children.text: kautsaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: The <s>Kautsa</s> is used.

children.text: etena vai kutso 'ndhaso vipānam apaśyat sa ha sma vai surādṛtinopavasathaṃ dhārayaty ubhayasyānnādyasyāvaruddhyai kautsaṃ kriyate
children.translated_text: With this, <s>Kutsa</s> perceived the drinking of the <s>andhas</s> (Soma-drink). He indeed used to keep the <s>upavasatha</s> with a skin of <s>surā</s> (liquor). The <s>Kautsa</s> is performed for securing both kinds of food-eating.

children.text: śuddhāśuddhīyaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: The <s>Śuddhāśuddhīya</s> is used.

children.text: indro yatīn sālāvṛkebhyaḥ prāyacchat tam aślīlā vāg abhyavadat so 'śuddho 'manyata sa etacchuddhāśuddhīyam apaśyat tenāśudhyacchudhyati śuddhāśuddhīyena tuṣṭuvānaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> handed the <s>Yati</s>s over to the <s>Sālāvṛka</s>s. Foul speech reproached him, and he thought himself impure. He saw this <s>Śuddhāśuddhīya</s>; by it he purified himself. One who praises with the <s>Śuddhāśuddhīya</s> becomes purified.

children.text: krauñcaṃ bhavati yad eva krauñcasya brāhmaṇaṃ yat dvitīye 'hani
children.translated_text: The <s>Krauñca</s> is used; whatever is the <s>brāhmaṇa</s> explanation of the <s>Krauñca</s> on the second day applies.

children.text: rayiṣṭhaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: The <s>Rayiṣṭha</s> is used.

children.text: paśavo vai rayiṣṭhaṃ paśūnām avaruddhyai
children.translated_text: Cattle are the <s>Rayiṣṭha</s>; it is for securing cattle.

children.text: audalaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: The <s>Audala</s> is used.

children.text: udalo vā etena vaiśvāmitraḥ prajātiṃ bhūmānam agacchat prajāyate bahur bhavatyaudalena tuṣṭuvānaḥ
children.translated_text: With this, <s>Udala Vaiśvāmitra</s> attained propagation and abundance. One who praises with the <s>Audala</s> propagates and becomes numerous.

children.text: brahmavādino vadanti yat ṣaḍahe stomāś chandāṃsy āpyante kiṃ chandasaś chandomā iti puruṣachandasa iti brūyāt puruṣo vai pāṅktaḥ puruṣo dvipadāśchandomānām ayātayāmatayau
children.translated_text: The <s>Brahmavādin</s>s say, "Since in the <s>Ṣaḍaha</s> the <s>stoma</s>s and metres are attained, what metres do the <s>Chandoma</s>s have?" One should say, "They have the person as their metre." For the person is <s>Paṅkti</s>, and the two-footed verses are the person; these are the unexhausted freshness of the <s>Chandoma</s>s.

children.text: viśoviśīyaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: The <s>Viśoviśīya</s> is used.

children.text: agnir akāmayata viśo viśo 'tithis syāṃ viśo viśa ātithyam aśnuvīyeti sa tapo 'tapyata sa etad viśoviśīyam apaśyat tena viśo viśo 'tithir abhavat viśo viśa ātithyam aśnuta viśo viśo 'tithir bhavati viśo viśa ātithyam aśnute viśoviśīyena tuṣṭuvānaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> desired, "May I be the guest of people after people; may I enjoy hospitality among people after people." He practiced austerity. He saw this <s>Viśoviśīya</s>; by it he became the guest of people after people and enjoyed hospitality among people after people. One who praises with the <s>Viśoviśīya</s> becomes the guest of people after people and enjoys hospitality among people after people.

children.text: gāyatrīṣu stuvanti pratiṣṭhāyai brahmavarcasāya yenaiva prāṇena prayanti tam abhyudyanti
children.translated_text: They praise on <s>Gāyatrī</s> verses, for stability and for <s>brahmavarcas</s> (sacred radiance). With the very breath by which they go forth, they rise up.

children.text: iḍāntāḥ pavamānā bhavanti paśavo vā iḍā paśavaśchandomāḥ paśuṣv eva tat paśūn dadhāti stomaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Pavamāna</s> chants have <s>Iḍā</s> as their ending. <s>Iḍā</s> is cattle, and the <s>Chandoma</s>s are cattle; thus he places cattle among cattle. It is the <s>stoma</s>.

children.text: preṣṭhaṃ vo atithim ityātithyasyaiva tad rūpaṃ kriyate
children.translated_text: With the line "Preṣṭhaṃ vo atithim," the very form of hospitality is fashioned.

children.text: aindra no gadhi priya itīndriyasya vīryasyāvaruddhyai
children.translated_text: With the line "Aindra no gadhi priya," it is for securing <s>indriya</s> (power) and heroic strength.

children.text: purāṃ bhindur yuvā kavir amitaujā ajāyata
children.translated_text: The young seer, breaker of forts, of boundless might, was born.

children.text: auśanaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: The <s>Auśana</s> is used.

children.text: uśanā vai kāvyo 'kāmayata yāvān itareṣāṃ kāvyānāṃ lokas tāvantaṃ spṛṇuyām iti sa tapo 'tapyata sa etad auśanam apaśyat tena tāvantaṃ lokam aspṛṇod yāvān itareṣāṃ kāvyānām āsīt tad vāva sa tarhyakāmayata kāmasani sāmauśanaṃ kāmam evaitenāvarundhe
children.translated_text: <s>Uśanā Kāvya</s> desired, "May I reach as much of the world as belongs to the other <s>Kāvya</s>s." He practiced austerity. He saw this <s>Auśana</s>; by it he reached as much of the world as belonged to the other <s>Kāvya</s>s. That indeed was what he desired then. The <s>Auśana</s> is a desire-winning <s>sāman</s>; by it he secures desire itself.

children.text: sāṃvartaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: The <s>Sāṃvarta</s> is used.

children.text: devānāṃ vai yajñaṃ rakṣāṃsyajighāṃsaṃs tānyetena indraḥ saṃvartam apāvapad yat saṃvartam apāvapat tasmāt sāṃvartaṃ pāpmā vāva sa tān asacata taṃ sāṃvartenāpāghnatāpa pāpmānaṃ hate sāṃvartena tuṣṭuvānaḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>Rakṣas</s>es wished to harm the sacrifice of the gods. With this, <s>Indra</s> swept them away by the <s>Saṃvarta</s>; because he swept them away by the <s>Saṃvarta</s>, it is called <s>Sāṃvarta</s>. Evil had attached itself to them; he struck it away with the <s>Sāṃvarta</s>. One who praises with the <s>Sāṃvarta</s> strikes evil away.

children.text: mārutaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: The <s>Māruta</s> is used.

children.text: māsā vai raśmayo maruto raśmayo maruto vai devānāṃ bhūyiṣṭhā bhūyiṣṭhā asāmeti vai sattram āsate bhūyiṣṭhā eva bhavantyṛtumanti pūrvāṇyahānyanṛtavaḥ chandomā yad etat sāma bhavati tenaitānyahānyahānyṛtumanti bhavanti
children.translated_text: The months are rays, and the <s>Marut</s>s are rays. The <s>Marut</s>s are the most numerous of the gods. They sit in the <s>sattra</s> saying, "May we be the most numerous," and they become the most numerous. The earlier days have seasons; the <s>Chandoma</s>s are without seasons. When this <s>sāman</s> is used, through it these days become furnished with seasons.

children.text: catuścatvāriṃśa eva stomo bhavatyojasyeva tad vīrye pratitiṣṭhatyojo vīrye triṣṭup ||
children.translated_text: The <s>stoma</s> is forty-fourfold. Thereby he stands firm in strength and heroic power; the <s>Triṣṭubh</s> is strength and heroic power.

children.text: Chapter 15
akrān samudraḥ parame vidharmann iti navamasyāhnaḥ pratipad bhavati ||
children.translated_text: The line "Akrān samudraḥ parame vidharman" is the <s>pratipad</s> (opening verse) of the ninth day.

children.text: paramaṃ vā etad ahar vidharma vidharma vā etad anyair aharbhir ahar yan navamaṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ hi variṣṭham ||
children.translated_text: This day is in the highest ordering. This day, the ninth, is in a distinct ordering from the other days, for the eldest is the best.

children.text: matsi vāyum iṣṭaye rādhase na iti vāruṇy eṣā bhavati yad vai yajñasya duriṣṭaṃ tad varuṇo gṛhṇati tad eva tad avayajati ||
children.translated_text: The line "Matsi vāyum iṣṭaye rādhase na" is a <s>Vāruṇī</s> verse. Whatever in the sacrifice is badly sacrificed, <s>Varuṇa</s> seizes; that very thing he thereby sacrifices away.

children.text: stotrīyas tṛco bhavati prāṇāpānānām avaruddhyai ||
children.translated_text: It is a <s>stotrīya</s> triplet, for securing the in-breaths and out-breaths.

children.text: daśarco bhavati daśākṣarā virāṭa vairājam annam annādyasyāvaruddhyai ||
children.translated_text: It has ten verses. The <s>Virāj</s> has ten syllables; food is <s>Vairāja</s>. It is for securing food-eating.

children.text: saprabhṛtayo bhavāntīndriyasya vīryasya rasasyānaticārāya yatra vai devā indriyaṃ vīryaṃ rasam apaśyaṃs tad anunyatudan ||
children.translated_text: They have that as their starting point, so that power, heroic strength, and sap may not be overpassed. Where the gods saw power, heroic strength, and sap, there they impelled it onward.

children.text: aṣṭarco bhavati ||
children.translated_text: It consists of eight verses.

children.text: aṣṭāśaphāḥ paśavaḥ śaphaśas tat paśūn āpnoti aṣṭākṣarā gāyatrī tejo brahmavarcasaṃ gāyatrī teja eva brahmavarcasam avarundhe ||
children.translated_text: Animals are eight-hoofed; hoof by hoof he obtains animals. The <s>Gāyatrī</s> has eight syllables; the <s>Gāyatrī</s> is brilliance and sacred luster. He thereby secures brilliance and sacred luster itself.

children.text: ṣaḍṛcā bhavanty ṛtūnāṃ dhṛtyai ||
children.translated_text: They are sets of six verses, for the support of the seasons.

children.text: catvāraḥ ṣaḍṛcā bhavanti caturviṃśatir ardhamāsāḥ saṃvatsaraḥ saṃvatsara eva pratitiṣṭhati ||
children.translated_text: There are four sets of six verses; the half-months are twenty-four, and that is the year. He becomes established in the year itself.

children.text: savān uttamaḥ ṣaḍṛco bhavaty ubhayasya parokṣapratyakṣasyāvaruddhyai ||
children.translated_text: The final set of six verses is a <s>savana</s> one, for securing both what is hidden and what is manifest.

children.text: tṛca uttamo bhavati yenaiva prāṇena prayanti tam abhyudyanti ||
children.translated_text: The final one is a triplet. With the very breath by which they set out, they rise up toward it.

children.text: aṣṭācatvāriṃśa eva stomo bhavati pratiṣṭhāyai prajātyai ||
children.translated_text: The <s>stoma</s> is precisely forty-eightfold, for establishment and procreation.

children.text: Chapter 16
aganma mahā namasā yaviṣṭham ity āgneyam ājyaṃ bhavati ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Āgneya Ājya</s> is the verse, "We have come with great homage to the youngest."

children.text: gacchantīva vā ete ye navamam ahar gacchanti ||
children.translated_text: Those who go to the ninth day are, as it were, going onward.

children.text: yo dīdāya samiddhasve duroṇa iti dīdāyeva hy eṣa yo navabhir aharbhis tuṣṭuvānaḥ svāhutam iti svāhuto hy eṣa yo navabhir aharbhir āhuto viśvataḥ pratyañcam iti viśvato hy eṣa pratyaṅ ||
children.translated_text: It says, "He who has shone, kindled in his own dwelling"; for this one indeed shines, who has praised for nine days. It says, "well-invoked"; for this one is well-invoked, who has been invoked for nine days. It says, "facing toward all sides"; for he indeed faces all sides.

children.text: tvaṃ varuṇa uta mitro agna iti vāruṇyeṣā bhavati yad vai yajñasya duriṣṭaṃ tad varuṇo gṛhṇati tad eva tad avayajati ||
children.translated_text: The verse, "You, O <s>Varuṇa</s>, and also <s>Mitra</s>, O <s>Agni</s>," is addressed to <s>Varuṇa</s>. Whatever in the sacrifice has been wrongly performed, <s>Varuṇa</s> seizes; that very thing he thereby expiates by sacrifice.

children.text: mitraṃ huve pūtadakṣam iti rāthantaraṃ maitrāvaruṇam ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Maitrāvaruṇa Rathantara</s> is the verse, "I call <s>Mitra</s> of purified skill."

children.text: ugragādham iva vā etad yacchandomās tad yathāta ugragādhe vyatiṣajya gāhanta evam evaitad rūpe vyatiṣajati chandomānām asaṃvyāthāya ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Chandoma</s>s are like a difficult ford. Just as, at a difficult ford, people enter while holding on to one another, so here he interlaces the forms, so that the <s>Chandoma</s>s may not be dislocated.

children.text: mahāṃ indro ya ojasā ityaindram aṣṭamena vai devā ahnendram avājayann avamena pāpmānam aghnann ahar evaitena mahayanti ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Aindra</s> is the verse, "Great is <s>Indra</s> through his might." By the eighth day the gods made <s>Indra</s> victorious; by the lower one they struck down evil. With this they magnify the day itself.

children.text: tā huve yayor idam iti rāthantaram aindrāgnam ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Aindrāgna Rathantara</s> is the verse, "I call those two to whom this belongs."

children.text: ugragādham iva vā etad yacchandomās tad yathāta ugragādhe vyatiṣajya gāhanta evam evaitad rūpe vyatiṣajati chandomānām asaṃvyāthāya stomaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Chandoma</s>s are like a difficult ford. Just as, at a difficult ford, people enter while holding on to one another, so here he interlaces the forms, so that the <s>Chandoma</s>s may not be dislocated. It is the <s>stoma</s>.

children.text: Chapter 17
pavamānasya jighnato hareś candrā asṛkṣata iti harivatyo gāyatryo bhavanti chandomānām ayātayāmatāyai ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Harivatī Gāyatrī</s> verses are used with the words, "The bright drops of the tawny <s>Pavamāna</s>, as he rushes, have been released," for the unwearied freshness of the <s>Chandoma</s>s.

children.text: pavamānasya jighnata iti vai bṛhato rūpaṃ hareś candrā asṛkṣata iti jagatyā ubhayoḥ saharūpam upaiti sāmnaś ca chandasaś ca ||
children.translated_text: The words "of <s>Pavamāna</s>, as he rushes" are the form of the <s>Bṛhat</s>; the words "the bright drops of the tawny one have been released" are the form of the <s>Jagatī</s>. He attains the common form of both, of the <s>sāman</s> and of the metre.

children.text: parīto ṣiñcatā sutam iti parivatyo bhavanty anto vai navamam ahas tasyaitāḥ paryāptyai ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Parivatī</s> verses are used with the words, "Sprinkle the pressed one all around." The ninth day is an end; these are for its full completion.

children.text: asāvi somo aruṣo vṛṣā harir iti jagatyas satyas triṣṭubho rūpeṇa tasmāt triṣṭubhāṃ loke kriyante ||
children.translated_text: The verses, "The tawny red bull <s>Soma</s> has been pressed," though <s>Jagatī</s>s, are in the form of <s>Triṣṭubh</s>s. Therefore they are performed in the place of the <s>Triṣṭubh</s>s.

children.text: gāyatraṃ bhavati yad eva gāyatrasya brāhmaṇam ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Gāyatra</s> is used; whatever is the <s>brāhmaṇa</s> explanation of the <s>Gāyatra</s> applies.

children.text: bharadvājasyādārasṛd bhavati ||
children.translated_text: <s>Bharadvāja</s>'s <s>Adārasṛt</s> is used.

children.text: divodāsaṃ vai bharadvājapurohitaṃ nanājanāḥ paryayanta sa upāsīdad ṛṣe gātuṃ me vindeti tasmā etena sāmnā gātum avindad gātuvid vā etatsāmānena dāre nāsṛnmeti tad adārasṛto 'dārasṛttvaṃ vindate gātuṃ na dāre dhāvaty adārasṛtā tuṣṭuvānaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Many peoples beset <s>Divodāsa</s>, whose priest was <s>Bharadvāja</s>. He approached the seer and said, "Find me a way." With this <s>sāman</s> he found a way for him. This <s>sāman</s> is indeed a finder of a way. "With this we did not run into a cleft": that is the <s>Adārasṛt</s>'s being <s>Adārasṛt</s>. One who praises with the <s>Adārasṛt</s> finds a way and does not run into a cleft.

children.text: surūpaṃ bhavati yad eva surūpasya brāhmaṇam ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Surūpa</s> is used; whatever is the <s>brāhmaṇa</s> explanation of the <s>Surūpa</s> applies.

children.text: hariśrīnidhanaṃ bhavati ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Hariśrīnidhana</s> is used.

children.text: paśavo vai hariśriyaḥ paśūnām avaruddhyai śriyaṃ ca haraś copaiti tuṣṭuvānaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Animals are indeed possessed of tawny splendor; it is for securing animals. The one who praises attains both splendor and tawny radiance.

children.text: saindhukṣitaṃ bhavati yad eva saindhukṣitasya brāhmaṇam ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Saindhukṣita</s> is used; whatever is the <s>brāhmaṇa</s> explanation of the <s>Saindhukṣita</s> applies.

children.text: gatanidhanaṃ bābhravaṃ bhavati gatyai ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Bābhrava</s> with the <s>Gata</s> as its <s>nidhana</s> is used, for going forward.

children.text: babhrur vā etena kaumbhyo 'ñjasā svargaṃ lokam apaśyat svargasya lokasyānukhyātyai svargāl lokān na cyavate tuṣṭuvānaḥ ||
children.translated_text: With this, <s>Babhrū Kaumbhya</s> saw the heavenly world straightaway. It is for the beholding of the heavenly world. The one who praises does not fall away from the heavenly world.

children.text: iḍānāṃ saṃkṣāro bhavati ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Saṃkṣāra of the Iḍās</s> is used.

children.text: paśavo vā iḍā paśavaś chandomāḥ paśuṣv eva tat paśūn dadhāti ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Iḍā</s>s are animals; the <s>Chandoma</s>s are animals. Thereby he places animals among animals.

children.text: ṛṣabhaḥ pāvamāno bhavati ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Ṛṣabha Pāvamāna</s> is used.

children.text: paśavo vai chandomāḥ paśuṣv eva tan mithunam apyarjati prajātyai na ha vā anṛṣabhāḥ paśavaḥ prajāyante ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Chandoma</s>s are animals. Thereby he brings a mating pair among animals, for procreation; animals without a bull do not reproduce.

children.text: pṛṣṭhaṃ bhavati ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Pṛṣṭha</s> is used.

children.text: pṛṣṭhaṃ vā etad ahnāṃ yan navamaṃ pṛṣṭha eva tat pṛṣṭhena stuvate pratiṣṭhāyai ||
children.translated_text: The ninth is the <s>pṛṣṭha</s>, the back or support, of the days. On the <s>pṛṣṭha</s> he praises with a <s>Pṛṣṭha</s>, for establishment.

children.text: kaulmalabarhiṣaṃ bhavati ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Kaulmalabarhiṣa</s> is used.

children.text: kulmalabarhir vā etena svargaṃ lokam apaśyat prajātiṃ bhūmānam agacchat prajāyate bahur bhavati kaulmalabarhiṣeṇa tuṣṭuvānaḥ ||
children.translated_text: With this, <s>Kulmalabarhis</s> saw the heavenly world and attained procreation and abundance. One who praises with the <s>Kaulmalabarhiṣa</s> procreates and becomes numerous.

children.text: arkapuṣpaṃ bhavati ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Arkapuṣpa</s> is used.

children.text: annaṃ vai devā arka iti vadanti rasam asya puṣpām iti sarasam evānnādyam avarundhe 'rkapuṣpeṇa tuṣṭuvānaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The gods call food <s>arka</s>; they call its sap the flower. One who praises with the <s>Arkapuṣpa</s> secures edible food that is rich in sap.

children.text: dairghyaśravasaṃ bhavati ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Dairghyaśravasa</s> is used.

children.text: dīrghaśravā vai rājanya ṛṣir jyog aparuddho 'śanāyaṃś caran sa etad dairghaśravasam apaśyat tena sarvābhyo digbhyo 'nnādyam avārundha sarvābhyo 'digbhyo 'nnādyam avārundhe dairghaśravasena tuṣṭuvānaḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Dīrghaśravas</s>, a royal seer, long shut out and wandering hungry, saw this <s>Dairghyaśravasa</s>. By it he secured edible food from all directions. One who praises with the <s>Dairghyaśravasa</s> secures edible food from all directions.

children.text: vaiyaśvaṃ bhavati yad eva vaiyaśvasya brāhmaṇam ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Vaiyaśva</s> is used; whatever is the <s>brāhmaṇa</s> explanation of the <s>Vaiyaśva</s> applies.

children.text: abhīśavaṃ yad ābhīśavasya ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Abhīśava</s> is used, since it is that of the <s>Ābhīśava</s>.

children.text: devasthānaṃ bhavati pratiṣṭhāyai saṃskṛti bhavati saṃskṛtyai ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Devasthāna</s> is used, for establishment; the <s>Saṃskṛti</s> is used, for putting together.

children.text: ahar vā etad avlīyata tad devā devasthāne tiṣṭhantaḥ saṃkṛtinā samaskurvaṃs tat saṃkṛteḥ saṃkṛtitvaṃ devasthānena vai devāḥ svarge loke pratyatiṣṭhan svarge loke pratitiṣṭām ety etat ||
children.translated_text: This day had become dissolved. The gods, standing in the <s>Devasthāna</s>, put it together with the <s>Saṃskṛti</s>; that is why the <s>Saṃskṛti</s> is called <s>Saṃskṛti</s>. With the <s>Devasthāna</s> the gods established themselves in the heavenly world; one thereby comes to establishment in the heavenly world.

children.text: varuṇāya devatā rājyāya nātiṣṭhanta sa etad devasthānam apaśyat tato vai tās tasmai rājyāyātiṣṭhanta tiṣṭhante 'smai samānāḥ śraiṣṭhyāya ||
children.translated_text: The deities did not stand by <s>Varuṇa</s> for kingship. He saw this <s>Devasthāna</s>; then they stood by him for kingship. His equals stand by him for preeminence.

children.text: kṣatrasyevāsya prakāśo bhavati pratitiṣṭhati ya evaṃ veda ||
children.translated_text: There is, as it were, a manifestation of his <s>kṣatra</s> (royal power); he is established, who knows thus.

children.text: bhargo bhargeṇa tuṣṭuvāno bhavati yaśo yaśasā ||
children.translated_text: Praising with <s>Bharga</s>, he becomes radiance by radiance, and fame by fame.

children.text: vāsiṣṭhaṃ bhavati yad eva vāsiṣṭhasya brāhmaṇam ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Vāsiṣṭha</s> is used; whatever is the <s>brāhmaṇa</s> explanation of the <s>Vāsiṣṭha</s> applies.

children.text: dīrghatamaso 'rko bhavaty annaṃ vā arko 'nnādyasyāvaruddhyai ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Arka</s> of <s>Dīrghatamas</s> is used. The <s>Arka</s> is food; it is for securing the eating of food.

children.text: sāmarājaṃ bhavati sāmrājyam ādhipatyaṃ gacchati sāmarājñā tuṣṭuvānaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Sāmarāja</s> is used. Praising with the <s>Sāmarāja</s>, he attains sovereignty and overlordship.

children.text: tad u saṃvad ity āhuḥ saṃvatā vai devāḥ svargaṃ lokaṃ prāyann udvatodāyan ||
children.translated_text: But they say that it is the <s>Saṃvat</s>: with the <s>Saṃvat</s> the gods went forth to the heavenly world, and with the <s>Udvat</s> they went up.

children.text: nidhanāntāḥ pavamānā bhavanty ahno dhṛtyai stomaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Pavamāna</s> chants end with the <s>nidhana</s>, for the support of the day. It is the <s>stoma</s>.

children.text: Chapter 18
śrāyanta iva sūryam iti sūryavatyo bhavanti ||
children.translated_text: They are verses containing the word 'sun', with the phrase 'as though resorting to the sun.'

children.text: ādityadevatyaṃ hy etad ahar anto vai sūro 'nta etan navamam ahnām anta eva tad antena stuvate pratiṣṭhāyai ||
children.translated_text: For this day has <s>Āditya</s> as its deity. The sun is the end, and this ninth day is the end of the days; thus at the end they praise with the end, for establishment.

children.text: yata indra bhayāvahe tato no abhayaṃ kṛdhi maghavañ chagdhi tava tan na ūtaye vidviṣo vimṛdho jahi iti dviṣaścaiva mṛdhaśca navamenāhnā vihatya daśamenāhnottiṣṭhanti ||
children.translated_text: From where, O <s>Indra</s>, we are afraid, from there make us free from fear. O <s>Maghavan</s>, be mighty; let that be for our help; smite the haters and attackers. Having struck away hostility and conflict with the ninth day, they rise on the tenth day.

children.text: śrīr vai śrāyantīyaṃ śrīr navamam ahaḥ śriyam eva tacchriyāṃ pratiṣṭhāpayati ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Śrāyantīya</s> is prosperity; the ninth day is prosperity. Thus he establishes prosperity precisely in prosperity.

children.text: samantaṃ bhavati ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Samanta</s> is used.

children.text: samantena paśukāmaḥ stuvīta purodhākāmaḥ samantena stuvīta ||
children.translated_text: One desiring cattle should praise with the <s>Samanta</s>; one desiring <s>purodhā</s> (priestly appointment) should praise with the <s>Samanta</s>.

children.text: āgneyī pṛthivyāgneyo brāhmaṇa aindrī dyaur aindro rājanyo 'ntarikṣeṇa dyāvāpṛthivī samante antarikṣeṇaivainaṃ samantaṃ karoti vindate paśūn pra purodhām āpnoti ya evaṃ vidvān samantena stuvate stomaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The earth belongs to <s>Agni</s>, and the brāhmaṇa belongs to <s>Agni</s>; heaven belongs to <s>Indra</s>, and the rājanya belongs to <s>Indra</s>. Heaven and earth are complete through the midspace; with the midspace itself he makes him complete on every side. He finds cattle and attains <s>purodhā</s> (priestly appointment), who, knowing thus, praises with the <s>Samanta</s>. It is the <s>stoma</s>.

children.text: Chapter 19
tvaṃ somāsi dhārayur iti gāyatrī bhavaty ahno dhṛtyai tvam iti bṛhato rūpaṃ bārhataṃ hy etad ahaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Gāyatrī</s> verse 'You are <s>Soma</s>, the supporter' is used, for the support of the day. The word 'you' is the form of the <s>Bṛhat</s>, for this day is <s>Bārhata</s>.

children.text: tvaṃ hyaṅga daivyā iti tvam iti bṛhato rūpaṃ bārhataṃ hy etad ahaḥ ||
children.translated_text: In the line 'You indeed, O divine one,' the word 'you' is the form of the <s>Bṛhat</s>, for this day is <s>Bārhata</s>.

children.text: pavasva deva vītaya iti bṛhato rūpaṃ bārhataṃ hy etad ahaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The verse 'Flow, O god, for the feast' has the form of the <s>Bṛhat</s>, for this day is <s>Bārhata</s>.

children.text: parityaṃ haryataṃ harim iti parivatyo bhavantyanto vai navamam ahasyaitāḥ paryāptyai ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Parivatī</s> verses are used, beginning 'Around that desirable tawny one.' These are the end of the ninth day; they are for completion.

children.text: pavasva soma mahe dakṣāya ityakṣarapaṅktiḥ stomānāṃ prabhūtir atho etaddhyevaitarhi chando 'yātayāma yad akṣarapaṅktis tena chandomā ayātayāmānaḥ kriyante brahmavādino vadanti yat ṣaḍahe stomāś chandāṃsy āpyante kiṃ chandasaś chandomā ity etacchandaso yad etā akṣarapaṅktaya iti brūyāt ||
children.translated_text: The verse 'Flow, O <s>Soma</s>, for great skill' is an <s>Akṣarapaṅkti</s>; it is the source of the <s>stoma</s>s. Moreover, this metre at this point is indeed unexhausted, namely the <s>Akṣarapaṅkti</s>; through it the <s>Chandoma</s>s are made unexhausted. The expounders of <s>brahman</s> say, 'Since in the <s>Ṣaḍaha</s> the <s>stoma</s>s and metres are attained, what metre do the <s>Chandoma</s>s have?' One should say, 'These <s>Akṣarapaṅkti</s>s are that metre.'

children.text: upoṣu jātam apturam iti gāyatryas satyo jagatyo rūpeṇa tasmāt jagatīnāṃ loke kriyante ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Gāyatrī</s>s beginning 'Up here the swift one has been born' are truly <s>Jagatī</s>s in form; therefore they are performed in the place of the <s>Jagatī</s>s.

children.text: gāyatraṃ bhavati yad eva gāyatrasya brāhmaṇam ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Gāyatra</s> is used; whatever is the <s>brāhmaṇa</s> explanation of the <s>Gāyatra</s> applies.

children.text: āśvasūktaṃ bhavati ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Āśvasūkta</s> is used.

children.text: agniṃ vai pūrvair aharbhir ājuhoty athaitad ādityadaivatyam ahaḥ śukra āhuta ity asau vā ādityaḥ śukras tam evaitenājuhoti ||
children.translated_text: With the preceding days he offers to <s>Agni</s>; but this day has <s>Āditya</s> as its deity. In 'the bright one has been offered,' that bright one is yonder <s>Āditya</s>; with this he offers to him himself.

children.text: śāmmadaṃ bhavati ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Śāmmada</s> is used.

children.text: śammad vā etenāṅgiraso 'ñjasā svargaṃ lokam apaśyat svargasya lokasyānukhyātyai svargāl lokān na cyavate tuṣṭuvānaḥ ||
children.translated_text: With this <s>Śammad Āṅgirasa</s> directly saw the heavenly world. It is for the seeing of the heavenly world; one who praises with it does not fall from the heavenly world.

children.text: āśiṣam evāsmā etenāśāste sāma hi satyāśīḥ ||
children.translated_text: With this he invokes precisely a blessing for him; for a <s>sāman</s> is a true blessing.

children.text: dāvasur vā etad āṅgirasaḥ paśukāmaḥ sāmāpaśyat tena sahasraṃ paśūn asṛjat yad etat sāma bhavati paśūnāṃ puṣṭyai ||
children.translated_text: <s>Dāvasu Āṅgirasa</s>, desiring cattle, saw this <s>sāman</s>; with it he produced a thousand cattle. When this <s>sāman</s> is used, it is for the thriving of cattle.

children.text: pratīcīneḍaṃ kāśītaṃ bhavati ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Kāśīta</s> with the inward-turned <s>iḍā</s> is used.

children.text: parācībhir vā anyābhir iḍābhī reto dadhad athaitat pratīcīneḍaṃ kāśītaṃ prajātyai tasmāt parāñco garbhāḥ sambhavanti pratyañcaḥ prajāyante tasmād ute 'vācīnabilebhyo nāvapadyanta etena hy eva te dhṛtāḥ ||
children.translated_text: With other <s>iḍā</s>s that are turned outward he places seed; but this <s>Kāśīta</s> has the <s>iḍā</s> turned inward, for procreation. Therefore embryos come into being turned away and are born turned back; therefore they do not even fall from downward-facing openings, for by this indeed they are held.

children.text: hāviṣkṛtaṃ bhavati pratiṣṭhāyai kṛtānuvāda eva saḥ ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Hāviṣkṛta</s> is used, for establishment; it is simply a restatement of what has been done.

children.text: sauparṇaṃ bhavati yad eva sauparṇasya brāhmaṇam ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Sauparṇa</s> is used; whatever is the <s>brāhmaṇa</s> explanation of the <s>Sauparṇa</s> applies.

children.text: vaiśvamanasaṃ bhavati ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Vaiśvamanasa</s> is used.

children.text: viśvamanasaṃ vā ṛṣim adhyāyam udvrajitaṃ rakṣo 'gṛhṇāt tam indro 'cāyad ṛṣiṃ vai rakṣo 'grahīd iti tam abhyavadad ṛṣe kas tvaiṣa iti sthāṇur iti brūhīti rakṣo 'bravīt sa sthāṇur ity abravīt tasmai vā etena praharety asmā iṣīkāṃ vajraṃ prayacchann abravīt tenāsya sīmānam abhinat saiṣendreṇateṣīkā pāpmā vāva sa tam agṛhṇāt taṃ vaiśvamanasenāpāhatāpapāpmānaṃ hate vaiśvamanasena tuṣṭuvānaḥ ||
children.translated_text: A <s>rakṣas</s> seized the seer <s>Viśvamanas</s> when he had gone out for recitation. <s>Indra</s> perceived him, thinking, 'A <s>rakṣas</s> has seized the seer.' He addressed him, 'Seer, who is this of yours?' The <s>rakṣas</s> said, 'Say, It is a stump.' He said, 'It is a stump.' Then <s>Indra</s>, giving him a reed as a <s>vajra</s> (thunderbolt), said, 'Strike him with this.' With it he split its crown. This is that reed of <s>Indra</s>'s. Evil indeed had seized him; with the <s>Vaiśvamanasa</s> he struck that evil away. One who praises with the <s>Vaiśvamanasa</s> strikes away evil.

children.text: gaurīvitaṃ bhavati yad eva gaurīvitasya brāhmaṇam ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Gaurīvita</s> is used; whatever is the <s>brāhmaṇa</s> explanation of the <s>Gaurīvita</s> applies.

children.text: nihavo bhavaty annādyasyāvaruddhyai ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Nihava</s> is used, for securing food and the eating of food.

children.text: hīti vā annaṃ pradīyata ītyāgrir annam atti ||
children.translated_text: For with the syllable 'hī' food is presented, and with 'ī' <s>Agni</s> eats food.

children.text: ṛṣayo vā indraṃ pratyakṣaṃ nāpaśyan sa vasiṣṭho 'kāmayata katham indraṃ pratyakṣaṃ paśyeyam iti sa etan nihavam apaśyat tato vai sa indraṃ pratyakṣam apaśyat sa enam abravīd brāhmaṇaṃ te vakṣyāmi yathā tvatpurohitā bharatāḥ prajaniṣyante 'tha mānyebhya ṛṣibhyo mā pravoca iti tasmā etān stomabhāgān abravīt tato vai vasiṣṭhapurohitā bharatāḥ prājāyanta sendraṃ vā etat sāma yad etat sāma bhavati sendratvāya ||
children.translated_text: The seers did not see <s>Indra</s> face to face. Then <s>Vasiṣṭha</s> desired, 'How might I see <s>Indra</s> face to face?' He saw this <s>Nihava</s>; then indeed he saw <s>Indra</s> face to face. He said to him, 'I will tell you a <s>brāhmaṇa</s> by which the <s>Bharata</s>s will be born with you as their household priest; but do not proclaim me to the other seers.' To him he told these <s>Stomabhāga</s>s. Then indeed the <s>Bharata</s>s were born with <s>Vasiṣṭha</s> as their household priest. This <s>sāman</s> is accompanied by <s>Indra</s>; when this <s>sāman</s> is used, it is for being accompanied by <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: yad vāhiṣṭhīyaṃ bhavati ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Vāhiṣṭhīya</s> is used.

children.text: brahmayaśasaṃ vā etāni sāmāny ṛcā śrotrīyāṇi brahmāyaśasī bhavati yad vāhiṣṭhīyena tuṣṭuvānaḥ ||
children.translated_text: These <s>sāman</s>s are indeed endowed with the glory of sacred knowledge and are learned through the <s>ṛc</s>; one who praises with the <s>Vāhiṣṭhīya</s> becomes endowed with the glory of sacred knowledge.

children.text: āsitaṃ bhavati yad evāsitasya brāhmaṇam ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Āsita</s> is used; whatever is the <s>brāhmaṇa</s> explanation of the <s>Āsita</s> applies.

children.text: sādhraṃ bhavati siddhyai ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Sādhra</s> is used, for accomplishment.

children.text: ākūpāraṃ bhavati ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Ākūpāra</s> is used.

children.text: akūpāro vā etena kaśyapo jemānaṃ mahimānam agacchajjemānaṃ mahimānaṃ gacchaty ākūpāreṇa tuṣṭuvānaḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Akūpāra Kāśyapa</s> attained conquering greatness by means of this. One who praises with the <s>Ākūpāra</s> attains conquering greatness.

children.text: vidharma bhavati dharmasya vidhṛtyai ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Vidharma</s> is used, for the support of <s>dharma</s> (ritual order).

children.text: brahmavādino vadanti yat ṣaḍahe stomāś chandāṃsyāpyante kiṃ chandasaśchandomā iti puruṣacchandasa iti brūyāt puruṣo vai pāṅktaḥ puruṣo dvipadā chandomānām ayātayāmatāyai ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Brahmavādin</s>s say, 'Since in the six-day rite the <s>stoma</s>s are completed by the metres, what, in respect of metre, are the <s>Chandoma</s>s?' One should say, 'They have the person as their metre.' The person is indeed fivefold, and the person is represented by two-footed verses, for the unworn character of the <s>Chandoma</s>s.

children.text: śrudhyaṃ bhavati ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Śrudhya</s> is used.

children.text: paśavo vai śrudhyaṃ paśūnām avaruddhyai ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Śrudhya</s> is cattle; it is for securing cattle.

children.text: prajāpatiḥ paśūn asṛjata te 'smāt sṛṣṭā apākrāmaṃs tān etena sāmnā śrūdhiyā ehiyety anvahvayat ta enam upāvartanta yad etat sāma bhavati paśūnām upāvṛttyai ||
children.translated_text: <s>Prajāpati</s> created cattle. Once created, they went away from him. With this <s>sāman</s>, saying, 'Listen, come here,' he called after them. They turned back to him. When this <s>sāman</s> is used, it is for the return of cattle.

children.text: upainaṃ paśava āvartante ya evaṃ veda ||
children.translated_text: Cattle turn back to the one who knows thus.

children.text: gāyatrīṣu stuvanti pratiṣṭhāyai brahmavarcasāya yenaiva prāṇena prayanti tam abhyudyantīḍāntāḥ pavamānā bhavanti paśavo vā iḍā paśavaśchandomāḥ paśuṣveva tat paśūn dadhāti stomaḥ ||
children.translated_text: They praise on <s>Gāyatrī</s> verses, for stability and for <s>brahmavarcasa</s>. With the very breath by which they set forth, they rise up to it. The <s>Pavamāna</s> chants have <s>Iḍā</s> as their ending. <s>Iḍā</s> is cattle; the <s>Chandoma</s>s are cattle. Thus he places cattle among cattle. This is the <s>stoma</s>.

children.text: Chapter 20
āgneyīṣu pūrveṣām ahnām ukthāni praṇayantyathaitasyāhna āgneyyaindryāṃ praṇayantyubhayor eva rūpayoḥ pratitiṣṭhati ||
children.translated_text: They lead forth the <s>uktha</s>s of the previous days on verses to <s>Agni</s>; but for this day they lead them forth on a verse to <s>Agni</s> and <s>Indra</s>. Thus he becomes established in both forms.

children.text: aidhmavāhaṃ bhavati ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Aidhmavāha</s> is used.

children.text: āgneyyaindrīṣu stuvanti brahma caiva tat kṣatraṃ ca sayujīkaroti brahmaiva kṣatrasya purastān nidadhāti brāhmaṇe kṣatraṃ ca viśaṃ cānuge karoti ||
children.translated_text: They praise on verses to <s>Agni</s> and <s>Indra</s>. Thereby he brings <s>brahman</s> and <s>kṣatra</s> into union. He places <s>brahman</s> before <s>kṣatra</s>; he makes the <s>kṣatra</s> and the <s>viś</s> followers of the Brahmin.

children.text: traikakubhaṃ bhavati ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Traikakubha</s> is used.

children.text: ojasy eva tad vīrye pratitiṣṭhaty ojo vīryaṃ traikakubham ||
children.translated_text: Thereby he becomes established in force and heroic power; the <s>Traikakubha</s> is force and heroic power.

children.text: udvaṃśīyaṃ bhavati yad evodvaṃśīyasya brāhmaṇam ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Udvaṃśīya</s> is used; whatever is the <s>brāhmaṇa</s> explanation of the <s>Udvaṃśīya</s> applies.

children.text: aṣṭācatvāriṃśaṃ eva stomo bhavati pratiṣṭhāyai prajātyai ||
children.translated_text: The <s>stoma</s> is precisely the forty-eightfold one, for stability and for procreation.

children.text: Chapter 21
gāyatraṃ vai saptamam ahas traiṣṭubham aṣṭamaṃ jāgataṃ navamam athaitad ānuṣṭubham ahar yad daśamam ||
children.translated_text: The seventh day is <s>Gāyatra</s>; the eighth is <s>Traiṣṭubha</s>; the ninth is <s>Jāgata</s>; and this, the tenth, is the <s>Ānuṣṭubha</s> day.

children.text: tad āhur yad ānuṣṭubhaṃ stomyāṃ pratyakṣam upeyuḥ parāṃ parāvataṃ yajamāno gacchen na pratitiṣṭhed iti yā vai caturviṃśatir gāyatryas tā aṣṭādaśānuṣṭubho 'nuṣṭubham eva tat stomyāṃ parokṣam upayanti pratiṣṭhāyai pratitiṣṭhati ||
children.translated_text: They say, 'If they were to approach the <s>Ānuṣṭubha</s> directly in the <s>stomyā</s> recitation, the sacrificer would go to the farthest distance and would not become established.' The twenty-four <s>Gāyatrī</s>s are eighteen <s>Anuṣṭubh</s>s; thus they approach the <s>Anuṣṭubh</s> indirectly in the <s>stomyā</s>, for stability. He becomes established.

children.text: prajāpatiṃ vā etenāhnā pariveviṣati tatra vyavavadyaṃ yad vai śreṣṭhe pariviṣyamāṇo vadaty annādyasya so 'vagrahas tasmān na vyavavadyam annādyasyānavagrāhāya ||
children.translated_text: With this day one attends upon <s>Prajāpati</s>. There the interjected speech is questionable: whatever one says while a superior is being served is an interruption of food and the eating of food. Therefore there should be no interjected speech, so that food and the eating of food are not interrupted.

children.text: tad u vyavavadyaṃ yathā śreṣṭhāya baliṃ hriyamāṇaṃ panthānaṃ paryanuvedayati gatyai tathā tat ||
children.translated_text: But it is indeed to be interjected: just as, when tribute is being brought to a superior, one indicates the road along the way for movement, so it is here.

children.text: yāvaty anuṣṭup tāvatīṃ vācaṃ sampādya vibrūyus tad v anatiriktaṃ svasyo caiva yajñasyāriṣṭyai ||
children.translated_text: Having composed the speech to the measure of an <s>Anuṣṭubh</s>, they should speak it out. That is not excessive, and it is for the uninjured state of oneself and of the sacrifice.

children.text: abhi vā ete devān ārohantīty āhur ye daśabhir aharbhiḥ stuvata iti pañcānām ahnām anurūpaiḥ pratyavayanti yathābhyāruhya pratyavarohet tathā tan navarco bhavati yā evāmūḥ prayacchan yā avadadhāti tā etā udasyati ||
children.translated_text: They say, 'Those who praise with ten days ascend to the gods.' They descend again by means of the corresponding verses of five days; just as, after climbing up, one would climb down again, so it is. It is nine-versed. Those very verses which they extend and lay down there, these he lifts up.

children.text: vāruṇy eṣā bhavati yad vai yajñasya duriṣṭaṃ tad varuṇo gṛhṇāti tad eva tad avayajaty ādityaiṣā bhavatīyaṃ vā aditir asyām eva pratitiṣṭhati ||
children.translated_text: This one is a <s>Vāruṇī</s> verse. Whatever in the sacrifice is badly performed, <s>Varuṇa</s> seizes that; that very thing he thereby expiates by sacrifice. This one is an <s>Ādityā</s> verse. This earth is <s>Aditi</s>; in her he becomes established.

children.text: caturviṃśa eva stomo bhavati tejase brahmavarcasāya ||
children.translated_text: The <s>stoma</s> is precisely the twenty-fourfold one, for splendor and for <s>brahmavarcasa</s>.

children.text: Chapter 22
suṣamiddho na āvaha ity āpriya ājyāni bhavanti ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Āprī Ājya</s> verses begin, 'Well-kindled, bring them to us.'

children.text: prajāpatiḥ prajā asṛjata sa dugdho riricānāmanyata sa etāny āpriya ājyāny apaśyat tair ātmānam āprīṇāt dugdha iva vā eṣa riricāno yo daśabhir aharbhis tuṣṭuvāno yad etāny āpriya ājyāni bhavanty ātmānam evaitair āprīṇāti ||
children.translated_text: <s>Prajāpati</s> created creatures. He thought himself milked out and emptied. He saw these <s>Āprī Ājya</s> verses. With them he satisfied himself. One who praises with ten days is as though milked out and emptied. When these <s>Āprī Ājya</s> verses are used, he satisfies himself with them.

children.text: yad adya sūra udita iti sūravan maitrāvaruṇam ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Maitrāvaruṇa</s> verse is in the <s>Sūravat</s> form, beginning, 'Since today, O <s>Sūra</s>, risen.'

children.text: anto vai sūro 'nta etad daśamam ahnām anta eva tadantena stuvate pratiṣṭhāyai ||
children.translated_text: <s>Sūra</s> is the end; this tenth day is the end of the days. Thus at the end they praise with the end, for stability.

children.text: ut tvā madantu somā ity udvad aindram utthānasya rūpam ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Udvad Aindra</s> is on the verse, "May the <s>Soma</s>s gladden you upward"; it is the form of rising.

children.text: indrāgnī āgataṃ sutam iti yenaiva rūpeṇa prayanti tad abhyudyanti stomaḥ ||
children.translated_text: On the verse, "<s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, come to the pressed offering": by the very form with which they set forth, by that they rise up. It is the <s>stoma</s>.

children.text: Chapter 23
uccā te jātam andhasa ity udvatyo gāyatryo bhavanty utthānasya rūpam ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Gāyatrī</s> verses beginning, "High for you the draught was born," are <s>udvatī</s> verses; they are the form of rising.

children.text: punānas soma dhāraya iti panthānam eva tat paryavayanti ||
children.translated_text: With the verse, "Purifying yourself, O <s>Soma</s>, with a stream," they complete that very path.

children.text: ā jāgṛvir vipra ṛtaṃ matīnām iti yad āpte pravatīḥ kuryur atipadyer anyad āvatyo bhavanty anatipādāya ||
children.translated_text: With the verse, "The wakeful inspired one has come to the truth of thoughts": if, at the point of attainment, they were to use <s>pravatī</s> verses, they would pass beyond it; instead they are <s>āvatī</s> verses, so that there may be no overpassing.

children.text: gāyatraṃ bhavati yad eva gāyatrasya brāhmaṇam ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Gāyatra</s> is used; whatever is the <s>brāhmaṇa</s> explanation of the <s>Gāyatra</s> applies.

children.text: āmahīyavaṃ bhavati kﾱptiś cānnādyaṃ ca kﾱptiṃ caivaitenānnādyaṃ cābhyuttiṣṭhanti ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Āmahīyava</s> is used. It is <s>kḷpti</s> (ordered accomplishment) and food-eating; with it they rise up to ordered accomplishment and to food-eating.

children.text: ājigaṃ bhavaty ājijityāyai ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Ājiga</s> is used, for victory in the contest.

children.text: ājir vā eṣa pratato yat dvādaśāhas tasyaitad ujjityai ||
children.translated_text: For this <s>Dvādaśāha</s> is a contest stretched out; this is for winning it.

children.text: ābhīkaṃ bhavaty abhikrāntyai ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Ābhīka</s> is used, for advance.

children.text: āṅgirasas tapas tepānāḥ śucam aśocaṃs ta etat sāmāpaśyaṃs tān abhīke 'bhyavarṣat tena śucam aśamayanta yad abhīke 'bhyavarṣat tasmād ābhīkaṃ yām eva pūrvair aharbhiḥ śucaṃ śocanti tām etenānna śamayitvottiṣṭhanti ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Āṅgirasa</s>s, practicing austerity, suffered burning distress. They saw this <s>sāman</s>; it rained upon them in the <s>Ābhīka</s>, and with it they appeased their distress. Because it rained upon them in the <s>Ābhīka</s>, therefore it is called <s>Ābhīka</s>. Whatever distress they suffer through the preceding days, having appeased that with this, they rise up.

children.text: utsedho bhavati ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Utsedha</s> is used.

children.text: utsedhena vai devāḥ paśūn udasedhan niṣedhena paryagṛhṇan ||
children.translated_text: With the <s>Utsedha</s> the gods drove the cattle upward; with the <s>Niṣedha</s> they enclosed them.

children.text: antarotsedhaniṣedhau yajñāyajñīyam ||
children.translated_text: Between the <s>Utsedha</s> and the <s>Niṣedha</s> stands the <s>Yajñāyajñīya</s>.

children.text: paśavo 'nnādyaṃ yajñāyajñīyaṃ paśūn eva tad annādyam utsedhaniṣedhābhyāṃ parigṛhṇāti ||
children.translated_text: Cattle are food for eating; the <s>Yajñāyajñīya</s> is food for eating. Thus he encloses cattle as food with the <s>Utsedha</s> and the <s>Niṣedha</s>.

children.text: mādhyandine vai pavamāne devā yajñāyajñīyena yajñaṃ saṃsthāpya svargaṃ lokam ārohaṃs tad ya evaṃ veda mādhyandina evaitat pavamāne yajñāyajñīyena yajñaṃ saṃsthāpya svargaṃ lokam ārohati ||
children.translated_text: At the midday <s>Pavamāna</s>, the gods, having established the sacrifice with the <s>Yajñāyajñīya</s>, ascended to the heavenly world. Therefore one who knows thus, at the midday <s>Pavamāna</s>, having established the sacrifice with the <s>Yajñāyajñīya</s>, ascends to the heavenly world.

children.text: atho parokṣam anuṣṭubhaṃ sampadyate 'har eṣā vai pratyakṣam anuṣṭup yad yajñāyajñīyaṃ tad yat tṛtīyasavane kuryuḥ pratyakṣam anuṣṭubham ṛccheyus tasmān mādhyandine kurvanti tena parokṣam anuṣṭubham upayanti ||
children.translated_text: Moreover, the day comes to possess the <s>Anuṣṭubh</s> indirectly. This, namely the <s>Yajñāyajñīya</s>, is the direct <s>Anuṣṭubh</s>. If they were to perform it at the third pressing, they would meet the direct <s>Anuṣṭubh</s>; therefore they perform it at midday, and thereby they approach the <s>Anuṣṭubh</s> indirectly.

children.text: gaurīvitaṃ bhavati ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Gaurīvita</s> is used.

children.text: etad vai yajñasya śvastanaṃ yad gaurīvitam etad āyatano yajamāno yan madhyandino yad gaurīvitaṃ madhyandine bhavati śvastanam eva tad yajamāna ātman dhatte stomaḥ ||
children.translated_text: This, namely the <s>Gaurīvita</s>, is the morrow of the sacrifice. This is the sacrificer's support, namely what belongs to midday. Since the <s>Gaurīvita</s> is used at midday, the sacrificer places the morrow in himself. It is the <s>stoma</s>.

children.text: Chapter 24
kayā naś citra ābhuvad iti kavatyas tena prājāpatyāḥ ko hi prajāpatiḥ prajāpater āptyai ||
children.translated_text: The verses beginning, "By what has he become wondrous for us?" contain the word <s>ka</s>; thereby they belong to <s>Prajāpati</s>, for <s>ka</s> is <s>Prajāpati</s>. This is for the attainment of <s>Prajāpati</s>.

children.text: mā cid anyad viśaṃsata ityutthānam eva tad āśiṣo hy etarhi ||
children.translated_text: With the verse, "Do not proclaim anything else," that is simply rising, for at this point these are blessings.

children.text: ud u tye madhumattamā ity udvatya udayanīye 'hany etad āśiṣo hy evaitarhi ||
children.translated_text: The verses beginning, "Up those sweetest ones," are upward verses on the <s>Udayanīya</s> day; for at this point these too are blessings.

children.text: tarobhir vo vidadvasum iti stomo vai taro yajño vidadvasuḥ stomena vai yajño yujyate yat tarobhir vo vidadvasum ity āha yajñam eva tad yunakti ||
children.translated_text: With the verse, "With powers, for you, the bestower of wealth": the <s>stoma</s> is power, and the sacrifice is the bestower of wealth. By the <s>stoma</s> the sacrifice is yoked; when he says, "With powers, for you, the bestower of wealth," he thereby yokes the sacrifice itself.

children.text: vāmadevyasyarkṣu rathantaraṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ bhavati ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Rathantara</s> is the <s>pṛṣṭha</s> among the verses of the <s>Vāmadevya</s>.

children.text: gāyatrī vai rathantarasya yoniḥ svāyām eva tad yonau rathantaraṃ pratiṣṭhāpayati ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Gāyatrī</s> is the womb of the <s>Rathantara</s>; he thereby establishes the <s>Rathantara</s> in its own womb.

children.text: tejo vai gāyatrī chandasā tejo rathantaraṃ sāmnā tejaś caturviṃśastomānāṃ teja eva tat samyak saṃdadhāty api ha putrasya putras tejasvī bhavati ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Gāyatrī</s> is brilliance as a metre; the <s>Rathantara</s> is brilliance as a <s>sāman</s>; brilliance belongs to the twenty-fourfold <s>stoma</s>s. Thus he properly joins brilliance with brilliance. Indeed even his son's son becomes brilliant.

children.text: aṣṭākṣareṇa prathamāyā ṛcaḥ prastauty aṣṭāśaphāṃstatpaśūn avarundhe ||
children.translated_text: He makes the <s>prastāva</s> with eight syllables of the first verse; thereby he secures cattle, for they are eight-hoofed.

children.text: dyvakṣareṇottarayor ṛcoḥ prastauti dvipād yajamāno yajamānam eva yajñe paśuṣu pratiṣṭhāpayati ||
children.translated_text: He makes the <s>prastāva</s> with two syllables of the two following verses. The sacrificer is two-footed; he establishes the sacrificer himself in the sacrifice among the cattle.

children.text: gāyatraṃ vai rathantaraṃ gāyatracchando yad gāyatrīṣu rathantaram bhavati tena svāyāṃ janatāyām ṛdhnotīme vai lokā gāyatrī yad gāyatrīṣu rathantaraṃ bhavatīmān eva tal lokān samāpyottiṣṭhanti ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Rathantara</s> is <s>Gāyatra</s>, with the <s>Gāyatrī</s> as its metre. When the <s>Rathantara</s> is used among <s>Gāyatrī</s> verses, by that he prospers among his own people. These worlds are indeed the <s>Gāyatrī</s>s; when the <s>Rathantara</s> is used among <s>Gāyatrī</s> verses, they rise up having attained these very worlds.

children.text: maidhātithaṃ bhavati ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Maidhātitha</s> is used.

children.text: etena vai medhātithiḥ kāṇvo vibhindukād vyūdhnīr gā udasṛjata paśūnām avarudhyai maidhātithaṃ kriyate ||
children.translated_text: With this <s>Medhātithi Kāṇva</s> released the <s>vyūdhnī</s> cows from <s>Vibhinduka</s>; the <s>Maidhātitha</s> is performed for the securing of cattle.

children.text: abhīvarto brahmasāma bhavaty ekākṣaranidhanaḥ pratiṣṭhāyai ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Abhīvarta</s> is the <s>brahmasāman</s>; it has a one-syllable <s>nidhana</s>, for stability.

children.text: ekākṣarā vai vāg vācyeva pratiṣṭhāyottiṣṭhanti ||
children.translated_text: Speech is one-syllabled; having taken their stand in speech itself, they rise up.

children.text: kāleyam acchāvākasāma bhavati ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Kāleya</s> is the <s>Acchāvāka</s>'s <s>sāman</s>.

children.text: samānaloke vai kāleyaṃ ca rathantaraṃ ceyaṃ vai rathantaraṃ paśavaḥ kāleyam asyāṃ caiva paśuṣu ca pratiṣṭhāyottiṣṭhanti stomaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Kāleya</s> and the <s>Rathantara</s> are in the same world. This earth is the <s>Rathantara</s>; cattle are the <s>Kāleya</s>. Having taken their stand in this earth and in cattle, they rise up. It is the <s>stoma</s>.
